using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using System.Threading;using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Caches;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Fetches, caches, and merges online mod catalogs from the URLs configured in <see cref="ModConfig.CatalogUrls"/>. Multiple catalogs are merged via deduplication by mod ID — the entry with the highest <see cref="CatalogExportEntry.Version"/> wins. Two-tier caching: an on-disk JSON cache at <c>user://catalog_cache.json</c> avoids network round-trips on every open of the Network tab; the cache is loaded eagerly on first access and refreshed when the user presses the Refresh button or when <see cref="ModConfig.CatalogUrls"/> changes. <see cref="OnRefreshed"/> / <see cref="OnRefreshFailed"/> fire on the main thread after an async fetch completes so that UI subscribers can safely rebuild their node trees. </summary>
public static class CatalogService{private static readonly System.Net.Http.HttpClient _httpClient=new(){Timeout=TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30),DefaultRequestHeaders={{"User-Agent","Cthangover/1.0"}},};private static List<CatalogExportEntry>_cachedEntries;private static List<ModCollection>_cachedCollections;private static bool _isFetching;private static DateTime _lastFetchTime=DateTime.MinValue;private static readonly TimeSpan FetchCooldown=TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5);/// <summary>The current merged catalog data, or null until first load.</summary>
public static List<CatalogExportEntry>CachedEntries=>_cachedEntries;/// <summary> The current merged collection list from every catalog, or null until first load. Consumed by <see cref="ModCollectionStore.LoadAll"/>. </summary>
public static List<ModCollection>CachedCollections=>_cachedCollections;/// <summary>True while an async refresh is in flight.</summary>
public static bool IsFetching=>_isFetching;/// <summary>Fired on the main thread after a successful refresh.</summary>
public static event Action OnRefreshed;/// <summary>Fired on the main thread with an error message when refresh fails.</summary>
public static event Action<string>OnRefreshFailed;/// <summary> Loads cached catalog data from disk if available. Safe to call multiple times — subsequent calls are no-ops. </summary>
public static void LoadCache(){if(_cachedEntries!=null)return;var path=GetCachePath();if(File.Exists(path)){try{var json=File.ReadAllText(path);if(TryLoadEnvelope(json)){GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Loaded catalog cache: {_cachedEntries?.Count ?? 0} mod(s), {_cachedCollections?.Count ?? 0} collection(s)");return;}_cachedEntries=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<CatalogExportEntry>>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Loaded legacy catalog cache: {_cachedEntries?.Count ?? 0} entr(y/ies)");}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Failed to load catalog cache: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Warning);}}}/// <summary> Reads the two-list cache envelope. Returns false for the legacy array-only format (a bare JSON array), which the caller then parses as a plain mod list. </summary>
private static bool TryLoadEnvelope(string json){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(json))return false;var trimmed=json.TrimStart();if(trimmed[0]!='{')return false;var root=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CatalogCacheRoot>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(root==null)return false;_cachedEntries=root.Mods??new List<CatalogExportEntry>();_cachedCollections=root.Collections??new List<ModCollection>();return true;}/// <summary> Fetches all configured catalog URLs, merges the results, and fires <see cref="OnRefreshed"/> on the main thread. Clears the on-disk cache if <paramref name="forceRefresh"/> is true before fetching. Cancelling <paramref name="cancellationToken"/> aborts the in-flight HTTP requests and suppresses the completion events, so a caller whose window is closing is never called back. The <see cref="IsFetching"/> flag is always cleared — on success, cancellation, and unexpected exceptions alike — otherwise a single failed merge would permanently block every later refresh. </summary>
public static async Task RefreshAsync(bool forceRefresh=false,CancellationToken cancellationToken=default){if(_isFetching)return;var sinceLast=DateTime.UtcNow-_lastFetchTime;if(!forceRefresh&&sinceLast<FetchCooldown){var remain=(FetchCooldown-sinceLast).TotalSeconds;GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Skipping refresh (cooldown, last attempt was {sinceLast.TotalSeconds:F1}s ago, {remain:F1}s remaining)");return;}_isFetching=true;_lastFetchTime=DateTime.UtcNow;try{cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(forceRefresh){ClearCache();ModIconCache.Clear();}var allEntries=new List<CatalogExportEntry>();var allCollections=new List<ModCollection>();var errors=new List<string>();var urls=ModConfig.Instance.CatalogUrls;if(urls==null||urls.Count==0){_cachedEntries=new List<CatalogExportEntry>();_cachedCollections=new List<ModCollection>();OnRefreshed?.Invoke();return;}GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Starting catalog refresh from {urls.Count} URL(s)...");foreach(var url in urls){cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url))continue;try{GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Fetching catalog from '{url}'...");var json=await _httpClient.GetStringAsync(url,cancellationToken);var catalog=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CatalogRoot>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(catalog?.Mods!=null){foreach(var mod in catalog.Mods)CatalogMerger.TagSource(mod,url);allEntries.AddRange(catalog.Mods);GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Fetched {catalog.Mods.Count} entr(y/ies) from '{url}'");}if(catalog?.Collections!=null){foreach(var collection in catalog.Collections)CatalogCollectionMerger.TagSource(collection,url);allCollections.AddRange(catalog.Collections);GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Fetched {catalog.Collections.Count} collection(s) from '{url}'");}}catch(OperationCanceledException)when(cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested){throw;}catch(Exception ex){var msg=$"Failed to fetch catalog from '{url}': {ex.Message}";GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",msg,LogLevel.Error);errors.Add(msg);}}if(allEntries.Count>0||allCollections.Count>0){_cachedEntries=CatalogMerger.MergeAndDeduplicate(allEntries);_cachedCollections=CatalogCollectionMerger.MergeAndDeduplicate(allCollections);SaveCache(_cachedEntries,_cachedCollections);GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Catalog refresh complete: {_cachedEntries.Count} total mod(s), {_cachedCollections.Count} collection(s) merged");OnRefreshed?.Invoke();}else if(_cachedEntries==null&&errors.Count>0){GameLogger.Log("CATALOG","Catalog refresh failed: all URLs returned errors",LogLevel.Error);OnRefreshFailed?.Invoke(string.Join("\n",errors));}else{GameLogger.Log("CATALOG","Catalog refresh complete: no new entries");OnRefreshed?.Invoke();}}finally{_isFetching=false;}}/// <summary> Deletes the on-disk cache and clears in-memory state. The next call to <see cref="RefreshAsync"/> will fetch everything from scratch. </summary>
public static void ClearCache(){_cachedEntries=null;_cachedCollections=null;var path=GetCachePath();if(File.Exists(path))File.Delete(path);}/// <summary> Compares a locally-installed mod against its catalog entry. </summary> <param name="localVersion">Installed mod version string.</param> <param name="localInstallSha256">SHA256 of the installed mod's content, computed by <see cref="ModHasher.ComputeInstallSha256"/>.</param> <param name="remoteEntry">Corresponding catalog entry.</param> <returns>The relationship between the local copy and the remote version.</returns>
public static RemoteModStatus GetRemoteModStatus(string localVersion,string localInstallSha256,CatalogExportEntry remoteEntry){if(localVersion==null)return RemoteModStatus.NotInstalled;var download=FindDownloadForVersion(remoteEntry,localVersion);var remoteVersion=remoteEntry.Version;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(remoteVersion)&&VersionHelper.IsGreaterThan(remoteVersion,localVersion))return RemoteModStatus.UpdateAvailable;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(localInstallSha256)&&download!=null&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(download.InstallSha256)&& !string.Equals(localInstallSha256,download.InstallSha256,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return RemoteModStatus.ModifiedLocally;return RemoteModStatus.Installed;}private static CatalogEntryDownload FindDownloadForVersion(CatalogExportEntry entry,string version){if(entry?.Downloads==null)return null;foreach(var d in entry.Downloads){if(string.Equals(d.Version,version,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return d;}return null;}private static void SaveCache(List<CatalogExportEntry>entries,List<ModCollection>collections){try{var path=GetCachePath();var root=new CatalogCacheRoot{Mods=entries,Collections=collections};var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(root,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteIndentedOptions);File.WriteAllText(path,json);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Failed to save catalog cache: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Warning);}}private static string GetCachePath(){if(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath("user://catalog_cache.json");return"catalog_cache.json";}}/// <summary> Relationship between a locally-installed mod and its remote catalog counterpart. </summary>
public enum RemoteModStatus{/// <summary>The mod is installed and up-to-date with the catalog.</summary>
Installed,/// <summary>A newer version is available in the catalog.</summary>
UpdateAvailable,/// <summary>The mod is not installed locally.</summary>
NotInstalled,/// <summary>Same version, but the local content differs from the catalog's <c>install_sha256</c> — the player has edited the mod locally and overwriting would lose their changes.</summary>
ModifiedLocally,}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods;/// <summary> Catalog category — or a combination of categories — used to group mods in the online catalog and in the mod manifests. Declared as a bit-flag enum so one mod can belong to several categories at once (e.g. a battle engine is both <c>Library</c> and <c>Gameplay</c>). JSON serialisation via <c>JsonStringEnumConverter</c> keeps single categories as plain names (<c>"gameplay"</c>, fully backward compatible with catalogs written before combinations existed) and writes combinations as a comma-separated list (<c>"library, gameplay"</c>). Parsing is case-insensitive. </summary>
[System.Flags]public enum CategoryType{Story=1<<0,Characters=1<<1,Gameplay=1<<2,Visual=1<<3,Audio=1<<4,UI=1<<5,Locale=1<<6,Library=1<<7,Engine=1<<8,Overhaul=1<<9,Tools=1<<10,Editor=1<<11,Debug=1<<12,Other=1<<13,}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Pure merge rules for collections published by several online catalogs, the collection counterpart of <see cref="CatalogMerger"/>. Collections carry no content hashes, so the rules are simpler: entries with the same id collapse into the one with the highest version, and every catalog that published the id is recorded in <see cref="ModCollection.SourceUrls"/> so the UI can show provenance (and future per-source variants). </summary>
public static class CatalogCollectionMerger{/// <summary> Tags a freshly fetched collection with the catalog URL it came from, preserving URLs already present. </summary>
public static void TagSource(ModCollection collection,string url){if(collection==null||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url))return;collection.SourceUrls??=new List<string>();if(!collection.SourceUrls.Contains(url))collection.SourceUrls.Add(url);}/// <summary> Merges raw catalog collections into the deduplicated list consumed by <see cref="CatalogService.CachedCollections"/>. Returns a new list; the winning collection objects are mutated in place with the merged sources. </summary>
public static List<ModCollection>MergeAndDeduplicate(List<ModCollection>collections){var result=new List<ModCollection>();if(collections==null)return result;var byId=new Dictionary<string,ModCollection>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var collection in collections){if(collection==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(collection.Id))continue;if(!byId.TryGetValue(collection.Id,out var existing)){byId[collection.Id]=collection;result.Add(collection);continue;}if(VersionHelper.Compare(collection.Version??"0.0.0",existing.Version??"0.0.0")>0){MergeSources(collection,existing);var index=result.IndexOf(existing);if(index>=0)result[index]=collection;byId[collection.Id]=collection;}else{MergeSources(existing,collection);}}return result;}private static void MergeSources(ModCollection target,ModCollection other){if(other.SourceUrls==null)return;target.SourceUrls??=new List<string>();foreach(var url in other.SourceUrls){if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url)&& !target.SourceUrls.Contains(url))target.SourceUrls.Add(url);}}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> A curated set of mods that together implement a game mechanic ("card novel", "developer tools") — the game-construction unit the mod catalog is organized by. Unlike <see cref="CategoryType"/>, which labels a single mod, a collection describes a composition: the same mod can be a required backbone in one collection and an optional layer in another. <para/> Collections are authored as JSON files shipped inside mod folders (<c>collections/*.json</c>), fetched from online catalogs, or created by the player (<c>user://collections.json</c>) — see <see cref="ModCollectionStore"/>. The dependency graph shown to the player is not stored here: it is derived from the mods' own <c>depends</c> by <see cref="ModCollectionResolver"/>, with <see cref="Mechanics"/> only telling the graph view how to group the nodes. </summary>
public class ModCollection{/// <summary>Canonical collection id, unique across all sources.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("id")]public string Id{get;set;}/// <summary>Human-readable collection name.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("name")]public string Name{get;set;}/// <summary>Author credit string.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("author")]public string Author{get;set;}/// <summary>Short description of the gameplay or toolset the collection assembles.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("description")]public string Description{get;set;}/// <summary>Semver version, used to pick the newest of identically-named catalog collections.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("version")]public string Version{get;set;}/// <summary>Optional preview icon URL, resolved through the mod icon cache.</summary>

using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Resolved, render-ready form of a <see cref="ModCollection"/>: the mods it needs (including transitive dependencies), the dependency edges between them, and each mod's availability state. public List<ModCollectionMechanic>Mechanics{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>All mod vertices: mechanic members first, then external dependencies in discovery order.</summary>
public List<ModCollectionNode>Nodes{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Dependency edges; <c>From</c> is the dependency of <c>To</c>.</summary>
public List<ModCollectionEdge>Edges{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Number of nodes already installed and enabled with a satisfying version.</summary>

===== FILE Core/Mods/Collections/ModCollectionPlan.cs =====
using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Action plan that turns a resolved <see cref="ModCollectionGraph"/> into concrete steps for the collections screen: which mods to download, which disabled mods to re-enable, and what blocks a full apply. The split keeps the decision logic testable — actual file writes and downloads stay in <c>ModDownloader</c> / <c>DisabledModsStore</c> / the UI. <para/> Enable list contains mods that are already on disk but disabled; mods in <see cref="Installed"/> state are left untouched. <see cref="Missing"/> and <see cref="Mismatches"/> are informational: the UI shows them as warnings and blocks applying while something is missing, because enabling a mod whose dependency cannot be loaded would only make the registry drop it at next boot. </summary>
public class ModCollectionPlan{/// <summary>Mods to download and install, in graph order (foundations first).</summary>
public List<ModCollectionInstallItem>Install{get;}=new();/// <summary>Ids of installed but disabled mods to remove from <c>disabled_mods.json</c>.</summary>
public List<string>Enable{get;}=new();/// <summary>Ids that are neither installed nor available in any catalog.</summary>
public List<string>Missing{get;}=new();/// <summary>Ids whose installed version does not satisfy the collection's pin, or that have no satisfying download.</summary>
public List<string>Mismatches{get;}=new();/// <summary>True when applying the collection would not change anything.</summary>
public bool IsEmpty=>Install.Count==0&&Enable.Count==0;/// <summary>True when the collection cannot be assembled completely.</summary>
public bool HasProblems=>Missing.Count>0||Mismatches.Count>0;/// <summary> Builds the plan for a resolved graph using the same merged catalog the downloader will read. Pass the catalog list the graph was resolved with so node states and chosen downloads stay consistent. </summary>
public static ModCollectionPlan Build(ModCollectionGraph graph,IReadOnlyList<CatalogExportEntry>catalogEntries){var plan=new ModCollectionPlan();if(graph==null)return plan;var catalogById=IndexCatalog(catalogEntries);foreach(var node in graph.Nodes){switch(node.State){case ModCollectionNodeState.InCatalog:AddInstall(plan,node,catalogById);break;case ModCollectionNodeState.Disabled:plan.Enable.Add(node.ModId);break;case ModCollectionNodeState.Missing:plan.Missing.Add(node.ModId);break;case ModCollectionNodeState.VersionMismatch:plan.Mismatches.Add(node.ModId);break;}}return plan;}private static void AddInstall(ModCollectionPlan plan,ModCollectionNode node,Dictionary<string,CatalogExportEntry>catalogById){if(!catalogById.TryGetValue(node.ModId,out var entry)){plan.Mismatches.Add(node.ModId);return;}var download=SelectDownload(entry,node.Dependency);if(download==null){plan.Mismatches.Add(node.ModId);return;}plan.Install.Add(new ModCollectionInstallItem{ModId=node.ModId,Version=download.Version,SourceUrl=FirstSource(entry),});}/// <summary> Picks the newest download that satisfies the collection's version pin. Downloads are ordered newest-first by <see cref="CatalogMerger"/>, so the first satisfying one is the best choice; without a pin the newest download is used as-is. </summary>
private static CatalogEntryDownload SelectDownload(CatalogExportEntry entry,ModDependency dependency){if(entry?.Downloads==null||entry.Downloads.Count==0)return null;if(!dependency.IsValid||string.IsNullOrEmpty(dependency.VersionRaw))return entry.Downloads[0];foreach(var download in entry.Downloads){if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(download.Version)&&dependency.IsSatisfiedBy(download.Version)){return download;}}return null;}private static string FirstSource(CatalogExportEntry entry){if(entry.SourceUrls==null)return null;foreach(var url in entry.SourceUrls){if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url))return url;}return null;}private static Dictionary<string,CatalogExportEntry>IndexCatalog(IReadOnlyList<CatalogExportEntry>catalogEntries){var index=new Dictionary<string,CatalogExportEntry>(System.StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);if(catalogEntries==null)return index;foreach(var entry in catalogEntries){if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry?.Id)&& !index.ContainsKey(entry.Id))index[entry.Id]=entry;}return index;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Builds a <see cref="ModCollectionGraph"/> for a collection by combining three live sources: the installed-mod registry, the disabled-mods store and the merged online catalog cache. The collection file itself only declares mechanics and mods — the dependency arrows come from the mods' own <c>depends</c>, so the graph always reflects reality even when a mod author changes dependencies without touching the collection. <para/> The resolver is pure and takes its sources as arguments, which keeps the graph testable without Godot and lets the screen pass the session-install overrides. Missing dependencies of collection mods are pulled into the graph as external nodes instead of being ignored, because they are exactly what makes a collection un-installable. </summary>
public static class ModCollectionResolver{/// <summary> Pure resolution entry point. <paramref name="sessionInstalled"/> lets the UI treat mods installed during the current session as present even though the registry only learns about them after a restart. </summary>
public static ModCollectionGraph Resolve(ModCollection collection,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IModInfo>localMods,IReadOnlyCollection<string>disabledIds,IReadOnlyList<CatalogExportEntry>catalogEntries,IReadOnlyCollection<string>sessionInstalled=null){var graph=new ModCollectionGraph();if(collection==null)return graph;var catalogById=IndexCatalog(catalogEntries);var nodes=new Dictionary<string,ModCollectionNode>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);var edges=new HashSet<(string From,string To)>();var mechanics=collection.Mechanics??new List<ModCollectionMechanic>();for(var i=0;i<mechanics.Count;i++){var mechanic=mechanics[i];if(mechanic==null)continue;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(mechanic.Id))mechanic.Id=$"mechanic_{i}";if(mechanic.Mods==null)continue;foreach(var raw in mechanic.Mods){var dependency=ModDependency.Parse(raw);var modId=dependency.IsValid?dependency.ModId:raw?.Trim();if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId))continue;if(nodes.TryGetValue(modId,out var existing)){// The same mod may be declared by several mechanics; the first one that names it owns the node.
if(existing.IsExternal){existing.MechanicId=mechanic.Id;existing.IsExternal=false;}continue;}var node=CreateNode(modId,mechanic.Id,dependency,false,localMods,disabledIds,sessionInstalled,catalogById);nodes[modId]=node;graph.Nodes.Add(node);}}graph.Mechanics.AddRange(mechanics.Where(m=>m!=null));AddDependencyClosure(graph,nodes,edges,localMods,disabledIds,sessionInstalled,catalogById);foreach(var(from,to)in edges)graph.Edges.Add(new ModCollectionEdge{FromModId=from,ToModId=to});return graph;}/// <summary> Walks the dependencies of every known node, adding edges and pulling unknown dependencies into the graph. The node list grows while it is being indexed, which naturally produces the transitive closure. </summary>
private static void AddDependencyClosure(ModCollectionGraph graph,Dictionary<string,ModCollectionNode>nodes,HashSet<(string From,string To)>edges,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IModInfo>localMods,IReadOnlyCollection<string>disabledIds,IReadOnlyCollection<string>sessionInstalled,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,CatalogExportEntry>catalogById){for(var i=0;i<graph.Nodes.Count;i++){var node=graph.Nodes[i];if(!localMods.TryGetValue(node.ModId,out var info)||info is not ModInfo modInfo)continue;var dependencies=modInfo.Manifest?.DependencyIds;if(dependencies==null)continue;foreach(var dependencyId in dependencies){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(dependencyId))continue;edges.Add((dependencyId,node.ModId));if(nodes.ContainsKey(dependencyId))continue;var external=CreateNode(dependencyId,null,default,true,localMods,disabledIds,sessionInstalled,catalogById);nodes[dependencyId]=external;graph.Nodes.Add(external);}}}private static ModCollectionNode CreateNode(string modId,string mechanicId,ModDependency dependency,bool external,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IModInfo>localMods,IReadOnlyCollection<string>disabledIds,IReadOnlyCollection<string>sessionInstalled,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,CatalogExportEntry>catalogById){var node=new ModCollectionNode{ModId=modId,Title=modId,MechanicId=mechanicId,IsExternal=external,Dependency=dependency,};if(localMods.TryGetValue(modId,out var info)){if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(info.Name))node.Title=info.Name;node.InstalledVersion=info.Version;if(disabledIds.Contains(modId)){node.State=ModCollectionNodeState.Disabled;}else if(dependency.IsValid&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dependency.VersionRaw)&& !dependency.IsSatisfiedBy(info.Version??"0.0.0.0")){node.State=ModCollectionNodeState.VersionMismatch;}else{node.State=ModCollectionNodeState.Installed;}return node;}if(sessionInstalled!=null&&sessionInstalled.Contains(modId)){node.State=ModCollectionNodeState.Installed;return node;}if(catalogById.TryGetValue(modId,out var entry)&&entry.Downloads!=null&&entry.Downloads.Count>0){node.State=ModCollectionNodeState.InCatalog;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry.Name))node.Title=entry.Name;return node;}node.State=ModCollectionNodeState.Missing;return node;}private static Dictionary<string,CatalogExportEntry>IndexCatalog(IReadOnlyList<CatalogExportEntry>catalogEntries){var index=new Dictionary<string,CatalogExportEntry>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);if(catalogEntries==null)return index;foreach(var entry in catalogEntries){if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry?.Id)&& !index.ContainsKey(entry.Id))index[entry.Id]=entry;}return index;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Loads and persists <see cref="ModCollection"/> definitions from the three distribution channels: <list type="bullet"> <item>mod folders — any mod may ship <c>collections/*.json</c>, read through <see cref="IModFileProvider"/> so zip mods work too;</item> <item>online catalogs — cached by <see cref="CatalogService"/>;</item> <item>the player — <c>user://collections.json</c>, the seed of the future in-game constructor.</item> </list> <see cref="LoadAll"/> merges the channels by id with explicit precedence: user &gt; built-in &gt; catalog. That lets a shipping mod override an outdated online collection without asking the catalog owner, and lets the player edit any collection locally. </summary>
public static class ModCollectionStore{private const string UserFilePath="user://collections.json";/// <summary>Conventional mod-relative directory scanned for bundled collections.</summary>
private const string ProviderDirectory="collections";private static string _resolvedPath;/// <summary> Resolves the user storage path once on the main thread before the background mod-load phase, mirroring <see cref="DisabledModsStore"/> — <c>ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath</c> is Godot API and is not available from worker threads. </summary>
public static void WarmUp(){_resolvedPath=GameEnvironment.IsRuntime?ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(UserFilePath):"collections.json";}private static string ResolvedPath=>_resolvedPath??(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime?ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(UserFilePath):"collections.json");/// <summary>Loads player-created collections; returns an empty list when the file is absent or broken.</summary>
public static List<ModCollection>LoadUser(){var path=ResolvedPath;var result=new List<ModCollection>();if(!File.Exists(path))return result;try{var json=File.ReadAllText(path);var list=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<ModCollection>>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(list==null)return result;foreach(var collection in list){if(collection==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(collection.Id)){GameLogger.Log("MOD_COLLECTIONS","Skipping user collection without an id",LogLevel.Warning);continue;}collection.Origin=ModCollectionOrigin.User;result.Add(collection);}}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MOD_COLLECTIONS",$"Failed to load user collections: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Warning);}return result;}/// <summary>Persists the player's collections, replacing the whole file.</summary>
public static void SaveUser(List<ModCollection>collections){try{var path=ResolvedPath;var dir=Path.GetDirectoryName(path);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dir)&& !Directory.Exists(dir))Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(collections??new List<ModCollection>(),JsonOptionsProvider.WriteIndentedIgnoreNullOptions);File.WriteAllText(path,json);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MOD_COLLECTIONS",$"Failed to save user collections: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}/// <summary> Reads every <c>collections/*.json</c> bundled inside a mod. Used for both folder and zip providers; a broken file is logged and skipped so one bad collection cannot hide the others. </summary>
public static List<ModCollection>LoadFromProvider(IModFileProvider provider){var result=new List<ModCollection>();if(provider==null)return result;foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles(ProviderDirectory)){if(entry.EndsWith("/",StringComparison.Ordinal)|| !entry.EndsWith(".json",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){continue;}var collection=Parse(provider.ReadFileText(entry),$"{provider.Mod}/{entry}");if(collection==null)continue;collection.Origin=ModCollectionOrigin.BuiltIn;result.Add(collection);}return result;}/// <summary> Loads and merges collections from every channel, ordered by precedence (catalog, then built-in, then user — each step may replace an entry with the same id). Entries without an id are ignored. </summary>
public static List<ModCollection>LoadAll(){ModRegistry.Instance.Initialize();var byId=new Dictionary<string,ModCollection>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);var catalog=CatalogService.CachedCollections;if(catalog!=null){foreach(var collection in catalog)AddIfValid(byId,collection,ModCollectionOrigin.Catalog,overwrite:false);}foreach(var info in ModRegistry.Instance.AllDiscoveredMods.Values){foreach(var collection in LoadFromProvider(info.FileProvider))AddIfValid(byId,collection,ModCollectionOrigin.BuiltIn,overwrite:true);}foreach(var collection in LoadUser())AddIfValid(byId,collection,ModCollectionOrigin.User,overwrite:true);return new List<ModCollection>(byId.Values);}private static void AddIfValid(Dictionary<string,ModCollection>byId,ModCollection collection,ModCollectionOrigin origin,bool overwrite){if(collection==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(collection.Id)){GameLogger.Log("MOD_COLLECTIONS","Skipping collection without an id",LogLevel.Warning);return;}collection.Origin=origin;if(overwrite|| !byId.ContainsKey(collection.Id))byId[collection.Id]=collection;}private static ModCollection Parse(string json,string label){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(json)){GameLogger.Log("MOD_COLLECTIONS",$"Collection file '{label}' is empty",LogLevel.Warning);return null;}try{var collection=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ModCollection>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(collection==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(collection.Id)){GameLogger.Log("MOD_COLLECTIONS",$"Collection '{label}' has no id",LogLevel.Warning);return null;}return collection;}catch(JsonException ex){GameLogger.Log("MOD_COLLECTIONS",$"Failed to parse collection '{label}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return null;}}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Persistent storage for disabled mod IDs in <c>user://disabled_mods.json</c>. Used by <see cref="ModRegistry"/> to filter out disabled mods during loading and by the mod manager screen to display and toggle mod states. The file is a simple JSON array of mod ID strings. </summary>
public static class DisabledModsStore{private const string FilePath="user://disabled_mods.json";private static string _resolvedPath;/// <summary> Resolves the storage path once on the main thread. Called from <see cref="ModRegistry.PreparePaths"/> before the background mod-load phase, because <c>ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath</c> is Godot API and cannot be called from a worker thread. </summary>
public static void WarmUp(){_resolvedPath=GameEnvironment.IsRuntime?ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(FilePath):"disabled_mods.json";}private static string ResolvedPath=>_resolvedPath??(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime?ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(FilePath):"disabled_mods.json");public static HashSet<string>Load(){var path=ResolvedPath;if(!File.Exists(path))return new HashSet<string>();try{var json=File.ReadAllText(path);var list=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<string>>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);return list!=null?new HashSet<string>(list):new HashSet<string>();}catch{return new HashSet<string>();}}public static void Save(HashSet<string>disabledIds){var path=ResolvedPath;var dir=System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(path);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dir)&& !Directory.Exists(dir))Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);var list=new List<string>(disabledIds);list.Sort();var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(list,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteCompactOptions);File.WriteAllText(path,json);}public static bool IsDisabled(string modId){return Load().Contains(modId);}public static void SetEnabled(string modId,bool enabled){var set=Load();if(enabled)set.Remove(modId);else set.Add(modId);Save(set);}/// <summary> Forgets a mod id entirely. public static void Remove(string modId){var set=Load();if(set.Remove(modId))Save(set);}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Discovery{/// <summary> A strategy that can open a specific mod entry and create the appropriate <see cref="IModFileProvider"/>. After an <see cref="IModScanner"/> enumerates entries, each entry URL is tested against all registered loaders — the first one whose <see cref="IModDiscoveryProvider.IsCanProvide"/> returns <c>true</c> (checked in LIFO order) creates the provider, reads <c>manifest.json</c>, and produces a <c>ModCandidate</c>. Built-in loaders: <c>FolderModLoader</c> (directories) and <c>ZipModLoader</c> (.zip archives). Mods can add loaders for custom formats or remote downloads. </summary>
public interface IModLoader:IModDiscoveryProvider{/// <summary> Creates an <see cref="IModFileProvider"/> for the given mod entry. The caller is responsible for disposing it if the mod is ultimately skipped (deduplication loss, disabled, etc.). </summary> <param name="url">Full filesystem path or URL to the mod entry.</param> <param name="modName">Short name (folder name, zip filename) used as the provider's <c>Mod</c> identifier.</param>
IModFileProvider CreateProvider(string url,string modName);/// <summary> Returns the fallback mod ID to use when <c>manifest.json</c> is present but does not contain an <c>id</c> field. For folder mods this is the directory name; for zip mods it is the filename without the <c>.zip</c> extension. </summary> <param name="url">Full filesystem path or URL to the mod entry.</param> <param name="entryName">Short entry name from <see cref="DiscoveredModEntry.EntryName"/>.</param>
string GetFallbackModId(string url,string entryName);}}

using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Discovery{/// <summary> A strategy that knows about a source of mods. Each scanner declares its own root URLs via <see cref="GetRoots"/> — this is what replaces the old hardcoded <c>ResolveModsRoots()</c>. <see cref="ModRegistry.Initialize"/> iterates every scanner, calls <see cref="IModDiscoveryProvider.IsCanProvide"/> on each root as a guard, and then delegates to <see cref="Discover"/> for actual enumeration. New mod sources (HTTP catalogs, Steam Workshop folders, Git repos) are added by shipping an <c>IModScanner</c> implementation inside a mod DLL — <c>Reflections.FindAndCreate</c> picks it up automatically when the assembly is registered. </summary>
public interface IModScanner:IModDiscoveryProvider{/// <summary> Returns the root URLs this scanner knows about, together with their deduplication priorities. Called once per scanner during <see cref="ModRegistry.Initialize"/>. </summary>
IEnumerable<ModSourceRoot>GetRoots();/// <summary> Enumerates mod entries (folders, zip files, remote descriptors) available at the given root URL. The returned <see cref="DiscoveredModEntry"/> objects are passed to <see cref="IModLoader"/> strategies for provider creation. </summary> <param name="rootUrl">A root URL previously returned by <see cref="GetRoots"/>.</param>
IEnumerable<DiscoveredModEntry>Discover(string rootUrl);}}

using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Providers;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Discovery{/// <summary> Loads mods stored as plain directories on disk. <see cref="IsCanProvide"/> returns <c>true</c> only for paths where <see cref="Directory.Exists(string)"/> succeeds, so this loader claims every filesystem directory and creates a <see cref="FolderModFileProvider"/> — the only provider type that supports <c>GetFileSystemPath</c> and therefore Godot scene instantiation via <c>ResourceLoader</c>. </summary>
public class FolderModLoader:IModLoader{/// <inheritdoc />
public string Name=>"Folder";/// <summary> Returns <c>true</c> for any path that is an existing directory on disk. </summary>
public bool IsCanProvide(string url){return Directory.Exists(url);}/// <summary> Creates a <see cref="FolderModFileProvider"/> rooted at the given directory path. This provider type is the only one that supports <c>GetFileSystemPath</c>, enabling Godot scene instantiation from folder mods. </summary>
public IModFileProvider CreateProvider(string url,string modName){return new FolderModFileProvider(url,modName);}/// <summary> Uses the raw entry name (directory name) as the fallback mod ID. </summary>
public string GetFallbackModId(string url,string entryName){return entryName;}}}

===== FILE Core/Mods/Discovery/Loaders/ZipModLoader.cs =====
using System;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Providers;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Discovery{/// <summary> Loads mods stored as <c>.zip</c> archives. <see cref="IsCanProvide"/> matches any path ending with <c>.zip</c> (case-insensitive). Creates a <see cref="ZipModFileProvider"/> which builds an O(1) lookup of all zip entries on construction. Zip mods cannot serve Godot scenes directly — <c>GetFileSystemPath</c> returns <c>null</c>. Callers that need resource loading (factories, scene instantiation) must either extract assets to the cache or fall back to folder mods. </summary>
public class ZipModLoader:IModLoader{/// <inheritdoc />
public string Name=>"Zip";/// <summary> Returns <c>true</c> for any path that ends with <c>.zip</c> (case-insensitive comparison). </summary>
public bool IsCanProvide(string url){return url.EndsWith(".zip",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);}/// <summary> Creates a <see cref="ZipModFileProvider"/> that opens the zip archive and builds an in-memory entry lookup. The archive remains open until <c>Dispose</c> is called. </summary>
public IModFileProvider CreateProvider(string url,string modName){return new ZipModFileProvider(url,modName);}/// <summary> Strips the <c>.zip</c> extension from the entry name to produce the fallback mod ID — the filename is typically the mod's canonical identifier. </summary>
public string GetFallbackModId(string url,string entryName){return Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(entryName);}}}

===== FILE Core/Mods/Discovery/ModDiscoveryRegistry.cs =====
using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Discovery{/// <summary> Central registry that auto-discovers all <see cref="IModScanner"/> and <see cref="IModLoader"/> implementations via <c>Reflections.FindAndCreate</c> and provides LIFO-ordered lookup. Call <see cref="Initialize"/> once before mod discovery (called by <see cref="ModRegistry.Initialize"/>). When a mod assembly is loaded, <see cref="ModAssemblyLoader.RegisterAssembly"/> fans out to <see cref="RegisterAssembly"/> so that new scanners and loaders shipped inside the mod are registered — at the end of the list, meaning they are checked first (LIFO) and can override built-in providers. </summary>
public static class ModDiscoveryRegistry{private static readonly List<IModScanner>_scanners=new();private static readonly List<IModLoader>_loaders=new();private static bool _initialized;/// <summary> All registered scanners in registration order. When iterating for matching, walk the list in reverse (LIFO) so that mod-added scanners can override core scanners. </summary>
public static IReadOnlyList<IModScanner>Scanners=>_scanners;/// <summary> All registered loaders in registration order. LIFO lookup: the last registered loader that answers <c>true</c> to <see cref="IModDiscoveryProvider.IsCanProvide"/> wins. </summary>
public static IReadOnlyList<IModLoader>Loaders=>_loaders;/// <summary> Idempotent initialisation. Scans all currently loaded assemblies for <c>IModScanner</c> and <c>IModLoader</c> implementations and registers them. Called once by <see cref="ModRegistry"/>. </summary>
public static void Initialize(){if(_initialized)return;_initialized=true;_scanners.AddRange(Reflections.FindAndCreate<IModScanner>());_loaders.AddRange(Reflections.FindAndCreate<IModLoader>());GameLogger.Log("MODS_DISCOVERY",$"Initialized: {_scanners.Count} scanner(s), {_loaders.Count} loader(s)");}/// <summary> Called by <see cref="ModAssemblyLoader.RegisterAssembly"/> when a mod DLL is loaded. Discovers new scanner/loader types in the assembly and appends them to the registered lists. Because lookup walks the list from the end, these new providers are checked before built-in ones. </summary> <param name="assembly">The assembly to scan for <see cref="IModScanner"/> and <see cref="IModLoader"/> implementations.</param>
public static void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly){_scanners.AddRange(Reflections.FindAndCreate<IModScanner>(assembly));_loaders.AddRange(Reflections.FindAndCreate<IModLoader>(assembly));}/// <summary> Returns the first <see cref="IModScanner"/> (checked LIFO — from the end of the registration list) whose <see cref="IModDiscoveryProvider.IsCanProvide"/> returns <c>true</c> for the given root URL, or <c>null</c>. </summary> <param name="url">A root URL to test against all registered scanners.</param>
public static IModScanner FindScanner(string url){for(int i=_scanners.Count-1;i>=0;i--){if(_scanners[i].IsCanProvide(url))return _scanners[i];}return null;}/// <summary> Returns the first <see cref="IModLoader"/> (checked LIFO) whose <see cref="IModDiscoveryProvider.IsCanProvide"/> returns <c>true</c> for the given mod entry URL, or <c>null</c>. </summary> <param name="url">A mod entry URL (folder path, zip file, etc.) to test against all registered loaders.</param>
public static IModLoader FindLoader(string url){for(int i=_loaders.Count-1;i>=0;i--){if(_loaders[i].IsCanProvide(url))return _loaders[i];}return null;}}}

===== FILE Core/Mods/Discovery/ModSourceRoot.cs =====
namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Discovery{/// <summary> Describes a single source of mods — a root directory, remote catalog URL, or any other entry point that a <see cref="IModScanner"/> can enumerate. Each root carries a <see cref="Priority"/> used by <see cref="ModRegistry"/> for deduplication: when two mods with the same ID are discovered under different roots, the mod from the lower-priority root takes precedence. </summary>
public class ModSourceRoot{/// <summary>Filesystem path or URL to the mod source root.</summary>
public string Url{get;set;}/// <summary> Deduplication precedence. Lower value = higher priority. <c>0</c> is the user mods directory, <c>1</c> is the built-in game mods directory, higher values are for remote/external sources. </summary>
public int Priority{get;set;}}}

===== FILE Core/Mods/Discovery/Scanners/GameDirModScanner.cs =====
using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Discovery{/// <summary> Scans the built-in mods directory shipped with the game. Returns the project-local <c>mods/</c> folder in editor/test environments (priority 0), or the globalised <c>res://mods/</c> path in runtime builds (priority 1). Priority 1 means user-installed mods from <see cref="UserDataModScanner"/> override built-in mods with the same ID — users can replace or update shipped content without modifying game files. </summary>
public class GameDirModScanner:IModScanner{/// <inheritdoc />
public string Name=>"GameDir";/// <summary> Returns <c>true</c> if the given path is an existing directory. Acts as an accessibility guard — roots returned by <see cref="GetRoots"/> are skipped when the directory does not exist. </summary>
public bool IsCanProvide(string url){return Directory.Exists(url);}/// <summary> Returns the project-local <c>mods/</c> path in editor (priority 0), or the globalised <c>res://mods/</c> path in runtime builds (priority 1). Uses the standard ternary pattern to avoid calling <c>ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath</c> outside the Godot runtime. </summary>
public IEnumerable<ModSourceRoot>GetRoots(){if(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime){var path=ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath("res://mods/");yield return new ModSourceRoot{Url=path,Priority=1};}else{yield return new ModSourceRoot{Url="mods",Priority=0};}}/// <summary> Enumerates all filesystem entries (folders and files) inside the given root directory. Normalises backslashes to forward slashes for cross-platform consistency. </summary>
public IEnumerable<DiscoveredModEntry>Discover(string rootUrl){foreach(var entry in Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(rootUrl)){yield return new DiscoveredModEntry{Url=entry.Replace('\\','/'),EntryName=Path.GetFileName(entry),};}}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Discovery{/// <summary> Scans the per-user mods directory (<c>user://mods/</c>) in runtime builds. This is where the mod manager downloads and installs mod subscriptions — it is the writable, user-specific mod source with the highest deduplication priority (0). Always returns its root from <see cref="GetRoots"/>; the <see cref="IsCanProvide"/> guard filters the root out when the filesystem path does not exist (non-runtime or user directory not yet created). Uses the standard ternary pattern to avoid calling <c>ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath</c> outside the Godot runtime. </summary>
public class UserDataModScanner:IModScanner{/// <inheritdoc />
public string Name=>"UserData";/// <summary> Returns <c>true</c> if the given path is an existing directory. Acts as an accessibility guard — roots returned by <see cref="GetRoots"/> are skipped when the filesystem path does not exist (mods directory was never created yet). </summary>
public bool IsCanProvide(string url){return Directory.Exists(url);}/// <summary> Returns the globalised <c>user://mods/</c> path when running inside Godot, or the raw <c>user://mods/</c> string as a fallback for editor and test environments. Always returns exactly one root with priority 0 (highest user precedence). </summary>
public IEnumerable<ModSourceRoot>GetRoots(){var path=GameEnvironment.IsRuntime?ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath("user://mods/"):"user://mods/";yield return new ModSourceRoot{Url=path,Priority=0};}/// <summary> Enumerates all filesystem entries (folders and files) inside the given root directory. Normalises backslashes to forward slashes for cross-platform consistency. </summary>
public IEnumerable<DiscoveredModEntry>Discover(string rootUrl){foreach(var entry in Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(rootUrl)){yield return new DiscoveredModEntry{Url=entry.Replace('\\','/'),EntryName=Path.GetFileName(entry),};}}}}

===== FILE Core/Mods/GDScriptHookRegistry.cs =====
using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Registry of <see cref="IGDScriptHook"/> implementations. Hooks are registered by mod initializers during assembly registration, which always happens before <see cref="ModGDScriptLoader"/> processes <c>.gd</c> sources. A later registration with the same <see cref="IGDScriptHook.Id"/> replaces the earlier one so mod reloads do not accumulate duplicates. </summary>
public static class GDScriptHookRegistry{private static readonly List<IGDScriptHook>hooks=new();/// <summary>Registers (or replaces by id) a GDScript hook.</summary>
public static void Register(IGDScriptHook hook){if(hook==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(hook.Id))return;hooks.RemoveAll(existing=>existing.Id==hook.Id);hooks.Add(hook);GameLogger.Log("GDS_MOD",$"GDScriptHookRegistry: registered hook '{hook.Id}'");}/// <summary>Offers a compiled GDScript object to every registered hook.</summary>
public static void TryRegisterAll(GodotObject obj,string modId,string filePath){if(obj==null)return;foreach(var hook in hooks){try{hook.TryRegister(obj,modId,filePath);}catch(System.Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("GDS_MOD",$"GDScriptHookRegistry: hook '{hook.Id}' failed on '{filePath}' from mod '{modId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}}}

using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Extension point for gameplay subsystems that can be implemented in GDScript. <see cref="ModGDScriptLoader"/> walks every <c>.gd</c> file a mod declares and hands each compiled object to the registered hooks; a hook recognizes its own method signatures (for example <c>get_action_id</c>/<c>execute</c>) and wraps the script in a C# adapter. This keeps the generic loader free of subsystem-specific method names — the owning mod registers the hook when it loads. </summary>
public interface IGDScriptHook{/// <summary>Stable id used to replace a hook when a mod reloads.</summary>
string Id{get;}/// <summary> Inspects the compiled GDScript object and registers an adapter if the script implements this hook's contract. Called for every <c>.gd</c> file of every mod; implementations should simply return when their expected methods are absent. </summary>
void TryRegister(GodotObject obj,string modId,string filePath);}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Utils.Types;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Abstraction over mod storage backends. Every mod — whether a loose folder on disk or a compressed <c>.zip</c> archive — exposes its files through this single interface, so the entire asset pipeline (<c>ModManager</c>, factories, compilers) never branches on storage format. Extends <c>IDisposable</c> because zip archives hold native OS file handles that must be released on mod unload. Folder providers implement <c>Dispose</c> as a no-op. <c>GetFileSystemPath</c> returns <c>null</c> for zip providers — Godot's <c>ResourceLoader</c> and <c>PackedScene</c> loading require real filesystem paths, so callers that depend on these (e.g. <c>EffectFactory</c>) must guard against zip-only mods. </summary>
public interface IModFileProvider:IDisposable{/// <summary>Short name/ID of this mod (for logging and lookup).</summary>
string Mod{get;}/// <summary>Returns true if the given path exists inside this mod.</summary>
bool FileExists(string path);/// <summary> Enumerates all files and directories immediately under the given directory. Directories have a trailing <c>/</c> to let recursive callers branch without additional stat calls. </summary>
IEnumerable<string>ListFiles(string directory="");/// <summary>Reads a text file as UTF-8 string, or null if not found.</summary>
string ReadFileText(string path);/// <summary>Reads a binary file as byte array, or null if not found.</summary>
byte[]ReadFileBinary(string path);/// <summary>Opens a seekable stream to a file inside the mod.</summary>
Stream OpenStream(string path);/// <summary> Returns an absolute filesystem path for the given mod-relative path, or null if this provider cannot give filesystem access (zip mods return null here). </summary>
string GetFileSystemPath(string path);/// <summary> Resolves a relative include path (<c>../shared/data.json</c>) against the current file's directory to produce a canonical mod-relative path. </summary>
string ResolveIncludePath(string includePath,string currentPath);/// <summary> Filesystem path to the mod's root storage. For folder mods this is the directory path; for zip mods this is the .zip file path. Returns <c>null</c> for providers that are not disk-backed (test mocks, in-memory stubs). </summary>
string RootPath{get;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Lifecycle hook for mod code that needs to run logic during mod loading. Implementations are auto-discovered via reflection in <c>ModInitializerRegistry</c>. <c>OnModLoaded</c> is called for <b>every</b> mod, not just the mod that owns the initializer — this cross-mod notification pattern allows a single initializer to react to any mod being added, e.g. a compatibility patch that detects a specific companion mod and registers bridging behaviour. <c>OnModResourcesReady</c> fires once, after all mods have been fully loaded and their JSON resources are accessible through factories (CharacterFactory, ItemFactory, etc.). Use this for initialisation that depends on mod data, such as adding default starter characters to the party. </summary>
public interface IModInitializer{/// <summary> Called for <b>every</b> mod that loads — the <c>modId</c> parameter is the mod that just finished loading, which may or may not be the mod that owns this initializer. </summary>
void OnModLoaded(string modId);/// <summary> Called once after all mods have been loaded and their resources (JSON data) are accessible through factories. Use this for initialisation that requires game resources, e.g. adding default characters to the party roster. </summary>
void OnModResourcesReady();}}

using System;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Interface for mods that need to persist custom data alongside the core game save. Implementations are auto-discovered via reflection in <see cref="ModSaveableRegistry"/> when a mod assembly is loaded. <b>Contract:</b> <list type="number"> <item><b>OnSave</b> — the mod receives a pre-filled slot (ModId, ModName, ModVersion set by the core) and writes its data, MinCoreVersion, IsRequired, and CustomData.</item> <item><b>OnLoad</b> — two variants: <list type="bullet"> <item><b>Preferred:</b> override <c>bool OnLoad(ModSlot, out string error)</c> — explicit contract, no exceptions.</item> <item><b>Legacy:</b> override <c>void OnLoadVoid(ModSlot)</c> — throw on error, core catches and reports.</item> </list> </item> </list> </summary>
public interface IModSaveable{/// <summary> Called by the core when saving the game. The mod receives a slot with <c>Metadata.ModId</c>, <c>Metadata.ModName</c>, and <c>Metadata.ModVersion</c> already filled by the core. The mod should set <c>MinCoreVersion</c>, <c>IsRequired</c>, <c>CustomData</c>, and write its state into <c>slot.Data</c>. </summary>
void OnSave(Cthangover.Core.Settings.ModSlot slot);/// <summary> Preferred entry point for loading. Called by the core after phase-1 validation. Return <c>false</c> with a descriptive <c>errorMessage</c> if the data is incompatible or a migration is impossible. The core logs and shows the message to the user. Default implementation delegates to <see cref="OnLoadVoid"/>. </summary>
bool OnLoad(Cthangover.Core.Settings.ModSlot slot,out string errorMessage){OnLoadVoid(slot);errorMessage=null;return true;}/// <summary> Legacy entry point for loading. Throw an exception with a descriptive message if the data is incompatible. Override <see cref="OnLoad(Cthangover.Core.Settings.ModSlot, out string)"/> instead for explicit error handling. The default throws <see cref="NotSupportedException"/> so that a mod must override at least one of the two methods. </summary>
void OnLoadVoid(Cthangover.Core.Settings.ModSlot slot){throw new NotSupportedException("Override either OnLoad(ModSlot, out string errorMessage) "+"for explicit errors, or OnLoadVoid(ModSlot) for throw-based errors.");}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Interface for mods that expose user-configurable settings in the in-game settings menu. Implementations are auto-discovered via reflection in <see cref="ModSettingsRegistry"/> when a mod assembly is loaded. The contract mirrors <see cref="IModSaveable"/>: the mod only needs to declare its settings shape (<see cref="GetDefinitions"/>) and provide two symmetric methods for reading and writing values through a <see cref="DataBlob"/>. The core owns all persistence and UI rendering. Lifecycle: <list type="number"> <item>On boot, the core loads persisted data from disk and calls <see cref="ReadValues"/> so the mod applies its saved state.</item> <item>When the player opens the Settings menu, the core calls <see cref="GetDefinitions"/> to build the UI, then <see cref="WriteValues"/> to fill the controls with current values.</item> <item>When the player changes a setting, the core writes the new value into a <c>DataBlob</c>, persists it, and calls <see cref="ReadValues"/> so the mod reacts immediately.</item> </list> </summary>
public interface IModSettings{/// <summary> Returns descriptors for every setting this mod exposes. Called every time the settings UI builds the controls for this mod. The list order defines the UI row order. </summary>
IReadOnlyList<ModSettingDefinition>GetDefinitions();/// <summary> The mod serialises its current setting values into the supplied <c>blob</c>. The core uses this to populate the UI controls and to persist to disk. Use <c>blob.SetInt</c>, <c>blob.SetBool</c>, <c>blob.SetString</c>, etc. </summary>
void WriteValues(DataBlob blob);/// <summary> The mod reads setting values from the supplied <c>blob</c> and applies them. Called on boot (from persisted data) and on every UI change (for immediate apply). Use <c>blob.GetInt</c>, <c>blob.GetBool</c>, etc. with fallback defaults. </summary>
void ReadValues(DataBlob blob);}}

using System.Text.Json.Serialization;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> JSON DTO for one entry of a mod manifest's <c>main_menu</c> array — the declarative way a mod adds a button to the title screen and binds a scene to it. This is the main-menu counterpart of <see cref="UiEntry"/>: same manifest-driven philosophy, but a different surface. Main menu GUI lives in the native <c>main_menu.tscn</c> (which mods cannot patch), is built by <c>MainMenuRegistry</c> + <c>MainMenuBuilder</c> and is never hosted by <c>UiHost</c>. <para/> The target scene is a mod-relative <c>.tscn</c> resolved through <see cref="Scenes.ModScenePrefab"/>. It is added as a full-rect child of the main menu root, so it is a fullscreen overlay owned by the mod itself: it closes by freeing itself (or by another mod button replacing it). <see cref="Button"/> reuses <see cref="UiButtonEntry"/> for ordering and the translation key; its icon is optional here (plain menu buttons are text-only unless the mod ships an icon), unlike panel buttons in <see cref="UiEntry"/> where the icon is mandatory. </summary>
public class MainMenuEntry{/// <summary>Unique within the owning mod; used for validation and registry lookup.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("id")]public string Id{get;set;}/// <summary>Mod-relative path to the .tscn implementing the button's screen (fullscreen Control).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("scene_path")]public string ScenePath{get;set;}/// <summary>Button definition: <c>locale</c> is required, <c>icon</c> optional, <c>index</c> sets the vertical order.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("button")]public UiButtonEntry Button{get;set;}/// <summary>Owning mod id, filled during collection.</summary>
[JsonIgnore]public string ModId{get;set;}/// <summary>Position of the owning mod in load order, filled during collection.</summary>
[JsonIgnore]public int ModOrderIndex{get;set;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Reflection;using System.Threading;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Discovery;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnBuild;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnParsing;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Loads compiled assemblies (DLLs) from mods and registers their types into every reflection-driven subsystem in the game. <b>Precompiled DLL discovery</b> — <c>LoadPrecompiledDlls</c> recursively scans each mod's <c>dll/</c> directory for <c>.dll</c> files, copies them to the assembly cache to give them a stable filesystem path, and registers each one. <b>Registration fan-out</b> — <c>RegisterAssembly</c> is the single point through which every new assembly enters the game. It calls into every subsystem that uses reflection to find implementations: scenario actions, command strategies, scene events, item actions, mod saveables, tool factories, toolbox button factories, and mod initialisers. Gameplay subsystems owned by mods (for example battle cores, winground listeners and recruit behaviours) register themselves from their <c>IModInitializer</c> instead. Adding a new reflection-based plugin system to the game requires adding exactly one line here. <b>Assembly resolve hook</b> — the static constructor subscribes to <c>AppDomain.AssemblyResolve</c> so that when a mod DLL references another mod DLL, the runtime can find it by name among already-loaded assemblies. Without this, inter-mod type references would throw <c>TypeLoadException</c> at runtime. </summary>
public static class ModAssemblyLoader{static ModAssemblyLoader(){AppDomain.CurrentDomain.AssemblyResolve+=OnModAssemblyResolve;}/// <summary> Loads a <c>.dll</c> assembly from raw bytes. Returns null on failure — the caller is responsible for logging. </summary>
public static Assembly LoadFromBytes(byte[]raw){try{return Assembly.Load(raw);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_ASSEMBLY",$"ModAssemblyLoader.LoadFromBytes: loading raw data fail: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");return null;}}/// <summary> Registers all types from a newly-loaded assembly into every reflection-based plugin system. This is the single point that fans a new assembly out to all registries. </summary>
public static void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly,string modId){ScenarioActionFactory.Instance.RegisterAssembly(assembly);ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory.RegisterAssembly(assembly);Scenes.SceneEventRegistry.RegisterAssembly(assembly);ItemActionFactory.RegisterAssembly(assembly);UI.Tool.ToolFactory.Instance.RegisterAssembly(assembly);UI.Tool.ToolBoxButtonFactory.Instance.RegisterAssembly(assembly);ModInitializerRegistry.RegisterAssembly(assembly,modId);ModSaveableRegistry.RegisterAssembly(assembly,modId);ModSettingsRegistry.RegisterAssembly(assembly,modId);ModDiscoveryRegistry.RegisterAssembly(assembly);SectionParserRegistry.RegisterAssembly(assembly);PropertyResolverRegistry.RegisterAssembly(assembly);SubResourceBuilderRegistry.RegisterAssembly(assembly);ExtResourceBuilderRegistry.RegisterAssembly(assembly);ModManager.Instance.RegisterResolversFromAssembly(assembly);}/// <summary> Scans each loaded mod's <c>dll/</c> directory for precompiled <c>.dll</c> files, copies them to the assembly cache, and loads each as an <see cref="Assembly"/> WITHOUT registering it. Registration fan-out (see <see cref="RegisterAssembly"/>) must be performed separately, on the main thread, after this returns — this keeps the file I/O and <c>Assembly.Load</c> work thread-safe for the background boot phase while deferring anything that touches Godot. </summary> <returns>A list of <c>(modId, assembly)</c> pairs for every loaded precompiled DLL, in discovery order.</returns>
public static List<(string ModId,Assembly Assembly)>LoadPrecompiledDlls(IEnumerable<IModInfo>mods,CancellationToken cancellationToken=default){var result=new List<(string ModId,Assembly Assembly)>();if(!Directory.Exists(ModCompiler.CacheRoot))Directory.CreateDirectory(ModCompiler.CacheRoot);foreach(var mod in mods){cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();var dllFiles=CollectDllFiles(mod.FileProvider,mod.Id);if(dllFiles.Count==0)continue;GameLogger.Log("MODS_ASSEMBLY",$"ModAssemblyLoader.LoadPrecompiledDlls: found {dllFiles.Count} precompiled DLL(s) in mod '{mod.Id}'");foreach(var(filePath,bytes)in dllFiles){cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();try{var fileName=Path.GetFileName(filePath);var cachedPath=Path.Combine(ModCompiler.CacheRoot,$"{mod.Id}_dll_{fileName}");File.WriteAllBytes(cachedPath,bytes);var assembly=LoadFromBytes(bytes);if(assembly!=null){ModNativeLoader.InstallResolverOnAssembly(assembly);result.Add((mod.Id,assembly));GameLogger.Log("MODS_ASSEMBLY",$"ModAssemblyLoader.LoadPrecompiledDlls: loaded precompiled DLL '{filePath}' from mod '{mod.Id}'");}}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.CompilationErrors.Add($"Mod '{mod.Id}', DLL '{filePath}': {ex.Message}");GameLogger.Log("MODS_ASSEMBLY",$"ModAssemblyLoader.LoadPrecompiledDlls: failed to load precompiled DLL '{filePath}' from mod '{mod.Id}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}return result;}private static List<(string FilePath,byte[]Bytes)>CollectDllFiles(IModFileProvider provider,string modId){var result=new List<(string,byte[])>();CollectDllFilesRecursive(provider,"dll",result);return result;}private static void CollectDllFilesRecursive(IModFileProvider provider,string directory,List<(string,byte[])>result){foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles(directory)){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){var subDir=entry.TrimEnd('/');CollectDllFilesRecursive(provider,subDir,result);}else if(entry.EndsWith(".dll",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){var bytes=provider.ReadFileBinary(entry);if(bytes!=null)result.Add((entry,bytes));}}}private static Assembly OnModAssemblyResolve(object sender,ResolveEventArgs args){var name=new AssemblyName(args.Name).Name;foreach(var asm in AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies()){if(!asm.IsDynamic&&asm.GetName().Name==name)return asm;}return null;}}}

using System.IO;using System.IO.Compression;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Generates catalog JSON entries from installed mods. Two entry points: <see cref="ExportFromFolder"/> — for folder mods under development. Creates a .zip archive next to the mod folder (if one doesn't already exist), computes both SHA256 checksums, and writes a companion .json catalog entry file. <see cref="ExportFromZip"/> — for already-packaged zip mods. Computes checksums from the existing archive and writes the companion .json file. The output .json file is named after the archive (<c>mod_name.json</c>) and placed alongside it. This file is a ready-to-embed snippet for the <c>"mods"</c> array in the online catalog. </summary>
public static class ModCatalogExporter{/// <summary> Exports a catalog entry for a folder mod. If no zip archive for this mod exists in <paramref name="outputDir"/>, one is created via <c>ZipFile.CreateFromDirectory</c>. The companion .json file is then written alongside the zip. </summary> <param name="modInfo">Loaded mod info with manifest metadata.</param> <param name="entry">Populated catalog entry DTO (download URL, category, tags, etc. must be set by the caller).</param> <param name="outputDir">Directory where the zip and json will be placed (typically the mods root directory).</param> <returns>Absolute path to the written .json file.</returns>
public static string ExportFromFolder(ModInfo modInfo,CatalogExportEntry entry,string outputDir){var folderPath=modInfo.FileProvider.RootPath;var zipName=entry.Id+".zip";var zipPath=Path.Combine(outputDir,zipName);if(!File.Exists(zipPath)){Directory.CreateDirectory(outputDir);File.Delete(zipPath+".tmp");ZipFile.CreateFromDirectory(folderPath,zipPath,CompressionLevel.Optimal,false);GameLogger.Log("MODS_EXPORT",$"Created archive '{zipPath}' from folder mod '{entry.Id}'");}var downloadEntry=EnsureDownloadEntry(entry);downloadEntry.ArchiveSha256=ModHasher.ComputeArchiveSha256(zipPath);downloadEntry.InstallSha256=ModHasher.ComputeInstallSha256(modInfo.FileProvider,ModConfig.Instance.CatalogIgnorePatterns);downloadEntry.SizeBytes=new FileInfo(zipPath).Length;var jsonPath=Path.ChangeExtension(zipPath,".json");WriteJsonFile(jsonPath,entry);GameLogger.Log("MODS_EXPORT",$"Exported catalog entry for '{entry.Id}' → '{jsonPath}'");return jsonPath;}/// <summary> Exports a catalog entry for a zip mod. The archive already exists; only the companion .json file is written. </summary> <param name="modInfo">Loaded mod info with manifest metadata.</param> <param name="entry">Populated catalog entry DTO.</param> <param name="outputDir">Directory where the json will be placed (typically the mods root directory).</param> <returns>Absolute path to the written .json file.</returns>
public static string ExportFromZip(ModInfo modInfo,CatalogExportEntry entry,string outputDir){var zipPath=modInfo.FileProvider.RootPath;var downloadEntry=EnsureDownloadEntry(entry);downloadEntry.ArchiveSha256=ModHasher.ComputeArchiveSha256(zipPath);downloadEntry.InstallSha256=ModHasher.ComputeInstallSha256(modInfo.FileProvider,ModConfig.Instance.CatalogIgnorePatterns);downloadEntry.SizeBytes=new FileInfo(zipPath).Length;var jsonPath=Path.Combine(outputDir,Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(zipPath)+".json");WriteJsonFile(jsonPath,entry);GameLogger.Log("MODS_EXPORT",$"Exported catalog entry for '{entry.Id}' → '{jsonPath}'");return jsonPath;}private static CatalogEntryDownload EnsureDownloadEntry(CatalogExportEntry entry){entry.Downloads??=new System.Collections.Generic.List<CatalogEntryDownload>();var downloadEntry=entry.Downloads.Count>0?entry.Downloads[0]:null;if(downloadEntry==null|| !string.Equals(downloadEntry.Version,entry.Version,System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){downloadEntry=new CatalogEntryDownload{Version=entry.Version};entry.Downloads.Add(downloadEntry);}return downloadEntry;}private static void WriteJsonFile(string path,CatalogExportEntry entry){var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(entry,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteIndentedIgnoreNullOptions);File.WriteAllText(path,json);}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using System.Threading;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Cthangover.Core.Actions;using Godot;using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Roslyn-based C# compiler for mod source files. The compilation pipeline is: 1. <b>Source collection</b> — walks each mod's declared source patterns (from <c>manifest.json</c>'s <c>sources</c> list), matching <c>.cs</c> files. Falls back to scanning the entire mod root if no patterns are declared, so a mod that just drops <c>.cs</c> files anywhere still compiles. 2. <b>Topological sort</b> — orders mods by their <c>depends</c> declarations so that a mod referencing another mod's types compiles after its dependency. Circular dependencies log a warning and break the cycle rather than deadlocking. 3. <b>Assembly reference discovery</b> — scans every loaded assembly's directory and the Godot build output directory for <c>.dll</c> files, adding them as metadata references so that mod code can call into any type in the game. 4. <b>SHA-256 output caching</b> — the compilation output is stored at <c>user://mod_cache/assemblies/{modId}_{hash}.dll</c>. On subsequent loads the hash is recomputed from source files; if it matches a cached DLL, recompilation is skipped entirely. The <c>use_assembly_cache</c> config toggle can force recompilation even when a cached DLL exists. 5. <b>Registration</b> — successful assemblies are passed to <c>ModAssemblyLoader.RegisterAssembly</c>, which fans them out to every reflection-based plugin registry in the game. <c>CompileString</c> is a separate entry point for ad-hoc code compilation (used by tools and the in-game script editor). </summary>

Mods are sorted topologically by dependencies before compilation; results are cached on disk by SHA-256 content hash. This is the pure-.NET phase of mod loading — it only does Roslyn compilation and file I/O, so it can run on a background thread during boot. Registration into the game's registries (which may instantiate Godot types) must happen later on the main thread via <see cref="ModAssemblyLoader.RegisterAssembly"/> and <see cref="ScriptTypeRegistry.RegisterAssembly"/>. </summary> <returns>A list of <c>(modId, assembly, sourceFiles)</c> tuples for every successfully compiled mod, in dependency order.</returns>
public static List<(string ModId,Assembly Assembly,List<(string FilePath,string Source)>Sources)>CompileAll(IDictionary<string,IModInfo>mods,CancellationToken cancellationToken=default){var result=new List<(string ModId,Assembly Assembly,List<(string FilePath,string Source)>Sources)>();cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();GameLogger.CompilationErrors.Clear();if(!Directory.Exists(CacheRoot))Directory.CreateDirectory(CacheRoot);var modsWithCode=new List<ModInfo>();foreach(var kvp in mods){var modInfo=kvp.Value as ModInfo;if(modInfo?.Manifest?.Sources==null||modInfo.Manifest.Sources.Count==0)continue;modsWithCode.Add(modInfo);}if(modsWithCode.Count==0)return result;var sorted=TopologicalSort(modsWithCode);foreach(var modInfo in sorted){cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();try{var sourceFiles=CollectSourceFiles(modInfo,cancellationToken);if(sourceFiles.Count==0)continue;GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"ModCompiler.CompileAll: compiling mod '{modInfo.Id}' with {sourceFiles.Count} source file(s):");foreach(var(path,_)in sourceFiles)GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"  {path}",LogLevel.Debug);var dependencySignature=BuildDependencySignature(modInfo,mods);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dependencySignature))GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"  dependencies: {dependencySignature}",LogLevel.Debug);var assembly=Compile(modInfo.Id,sourceFiles,dependencySignature,cancellationToken);if(assembly!=null){result.Add((modInfo.Id,assembly,sourceFiles));GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"ModCompiler.CompileAll: Compiled mod '{modInfo.Id}', {sourceFiles.Count} source file(s)");}}catch(OperationCanceledException)when(cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested){throw;}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.CompilationErrors.Add($"Mod '{modInfo.Id}': {ex.Message}");GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"ModCompiler.CompileAll: Failed to compile mod '{modInfo.Id}': {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}",LogLevel.Error);}}return result;}/// <summary> Builds a deterministic signature of a mod's dependencies for the compilation cache key: every dependency id together with "missing"}");}return string.Join(";",parts);}private static List<(string FilePath,string Source)>CollectSourceFiles(ModInfo modInfo,CancellationToken cancellationToken){var result=new List<(string,string)>();foreach(var pattern in modInfo.Manifest.Sources){cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();var prefix=pattern;var suffix="*.cs";var false;var fileName=file.Replace('\\','/');var fileNamePart=fileName.Substring(fileName.LastIndexOf('/')+1);return file.EndsWith(".cs",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);},result,cancellationToken);}return result;}private static void CollectSourceFilesRecursive(IModFileProvider provider,string directory,Func<string,bool>fileFilter,List<(string,string)>result,CancellationToken cancellationToken){foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles(directory)){cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(entry.EndsWith("/")){var detected involving mod '{mod.Id}'",LogLevel.Warning);return;}visiting.Add(mod.Id);if(mod.Manifest.DependencyIds!=null){foreach(var depId in mod.Manifest.DependencyIds){var dep=modsWithCode.Find(m=>m.Id==depId);if(dep!=null)Visit(dep);}}visiting.Remove(mod.Id);visited.Add(mod.Id);result.Add(mod);}foreach(var mod in modsWithCode)Visit(mod);return result;}/// <summary> sourceList=sources.ToList();if(sourceList.Count==0)return null;cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();var hash=ModHasher.ComputeHash(sourceList,dependencySignature);var cachedPath=Path.Combine(CacheRoot,$"{modId}_{hash}.dll");if(File.Exists(cachedPath)){if(ModConfig.Instance.UseAssemblyCache){GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"ModCompiler.Compile: loading cached {cachedPath}");return ModAssemblyLoader.LoadFromBytes(File.ReadAllBytes(cachedPath));}File.Delete(cachedPath);GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"ModCompiler.Compile: cached {cachedPath} need delete by syntaxTrees=sourceList.Select(s=>CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(s.Source,options:parseOptions,path:s.FilePath,cancellationToken:cancellationToken)).ToList();var metadataReferences=new List<MetadataReference>();AddCoreReferences(metadataReferences);var compilation=CSharpCompilation.Create(assemblyName:modId,syntaxTrees:syntaxTrees,references:metadataReferences,options:new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary).WithOptimizationLevel(OptimizationLevel.Debug));cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();using var ms=new MemoryStream();var result=compilation.Emit(ms);cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(!result.Success){var errors=result.Diagnostics.Where(d=>d.Severity==DiagnosticSeverity.Error).Take(20).Select(d=>$"{d.Location}: {d.GetMessage()}").ToList();GameLogger.CompilationErrors.Add($"Mod '{modId}' failed with {result.Diagnostics.Count(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error)} error(s):\n  "+string.Join("\n  ",errors));var errCount=0;foreach(var d in result.Diagnostics.Where(d=>d.Severity==DiagnosticSeverity.Error).Take(20)){GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"  ERR{++errCount}: {d.Location}: {d.GetMessage()}",LogLevel.Debug);}GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"ModCompiler.Compile: '{modId}' FAILED with {result.Diagnostics.Count(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error)} error(s)",LogLevel.Error);return null;}Directory.CreateDirectory(CacheRoot);ms.Seek(0,SeekOrigin.Begin);File.WriteAllBytes(cachedPath,ms.ToArray());GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"ModCompiler.Compile: errors=new List<string>();foreach(var d in result.Diagnostics){if(d.Severity==DiagnosticSeverity.Error)errors.Add(d.GetMessage());}return new CompileResult{Success=false,Errors=errors};}var buildOutputDir=ResolveBuildOutputDir();if(buildOutputDir!=null&&searchedDirs.Add(buildOutputDir)){GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"AddCoreReferences: scanning build output dir '{buildOutputDir}'");foreach(var dll in using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Text.Json;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Singleton configuration bridge between the mod system and the JSON config file at <c>config/mod_config.json</c>. [JsonPropertyName("audio_extensions")]public List<string>AudioExtensions{get;set;}=new(){".ogg",".wav"};/// <summary>File extensions treated as textures (.png, .jpg, .jpeg).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("texture_extensions")]public List<string>TextureExtensions{get;set;}=new(){".png",".jpg",".jpeg"};/// <summary>File extensions treated as shaders (.gdshader, .gdshaderinclude).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("shader_extensions")]public List<string>ShaderExtensions{get;set;}=new(){".gdshader",".gdshaderinclude"};/// <summary> Mod directory groups that are scanned for textures. [JsonPropertyName("texture_groups")]public List<string>TextureGroups{get;set;}=new(){"ui","backgrounds","avatars","icons","items","characters","effects","skills"};/// <summary> When true, cached compilation output is reused across runs. When false, cached DLLs are deleted and recompiled every time — useful during mod development. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("use_assembly_cache")]public bool UseAssemblyCache{get;set;}=true;/// <summary>Per-factory cache configuration (root path, size overrides).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("cache")]public CacheConfig Cache{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> File path patterns to exclude when computing the mod's install SHA256 checksum for catalog export. [JsonPropertyName("catalog_ignore_patterns")]public List<string>CatalogIgnorePatterns{get;set;}=new(){".*"};/// <summary> URLs of catalog JSON files to fetch when browsing online mods. [JsonPropertyName("catalog_urls")]public List<string>CatalogUrls{get;set;}=new();private HashSet<string>textureExtensionSet;private HashSet<string>shaderExtensionSet;/// <summary> Returns a lazily-built <c>HashSet</c> of texture extensions for O(1) membership tests during file scanning. </summary>
