using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.IO.Compression;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Providers{/// <summary> Mod file provider backed by a <c>.zip</c> archive. On construction the entire zip entry table is flattened into a case-insensitive dictionary — this trades startup memory for O(1) lookups on every subsequent file access call, which dominates because factories repeatedly check file existence during cache-population scans. <see cref="ListFiles"/> simulates a shallow directory listing by parsing the flat zip entry list: entries whose relative path contains a <c>/</c> after the prefix become synthetic directory entries (trailing <c>/</c>), while entries at the prefix level become file entries. This preserves the same recursive-walk interface that <see cref="FolderModFileProvider"/> provides natively. <see cref="GetFileSystemPath"/> always returns <c>null</c> — Godot cannot load resources or scenes directly from within a zip, so callers that need filesystem paths (e.g. <c>EffectFactory</c>, shader loading) must extract files to the cache or skip zip mods entirely. </summary>
public class ZipModFileProvider:IModFileProvider{private readonly ZipArchive archive;private readonly Dictionary<string,ZipArchiveEntry>entryLookup;/// <inheritdoc />
public string Mod{get;}/// <inheritdoc />
public string RootPath{get;}/// <summary> Opens the zip archive at <paramref name="zipPath"/> and builds an O(1) case-insensitive lookup dictionary from every entry's full path. The zip remains open until <see cref="Dispose"/> is called — callers must dispose the provider to release the native file handle. </summary> <param name="zipPath">Absolute or relative path to the <c>.zip</c> file.</param> <param name="modName">Short identifier for this mod, used in log messages and as the <see cref="Mod"/> value.</param>
public ZipModFileProvider(string zipPath,string modName){this.RootPath=zipPath;this.Mod=modName;archive=ZipFile.OpenRead(zipPath);entryLookup=new Dictionary<string,ZipArchiveEntry>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var e in archive.Entries){var name=ModPath.Normalize(e.FullName);if(name.Length>0)entryLookup[name]=e;}GameLogger.Log("MODS_ZIP",$"Opened zip '{Path.GetFileName(zipPath)}': {entryLookup.Count} entries total");foreach(var e in archive.Entries)GameLogger.Log("MODS_ZIP",$"  entry: '{e.FullName}' length={e.Length}",LogLevel.Debug);}/// <summary> Closes the underlying <see cref="ZipArchive"/> and releases the native file handle. After disposal, all read operations will fail. </summary>
public void Dispose(){archive?.Dispose();}/// <summary> Checks whether the given path exists as a zip entry using the case-insensitive lookup dictionary built during construction. </summary>
public bool FileExists(string path){var normalized=ModPath.Normalize(path);var result=entryLookup.ContainsKey(normalized);return result;}/// <summary> Returns a simulated shallow directory listing by grouping zip entries. Entries at the given directory level become file entries; entries one level deeper become synthetic directory entries suffixed with <c>/</c>. This preserves the same recursive-walk contract that <see cref="FolderModFileProvider"/> provides natively. </summary> <param name="directory">Mod-relative directory path. Empty string for the archive root.</param>
public IEnumerable<string>ListFiles(string directory=""){var prefix=ModPath.NormalizeDirectory(directory);var seen=new HashSet<string>();var yieldList=new List<string>();foreach(var entry in archive.Entries){var rawName=entry.FullName.Replace('\\','/');var isDir=rawName.EndsWith("/");var fullName=ModPath.Normalize(rawName);if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefix)||fullName.StartsWith(prefix)){var suffix=string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefix)?fullName:fullName.Substring(prefix.Length);if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(suffix))continue;var idx=suffix.IndexOf('/');if(idx>=0){var dirPart=prefix+suffix.Substring(0,idx+1);if(seen.Add(dirPart))yieldList.Add(dirPart);}else if(isDir){var dirPart=prefix+suffix+"/";if(seen.Add(dirPart))yieldList.Add(dirPart);}else{var filePath=prefix+suffix;if(seen.Add(filePath))yieldList.Add(filePath);}}}foreach(var item in yieldList)yield return item;}/// <summary> Reads the full text content of a zip entry as a UTF-8 string. Returns <c>null</c> if the entry does not exist. </summary>
public string ReadFileText(string path){var normalized=ModPath.Normalize(path);if(!entryLookup.TryGetValue(normalized,out var entry))return null;GameLogger.Log("MODS_ZIP",$"ReadFileText('{path}') norm='{normalized}' => found ({entry.Length} bytes)");using var reader=new StreamReader(entry.Open());return reader.ReadToEnd();}/// <summary> Reads the full binary content of a zip entry. Returns <c>null</c> if the entry does not exist. </summary>
public byte[]ReadFileBinary(string path){var normalized=ModPath.Normalize(path);if(!entryLookup.TryGetValue(normalized,out var entry))return null;GameLogger.Log("MODS_ZIP",$"ReadFileBinary('{path}') norm='{normalized}' => found ({entry.Length} bytes)");using var stream=entry.Open();using var ms=new MemoryStream();stream.CopyTo(ms);return ms.ToArray();}/// <summary> Opens a read-only stream to the zip entry. Returns <c>null</c> if the entry does not exist. The caller is responsible for disposing the stream. </summary>
public Stream OpenStream(string path){var normalized=ModPath.Normalize(path);if(!entryLookup.TryGetValue(normalized,out var entry))return null;GameLogger.Log("MODS_ZIP",$"OpenStream('{path}') norm='{normalized}' => found");return entry.Open();}/// <summary> Always returns <c>null</c>. Zip mods cannot provide filesystem paths — Godot's <c>ResourceLoader</c> requires real filesystem paths, so callers dependent on scene instantiation must use folder mods or extract assets to the cache first. </summary>
public string GetFileSystemPath(string path){return null;}/// <summary> Resolves a relative include path (<c>../shared/data.json</c>) against the directory of <paramref name="currentPath"/> to produce a canonical mod-relative path. Delegates to <see cref="ModPath.ResolveRelative"/> so zip and folder mods resolve includes identically. </summary>
public string ResolveIncludePath(string includePath,string currentPath){var result=ModPath.ResolveRelative(includePath,currentPath);GameLogger.Log("MODS_ZIP",$"ResolveIncludePath(include='{includePath}', current='{currentPath}') => '{result}'");return result;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Contract for a pluggable asset resolver — a subsystem that collects and resolves typed assets from loaded mods. Each resolver has a unique <see cref="Id"/> (e.g. "textures", "shaders") and is initialised with a <see cref="ModResolutionContext"/> that provides access to the mod registry and cross-resolver lookup via <see cref="ModResolutionContext.GetResolver{T}"/>. Implementations are auto-discovered by <c>Reflections.FindAndCreate</c> and registered in <see cref="ModManager"/>. Mod DLLs can ship custom resolvers that will be picked up automatically when the assembly is loaded. </summary>
public interface IModAssetResolver{/// <summary> Unique identifier for this resolver, used as a key in the resolver dictionary inside <see cref="ModManager"/>. </summary>
string Id{get;}/// <summary> Called once during mod loading to provide the resolver with access to the mod registry, file I/O helpers, and other resolvers. Must be called before <c>Collect</c> or <c>Resolve</c> methods. </summary>
void Initialize(ModResolutionContext context);/// <summary> Clears all cached data collected from mods. Called on mod reload so that the next collection picks up changes from newly loaded or unloaded mods. </summary>
void ClearCache();}}

using System.Collections.Concurrent;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Provides a generic file-list collection grouped by directory name. Iterates all loaded mods in dependency order, recursively collecting every file under a given directory group. Later mods override earlier ones for files with the same relative key (last-in-wins deduplication). Used as a building block by other resolvers — <see cref="ShaderResolver"/> and <see cref="TextureResolver"/> both delegate to this resolver for raw file discovery, then apply their own filtering and processing. </summary>
public class FileListResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"file_list";/// <summary> Per-group file cache. <see cref="ConcurrentDictionary"/> because <see cref="Collect"/> may be entered concurrently (factories, parallel tests); the inner dictionaries are built locally and only published after they are complete, so they stay read-only in the cache. A plain dictionary here used to corrupt its internal state when two threads collected the same group at once. </summary>
private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string,Dictionary<string,FileEntry>>_cache=new();/// <summary> Collects all files under the given directory group (e.g. "shaders", "textures/portraits") from every loaded mod. Files are keyed by their path relative to the group directory. Later mods in load order override earlier ones with the same relative key. Caches the result per group. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,FileEntry>Collect(string group){Context.Initialize();if(_cache.TryGetValue(group,out var cached))return cached;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"CollectFileList('{group}'): CACHE MISS, collecting from {Context.Mods.Count} mod(s)...");var result=new Dictionary<string,FileEntry>();var prefix=ModPath.NormalizeDirectory(group);foreach(var modId in Context.GetOrderedModIds()){var provider=Context.Mods[modId].FileProvider;var before=result.Count;CollectGroupFiles(provider,modId,group,prefix,result);if(result.Count>before){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"mod '{modId}' contributed {result.Count - before} file(s) to group '{group}'");}}_cache[group]=result;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"CollectFileList('{group}') → {result.Count} file(s), keys=[{string.Join(", ", result.Keys)}]");return result;}/// <inheritdoc />
public override void ClearCache(){_cache.Clear();}private static void CollectGroupFiles(IModFileProvider provider,string modId,string dir,string prefix,Dictionary<string,FileEntry>result){var entries=provider.ListFiles(dir).ToList();GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"[{modId}]  CollectGroupFiles: dir='{dir}', provider entries count={entries.Count}, prefix='{prefix}'",LogLevel.Debug);foreach(var entry in entries){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){var subDir=entry.TrimEnd('/');GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"    -> subdir '{subDir}'",LogLevel.Debug);CollectGroupFiles(provider,modId,subDir,prefix,result);}else if(entry.StartsWith(prefix)){var key=entry.Substring(prefix.Length);if(result.ContainsKey(key)){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"conflict: '{key}' in mod '{modId}' overrides previous entry",LogLevel.Warning);ModConflictRegistry.Record("file",key,modId,result[key].ModId,false);}result[key]=new FileEntry(modId,entry);GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"    + file '{key}' <- {entry} (mod={modId})",LogLevel.Debug);}else{GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"    SKIP '{entry}': does not start with prefix '{prefix}'",LogLevel.Warning);}}}}/// <summary> Static convenience accessor for <see cref="FileListResolver"/>, proxying through <see cref="ModManager.Instance.GetResolver{T}"/>. </summary>
public static class Files{public static Dictionary<string,FileEntry>Collect(string group)=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<FileListResolver>()?.Collect(group);}}

using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Bridge that wraps a GDScript object as an <see cref="IModAssetResolver"/>. Enables GDScript mods to provide custom asset resolvers without writing C# — the GDScript object must expose <c>resolver_id</c> as a property and may implement <c>initialize()</c> and <c>clear_cache()</c> methods. Unlike C# resolvers discovered via reflection, GDScript resolvers are manually instantiated and registered by <see cref="ModGDScriptLoader"/>. </summary>
public class GDScriptModAssetResolver:IModAssetResolver{private readonly GodotObject _instance;/// <summary> The resolver ID, read from the GDScript object's <c>resolver_id</c> property. Used as the key in the resolver dictionary inside <see cref="ModManager"/>. </summary>
public string Id=>(string)_instance.Get("resolver_id");/// <summary> Creates a bridge wrapping the given GDScript object. The object must have a <c>resolver_id</c> property and may optionally implement <c>initialize</c> and <c>clear_cache</c>. </summary>
public GDScriptModAssetResolver(GodotObject instance){_instance=instance;}/// <summary> Calls the GDScript object's <c>initialize()</c> method if present. Unlike the C# interface, the context is not passed to GDScript — GDScript resolvers access mod data through their own mechanisms. </summary>
public void Initialize(ModResolutionContext context){if(_instance.HasMethod("initialize"))_instance.Call("initialize");}/// <summary> Calls the GDScript object's <c>clear_cache()</c> method if present. </summary>
public void ClearCache(){if(_instance.HasMethod("clear_cache"))_instance.Call("clear_cache");}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Collects interactive object definitions from mods. Interactives are environment objects that the player can interact with in scenes — they are defined in <c>.json</c> files under <c>interactives/</c> directories. Each definition specifies an interaction type, position, appearance, and behaviour. Collected in mod load order — later mods override earlier ones for the same interactive ID, enabling mods to replace or extend base game interactives. </summary>
public class InteractiveResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"interactives";private Dictionary<string,InteractiveDefinition>_cache;/// <summary> Collects all interactive definitions from every loaded mod, keyed by interactive ID. Later mods in load order override earlier ones for the same ID. Caches the result. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,InteractiveDefinition>Collect(){Context.Initialize();if(_cache!=null)return _cache;var result=new Dictionary<string,InteractiveDefinition>();foreach(var modId in Context.GetOrderedModIds()){var provider=Context.Mods[modId].FileProvider;CollectInteractiveDefsRecursive(provider,modId,"interactives",result);}_cache=result;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"CollectInteractives -> {result.Count} definition(s)");return result;}/// <inheritdoc />
public override void ClearCache(){_cache=null;}private void CollectInteractiveDefsRecursive(IModFileProvider provider,string modId,string dir,Dictionary<string,InteractiveDefinition>result){foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles(dir)){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){var subDir=entry.TrimEnd('/');CollectInteractiveDefsRecursive(provider,modId,subDir,result);continue;}if(!entry.EndsWith(".json",System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var text=Context.ReadResolvedText(modId,entry,provider);if(text==null)continue;try{var fileData=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<FileData<InteractiveDefinition>>(text,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(fileData?.Items==null||fileData.Items.Count==0)continue;foreach(var item in fileData.Items){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ID))continue;item.ModId=modId;if(result.ContainsKey(item.ID)){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"interactive '{item.ID}' from mod '{modId}' overrides previous definition",LogLevel.Warning);ModConflictRegistry.Record("interactive",item.ID,modId,result[item.ID].ModId,false);}result[item.ID]=item;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"interactive '{item.ID}' from mod '{modId}' ({entry})");}}catch(JsonException ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"JSON parse failed for interactive '{modId}/{entry}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}}/// <summary> Static convenience accessor for <see cref="InteractiveResolver"/>, proxying through <see cref="ModManager.Instance.GetResolver{T}"/>. </summary>
public static class Interactives{public static Dictionary<string,InteractiveDefinition>Collect()=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<InteractiveResolver>()?.Collect();}}

using System.Collections.Concurrent;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Factories;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Patches;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Generic JSON entity collector. Reads <c>.json</c> files from a given directory (e.g. <c>data/items/</c>) across all mods, deserialises them as <c>FileData{T}</c>, and builds a dictionary keyed by each item's <see cref="IIdentifiable.ID"/>. Later mods override earlier ones for the same ID. After collecting base data, applies JSON property patches from <see cref="PatchResolver"/> using <see cref="JsonPatchMerger.Merge"/> — enabling mods to tweak individual properties of entities defined by other mods without replacing the entire entity. </summary>
public class JsonGroupResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"json_group";/// <summary> Type+directory keyed entity cache. <see cref="ConcurrentDictionary"/> because <see cref="Collect{T}"/> can be invoked concurrently (e.g. by parallel unit tests or factory lookups during startup) — a plain dictionary corrupts under concurrent writes. </summary>
private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string,object>_cache=new();/// <summary> Collects all entities of type <typeparamref name="T"/> from the given directory across all loaded mods. Deserialises each <c>.json</c> file as <c>FileData{T}</c>, deduplicates by ID, and applies patches from <see cref="PatchResolver"/>. Caches by type + directory combination. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,T>Collect<T>(string directory)where T:class,IIdentifiable{Context.Initialize();var cacheKey=typeof(T).FullName+"@"+directory;if(_cache.TryGetValue(cacheKey,out var cached))return(Dictionary<string,T>)cached;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"CollectJsonGroup<{typeof(T).Name}>('{directory}'): CACHE MISS, scanning {Context.Mods.Count} mod(s)...");var result=new Dictionary<string,T>();var prefix=ModPath.NormalizeDirectory(directory);var foundAny=false;foreach(var modId in Context.GetOrderedModIds()){var provider=Context.Mods[modId].FileProvider;foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles(directory)){if(entry.EndsWith("/"))continue;var relativePath=entry.StartsWith(prefix)?entry.Substring(prefix.Length):entry;if(!relativePath.EndsWith(".json",System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"  Reading json: mod='{modId}', entry='{entry}'",LogLevel.Debug);var jsonText=Context.ReadResolvedText(modId,entry,provider);if(jsonText==null){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"  ReadResolvedText returned null for '{modId}/{entry}'",LogLevel.Error);continue;}try{var fileData=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<FileData<T>>(jsonText,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(fileData?.Items==null||fileData.Items.Count==0){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"  No items in file '{entry}'",LogLevel.Error);continue;}foundAny=true;foreach(var item in fileData.Items){if(result.ContainsKey(item.ID)){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"'{item.ID}' from mod '{modId}' overrides previous Each patch specifies a target entity ID, a property path, and the value to apply. Also reads flat patch files named <c>patches/{entityType}.json</c> for simpler single-file patch sets. The collected patches are applied by <see cref="JsonGroupResolver"/> after collecting base entity data — patches from later mods override earlier ones. </summary>
public class PatchResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"patches";/// <summary> Per-entity-type patch cache. <see cref="ConcurrentDictionary"/> because resolution may be triggered concurrently (e.g. by parallel unit tests bootstrapping mods through <see cref="Context.Initialize"/>) — a plain dictionary corrupts under concurrent writes. </summary>
private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string,Dictionary<string,List<PropertyPatch>>>_cache=new();/// <summary> Collects all patches for the given entity type from every loaded mod. public static class Patches{public static Dictionary<string,List<PropertyPatch>>Collect(string entityType)=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<PatchResolver>()?.Collect(entityType);}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Collects scene definitions from mods. A scene definition describes a playable scene — its name, default ambient, default scenario, and backgrounds. Mods can define scenes in <c>scenes/</c> via <c>.json</c> files. When multiple mods define the same scene name, the first mod's definition is the base, and subsequent mods merge their values on top — enabling mods to extend a base scene with additional backgrounds or change the default scenario. </summary>
public class SceneDefinitionResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"scene_definitions";private Dictionary<string,List<SceneDefinition>>_cache;/// <summary> Collects all scene definitions from every loaded mod. The first mod that defines a scene name becomes the base; subsequent mods merge extra backgrounds and override the default ambient and scenario via <c>MergeSceneDef</c>. Caches the result. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,List<SceneDefinition>>Collect(){Context.Initialize();if(_cache!=null)return _cache;var result=new Dictionary<string,List<SceneDefinition>>();var foundAny=false;foreach(var modId in Context.GetOrderedModIds()){var provider=Context.Mods[modId].FileProvider;CollectSceneDefsRecursive(provider,modId,"scenes",result,ref foundAny);}if(!foundAny){GameLogger.Log("MODS","CollectSceneDefinitions — no scene definitions found",LogLevel.Error);}_cache=result;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"CollectSceneDefinitions → {result.Count} scene(s)");return result;}/// <inheritdoc />
public override void ClearCache(){_cache=null;}private void CollectSceneDefsRecursive(IModFileProvider provider,string modId,string dir,Dictionary<string,List<SceneDefinition>>result,ref bool foundAny){foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles(dir)){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){var subDir=entry.TrimEnd('/');CollectSceneDefsRecursive(provider,modId,subDir,result,ref foundAny);continue;}if(!entry.EndsWith(".json",System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var text=Context.ReadResolvedText(modId,entry,provider);if(text==null)continue;try{var def=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SceneDefinition>(text,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(def==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(def.Name))continue;def.ModId=modId;foundAny=true;if(!result.TryGetValue(def.Name,out var list)){list=new List<SceneDefinition>();result[def.Name]=list;list.Add(def);}else{var baseDef=list[0];MergeSceneDef(baseDef,def);GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"scene '{def.Name}' from mod '{modId}' merged with base from '{baseDef.ModId}'");}GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"scene '{def.Name}' from mod '{modId}' ({entry})");}catch(JsonException ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"JSON parse failed for scene '{modId}/{entry}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}private static void MergeSceneDef(SceneDefinition baseDef,SceneDefinition incoming){if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(incoming.DefaultAmbient))baseDef.DefaultAmbient=incoming.DefaultAmbient;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(incoming.DefaultScenario))baseDef.DefaultScenario=incoming.DefaultScenario;if(incoming.DefaultBackground?.Count>0){baseDef.DefaultBackground??=new List<string>();baseDef.DefaultBackground.AddRange(incoming.DefaultBackground);}}}/// <summary> Static convenience accessor for <see cref="SceneDefinitionResolver"/>, proxying through <see cref="ModManager.Instance.GetResolver{T}"/>. </summary>
public static class SceneDefinitions{public static Dictionary<string,List<SceneDefinition>>Collect()=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<SceneDefinitionResolver>()?.Collect();}}

using System;using System.Collections.Concurrent;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Caches;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Providers;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Collects and resolves <c>.gdshader</c> files from mods. Uses <see cref="FileListResolver"/> to get the raw list of shader files grouped by logical name, then resolves each one to a Godot <see cref="Shader"/> resource. For folder mods the shader is loaded directly via <c>GD.Load</c> from the filesystem path. For zip mods the shader is extracted to the mod cache first via <see cref="ModCacheManager.ExtractShaders"/>. Caching is two-layer: a resolved-cache for already-loaded <see cref="Shader"/> instances, and the disk-based mod cache for extracted files. </summary>
public class ShaderResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"shaders";/// <summary> Collected shader file entries. The reference is written once after the build completes, hence <c>volatile</c> so other threads observe the fully-populated dictionary instead of a stale null. </summary>
private volatile Dictionary<string,FileEntry>_fileCache;/// <summary> Resolved Godot shaders, keyed by logical name. <see cref="ConcurrentDictionary"/> because <see cref="Resolve"/> and <see cref="ClearCache"/> may run from different threads; a plain dictionary corrupts under concurrent writes. </summary>
private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string,Shader>_resolvedCache=new();/// <summary> Collects all shader file entries from mods via <see cref="FileListResolver"/>. Filters to <c>.gdshader</c> files only (excluding <c>.gdshaderinclude</c>). Caches the result so subsequent calls return the same dictionary. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,FileEntry>Collect(){Context.Initialize();if(_fileCache!=null)return _fileCache;var fileListResolver=Context.GetResolver<FileListResolver>();var raw=fileListResolver?.Collect("shaders")??new Dictionary<string,FileEntry>();var result=new Dictionary<string,FileEntry>();foreach(var kvp in raw){if(kvp.Key.EndsWith(".gdshader",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)&& !kvp.Key.EndsWith(".gdshaderinclude",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){var shaderName=kvp.Key.Substring(0,kvp.Key.Length-".gdshader".Length);result[shaderName]=kvp.Value;}}_fileCache=result;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"CollectShaders → {result.Count} shader(s)");return result;}/// <summary> Resolves a shader by logical name. Returns the Godot <see cref="Shader"/> resource, loading from disk cache or extracting from the mod provider as needed. </summary>
public Shader Resolve(string shaderName){var cached=TryGetCached(shaderName);if(cached!=null)return cached;if(ModCacheManager.IsShaderCached(shaderName)){var cachedPath=ModCacheManager.GetShaderCachePath(shaderName);var cachedShader=GD.Load<Shader>(cachedPath);if(cachedShader!=null){_resolvedCache[shaderName]=cachedShader;return cachedShader;}}var shaders=Collect();if(!shaders.TryGetValue(shaderName,out var entry)){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveShader: '{shaderName}' not found in any mod",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var mod=Context.GetMod(entry.ModId);if(mod==null){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveShader: owning mod '{entry.ModId}' of '{shaderName}' is not loaded",LogLevel.Error);return null;}if(mod.FileProvider is FolderModFileProvider){var fsPath=mod.FileProvider.GetFileSystemPath(entry.FullPath);if(fsPath==null){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveShader: '{shaderName}' file '{entry.FullPath}' missing on disk in mod '{entry.ModId}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var shader=GD.Load<Shader>(fsPath);if(shader!=null)_resolvedCache[shaderName]=shader;return shader;}ModCacheManager.ExtractShaders(entry.ModId,mod.FileProvider);if(ModCacheManager.IsShaderCached(shaderName)){var extractedPath=ModCacheManager.GetShaderCachePath(shaderName);var extractedShader=GD.Load<Shader>(extractedPath);if(extractedShader!=null)_resolvedCache[shaderName]=extractedShader;return extractedShader;}GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveShader: '{shaderName}' failed to extract from mod '{entry.ModId}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}/// <summary> Returns a previously resolved shader from the in-memory cache, validated with <c>GodotObject.IsInstanceValid</c>. Returns <c>null</c> if not cached or the cached instance was freed. </summary>
public Shader TryGetCached(string shaderName){if(_resolvedCache.TryGetValue(shaderName,out var cached)&&GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(cached))return cached;return null;}/// <inheritdoc />
public override void ClearCache(){_fileCache=null;_resolvedCache.Clear();}}/// <summary> Static convenience accessor for <see cref="ShaderResolver"/>, proxying through <see cref="ModManager.Instance.GetResolver{T}"/>. </summary>
public static class Shaders{public static Dictionary<string,FileEntry>Collect()=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<ShaderResolver>()?.Collect();public static Shader Resolve(string name)=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<ShaderResolver>()?.Resolve(name);public static Shader TryGetCached(string name)=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<ShaderResolver>()?.TryGetCached(name);}}

using System;using System.Collections.Concurrent;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Collects and resolves texture files (PNG, JPG, WebP) from mods. Textures are grouped into logical directories defined by <see cref="ModConfig.TextureGroups"/> (e.g. "textures/portraits", "textures/backgrounds"). Files are collected via <see cref="FileListResolver"/>, filtered by the configured texture extensions, and deduplicated — later mods in load order override earlier ones with the same logical name. Resolution decodes the raw image bytes into a Godot <see cref="ImageTexture"/> and caches the result in memory. </summary>
public class TextureResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"textures";/// <summary> Collected file entries. The reference is written once after the build completes, hence <c>volatile</c> so other threads observe the fully-populated dictionary instead of a stale null. </summary>
private volatile Dictionary<string,FileEntry>_fileCache;/// <summary> Resolved Godot textures, keyed by logical name. <see cref="ConcurrentDictionary"/> because <see cref="Resolve"/> and <see cref="ClearCache"/> may run from different threads; a plain dictionary corrupts under concurrent writes. </summary>
private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string,Texture2D>_resolvedCache=new();/// <summary> Collects all texture file entries from every configured texture group directory. Deduplicates by logical name (filename without extension) — later mods in load order win. Caches the result for subsequent calls. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,FileEntry>Collect(){Context.Initialize();if(_fileCache!=null)return _fileCache;var result=new Dictionary<string,FileEntry>();var textureGroups=ModConfig.Instance.TextureGroups;var textureExts=ModConfig.Instance.GetTextureExtensionSet();var fileListResolver=Context.GetResolver<FileListResolver>();if(fileListResolver==null){_fileCache=result;return result;}foreach(var group in textureGroups){var files=fileListResolver.Collect(group);foreach(var kvp in files){var ext=Path.GetExtension(kvp.Key);if(textureExts.Contains(ext)){var textureName=Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(kvp.Key);if(result.ContainsKey(textureName)){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"texture conflict: '{textureName}' from mod '{kvp.Value.ModId}' overrides previous",LogLevel.Warning);ModConflictRegistry.Record("texture",textureName,kvp.Value.ModId,result[textureName].ModId,false);}result[textureName]=kvp.Value;}}}_fileCache=result;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"CollectTextures → {result.Count} texture(s)");return result;}/// <summary> Resolves a texture by logical name, decoding the raw image bytes into a Godot <see cref="ImageTexture"/>. Supports PNG, JPG, and WebP formats. Returns <c>null</c> on decode failure or if the texture is not found in any mod. <see cref="Collect"/> keys textures by basename only, so an ID with a directory prefix (e.g. <c>"prolog/cloak_ground"</c>) would miss on the exact lookup. As a fallback the ID is also matched against the full relative path without extension and against the basename, letting callers address textures the same way the editor's <c>BackgroundFactory</c> does. </summary>
public Texture2D Resolve(string textureName){var cached=TryGetCached(textureName);if(cached!=null)return cached;var textures=Collect();if(!textures.TryGetValue(textureName,out var entry)){entry=FindByPathOrBasename(textures,textureName);if(entry.ModId==null){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveTexture: '{textureName}' not found in any mod",LogLevel.Error);return null;}}var data=Context.ReadFileBinary(entry.ModId,entry.FullPath);if(data==null){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveTexture: '{textureName}' could not be read from mod '{entry.ModId}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var ext=Path.GetExtension(entry.FullPath)?.ToLowerInvariant();var image=new Image();Error loadError;if(ext==".png")loadError=image.LoadPngFromBuffer(data);else if(ext==".jpg"||ext==".jpeg")loadError=image.LoadJpgFromBuffer(data);else if(ext==".webp")loadError=image.LoadWebpFromBuffer(data);else{GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveTexture: unsupported extension '{ext}' for '{textureName}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}if(loadError!=Error.Ok){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveTexture: image decode failed for '{textureName}' ({loadError})",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var texture=ImageTexture.CreateFromImage(image);image.Dispose();if(texture!=null)_resolvedCache[textureName]=texture;return texture;}/// <summary> Locates a texture entry when the exact basename lookup misses. First tries the full relative path without extension (so <c>"prolog/cloak_ground"</c> matches <c>"prolog/cloak_ground.png"</c>), then falls back to the bare filename (so a flat <c>"lamp"</c> ID keeps working regardless of which texture group directory it lives in). Matching is case-insensitive. Returns a default <see cref="FileEntry"/> when nothing matches. </summary>
private static FileEntry FindByPathOrBasename(Dictionary<string,FileEntry>textures,string textureName){var normalized=textureName.Replace('\\','/');foreach(var kvp in textures){var pathNoExt=Path.ChangeExtension(kvp.Key,null)?.TrimEnd('.');if(string.Equals(pathNoExt,normalized,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return kvp.Value;}foreach(var kvp in textures){var baseName=Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(kvp.Key);if(string.Equals(baseName,textureName,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return kvp.Value;}return default;}/// <summary> Returns a previously resolved texture from the in-memory cache, validated with <c>GodotObject.IsInstanceValid</c>. </summary>
public Texture2D TryGetCached(string textureName){if(_resolvedCache.TryGetValue(textureName,out var cached)&&GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(cached))return cached;return null;}/// <inheritdoc />
public override void ClearCache(){_fileCache=null;_resolvedCache.Clear();}}/// <summary> Static convenience accessor for <see cref="TextureResolver"/>, proxying through <see cref="ModManager.Instance.GetResolver{T}"/>. </summary>
public static class Textures{public static Dictionary<string,FileEntry>Collect()=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<TextureResolver>()?.Collect();public static Texture2D Resolve(string name)=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<TextureResolver>()?.Resolve(name);public static Texture2D TryGetCached(string name)=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<TextureResolver>()?.TryGetCached(name);}}

public override string Id=>"wrappers";private List<WrapperDefinition>_cache;/// <summary> Collects all wrapper template definitions from every loaded mod. Templates are read from <c>wrappers/</c> directories and identified by filename without extension. Caches the result. </summary>
public List<WrapperDefinition>Collect(){Context.Initialize();if(_cache!=null)return _cache;var result=new List<WrapperDefinition>();foreach(var modId in Context.GetOrderedModIds()){var provider=Context.Mods[modId].FileProvider;CollectWrapperDefsRecursive(provider,modId,"wrappers",result);}_cache=result;return result;}/// <inheritdoc />
public override void ClearCache(){_cache=null;}private static void CollectWrapperDefsRecursive(IModFileProvider provider,string modId,string dir,List<WrapperDefinition>result){foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles(dir)){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){var subDir=entry.TrimEnd('/');CollectWrapperDefsRecursive(provider,modId,subDir,result);continue;}if(!entry.EndsWith(".wrappertmpl",System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var text=provider.ReadFileText(entry);if(text==null)continue;var name=Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(entry.Replace('\\','/').Split('/')[^1]);result.Add(new WrapperDefinition{ModId=modId,Name=name,Content=text});}}}/// <summary> Static convenience accessor for <see cref="WrapperTemplateResolver"/>, proxying through <see cref="ModManager.Instance.GetResolver{T}"/>. </summary>
public static class WrapperTemplates{public static List<WrapperDefinition>Collect()=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<WrapperTemplateResolver>()?.Collect();}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Convenience base class for <see cref="IModAssetResolver"/> implementations. Stores the <see cref="ModResolutionContext"/> reference provided by <see cref="Initialize"/> so that derived classes can access the mod registry and cross-resolver lookup without manual plumbing. </summary>
public abstract class ModAssetResolver:IModAssetResolver{/// <summary> Unique identifier for this resolver. Must be overridden by derived classes (e.g. "textures", "shaders", "scenarios"). </summary>
public abstract string Id{get;}/// <summary> The <see cref="ModResolutionContext"/> provided during <see cref="Initialize"/>. Gives access to the mod registry, file I/O helpers, and cross-resolver lookup via <see cref="ModResolutionContext.GetResolver{T}"/>. </summary>
protected ModResolutionContext Context{get;private set;}/// <summary> Stores the context reference for use by derived classes. Override to add custom initialisation logic — always call <c>base.Initialize(context)</c> first. </summary>
public virtual void Initialize(ModResolutionContext context){Context=context;}/// <summary> Clears all cached data. Must be overridden by derived classes to reset their collection caches so the next collection picks up changes from newly loaded or unloaded mods. </summary>
public abstract void ClearCache();}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using System.Text.RegularExpressions;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Provides resolvers with a unified API for accessing the mod registry, reading files from mod providers, resolving JSON with <c>${include}</c> directives, and looking up other resolvers. Created internally by <see cref="ModManager"/> and injected into each <see cref="IModAssetResolver"/> via <see cref="IModAssetResolver.Initialize"/>. All file I/O methods route through the mod's <see cref="IModFileProvider"/>, which means they work identically for folder mods and zip mods — the resolver never branches on storage format. </summary>
public class ModResolutionContext{private readonly ModRegistry _registry;private Dictionary<string,IModAssetResolver>_resolvers;internal ModResolutionContext(ModRegistry registry){_registry=registry;}internal void SetResolvers(Dictionary<string,IModAssetResolver>resolvers){_resolvers=resolvers;}/// <summary>Read-only snapshot of currently loaded mods.</summary>
public IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IModInfo>Mods=>_registry.Mods;/// <summary>Whether the registry has completed initialisation.</summary>
public bool IsInitialized=>_registry.IsInitialized;/// <summary>Idempotent bootstrap of the mod registry.</summary>
public void Initialize(){_registry.Initialize();}/// <summary>Discards all loaded mods and re-runs discovery.</summary>
public void Reload(){_registry.Reload();}/// <summary>Returns mod IDs in dependency-respecting order.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>GetOrderedModIds(bool filterDisabled=true)=>_registry.GetOrderedModIds(filterDisabled);/// <summary>Looks up a mod by ID from the registry.</summary>
public IModInfo GetMod(string id){return _registry.GetMod(id);}/// <summary> Checks whether the given mod-relative path exists inside the specified mod's provider. </summary>
public bool FileExists(string modId,string path){var mod=GetMod(modId);return mod?.FileProvider?.FileExists(path)??false;}/// <summary> Lists files and directories at the given mod-relative path inside the specified mod. Directories are suffixed with <c>/</c>. </summary>
public IEnumerable<string>ListFiles(string modId,string directory=""){var mod=GetMod(modId);if(mod==null)return Enumerable.Empty<string>();return mod.FileProvider.ListFiles(directory);}/// <summary>Reads a text file from the specified mod's provider.</summary>
public string ReadFileText(string modId,string path){var mod=GetMod(modId);if(mod==null)return null;return mod.FileProvider.ReadFileText(path);}/// <summary>Reads a binary file from the specified mod's provider.</summary>
public byte[]ReadFileBinary(string modId,string path){var mod=GetMod(modId);if(mod==null)return null;return mod.FileProvider.ReadFileBinary(path);}/// <summary> Opens a read-only stream to a file inside the specified mod's provider. The caller must dispose the stream. </summary>
public Stream OpenStream(string modId,string path){var mod=GetMod(modId);if(mod==null)return null;return mod.FileProvider.OpenStream(path);}/// <summary> Returns the absolute filesystem path for a mod-relative path, or <c>null</c> for zip mods (which cannot provide filesystem access). </summary>
public string GetFileSystemPath(string modId,string path){var mod=GetMod(modId);if(mod==null)return null;return mod.FileProvider.GetFileSystemPath(path);}/// <summary> Reads a text file and recursively resolves all <c>${ path/to/include }</c> directives within it, returning the fully-expanded text. Circular includes are detected and reported as errors. </summary>
public string ReadResolvedText(string modId,string path){var mod=GetMod(modId);if(mod==null)return null;var content=mod.FileProvider.ReadFileText(path);if(content==null)return null;try{var visited=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase){path};return ExpandModIncludes(mod.FileProvider,content,path,visited);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"Include resolution failed for '{modId}/{path}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return null;}}/// <summary> Overload of <see cref="ReadResolvedText(string, string)"/> that uses an explicit provider instead of the mod's built-in one. Useful for resolving includes from unpacked or temporary files. </summary>
public string ReadResolvedText(string modId,string path,IModFileProvider providerOverride){var content=providerOverride.ReadFileText(path);if(content==null)return null;try{var visited=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase){path};return ExpandModIncludes(providerOverride,content,path,visited);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"Include resolution failed for '{modId}/{path}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return null;}}/// <summary> Reads a JSON file with include resolution and deserialises it to the requested type. Returns <c>null</c> on any error. </summary>
public T ReadJson<T>(string modId,string path)where T:class{var text=ReadResolvedText(modId,path);if(text==null)return null;try{return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(text,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);}catch(JsonException ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"JSON deserialize failed for '{modId}/{path}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return null;}}/// <summary> Returns a registered resolver of the specified type, or <c>null</c> if not found. Used for cross-resolver dependencies — e.g. <see cref="ShaderResolver"/> looks up <see cref="FileListResolver"/> to get the raw file list. </summary>
internal T GetResolver<T>()where T:class,IModAssetResolver{if(_resolvers==null)return null;return _resolvers.Values.OfType<T>().FirstOrDefault();}private static readonly Regex _includePattern=new Regex(@"\$\s*\{\s*([^{}]+)\s*\}",RegexOptions.Compiled);/// <summary> Recursively processes <c>${ path }</c> include directives in a text file, replacing each directive with the content of the referenced file. Detects circular includes and missing files. Shared statically so that it can be used in tests without a full <see cref="ModResolutionContext"/>. </summary>
public static string ExpandModIncludes(IModFileProvider provider,string content,string currentPath,HashSet<string>visited){return _includePattern.Replace(content,match=>{var includePath=match.Groups[1].Value.Trim();if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(includePath))throw new InvalidOperationException("Empty include path in ${}.");var resolvedPath=provider.ResolveIncludePath(includePath,currentPath);var loaded=provider.ReadFileText(resolvedPath);if(loaded==null)loaded=provider.ReadFileText(resolvedPath+".json");if(loaded==null)throw new InvalidOperationException($"Include not found: '{resolvedPath}' (from '${{{includePath}}}').");if(visited.Contains(resolvedPath))throw new InvalidOperationException($"Circular include detected: {resolvedPath}");visited.Add(resolvedPath);try{var expanded=ExpandModIncludes(provider,loaded,resolvedPath,visited);return expanded.Trim();}finally{visited.Remove(resolvedPath);}});}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Maps script file paths and class names to compiled C# <see cref="System.Type"/> objects across all loaded mods, respecting mod load-order priority. <para/> Populated by <see cref="ModCompiler"/> after each mod's C# source is compiled. Each mod contributes a {path → Type} and {name → Type} mapping. <para/> Resolution order: 1. <see cref="ResolveByPath"/> — iterates mods in priority order, returns first match 2. <see cref="ResolveByName"/> — same priority-ordered search by class name / full name 3. <see cref="Resolve"/> — tries path first, falls back to file-name → class-name lookup <para/> This is the bridge between a .tscn's <c>path="scripts/MyScript.cs"</c> reference and the actual <c>Type</c> in the compiled mod assembly. Paths are normalized (stripped of <c>res://</c> prefix, backslashes → forward slashes) before lookup. </summary>
public static class ScriptTypeRegistry{private static readonly Dictionary<string,Dictionary<string,Type>>_modPathToType=new();private static readonly Dictionary<string,Dictionary<string,Type>>_modNameToType=new();private static readonly List<Type>_allTypes=new();private static List<(string ModId,int Priority)>_orderedModIds;static ScriptTypeRegistry(){RegisterCoreAssembly(typeof(ScriptTypeRegistry).Assembly);}/// <summary> Registers the main game assembly's Node types as the lowest-priority fallback. Mod-provided scenes reference core behaviours by their <c>res://Core/...cs</c> path; <see cref="Resolve"/> has no path entry for them, so it falls through to <see cref="ResolveByName"/>, which needs these types. Mod assemblies registered later still win because their name maps are consulted before the fallback list. </summary>
public static void RegisterCoreAssembly(Assembly assembly){if(assembly==null)return;try{foreach(var type in assembly.GetTypes()){if(!type.IsClass||type.IsAbstract|| !typeof(Godot.Node).IsAssignableFrom(type))continue;if(!_allTypes.Contains(type))_allTypes.Add(type);}}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ScriptTypeRegistry: failed to scan core assembly: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}public static void SetModOrder(List<(string ModId,int Priority)>orderedMods){_orderedModIds=orderedMods;}public static void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly,string modId,IEnumerable<(string FilePath,string Source)>sourceFiles){if(!_modPathToType.ContainsKey(modId)){_modPathToType[modId]=new Dictionary<string,Type>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);_modNameToType[modId]=new Dictionary<string,Type>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);}var pathDict=_modPathToType[modId];var nameDict=_modNameToType[modId];var types=assembly.GetTypes();foreach(var type in types){if(!type.IsClass||type.IsAbstract)continue;if(!typeof(Godot.Node).IsAssignableFrom(type))continue;_allTypes.Add(type);var typeName=type.Name;if(!nameDict.ContainsKey(typeName))nameDict[typeName]=type;var fullName=type.FullName;if(!nameDict.ContainsKey(fullName))nameDict[fullName]=type;}foreach(var(filePath,_)in sourceFiles){var relative=NormalizePath(filePath);var fileName=System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(relative);if(nameDict.TryGetValue(fileName,out var t)){if(!pathDict.ContainsKey(relative))pathDict[relative]=t;}else{foreach(var type in types){if(!type.IsClass||type.IsAbstract|| !typeof(Godot.Node).IsAssignableFrom(type))continue;if(type.Name.Equals(fileName,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){if(!pathDict.ContainsKey(relative))pathDict[relative]=type;break;}}}}}public static Type ResolveByPath(string tscnPath){var normalized=NormalizePath(tscnPath);if(_orderedModIds!=null){foreach(var(modId,_)in _orderedModIds){if(_modPathToType.TryGetValue(modId,out var pathDict)&&pathDict.TryGetValue(normalized,out var type))return type;}}foreach(var kvp in _modPathToType){if(kvp.Value.TryGetValue(normalized,out var type))return type;}return null;}public static Type ResolveByName(string className){if(_orderedModIds!=null){foreach(var(modId,_)in _orderedModIds){if(_modNameToType.TryGetValue(modId,out var nameDict)&&nameDict.TryGetValue(className,out var type))return type;}}foreach(var kvp in _modNameToType){if(kvp.Value.TryGetValue(className,out var type))return type;}return _allTypes.FirstOrDefault(t=>t.Name.Equals(className,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)||t.FullName.Equals(className,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));}public static Type Resolve(string tscnPath){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(tscnPath))return null;if(!tscnPath.Contains("/")&& !tscnPath.Contains("\\")&& !tscnPath.Contains("."))return ResolveByName(tscnPath);var result=ResolveByPath(tscnPath);if(result!=null)return result;var fileName=System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(tscnPath);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))return ResolveByName(fileName);return null;}public static void Clear(){_modPathToType.Clear();_modNameToType.Clear();_allTypes.Clear();_orderedModIds=null;RegisterCoreAssembly(typeof(ScriptTypeRegistry).Assembly);}private static string NormalizePath(string path){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))return path;if(path.StartsWith("res://",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))path=path.Substring(6);return ModPath.Normalize(path);}}}

using System.Text.Json.Serialization;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> JSON DTO for one entry of a mod manifest's <c>ui</c> array — the single, manifest-driven way a mod declares a GUI element (no C# registration API). <para/> Two kinds exist. <see cref="KindPanel"/> is a button-toggled panel: the UI registry owns a toolbar button for it and is the only one allowed to change its visibility. <see cref="KindOverlay"/> has no button; the element's own code decides when it is visible (optionally auto-shown by <see cref="ShowOnStart"/>). <para/> Entries are validated at startup by <c>UiRegistry.Initialize</c>; invalid entries are logged and skipped. <see cref="ModId"/> and <see cref="ModOrderIndex"/> are filled in during collection and never come from JSON — they carry the owning mod and its load-order position, which are needed to break ordering ties deterministically. </summary>
public class UiEntry{/// <summary>Panel kind: has a toolbar button, visibility owned by the registry.</summary>
public const string KindPanel="panel";/// <summary>Overlay kind: no button, visibility owned by the element's own code.</summary>
public const string KindOverlay="overlay";/// <summary>Unique within the owning mod; doubles as the runtime cache key and Toggle target.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("id")]public string Id{get;set;}/// <summary>Either <see cref="KindPanel"/> or <see cref="KindOverlay"/>.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("kind")]public string Kind{get;set;}/// <summary> Optional logical scene this GUI belongs to. When set, the GUI is only available in that scene and is hidden when leaving it. When absent the GUI is scene-independent and lives for the whole session. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("scene")]public string Scene{get;set;}/// <summary>Name of the anchor slot node (e.g. "ModBeforeUIPanel", "Lastground").</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("slot")]public string Slot{get;set;}/// <summary>Mod-relative path to the .tscn scene, resolved through TscnScenes.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("scene_path")]public string ScenePath{get;set;}/// <summary> When true the instance lives for the whole application; when false it is created on scene entry and freed on scene exit. Panels are always treated as <c>true</c> during collection. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("once")]public bool Once{get;set;}/// <summary> Overlays only: when true the element is shown as soon as its scene is entered; when false (default) it waits for a registry Toggle or its own code. Ignored for panels. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("show_on_start")]public bool ShowOnStart{get;set;}/// <summary>Layer/order inside the anchor slot. Defaults to 10; optional.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("priority")]public int Priority{get;set;}=10;/// <summary>Present only for <see cref="KindPanel"/>; forbidden for overlays.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("button")]public UiButtonEntry Button{get;set;}/// <summary>Owning mod id, filled during collection.</summary>
[JsonIgnore]public string ModId{get;set;}/// <summary>Position of the owning mod in load order, filled during collection.</summary>
[JsonIgnore]public int ModOrderIndex{get;set;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Events;namespace Cthangover.Core.Quests{/// <summary> Primary concrete implementation of <see cref="IQuest"/> that serves as both the runtime quest instance (created by <see cref="QuestFactory"/> from <see cref="QuestDefinition"/> data) and the serialization unit written into save files. Because it is marked <c>[Serializable]</c>, Godot's JSON serialization can round-trip the entire quest graph — including the mutable <see cref="Data"/> payload — when the player saves or loads a game. The <see cref="StatusToDescription"/> dictionary maps raw <see cref="QuestStatus"/> integer values to localised description strings that the journal UI renders for each progression stage. </summary>
[Serializable]public class QuestBase:IQuest{/// <summary> Unique string identifier matching the quest's definition key in the mod data. Used by <see cref="QuestFactory.Get"/> for lookup and preserved in save files so that loaded state can be reattached to the correct definition. </summary>
public string ID{get;set;}/// <summary> Localised display name shown in the quest journal and notification banners. This value originates from the mod definition file and is translated before display. </summary>
public string Name{get;set;}/// <summary> Current progression state of the quest. Defaults to <see cref="QuestStatus.NotStarted"/>. This property is updated at runtime by quest‑advancement logic and restored from save data by <see cref="QuestFactory.SetAll"/>. </summary>
public QuestStatus Status{get;set;}=QuestStatus.NotStarted;/// <summary> Mutable runtime payload holding the quest's numeric status and the collection of string tags accumulated during gameplay. The factory overwrites this object when restoring a save file via <see cref="QuestFactory.SetAll"/>, so any modifications to tags or status through <see cref="AddTag"/>, <see cref="RemoveTag"/>, or <see cref="QuestData.SetStatus"/> persist until the next load. </summary>
public QuestData Data{get;set;}=new QuestData();/// <summary> Lookup table that maps integer <see cref="QuestStatus"/> values to human‑readable description strings. The journal window uses this to select which narrative text to display underneath the quest title as the player advances through <c>NotStarted</c>, <c>Progress</c>, and <c>End</c> states. </summary>
public IDictionary<int,string>StatusToDescription{get;set;}=new Dictionary<int,string>();/// <summary> Returns <c>true</c> when <paramref name="tag"/> is present in the underlying <see cref="Data"/>.<see cref="QuestData.Tags"/> set. Tags act as boolean flags for sub‑objective completion; dialogue conditions and scene‑transition gates call this to decide whether a particular branch should be available. </summary>
public bool ContainsTag(string tag){return Data.Tags.Contains(tag);}/// <summary> Syntactic negation helper that returns <c>true</c> when <paramref name="tag"/> is absent from the quest's tag set. Exists so that scenario scripts can express "tag not yet earned" conditions as a direct method call without writing a negation operator in YAML condition strings. </summary>
public bool NotContainsTag(string tag){return!ContainsTag(tag);}/// <summary> Inserts <paramref name="tag"/> into the mutable <see cref="Data"/>.<see cref="QuestData.Tags"/> set, marking a sub‑objective or milestone as completed. Typically called from scenario action nodes or dialogue event handlers when the player reaches a logical checkpoint. Publishes a <see cref="QuestTagChangedEvent"/> only when the tag was actually added (duplicates are a no-op and publish nothing), so condition caches invalidate exactly on real change. </summary>
public void AddTag(string tag){if(Data.Tags.Add(tag))ModEventBus.Publish(new QuestTagChangedEvent{QuestId=ID,Tag=tag,Added=true});}/// <summary> Removes <paramref name="tag"/> from the mutable <see cref="Data"/>.<see cref="QuestData.Tags"/> set, effectively revoking a previously earned milestone. Useful for branching narratives where the player can lose access to a completed sub‑objective through a different choice path. Publishes a <see cref="QuestTagChangedEvent"/> only when the tag was actually present and removed. </summary>
public void RemoveTag(string tag){if(Data.Tags.Remove(tag))ModEventBus.Publish(new QuestTagChangedEvent{QuestId=ID,Tag=tag,Added=false});}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Events;namespace Cthangover.Core.Quests{/// <summary> Serialisable payload that holds the mutable, per‑save‑file runtime state of a single quest. Separating this from the immutable <see cref="QuestDefinition"/> allows the save system to persist only the dirty data (current status and earned tags) without duplicating the static definition fields that are reloaded from mod JSON every session. An instance of this class lives inside <see cref="QuestBase.Data"/> and is replaced wholesale by <see cref="QuestFactory.SetAll"/> when the player loads a game. </summary>
[Serializable]public class QuestData{/// <summary> Numeric representation of the current quest stage, castable to <see cref="QuestStatus"/>. The journal UI maps this to a description string via <see cref="QuestBase.StatusToDescription"/>. </summary>
public int Status{get;set;}/// <summary> Set of string tags earned during this playthrough. Each tag represents a branching milestone or sub‑objective; scenario scripts query membership via <see cref="IQuest.ContainsTag"/> to gate dialogue options and scene transitions. </summary>
public HashSet<string>Tags{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> Sets the numeric status to <paramref name="value"/>, advancing (or potentially resetting) the quest's progression stage. Publishes a <see cref="QuestDataStatusChangedEvent"/> only when the value actually changed, so cached condition results invalidate on real change rather than on every redundant assignment. </summary>
public void SetStatus(int value){if(Status==value)return;ModEventBus.Publish(new QuestDataStatusChangedEvent{Old=Status,New=value});Status=value;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Factories;namespace Cthangover.Core.Quests{/// <summary> Immutable data template loaded from a mod's JSON group file (stored under the <c>"quests"</c> key). Each definition carries the quest's identity, display name, and a mapping from <see cref="QuestStatus"/> integer values to localised description strings. <see cref="QuestFactory"/> reads these definitions once on initialisation and uses them to seed <see cref="QuestBase"/> runtime instances. The definition itself never changes during gameplay; all mutable progression lives in <see cref="QuestData"/>. Implements <see cref="IIdentifiable"/> so the factory can store quest definitions in a keyed collection. </summary>
public class QuestDefinition:IIdentifiable{/// <summary> Unique string key used both as the JSON filename (minus extension) in the mod archive and as the lookup key inside <see cref="QuestFactory"/>'s internal dictionary. </summary>
public string ID{get;set;}/// <summary> Display name of the quest as written in the mod definition; passed through <c>TranslationServer.Translate</c> before being shown in the journal or notification banners. </summary>

===== FILE Core/Quests/QuestFactory.cs =====
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Quests{/// <summary> Thread‑safe singleton that manages the entire lifecycle of <see cref="QuestBase"/> instances: lazy initialisation from mod JSON definitions, on‑demand lookup by ID, and restoration of mutable state when the player loads a save file. The factory defers loading until the first access (via <see cref="Get"/> or <see cref="GetAll"/>) and guards against re‑initialisation through the <c>isLoaded</c> flag. Because quest definitions come from <see cref="QuestDefinition"/> objects read by <see cref="ModManager.GetResolver<JsonGroupResolver>()?.Collect<T>()"/>, the factory remains decoupled from any single storage format — new mods can register quests simply by placing JSON files in the correct group folder. </summary>
public class QuestFactory{private static Lazy<QuestFactory>instance=new(()=>new QuestFactory());/// <summary> The single global access point for quest lookup and save‑state restoration. The underlying <c>Lazy&lt;T&gt;</c> ensures that the factory is constructed on first access, avoiding order‑ dependent initialisation races with other subsystems. </summary>
public static QuestFactory Instance=>instance.Value;private readonly IDictionary<string,QuestBase>dataByID=new Dictionary<string,QuestBase>();private bool isLoaded;private QuestFactory(){}/// <summary> Seeds the internal <c>dataByID</c> dictionary from mod JSON if it has not been seeded yet. When <see cref="ModManager"/> is still mid‑initialisation, the call is silently deferred (logged at debug level) so that early code paths don't crash; the next access will retry. Each <see cref="QuestDefinition"/> is converted into a fresh <see cref="QuestBase"/> with default status and an empty tag set. </summary>
private void EnsureLoaded(){if(isLoaded)return;if(!ModManager.Instance.IsInitialized){GameLogger.Log("QUEST","mods not initialized, quest loading deferred");return;}isLoaded=true;try{var definitions=JsonGroup.Collect<QuestDefinition>("quests");if(definitions!=null){foreach(var(id,def)in definitions){var quest=new QuestBase{ID=def.ID,Name=def.Name,StatusToDescription=def.StatusToDescription??new Dictionary<int,string>(),};dataByID.Add(quest.ID,quest);}}}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("QUEST","failed to load quests from mods: "+ex.Message,LogLevel.Error);}GameLogger.Log("QUEST","loaded '"+dataByID.Count+"' quests");}/// <summary> Looks up a quest by its unique string identifier and returns the shared <see cref="QuestBase"/> runtime instance. Throws <c>KeyNotFoundException</c> when no definition for <paramref name="id"/> was loaded from mod data, which typically indicates a typo in a scenario script's quest reference. </summary>
public QuestBase Get(string id){EnsureLoaded();if(dataByID.TryGetValue(id,out var quest))return quest;GameLogger.Log("QUEST","quest '"+id+"' not registered",LogLevel.Error);throw new KeyNotFoundException(id);}/// <summary> Returns a snapshot list of every <see cref="QuestBase"/> instance known to the factory. Used primarily by the save system to serialise the full quest state for the save file, and by the journal UI to populate the quest list window. </summary>
public List<QuestBase>GetAll(){EnsureLoaded();return dataByID.Values.ToList();}/// <summary> Restores mutable quest state from a deserialised save file. Iterates over every quest in the provided list, looks up the corresponding entry by ID, and overwrites its <see cref="QuestBase.Data"/> and <see cref="QuestBase.Status"/> properties. Entries whose ID is not registered (a removed mod or a quest renamed between sessions) are skipped with a warning so that an ageing save cannot block loading. Reads from empty or <c>null</c> lists are silently ignored so that save files created before the quest system existed (or with no quest progress) do not break the pipeline. Publishes a single <see cref="QuestStateRestoredEvent"/> marker after the restore loop (not per-quest) so condition caches invalidate once without a per-quest event storm. </summary>
public void SetAll(List<QuestBase>quests){EnsureLoaded();if(Lists.IsEmpty(quests))return;foreach(var questFromSave in quests){if(!dataByID.TryGetValue(questFromSave.ID,out var quest)){GameLogger.Log("QUEST","quest '"+questFromSave.ID+"' from save is not registered, skipped",LogLevel.Warning);continue;}quest.Data=questFromSave.Data;quest.Status=questFromSave.Status;}ModEventBus.Publish(new QuestStateRestoredEvent());}/// <summary> Returns every quest to the state it has right after mod loading: <see cref="QuestStatus.NotStarted"/>, numeric stage zero, and an empty tag set. Called by <c>GameData.StartNewGame</c> because the factory is a process‑wide singleton that survives returning to the main menu — without this reset, tags and statuses earned in the previous playthrough would leak into a new game and satisfy (or block) prologue conditions that test for absent tags. Publishes <see cref="QuestStateRestoredEvent"/> so cached scenario conditions invalidate once. </summary>
public void ResetAll(){EnsureLoaded();foreach(var quest in dataByID.Values){quest.Status=QuestStatus.NotStarted;quest.Data=new QuestData();}ModEventBus.Publish(new QuestStateRestoredEvent());}}}

===== FILE Core/Quests/QuestStatus.cs =====
namespace Cthangover.Core.Quests{/// <summary> Discrete progression states for the quest lifecycle. Each value maps to a 1‑byte integer that doubles as an array index into <see cref="QuestBase.StatusToDescription"/> and as the key for journal‑window filtering. The three‑state model avoids the complexity of arbitrary stage counts while still supporting branch‑like progression via the tag system in <see cref="QuestData"/>. </summary>
public enum QuestStatus:byte{/// <summary> The quest has never been accepted or activated. The journal window hides quests in this state unless the player has explicitly toggled "show all" mode. </summary>
NotStarted=0x00,/// <summary> The quest is in progress; the player has accepted the task and may have completed some sub‑objectives (tracked via tags) but has not yet reached the final stage. </summary>
Progress=0x01,/// <summary> Terminal state indicating the quest has been fully completed. Quests in this state are usually moved to a "completed" section of the journal and are excluded from most progression‑gating condition checks. </summary>
End=0x02,};}

===== FILE Core/Quests/QuestTagLocale.cs =====
using Cthangover.Core.Localization;namespace Cthangover.Core.Quests{/// <summary> Maps quest tags to locale keys and resolves their display text. A bare tag id is only unique inside its quest — the same word may mean different milestones in different quests — so the key is composed from the quest's locale prefix (<see cref="IQuest.Name"/>) and the tag: <c>{quest.Name}/tag/{tag}</c>. For <c>MeetingMurakamiQuest</c> (<c>Name = quest/meeting/murakami</c>) the tag <c>go_home</c> maps to <c>quest/meeting/murakami/tag/go_home</c>, sharing the namespace of the quest's own name and stage descriptions. The journal renders every earned tag as a stamp through <see cref="Translate(IQuest, string)"/>; when no translation exists the raw tag id is shown, which is the behaviour tags had before locale support was added. </summary>
public static class QuestTagLocale{/// <summary> Builds the composite locale key for <paramref name="tag"/> inside <paramref name="quest"/>: <c>{quest.Name}/tag/{tag}</c>. Returns <c>null</c> when the quest is missing, has no locale prefix, or the tag is empty, so callers can distinguish "no key to look up" from "key not translated" and fall back to the raw tag. </summary>
public static string Key(IQuest quest,string tag){if(quest==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(quest.Name)||string.IsNullOrEmpty(tag))return null;return quest.Name+"/tag/"+tag;}/// <summary> Returns the display text of <paramref name="tag"/> in the player's current language, falling back to the raw tag id when the composite key is absent from all loaded mods' properties files. </summary>
public static string Translate(IQuest quest,string tag){return Translate(quest,tag,GodotTranslationProvider.Instance);}/// <summary> Provider-injected variant of <see cref="Translate(IQuest, string)"/> for tests and for callers that already hold an <see cref="ILocalizationProvider"/>. A provider that returns <c>null</c> for the composite key (the "untranslated" signal of <see cref="ILocalizationProvider"/>) also yields the raw tag. </summary>
public static string Translate(IQuest quest,string tag,ILocalizationProvider provider){var key=Key(quest,tag);if(key==null||provider==null)return tag;return provider.Get(key)??tag;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenarios{/// <summary> Optional declarative contract of a scenario command, implemented by <see cref="IScenarioCommandStrategy"/> classes that want their arguments checked without the checker knowing the command name. The default members mean a strategy overrides only what differs from "accepts anything". The contract belongs to the command itself, so including a new command from a mod (or Core) automatically teaches the validator its rules; a command that does not implement this interface is still recognised as a known command but its arguments are not constrained. </summary>
public interface IScenarioCommandSpec{/// <summary>Minimum number of positional arguments. Default: 0.</summary>
int MinPositional=>0;/// <summary>Maximum number of positional arguments; -1 means unlimited. Default: -1.</summary>
int MaxPositional=> -1;/// <summary> Minimum number of arguments in total (positional + named). Used by commands whose required input may arrive either way, e.g. text that is either literal or a <c>key=</c> lookup. </summary>
int MinArguments=>0;/// <summary>Named arguments that must be present. Default: none.</summary>
IReadOnlyList<string>RequiredNamed=>Array.Empty<string>();/// <summary> Named arguments the command understands. Empty/null means the command accepts arbitrary named arguments (e.g. <c>action</c> forwards them as dialog variables), so unknown-name checks are skipped. </summary>
IReadOnlyList<string>AllowedNamed=>null;/// <summary> Named argument that carries a <c>:label</c> jump target, or null. Lets the checker validate that the target exists without knowing the command; <c>goto</c> declares <c>"target"</c> here. </summary>
string JumpTargetNamedKey=>null;}}

Each command word (e.g. <c>text</c>, <c>music</c>, <c>goto</c>) maps to one strategy implementation. The <see cref="ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory"/> auto-discovers all implementations via reflection and dispatches commands to the matching strategy during parsing. </summary>

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Localization;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenarios{/// <summary> Handles the <c>action</c> DSL command. Triggers a named interactive action (defined in the action system) and forwards any extra named parameters as context variables via <see cref="DialogQueue.Set"/>. Implements <see cref="ICommandReferenceMetadata"/> to signal that the first positional argument is an <see cref="PositionalReferenceKind.Action"/> reference. </summary>
public class ActionCommandStrategy:IScenarioCommandStrategy,ICommandReferenceMetadata,IScenarioCommandSpec{/// <inheritdoc/>
public string Command=>"action";/// <inheritdoc/>
public PositionalReferenceKind Positional0Kind=>PositionalReferenceKind.Action;/// <inheritdoc/>
public int MinPositional=>1;/// <inheritdoc/>

public void Execute(DialogQueue dlg,List<string>positional,Dictionary<string,string>named,string arrowTarget,ILocalizationProvider locale){var actionName=positional.Count>0?positional[0]:"";foreach(var kv in named){if(kv.Key is"name"or"key")continue;dlg.Set(kv.Key,kv.Value);}dlg.Action(actionName);}}}

Supports two modes: (a) multiple sprites via <c>sprites=</c> named parameter, or (b) a single sprite base with <c>start</c>, <c>count</c>, <c>speed</c>, and <c>loop</c> controls. Delegates to <see cref="DialogQueue.Animation"/>. </summary>

public string Command=>"animation";/// <inheritdoc/>
public int MinArguments=>1;/// <inheritdoc/>

public void Execute(DialogQueue dlg,List<string>positional,Dictionary<string,string>named,string arrowTarget,ILocalizationProvider locale){if(named.TryGetValue("sprites",out var spritesStr)){var sprites=new List<string>(spritesStr.Split(','));var speed=named.TryGetValue("speed",out var sp)?ParseFloat(sp):1f;var loop= !named.TryGetValue("loop",out var lp)||lp=="true";dlg.Animation(sprites,speed,1f,loop);}else if(positional.Count>0){var sprite=positional[0];var start=named.TryGetValue("start",out var st)?ParseInt(st):0;var count=named.TryGetValue("count",out var cn)?ParseInt(cn):1;var speed=named.TryGetValue("speed",out var sp)?ParseFloat(sp):1f;var loop= !named.TryGetValue("loop",out var lp)||lp=="true";dlg.Animation(sprite,start,count,speed,1f,loop);}}private static float ParseFloat(string s){return float.TryParse(s,NumberStyles.Float,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out var v)?v:0f;}private static int ParseInt(string s){return int.TryParse(s,NumberStyles.Integer,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out var v)?v:0;}}}

Supports localization via the <c>key=</c> named parameter. </summary>
public class DelayCommandStrategy:IScenarioCommandStrategy,IScenarioCommandSpec{/// <inheritdoc/>

public IReadOnlyList<string>AllowedNamed=>new[]{"key","hidden"};/// <inheritdoc/>

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Localization;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog.Action;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog.Action.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenarios{/// <summary> Converts scenario DSL text or files into <see cref="DialogQueue"/> instances. Wraps <see cref="ScenarioParser"/> with a configurable <see cref="ILocalizationProvider"/> that defaults to <see cref="GodotTranslationProvider.Instance"/> when none is supplied. </summary>
public class ScenarioConverter{private readonly ILocalizationProvider locale;/// <summary> Creates a converter with an optional localization provider. </summary> <param name="locale">Localization provider for <c>key=</c> text lookups. Defaults to Godot translations.</param>
public ScenarioConverter(ILocalizationProvider locale=null){this.locale=locale??GodotTranslationProvider.Instance;}/// <summary> Parses raw scenario script text into a dialog queue using the configured locale. </summary>
public DialogQueue Convert(string text){return ScenarioParser.Parse(text,locale);}/// <summary> Reads a scenario file from disk and parses it into a dialog queue. </summary> <param name="path">Filesystem path to the <c>.scenario</c> file.</param> <returns>The parsed <see cref="DialogQueue"/>, or <c>null</c> if the file could not be opened.</returns>
public DialogQueue ConvertFile(string path){foreach(var kvp in ModRegistry.Instance.Mods){var text=kvp.Value.FileProvider.ReadFileText(path);if(text!=null)return Convert(text);}var file=FileAccess.Open(path,FileAccess.ModeFlags.Read);if(file==null){GameLogger.Log("CONVERTER",$"Failed to open '{path}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var fileText=file.GetAsText();file.Close();return Convert(fileText);}}}

Uses <see cref="GodotTranslationProvider.Instance"/> as the default localization source. </summary>

public static DialogQueue Load(string path){return Load(path,GodotTranslationProvider.Instance);}/// <summary> Loads and parses a scenario file with a custom localization provider for text lookups. </summary> <param name="path">Filesystem path to the <c>.scenario</c> file.</param> <param name="provider">Localization provider to resolve <c>key=</c> references during parsing.</param> <returns>The parsed <see cref="DialogQueue"/>, or <c>null</c> if the file could not be opened.</returns>
