using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Localization;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog.Action.Impls;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenarios{/// <summary> Parses scenario DSL script text into a <see cref="DialogQueue"/> of dialog actions. The pipeline works in two phases: first the text is split into lines, then each non-empty, non-comment line is tokenized and dispatched to the matching <see cref="IScenarioCommandStrategy"/> via <see cref="ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory"/>. Special handling exists for <c>:label</c> anchor points, <c>select/option</c> blocks (accumulated into <see cref="ActionSelect"/>), and <c>-&gt;</c> arrow targets. </summary>
public static class ScenarioParser{/// <summary> Parses a complete scenario script text and returns the resulting dialog queue. </summary> <param name="text">Raw scenario DSL content.</param> <param name="locale">Optional localization provider for <c>key=</c> text lookups.</param>
public static DialogQueue Parse(string text,ILocalizationProvider locale=null){var dlg=new DialogQueue();var lines=text.Split('\n');ActionSelect pendingSelect=null;foreach(var rawLine in lines){var line=rawLine.Trim();if(line.Length==0||line.StartsWith('#')){FinalizePendingSelect(dlg,ref pendingSelect);continue;}if(line.StartsWith(':')){FinalizePendingSelect(dlg,ref pendingSelect);dlg.Point(line.Substring(1));continue;}var tokens=Tokenize(line);if(tokens.Count==0)continue;var cmd=tokens[0].ToLowerInvariant();tokens.RemoveAt(0);var positional=new List<string>();var named=new Dictionary<string,string>();var arrowTarget="";for(var i=0;i<tokens.Count;i++){var t=tokens[i];if(t=="->"){if(i+1<tokens.Count){arrowTarget=tokens[i+1].TrimStart(':');i++;}continue;}var eqIdx=t.IndexOf('=');if(eqIdx>0){var name=t.Substring(0,eqIdx);if(IsValidIdent(name)){named[name.ToLowerInvariant()]=t.Substring(eqIdx+1);continue;}}positional.Add(t);}if(cmd=="select"){FinalizePendingSelect(dlg,ref pendingSelect);pendingSelect=new ActionSelect();var promptText=positional.Count>0?positional[0]:null;if(named.TryGetValue("key",out var key)&&locale!=null){var loc=locale.Get(key);if(loc!=null)promptText=loc;}if(promptText!=null)pendingSelect.Text=promptText;if(named.TryGetValue("first",out var first))pendingSelect.FirstAvatar=first;if(named.TryGetValue("second",out var second))pendingSelect.SecondAvatar=second;continue;}if(cmd=="option"){if(pendingSelect==null)continue;var optText=positional.Count>0?positional[0]:"";if(named.TryGetValue("key",out var key)&&locale!=null){var loc=locale.Get(key);if(loc!=null)optText=loc;}var goTo=arrowTarget;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(goTo)){if(named.TryGetValue("goto",out var gt))goTo=gt;else if(positional.Count>1&&positional[1].StartsWith(':'))goTo=positional[1].TrimStart(':');}if(pendingSelect.Variants==null)pendingSelect.Variants=new List<SelectVariant>();pendingSelect.Variants.Add(SelectVariant.New(optText,goTo));continue;}FinalizePendingSelect(dlg,ref pendingSelect);var strategy=ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory.Get(cmd);if(strategy!=null)strategy.Execute(dlg,positional,named,arrowTarget,locale);}FinalizePendingSelect(dlg,ref pendingSelect);return dlg;}/// <summary> Extracts YAML-like front-matter metadata from script text. Lines before a <c>---</c> separator or the first non-key:value line are parsed as <c>key: value</c> pairs. Returns both the metadata dictionary and the remaining script content after the metadata block. </summary>
public static(Dictionary<string,string>metadata,string remainingText)ParseMetadata(string text){var metadata=new Dictionary<string,string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);var lines=text.Split('\n');var contentStart=0;var inMetadata=true;for(var i=0;i<lines.Length;i++){var line=lines[i].Trim();if(!inMetadata){continue;}if(line=="---"){contentStart=i+1;break;}if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(line)){contentStart=i;break;}var colonIdx=line.IndexOf(':');if(colonIdx>0){var key=line.Substring(0,colonIdx).Trim();var val=line.Substring(colonIdx+1).Trim();metadata[key]=val;}else{contentStart=i;break;}}var remaining=string.Join("\n",lines,contentStart,lines.Length-contentStart);return(metadata,remaining);}private static void FinalizePendingSelect(DialogQueue dlg,ref ActionSelect pending){if(pending==null)return;if(pending.Variants==null||pending.Variants.Count==0){pending=null;return;}dlg.Queue.Add(pending);pending=null;}private static List<string>Tokenize(string line){var result=new List<string>();var i=0;while(i<line.Length){if(char.IsWhiteSpace(line[i])){i++;continue;}if(line[i]=='"'){i++;var start=i;while(i<line.Length&&line[i]!='"'){if(line[i]=='\\'&&i+1<line.Length)i++;i++;}result.Add(line[start..i].Replace("\\\"","\""));if(i<line.Length)i++;continue;}var tokenStart=i;while(i<line.Length&& !char.IsWhiteSpace(line[i]))i++;result.Add(line[tokenStart..i]);}return result;}private static bool IsValidIdent(string s){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(s))return false;for(var i=0;i<s.Length;i++){var c=s[i];if(!char.IsLetterOrDigit(c)&&c!='_')return false;}return true;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> Shared integer comparison utility consumed by <see cref="FlagCondition"/> and <see cref="QuestPropCondition"/> during evaluation. Both node types support the same six operators (<c>== != &gt;= &lt;= &gt; &lt;</c>) on integer values, so the comparison logic lives here to avoid duplication. Extracted from the former <c>ScenarioCondition.Compare</c> private method when evaluation moved into polymorphic <see cref="ConditionNode.Evaluate"/> methods. </summary>
public static class ConditionCompare{/// <summary> Compares two integers using the given operator string. Unknown operators return <c>false</c>. </summary>
public static bool Compare(string op,int a,int b){return op switch{"=="=>a==b,"!="=>a!=b,">="=>a>=b,"<="=>a<=b,">"=>a>b,"<"=>a<b,_=>false};}}}

===== FILE Core/Scenes/ConditionNode.cs =====
namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> Abstract base for all nodes in the condition expression AST produced by <see cref="ConditionParser"/>. Every node implements <see cref="Evaluate(EvaluationContext)"/> — the tree is walked polymorphically rather than via a central switch statement. This design means that a mod assembly can define a custom <see cref="ConditionNode"/> subclass, and any code that constructs an AST containing it (including the core parser once extended) automatically evaluates it — no registration, no dispatch table, no <c>_ => true</c> fallthrough. Built-in node types: <list type="bullet"> <item><see cref="AndNode"/> / <see cref="OrNode"/> — binary boolean combinators with short-circuit</item> <item><see cref="NotNode"/> — unary negation</item> <item><see cref="BoolLiteral"/> — constant <c>true</c> / <c>false</c></item> <item><see cref="FlagCondition"/> — runtime flag comparison</item> <item><see cref="QuestMethodCondition"/> — quest tag membership</item> <item><see cref="QuestPropCondition"/> — quest int-property comparison</item> <item><see cref="QuestBoolPropCondition"/> — quest boolean property</item> </list> </summary>
public abstract class ConditionNode:ICondition{/// <summary> Evaluates this node against the given runtime context and returns the boolean result. Called recursively — for combinator nodes like <see cref="AndNode"/> this triggers a depth-first walk. </summary> <param name="ctx">Runtime state: flag dictionary and quest factory.</param>
public abstract bool Evaluate(EvaluationContext ctx);}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> Tokenizes condition expression strings and delegates tree construction to the pluggable <see cref="Parsing.ExpressionParser"/>. Operators are resolved through <see cref="Parsing.OperatorRegistry"/>; leaf values through <see cref="Parsing.LeafParserRegistry"/>. Mods can register custom parsers in either registry to extend the condition DSL without touching core code. </summary>
public static class ConditionParser{public enum TokenType{Ident,Number,String,Dot,LParen,RParen,Comma,And,Or,Not,Eq,Neq,Ge,Le,Gt,Lt,EOF}public class Token{public TokenType Type;public string Value;}private class Tokenizer{private readonly string input;private int pos;private readonly List<Token>tokens=new();public Tokenizer(string input){this.input=input;}public List<Token>Tokenize(){tokens.Clear();pos=0;while(pos<input.Length){SkipWhitespace();if(pos>=input.Length)break;var c=input[pos];if(c=='('){Add(TokenType.LParen,"(");pos++;}else if(c==')'){Add(TokenType.RParen,")");pos++;}else if(c==','){Add(TokenType.Comma,",");pos++;}else if(c=='.'){Add(TokenType.Dot,".");pos++;}else if(c=='!'){if(pos+1<input.Length&&input[pos+1]=='='){Add(TokenType.Neq,"!=");pos+=2;}else{Add(TokenType.Not,"!");pos++;}}else if(c=='='){if(pos+1<input.Length&&input[pos+1]=='='){Add(TokenType.Eq,"==");pos+=2;}else throw Error("expected '='");}else if(c=='>'){if(pos+1<input.Length&&input[pos+1]=='='){Add(TokenType.Ge,">=");pos+=2;}else{Add(TokenType.Gt,">");pos++;}}else if(c=='<'){if(pos+1<input.Length&&input[pos+1]=='='){Add(TokenType.Le,"<=");pos+=2;}else{Add(TokenType.Lt,"<");pos++;}}else if(c=='&'){if(pos+1<input.Length&&input[pos+1]=='&'){Add(TokenType.And,"&&");pos+=2;}else throw Error("expected '&'");}else if(c=='|'){if(pos+1<input.Length&&input[pos+1]=='|'){Add(TokenType.Or,"||");pos+=2;}else throw Error("expected '|'");}else if(c=='"'||c=='\''){var quote=c;pos++;var start=pos;while(pos<input.Length&&input[pos]!=quote)pos++;if(pos>=input.Length)throw Error("unterminated string");var val=input.Substring(start,pos-start);Add(TokenType.String,val);pos++;}else if(char.IsDigit(c)){var start=pos;while(pos<input.Length&&char.IsDigit(input[pos]))pos++;Add(TokenType.Number,input.Substring(start,pos-start));}else if(char.IsLetter(c)||c=='_'){var start=pos;while(pos<input.Length&&(char.IsLetterOrDigit(input[pos])||input[pos]=='_'))pos++;Add(TokenType.Ident,input.Substring(start,pos-start));}else{throw Error($"unexpected character '{c}'");}}Add(TokenType.EOF,"");return tokens;}private void SkipWhitespace(){while(pos<input.Length&&char.IsWhiteSpace(input[pos]))pos++;}private void Add(TokenType type,string value){tokens.Add(new Token{Type=type,Value=value});}private FormatException Error(string msg){return new FormatException($"Condition parse error at pos {pos}: {msg}\n{input}\n{new string(' ', pos)}^");}}/// <summary> Parses a condition expression string into a <see cref="ConditionNode"/> AST. Delegates tokenisation to the built-in tokenizer and tree construction to the pluggable <see cref="Parsing.ExpressionParser"/> which resolves operators through <see cref="Parsing.OperatorRegistry"/> and leaf values through <see cref="Parsing.LeafParserRegistry"/>. Returns <c>null</c> for null, empty, or whitespace-only input. Throws <see cref="FormatException"/> on syntax errors with position information. </summary> <param name="input">The condition expression string to parse.</param>
public static ConditionNode Parse(string input){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input))return null;var tokenizer=new Tokenizer(input);var tokens=tokenizer.Tokenize();return(ConditionNode)new Parsing.ExpressionParser().Parse(tokens);}}}

using System.Threading;using Cthangover.Core.Events;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> Единый «флаг актуальности» результатов вычисления сценарных условий. Подписывается на все события изменения состояния, влияющие на кондишины (теги/статусы квестов, флаги, восстановление сейва, интерактивы), и инкрементирует монотонный Version. Потребители (ScenarioEvent, цепочки) считают закешированный результат актуальным, пока Version не изменился. MarkStateChanged() — публичный ручной инвалидатор для модов с кастомным состоянием вне квестов. Notify&lt;T&gt; — публичен для юнит-тестов без Godot. Внимание: ModEventBus.ClearAll() сбрасывает подписки; в игре он не вызывается, но при вызове нужно заново дёрнуть EnsureSubscribed(). </summary>
public static class ConditionStateMonitor{private static long _version;private static readonly object Lock=new();private static bool _subscribed;/// <summary> Монотонно растущий счётчик изменений состояния. Любое событие, подписанное монитором, увеличивает его на 1; равенство значений означает «состояние не менялось с прошлого чтения». </summary>
public static long Version=>Interlocked.Read(ref _version);/// <summary> Ручной инвалидатор: форсирует рост Version вне штатных событий (для модов с кастомным состоянием, влияющим на кондишины). </summary>
public static void MarkStateChanged(){Interlocked.Increment(ref _version);}/// <summary>Обработчик любого события монитора — бампает версию.</summary>
public static void Notify<T>(T evt)where T:ModEvent{MarkStateChanged();}/// <summary> Гарантирует подписку монитора на все события изменения состояния. Идемпотентна — повторные вызовы ничего не делают. Вызывается из статического конструктора; повторный вызов нужен только если <c>ModEventBus.ClearAll()</c> сбросил статические подписки. </summary>
public static void EnsureSubscribed(){lock(Lock){if(_subscribed)return;_subscribed=true;ModEventBus.Subscribe<QuestTagChangedEvent>(Notify);ModEventBus.Subscribe<QuestStatusChangedEvent>(Notify);ModEventBus.Subscribe<QuestDataStatusChangedEvent>(Notify);ModEventBus.Subscribe<FlagChangedEvent>(Notify);ModEventBus.Subscribe<QuestStateRestoredEvent>(Notify);ModEventBus.Subscribe<InteractiveStateChangedEvent>(Notify);}}static ConditionStateMonitor(){EnsureSubscribed();}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Quests;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> Carries the runtime state that condition nodes need during evaluation. A single instance is reused across the entire AST walk — created once in <see cref="ScenarioCondition.Evaluate"/> and passed through every <see cref="ConditionNode.Evaluate"/> call. <c>Flags</c> is a reference to the static flag dictionary managed by <see cref="ScenarioCondition.SetFlag"/>, allowing <see cref="FlagCondition"/> to resolve flag values without static access. <c>QuestFactory</c> is a reference to the singleton <see cref="QuestFactory"/> instance, injected so that quest-based leaf nodes (<see cref="QuestMethodCondition"/>, <see cref="QuestPropCondition"/>, <see cref="QuestBoolPropCondition"/>) can resolve quests without a hard reference to the singleton. The context is deliberately a plain POCO — not a Godot object — so that it can be instantiated in unit tests without the Godot runtime. </summary>
public class EvaluationContext{/// <summary>Reference to the static flag dictionary from <see cref="ScenarioCondition"/>.</summary>
public Dictionary<string,string>Flags;/// <summary>Reference to the singleton <see cref="QuestFactory"/> for quest resolution.</summary>
public QuestFactory QuestFactory;}}

===== FILE Core/Scenes/FlagCondition.cs =====
namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> An AST leaf node representing a comparison between a named runtime flag and a literal value. Looks up the flag key in the <see cref="EvaluationContext.Flags"/> dictionary at evaluation time. Supports both numeric and string comparisons; if both the stored and expected values parse as integers, a numeric comparison is performed via <see cref="ConditionCompare.Compare"/>. When the flag is absent from the dictionary, the condition returns <c>true</c> for <c>!=</c> and <c>false</c> for all other operators — this "missing means not-equal" semantics allows scenario scripts to gate on flags that may not yet have been set. </summary>
public class FlagCondition:ConditionNode{/// <summary>The flag key to look up in the runtime flag dictionary.</summary>
public string Key{get;}/// <summary>The comparison operator (<c>==</c>, <c>!=</c>, etc.).</summary>
public string Op{get;}/// <summary>The literal value to compare the flag against.</summary>
public string Value{get;}/// <summary> Creates a flag comparison condition node. </summary> <param name="key">The flag key.</param> <param name="op">The comparison operator.</param> <param name="value">The literal value to compare against.</param>
public FlagCondition(string key,string op,string value){Key=key;Op=op;Value=value;}public override bool Evaluate(EvaluationContext ctx){if(!ctx.Flags.TryGetValue(Key,out var current))return Op=="!=";if(int.TryParse(current,out var ci)&&int.TryParse(Value,out var fi))return ConditionCompare.Compare(Op,ci,fi);return Op switch{"=="=>current==Value,"!="=>current!=Value,_=>false};}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes.Parsing.Impls;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.Parsing{/// <summary> Pratt precedence-climbing parser that converts a token list into an <see cref="ICondition"/> tree. Operators are resolved through <see cref="OperatorRegistry"/>; leaf values through <see cref="LeafParserRegistry"/>. Precedence values: higher = tighter binding. Infix operators use <c>op.Precedence</c> for the right operand to enforce left- associativity. The loop condition is strict greater-than (<c>></c>) so that operators at the current precedence level are consumed from left to right. The parser makes a single left-to-right pass over the token list, consuming each token exactly once. No backtracking, no regex. </summary>
public class ExpressionParser{private TokenPeeker _peeker;static ExpressionParser(){OperatorRegistry.Register(new AndOpParser());OperatorRegistry.Register(new OrOpParser());OperatorRegistry.Register(new NotOpParser());}/// <summary> Parses a complete token list into an <see cref="ICondition"/> tree. </summary>

"EOF" : _peeker.Peek.Value)}'");return leafParser.Parse(_peeker,()=>ParseExpr(0));}}}

using System;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.Parsing{public class GDLeafParser:ILeafParser{private readonly string _conditionName;private readonly GodotObject _instance;public GDLeafParser(string conditionName,GodotObject instance){_conditionName=conditionName;_instance=instance;}public bool CanParse(TokenPeeker peeker){if(peeker.AtEnd||peeker.Peek.Type!=ConditionParser.TokenType.Ident)return false;var snapshot=peeker.Snapshot();var ident=snapshot.Advance().Value;if(snapshot.AtEnd||snapshot.Peek.Type!=ConditionParser.TokenType.Dot)return false;snapshot.Advance();if(snapshot.AtEnd||snapshot.Peek.Type!=ConditionParser.TokenType.Ident)return false;var method=snapshot.Advance().Value;return$"{ident}.{method}"==_conditionName;}public ICondition Parse(TokenPeeker peeker,Func<ICondition>parseSubExpr){peeker.Advance();// ident

using System;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.Parsing{/// <summary> Parses a leaf value from the token stream — a literal, a flag comparison, a quest method call, or any other terminal expression that produces an <see cref="ICondition"/>. Registered in <see cref="LeafParserRegistry"/>. Mods add custom leaf types (e.g. weather conditions, skill checks) by implementing this interface and calling <see cref="LeafParserRegistry.Register"/>. <see cref="CanParse"/> receives a <see cref="TokenPeeker"/> — a read-only view of upcoming tokens — and must return true only when this parser can handle the input. No tokens are consumed during the check. <see cref="Parse"/> receives a mutable stream and the <paramref name="parseSubExpr"/> callback for recursive sub-expression parsing (used when a leaf contains parentheses, e.g. flag arguments that are themselves expressions). </summary>
public interface ILeafParser{/// <summary> Checks whether this parser can handle the tokens at the current position. Peek only — do not advance the stream. </summary>
bool CanParse(TokenPeeker peeker);/// <summary> Consumes tokens from the stream and returns the parsed <see cref="ICondition"/>. </summary> <param name="peeker">Mutable token stream — advance past consumed tokens.</param> <param name="parseSubExpr">Callback for nested sub-expression parsing, e.g. content inside parentheses.</param>
ICondition Parse(TokenPeeker peeker,Func<ICondition>parseSubExpr);}}

using System;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.Parsing{/// <summary> Parses a binary or unary operator token into an <see cref="ICondition"/> subtree. Registered in <see cref="OperatorRegistry"/> — mods can add custom operators (e.g. XOR, NAND) by implementing this interface and calling <see cref="OperatorRegistry.Register"/> during mod initialisation. <see cref="Precedence"/> controls binding strength: higher values mean looser binding. In <c>A && B || C</c>, <c>||</c> has higher precedence (binds looser) than <c>&&</c>, so the tree is <c>||(&&(A, B), C)</c>. For infix operators (<c>&&</c>, <c>||</c>), <see cref="ExpressionParser"/> calls <see cref="BuildInfix"/> with left and right operands. For prefix operators (<c>!</c>), it calls <see cref="BuildPrefix"/> with the single operand. </summary>
public interface IOperatorParser{/// <summary>The token type this parser handles.</summary>
ConditionParser.TokenType Token{get;}/// <summary>Binding precedence — higher = looser binding (||=40, &&=30, !=50).</summary>
int Precedence{get;}/// <summary>True for prefix unary operators (!A).</summary>
bool IsPrefix{get;}/// <summary>True for infix binary operators (A && B).</summary>
bool IsInfix{get;}/// <summary>Constructs an infix node from left and right operands. Returns null when <see cref="IsInfix"/> is false.</summary>
ICondition BuildInfix(ICondition left,ICondition right);/// <summary>Constructs a prefix node from its operand. Returns null when <see cref="IsPrefix"/> is false.</summary>
ICondition BuildPrefix(ICondition operand);}}

using System;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.Parsing.Impls{/// <summary> Parses flag comparison expressions: <c>flag_name OP literal</c>. Matches when the stream contains an identifier followed by a comparison operator (== != >= <= > <). Must be tried AFTER <see cref="QuestParser"/> and <see cref="BoolLiteralParser"/> in the registry — those parsers also start with an identifier but consume the dot or check for true/false respectively. By the time <see cref="CanParse"/> is called here, any dot-followed or keyword identifiers have already been claimed. </summary>

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes.Parsing.Impls;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.Parsing{/// <summary> Ordered registry of <see cref="ILeafParser"/> instances, queried by <see cref="ExpressionParser"/> when the next token does not match any registered operator. Core parsers (booleans, flags, quests, groups) are registered at static init. </summary>

public static void Register(ILeafParser parser){_parsers.Add(parser);}/// <summary>Inserts a parser at the front of the list so it takes priority.</summary>

public static ILeafParser FindParser(TokenPeeker peeker){foreach(var parser in _parsers){if(parser.CanParse(peeker))return parser;}return null;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.Parsing{/// <summary> Read-only view of upcoming tokens used by <see cref="ILeafParser.CanParse"/> and <see cref="ILeafParser.Parse"/>. Wraps a <see cref="ConditionParser.Token"/> list and position index. Peek methods do not advance — only <see cref="Advance"/> consumes. Also carries the <paramref name="parseSubExpr"/> callback injected by <see cref="ExpressionParser"/> so that leaf parsers can recursively parse sub-expressions (e.g. inside parentheses). </summary>
public class TokenPeeker{private readonly List<ConditionParser.Token>_tokens;private int _pos;private readonly Func<ICondition>_parseSubExpr;public TokenPeeker(List<ConditionParser.Token>tokens,Func<ICondition>parseSubExpr){_tokens=tokens;_pos=0;_parseSubExpr=parseSubExpr;}public ConditionParser.Token Peek=>_tokens[_pos];public bool AtEnd=>_pos>=_tokens.Count;public ConditionParser.Token PeekAhead(int offset){var idx=_pos+offset;return idx<_tokens.Count?_tokens[idx]:_tokens[_tokens.Count-1];}public bool Check(ConditionParser.TokenType type)=> !AtEnd&&Peek.Type==type;public ConditionParser.Token Advance(){var token=Peek;_pos++;return token;}public ConditionParser.Token Expect(ConditionParser.TokenType type,string errorMsg){if(AtEnd||Peek.Type!=type)throw new FormatException($"Condition parse error: {errorMsg}, got '{(AtEnd ? "EOF" : Peek.Value)}'");return Advance();}/// <summary>Clones the position for speculative CanParse checks.</summary>
public TokenPeeker Snapshot(){var clone=new TokenPeeker(_tokens,_parseSubExpr);clone._pos=_pos;return clone;}/// <summary>Parses a sub-expression using the injected callback.</summary>
public ICondition ParseSubExpr()=>_parseSubExpr();}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Quests;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> Evaluates condition expression strings by parsing them into an AST via <see cref="ConditionParser"/> and walking the tree polymorphically — each <see cref="ConditionNode"/> subclass implements its own <see cref="ConditionNode.Evaluate"/> method. Maintains a static dictionary of named flags settable via <see cref="SetFlag"/> and injects them (along with <see cref="QuestFactory"/>) into an <see cref="EvaluationContext"/> that is carried through the entire AST walk. The polymorphic design means that a mod assembly can define a custom <see cref="ConditionNode"/> and it will be evaluated automatically when present in the AST — no dispatch table, no switch, no registration. </summary>
public static class ScenarioCondition{private static readonly Dictionary<string,string>flags=new();private static readonly Dictionary<string,ConditionNode>AstCache=new();private static readonly object AstLock=new();private static readonly EvaluationContext evalCtx=new();/// <summary> Sets a named flag value in the static flag dictionary. Used by scenario scripts to set conditions that can be checked in subsequent <see cref="Evaluate"/> calls. Publishes a <see cref="FlagChangedEvent"/> only when the value actually changed (setting the same value is a no-op), so condition caches invalidate on real change. </summary> <param name="key">The flag name.</param> <param name="value">The flag value, which may be parsed as integer for numeric comparisons.</param>
public static void SetFlag(string key,string value){if(flags.TryGetValue(key,out var current)&&current==value)return;flags[key]=value;ModEventBus.Publish(new FlagChangedEvent{Key=key,Value=value});}/// <summary> Parses and evaluates a condition expression string. Returns <c>true</c> for null or whitespace-only input (vacuous truth). Returns <c>false</c> on parse errors. Supports boolean combinators (<c>&amp;&amp;</c>, <c>||</c>, <c>!</c>), numeric comparisons on flags and quest properties, quest tag membership checks (<c>hasTag</c>, <c>notHasTag</c>), and boolean literals (<c>true</c>, <c>false</c>). The parsed AST is cached per unique condition string (the tree and its static inputs are immutable), while execution still reads live flag and quest state at evaluation time. Parse errors are not cached and re-parse (and fail) on every call. </summary> <param name="condition">The condition expression string to evaluate.</param>
public static bool Evaluate(string condition){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(condition))return true;ConditionNode ast;lock(AstLock){if(!AstCache.TryGetValue(condition,out ast)){try{ast=ConditionParser.Parse(condition);}catch(FormatException ex){GameLogger.Log("COND",$"parse error: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return false;}if(ast==null)return true;AstCache[condition]=ast;}}evalCtx.Flags=flags;evalCtx.QuestFactory=QuestFactory.Instance;return ast.Evaluate(evalCtx);}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> Represents a parsed .scenario file entry from a mod manifest. Maps a visual novel scenario script to a target scene with scheduling metadata, condition expressions, and save/permanence flags. public class ScenarioDefinition{/// <summary> The display name of the scenario, also used as the unique event identifier within its scene. </summary>

public string Scene{get;set;}/// <summary> Execution priority; lower values execute earlier. Ties are broken by identifier ordering. </summary>

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{public static class SceneEventRegistry{private static readonly Dictionary<string,List<SceneEventInfo>>events=new();private static bool initialized;/// <summary> Scans all loaded assemblies for <see cref="ExecutableEvent"/> types decorated with <see cref="SceneEventAttribute"/> and registers them in the event table. Uses double-checked locking for thread safety. Subsequent calls are no-ops. </summary>
public static void Initialize(){if(initialized)return;lock(events){if(initialized)return;RegisterFromAttributes();initialized=true;}}/// <summary> Registers a specific <see cref="ExecutableEvent"/> subclass for a scene with optional priority, dependency, and condition parameters. </summary> <typeparam name="T">The <see cref="ExecutableEvent"/> subclass to register.</typeparam> <param name="sceneName">The scene identifier to associate the event with.</param> <param name="priority">Execution priority (lower = earlier). Default 0.</param> <param name="after">Identifier of an event that must precede this one.</param> <param name="condition">Condition expression string evaluated at runtime.</param>
public static void Register<T>(string sceneName,int priority=0,string after=null,string condition=null)where T:class{Register(typeof(T),sceneName,priority,after,condition);}/// <summary> Non-generic variant of <see cref="Register{T}"/> that accepts a <see cref="Type"/> directly. </summary> <param name="type">The <see cref="ExecutableEvent"/> type to register.</param> <param name="sceneName">The scene identifier to associate the event with.</param> <param name="priority">Execution priority (lower = earlier). Default 0.</param> <param name="after">Identifier of an event that must precede this one.</param> <param name="condition">Condition expression string evaluated at runtime.</param>
public static void Register(Type type,string sceneName,int priority=0,string after=null,string condition=null){lock(events){if(!events.TryGetValue(sceneName,out var list)){list=new List<SceneEventInfo>();events[sceneName]=list;}list.Add(new SceneEventInfo{Id=type.FullName,ClassName=type.FullName,Priority=priority,After=after,Condition=condition,});}}/// <summary> Returns all registered <see cref="SceneEventInfo"/> entries for the given scene name, sorted topologically by priority and <c>After</c> dependencies. Ensures <see cref="Initialize"/> has been called first. </summary> <param name="sceneName">The scene identifier to retrieve events for.</param>

public static void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly){lock(events){RegisterFromAttributes(assembly);}}private static void RegisterFromAttributes(Assembly assembly){foreach(var type in assembly.GetTypes()){var attr=type.GetCustomAttribute<SceneEventAttribute>();if(attr==null)continue;if(!typeof(ExecutableEvent).IsAssignableFrom(type))continue;Register(type,attr.SceneName,attr.Priority,attr.After,attr.Condition);}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> Self-registration point for mod-provided scene routes. The core keeps no knowledge of gameplay-specific scene names or paths: a mod's initializer calls <see cref="Register"/> with a logical name (the value scenarios use in <c>switch_scene</c>) and a mod-relative tscn path. <see cref="SceneManager"/> consults the registry before falling back to scenario composition, and <see cref="GodotSceneService"/> asks it for the transition style and music bucket when the path is loaded. A later registration with the same logical name overrides the earlier one (mod load order). Cleared on mod reload together with the other UI registries. </summary>
public static class SceneRouteRegistry{private static readonly Dictionary<string,SceneRoute>routes=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);/// <summary> Registers (or replaces) a route. The logical name is matched case-insensitively, so <c>switch_scene Battle</c> and <c>scene=battle</c> resolve to the same entry. </summary>
public static void Register(string logicalName,string modRelativeScenePath,bool fade,string musicScene=null,Audio.MusicType music=Audio.MusicType.Ambient){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(logicalName)||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(modRelativeScenePath)){GameLogger.Log("SCENE","SceneRouteRegistry.Register: empty name or path ignored",LogLevel.Error);return;}routes[logicalName]=new SceneRoute{LogicalName=logicalName,ScenePath=modRelativeScenePath,Fade=fade,MusicScene=musicScene,Music=music,};GameLogger.Log("SCENE",$"SceneRouteRegistry: '{logicalName}' -> '{modRelativeScenePath}' (fade={fade})");}/// <summary>Looks up a route by logical name; false when no mod registered it.</summary>
public static bool TryGet(string logicalName,out SceneRoute route){route=null;return!string.IsNullOrEmpty(logicalName)&&routes.TryGetValue(logicalName,out route);}/// <summary> Finds the route whose scene path matches the pending scene path, so the transition and music layers do not need to know logical names. </summary>
public static SceneRoute FindByPath(string scenePath){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(scenePath))return null;foreach(var route in routes.Values){if(string.Equals(route.ScenePath,scenePath,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return route;}return null;}/// <summary>Drops all registrations; next route lookup fails until a mod re-registers.</summary>
public static void Clear(){routes.Clear();}}}

using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnParsing;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnBuild.PropertyResolvers{/// <summary> Resolves <c>ExtResource("id")</c> properties. public class ExtResourcePropertyResolver:IPropertyResolver{public bool CanResolve(string k,object v)=>v is TscnPropertyValue pv&&pv.IsExtResourceRef;public void Apply(Node node,string key,object value,PropertyContext ctx){var pv=(TscnPropertyValue)value;var extRes=ctx.Scene.ExtResources.FirstOrDefault(r=>r.Id==pv.RefId);if(extRes==null)return;if(extRes.Type=="Script"){var st=ScriptTypeRegistry.Resolve(extRes.Path);if(st!=null&&typeof(Node).IsAssignableFrom(st))return;}if(extRes.Type=="PackedScene"&&ctx.InstanceLoader!=null){var sub=ctx.InstanceLoader(extRes.Path);if(sub!=null){AssignSceneOwners(sub,sub);var packed=new PackedScene();if(packed.Pack(sub)==Error.Ok)node.Set(key,packed);else GameLogger.Log("TSCN_BUILD",$"ExtResourcePropertyResolver: failed to pack '{extRes.Path}' for '{key}'",LogLevel.Warning);}return;}if(ctx.ExtResourceResolver!=null){var r=ctx.ExtResourceResolver(pv.RefId);if(r!=null)node.Set(key,Variant.From(r));}}/// <summary> <see cref="PackedScene.Pack"/> serializes only nodes whose <c>Owner</c> is the packed root, while the runtime builder produces owner-less trees (Godot assigns owners only when loading native scenes). Without this, PackedScene-typed exports (e.g. <c>DialogBox.answerBoxScene</c>) instantiate as a bare root with no children. Owners are assigned on the throwaway instance built for packing, not on the cached resolver tree. </summary>

using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnBuild{/// <summary> Auto-discovering registry of <see cref="ISubResourceBuilder"/> implementations, indexed by ResourceType. <para/> Initial scan on first access picks up all already-loaded assemblies (including core). <see cref="RegisterAssembly"/> is called by <see cref="Mods.ModAssemblyLoader.RegisterAssembly"/> when a mod DLL is loaded, adding the mod's builders without re-scanning everything. public static class SubResourceBuilderRegistry{private static System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string,ISubResourceBuilder>_builders;/// <summary>Lazy-initialises the registry by scanning all loaded assemblies for <see cref="ISubResourceBuilder"/> implementations. Idempotent.</summary>
public static void Initialize(){if(_builders!=null)return;_builders=new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string,ISubResourceBuilder>();foreach(var b in Reflections.FindAndCreate<ISubResourceBuilder>())if(!_builders.ContainsKey(b.ResourceType))_builders[b.ResourceType]=b;}/// <summary>Scans a newly-loaded mod assembly for <see cref="ISubResourceBuilder"/> implementations and registers them. Called from <see cref="Mods.ModAssemblyLoader.RegisterAssembly"/>.</summary>
public static void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly){Initialize();foreach(var b in Reflections.FindAndCreate<ISubResourceBuilder>(assembly))if(!_builders.ContainsKey(b.ResourceType))_builders[b.ResourceType]=b;}/// <summary>Looks up a builder by resource type name. Returns null if no builder is registered for the given type.</summary>
public static ISubResourceBuilder Get(string type){Initialize();_builders.TryGetValue(type,out var b);return b;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnParsing{/// <summary> Parses a single section type in a .tscn file (e.g. [node], [ext_resource]). Each implementation is responsible for exactly one section type. <para/> Lifecycle: Open (section header) → Property* (zero or more property lines) → Close (commit to ParsedScene). The orchestrator (<see cref="TscnParser"/>) calls these methods as it walks token stream, never branching on section type itself — lookup is deferred to <see cref="SectionParserRegistry"/>. <para/> Auto-discovered via <c>Reflections.FindAndCreate&lt;ISectionParser&gt;()</c>. To add a new section type, implement this interface in any loaded assembly — no registration code needed. </summary>
public interface ISectionParser{/// <summary>Section type name as it appears in .tscn (e.g. "node", "ext_resource").</summary>
string SectionType{get;}/// <summary>Called when a section header is encountered. <paramref name="headerAttrs"/> are the parsed key=value attributes from the brackets.</summary>
void Open(Dictionary<string,string>headerAttrs);/// <summary>Called for each key=value property line under the current section.</summary>
void Property(string key,string rawValue);/// <summary>Called when the next section header is encountered (or at end of file). Commits all accumulated state to <paramref name="scene"/>.</summary>
void Close(ParsedScene scene);}}

public class SubResourceDef{public string Type{get;set;}public string Id{get;set;}public Dictionary<string,object>Properties{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Keys of <see cref="Properties"/> in source-file order. public List<string>PropertyOrder{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Properties in the order they appeared in the .tscn source.</summary>
public IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string,object>>OrderedProperties{get{foreach(var key in PropertyOrder)if(Properties.TryGetValue(key,out var value))yield return new KeyValuePair<string,object>(key,value);}}}/// <summary> Parsed [node] section. Godot applies node properties in file order — critical for <c>layout_mode</c> → <c>anchors_preset</c> → <c>anchor_*</c>/<c>offset_*</c> sequencing.</summary>
public List<string>PropertyOrder{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Properties in the order they appeared in the .tscn source.</summary>
public IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string,object>>OrderedProperties{get{foreach(var key in PropertyOrder)if(Properties.TryGetValue(key,out var value))yield return new KeyValuePair<string,object>(key,value);}}}/// <summary>Parsed [connection] section. using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnParsing{/// <summary>Auto-discovering registry of <see cref="ISectionParser"/> implementations, indexed by SectionType. First-registered-wins.</summary>

using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnParsing.SectionParsers{/// <summary> Parses <c>[node]</c> — the core section. Extracts name, type, parent, instance (PackedScene ref), script (C# class ref), groups, node_paths. Special property handling: <c>script=</c> stored as ScriptRef, <c>__entry_point=</c> extracted to <see cref="ParsedScene.EntryPointClass"/> on root nodes, node_path vars stored as raw strings for build-time resolution. </summary>
public class NodeSectionParser:ISectionParser{public string SectionType=>"node";private ParsedNode _current;public void Open(Dictionary<string,string>h){_current=new ParsedNode{Name=h.GetValueOrDefault("name"),Type=h.GetValueOrDefault("type"),Parent=h.GetValueOrDefault("parent"),InstanceRef=h.GetValueOrDefault("instance"),ScriptRef=h.GetValueOrDefault("script")};if(h.TryGetValue("groups",out var gr))_current.Groups=ParseGroupArray(gr);if(h.TryGetValue("node_paths",out var np)){var vars=ParseGroupArray(np);_current.NodePathVars=new Dictionary<string,string>();foreach(var v in vars)_current.NodePathVars[v]=null;}}public void Property(string key,string rawValue){if(_current==null)return;if(key=="script"){_current.ScriptRef=rawValue;return;}var pv=TscnPropertyParser.Parse(rawValue);if(_current.NodePathVars!=null&&_current.NodePathVars.ContainsKey(key)){_current.NodePathVars[key]=rawValue;return;}_current.Properties[key]=pv;_current.PropertyOrder.Add(key);}public void Close(ParsedScene s){if(_current==null)return;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(s.EntryPointClass)&&(_current.Parent==null||_current.Parent==".")&&_current.Properties.TryGetValue("__entry_point",out var ep)&&ep is string ec){s.EntryPointClass=ec;_current.Properties.Remove("__entry_point");}s.Nodes.Add(_current);_current=null;}private static string[]ParseGroupArray(string raw){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(raw))return new string[0];var t=raw.Trim();if(t.StartsWith("[")&&t.EndsWith("]"))t=t.Substring(1,t.Length-2);if(t.StartsWith("PackedStringArray(")&&t.EndsWith(")"))t=t.Substring("PackedStringArray(".Length,t.Length-"PackedStringArray(".Length-1);var items=new List<string>();foreach(var p in TscnPropertyParser.SplitArgs(t)){var c=p.Trim();if(c.StartsWith("\"")&&c.EndsWith("\""))c=c.Substring(1,c.Length-2);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(c))items.Add(c);}return items.ToArray();}}}

public class TscnToken{public TscnTokenType Type{get;set;}public string SectionName{get;set;}public Dictionary<string,string>SectionAttrs{get;set;}public string PropertyKey{get;set;}public string PropertyValue{get;set;}public int LineNumber{get;set;}/// <summary>Factory for a [section_header] token with parsed key=value attributes.</summary>

using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnParsing{/// <summary> Orchestrator for .tscn parsing. Delegates section handling to <see cref="SectionParserRegistry"/> — no section-specific logic lives here. Produces a <see cref="ParsedScene"/> without creating Godot objects. </summary>
public class TscnParser{/// <summary>Parses .tscn source text into a ParsedScene. The scene contains flat lists of resources, nodes, and connections ready for <see cref="TscnBuild.SceneBuilder"/>.</summary>
public ParsedScene Parse(string source){var tokens=new TscnLexer().Tokenize(source);var scene=new ParsedScene();ISectionParser current=null;foreach(var token in tokens){if(token.Type==TscnTokenType.SectionHeader){current?.Close(scene);current=SectionParserRegistry.Get(token.SectionName);current?.Open(token.SectionAttrs??new Dictionary<string,string>());}else if(token.Type==TscnTokenType.Property&&current!=null){current.Property(token.PropertyKey,token.PropertyValue);}}current?.Close(scene);return scene;}}}

'{scenePath}' → root='{native.Name}' ({native.GetType().Name})");return native;}GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndBuild: scene '{scenePath}' not found in any mod",LogLevel.Error);return null;}}var cacheKey=scenePath;if(_builtCache.TryGetValue(cacheKey,out var cached)){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndBuild: HIT cached parsed=LoadAndParse(scenePath,modId);if(parsed==null){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndBuild: FAILED parse for '{cacheKey}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var previousScene=_resolvingScene;_resolvingScene=parsed;var root=new SceneBuilder().Build(parsed,InstanceLoader,ResolveExtResource);_resolvingScene=previousScene;if(root!=null){_builtCache[cacheKey]=root;GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndBuild: OK NOT FOUND for mod '{resolvedModId}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndParse: reading '{scenePath}' from mod='{resolvedModId}', provider={provider.GetType().Name}");var text=provider.ReadFileText(scenePath);if(text==null){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndParse: file text is NULL for path='{scenePath}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndParse: got {text.Length} chars, parsing...");var parsed=_parser.Parse(text);_parsedCache[cacheKey]=parsed;GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndParse: parsed OK — {parsed.ExtResources.Count} ext_resources, {parsed.SubResources.Count} ===== FILE Core/Settings/DataBlob.cs =====
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Smart container for a single logical entity (e.g. player stats, world map, textures). Each block carries its own schema version and a byte payload. Provides three data access modes: <list type="number"> <item><b>Key-value API</b> (GetInt/SetInt etc.) — lazy access via an internal dictionary, serialised to JSON on flush.</item> <item><b>JSON API</b> (ReadJson/WriteJson) — direct serialisation/deserialisation of an object into the payload.</item> <item><b>Binary API</b> (GetBytes/SetBytes) — raw byte access for textures, compressed data, etc.</item> </list> Key-value and JSON methods conflict: calling <c>WriteJson</c> overwrites the internal dictionary. Calling <c>SetInt</c> after <c>WriteJson</c> replaces the JSON object with a dictionary. </summary>
public class DataBlob{/// <summary>Schema version of the data in this block (default 1).</summary>
public int Version{get;set;}=1;private byte[]_payload=Array.Empty<byte>();public byte[]Payload{get=>_payload;set=>_payload=value??Array.Empty<byte>();}// Lazy cache of _payload deserialised as Dictionary. Private field, not persisted by System.Text.Json serialisation.
private Dictionary<string,object>_dict;public DataBlob(){}public DataBlob(int version){Version=version;}public DataBlob(int version,object data){Version=version;WriteJson(data);}public DataBlob(byte[]data){_payload=data??Array.Empty<byte>();}public int GetInt(string key,int defaultValue=0){EnsureDictLoaded();if(_dict.TryGetValue(key,out var val)){if(val is JsonElement je&&je.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.Number)return je.GetInt32();try{return Convert.ToInt32(val);}catch{return defaultValue;}}return defaultValue;}public float GetFloat(string key,float defaultValue=0f){EnsureDictLoaded();if(_dict.TryGetValue(key,out var val)){if(val is JsonElement je&&je.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.Number)return je.GetSingle();try{return Convert.ToSingle(val);}catch{return defaultValue;}}return defaultValue;}public string GetString(string key,string defaultValue=""){EnsureDictLoaded();if(_dict.TryGetValue(key,out var val)){if(val is JsonElement je&&je.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.String)return je.GetString()??defaultValue;return val?.ToString()??defaultValue;}return defaultValue;}public bool GetBool(string key,bool defaultValue=false){EnsureDictLoaded();if(_dict.TryGetValue(key,out var val)){if(val is JsonElement je&&(je.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.True||je.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.False))return je.GetBoolean();try{return Convert.ToBoolean(val);}catch{return defaultValue;}}return defaultValue;}public void SetInt(string key,int value){EnsureDictLoaded();_dict[key]=value;}public void SetFloat(string key,float value){EnsureDictLoaded();_dict[key]=value;}public void SetString(string key,string value){EnsureDictLoaded();_dict[key]=value??"";}public void SetBool(string key,bool value){EnsureDictLoaded();_dict[key]=value;}/// <summary> Deserialises the payload as the given type. Returns <c>new T()</c> when the payload is empty or invalid. </summary>
public T ReadJson<T>()where T:new(){if(_payload==null||_payload.Length==0)return new T();try{var result=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(_payload,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);return result??new T();}catch{return new T();}}/// <summary> Serialises an object into the payload, overwriting the internal dictionary if one exists. </summary>
public void WriteJson<T>(T data){if(data==null){_payload=Array.Empty<byte>();_dict=null;return;}_payload=JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes(data,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteCompactOptions);_dict=null;}/// <summary> Returns the raw byte payload. If data was written via the key-value API, flushes the dictionary to JSON first. </summary>
public byte[]GetBytes(){EnsurePayloadFromDict();return _payload;}public void SetBytes(byte[]data){_payload=data??Array.Empty<byte>();_dict=null;}private void EnsureDictLoaded(){if(_dict!=null)return;_dict=new Dictionary<string,object>();if(_payload==null||_payload.Length==0)return;try{var deserialized=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string,object>>(_payload,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(deserialized!=null)_dict=deserialized;}catch{_dict=new Dictionary<string,object>();}}private void EnsurePayloadFromDict(){if(_dict!=null){_payload=JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes(_dict,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteCompactOptions);}}}}

using System;using System.IO;using System.Text.Json;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;using Cthangover.Core.Settings.Configs;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Thread-safe singleton holding deserialised application configuration from <c>res://config/game_config.json</c>. Wraps audio, display, language, and logging sections. Initialisation is lazy — the static <see cref="Instance"/> accessor triggers <see cref="Load"/> on first use. If the Godot engine is not running (e.g. in unit tests), loading is silently skipped so the class degrades to defaults. </summary>
public class GameConfig{private static readonly Lazy<GameConfig>instance=new(()=>{var config=new GameConfig();config.Load();return config;});/// <summary>Global singleton instance, constructed on first access.</summary>
public static GameConfig Instance=>instance.Value;/// <summary>Audio bus preferences (volume, toggles).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("audio")]public AudioSection Audio{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Display mode, resolution, vsync, and scale.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("display")]public DisplaySection Display{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Logging verbosity and category whitelist.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("logging")]public LoggingSection Logging{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Locale code (e.g. "ru-ru", "en-us").</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("language")]public string Language{get;set;}="ru-ru";/// <summary> JSON constructor kept private to enforce singleton access through <see cref="Instance"/>. The parameterless constructor is required by <c>System.Text.Json</c> for deserialization. </summary>
[JsonConstructor]private GameConfig(){}/// <summary> Checks whether the Godot engine main loop is reachable. The result is cached after the first call so subsequent queries are cheap. Used by <see cref="Load"/> to decide whether file-system access via <c>ProjectSettings</c> is safe. </summary>
public static bool IsGodotRunning(){return GameEnvironment.IsRuntime;}/// <summary> Reads <c>res://config/game_config.json</c>, deserializes it via <c>System.Text.Json</c>, and copies each section into the corresponding property. Missing keys or malformed JSON leave defaults intact; parse errors are logged. </summary>
private void Load(){var configPath=GameEnvironment.IsRuntime?ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath("res://config/game_config.json"):"config/game_config.json";if(!File.Exists(configPath))return;try{var json=File.ReadAllText(configPath);var parsed=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<GameConfig>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(parsed==null)return;Audio=parsed.Audio??new AudioSection();Display=parsed.Display??new DisplaySection();Language=parsed.Language??"ru-ru";Logging=parsed.Logging??new LoggingSection();}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("CONFIG",$"Failed to parse game_config.json: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Localization;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Quests;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Unity-style Godot autoload that serves as the single entry point for the game state subsystem. Holds the <see cref="SettingsData"/> (persisted user preferences) and <see cref="RuntimeData"/> (session state). On <c>_Ready</c> it loads saved settings, initialises the locale, and plugs the <see cref="TimeTickController"/> into the global event system so that in-game time advances each tick. </summary>
public partial class GameData:Node{static GameData(){GameEnvironment.IsRuntime=true;GameEnvironment.MarkMainThread();}/// <summary>Global singleton, set once during <c>_EnterTree</c>.</summary>
public static GameData Instance{get;private set;}public GameData(){GameLogger.Init();}/// <summary> Registers this node as the global <see cref="Instance"/>. If a previous valid instance still exists (e.g. scene reload without proper cleanup), logs a diagnostic warning before overwriting. </summary>
public override void _EnterTree(){if(Instance!=null&&GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(Instance)){var scene=GetTree()?.CurrentScene?.Name??"?";var existingPath=Instance.GetPath().ToString();var myPath=GetPath().ToString();GameLogger.Log("DUPLICATE",$"GameData._EnterTree: Instance ALREADY SET by '{existingPath}', overwriting with duplicate at '{myPath}' on scene '{scene}'",LogLevel.Error);}Instance=this;GameLogger.Init();}/// <summary>Drives in-game time by listening to timer tick events from the <see cref="Cthangover.Core.UI.Event.SceneEventController"/>.</summary>
private readonly TimeTickController _timeTickController=new();/// <summary>Persisted user-facing settings (audio, display, language, etc.).</summary>
public SettingsData Settings{get;private set;}=new();private RuntimeData _runtime;/// <summary> All mutable session state: time, characters, inventory, recipes, lamp. Created lazily because constructing <see cref="RuntimeData"/> seeds the starter <see cref="Inventory"/> through mod factories. During launcher boot the autoload is constructed before the launcher loads mods, so an eager construction would query an empty registry and permanently cache "no items". Deferring the first construction until after mod initialisation guarantees the factories see the loaded mods. </summary>
public RuntimeData Runtime=>_runtime??=new RuntimeData();/// <summary> Discards the current <see cref="RuntimeData"/> and creates a fresh one. Must be called when starting a new game: the autoload (and therefore <see cref="Runtime"/>) survives returning to the main menu, so without a reset, state from a previous playthrough — including completed one-run scenario history — would leak into the new game. </summary>
public void ResetRuntime(){_runtime=new RuntimeData();GameLogger.Log("GAME","RuntimeData reset for new game");}/// <summary> Begins a "New Game": wipes the runtime state, resets every quest to its freshly loaded state (the quest factory survives returning to the menu, so without this step tags and statuses from the previous playthrough would poison the new one), and then publishes <see cref="Events.NewGameStartedEvent"/>. Mods listen to that event to re-seed per-session data — the core mod restores the starter party there, because <see cref="ResetRuntime"/> discards it and <c>IModInitializer.OnModResourcesReady</c> only runs once at boot. Call this instead of <see cref="ResetRuntime"/> whenever a fresh game starts. </summary>
public void StartNewGame(){ResetRuntime();QuestFactory.Instance.ResetAll();Events.ModEventBus.Publish(new Events.NewGameStartedEvent());}/// <summary> Called once after entering the scene tree. Loads previously saved <see cref="SettingsData"/> from disk, activates the current locale, registers <see cref="_timeTickController"/> with the event system, and emits a boot log message. </summary>
public override void _Ready(){Settings.Load();if(!BootController.IsLauncherBoot)LocaleLoader.LoadCurrentLanguage();_timeTickController.EnsureRegistered(this);GameLogger.Log("GAME",$"Game initialized, version={ProjectSettings.GetSetting("application/config/version")}");}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Per-mod metadata stored alongside its data in the save file. Filled by the mod during <c>OnSave</c> and inspected by the core during the validation phase before <c>OnLoad</c>. <b>Required fields</b> (<c>ModId</c>, <c>ModName</c>, <c>MinCoreVersion</c>, <c>IsRequired</c>) are validated by the core. <b>Optional fields</b> (<c>ModVersion</c>, <c>CustomData</c>) are ignored by the core — they exist for the mod's own use. </summary>

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Items;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Tracks which crafting recipes the player has unlocked. Internally a <see cref="HashSet{String}"/> of recipe IDs that provides <c>O(1)</c> lookup. Recipes can be queried by <see cref="IRecipe.WorkbenchType"/> via <see cref="GetRecipesByType"/>, which resolves each ID through <see cref="Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls.RecipeFactory"/> and filters the resulting <see cref="IRecipe"/> objects. </summary>
public class RecipeData{/// <summary>Set of known recipe IDs (duplicate insertion is silently ignored).</summary>
public HashSet<string>Data{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> Unlocks a recipe by ID. Returns <c>false</c> if the recipe was already known (duplicate). </summary>
public bool Add(string id){return Data.Add(id);}/// <summary><c>true</c> if the recipe with the given ID is already unlocked.</summary>
public bool Has(string id){return Data.Contains(id);}/// <summary> Returns all known recipes that belong to the specified <see cref="WorkbenchType"/>. public List<IRecipe>GetRecipesByType(WorkbenchType type){return Data.Select(o=>RecipeFactory.Instance.Get(o)).Where(o=>o.WorkbenchType==type).ToList();}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Skills;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Central mutable state bag for the entire game session. Every subsystem — time, characters, inventory, recipes, lamp and skills — lives here. <see cref="SaveService.Save"/> samples all these fields into a <see cref="SavePackage"/> DTO; <see cref="SaveService.Load"/> writes them back. The <see cref="CurrentScene"/> property resolves the active scene name into a <see cref="Cthangover.Core.Scenes.GodotSceneType"/> enum for conditional logic elsewhere. </summary>
public class RuntimeData{/// <summary>In-game clock (minutes-based) driving day/night cycles.</summary>
public TimeData Time{get;set;}=new TimeData(143546335);/// <summary>Recruited character roster with attributes and battle party set.</summary>
public CharacterData CharacterData{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Unlocked skills and their cooldown state.</summary>
public SkillData SkillData{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Player inventory of item stacks.</summary>
public Inventory Inventory{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Unlocked recipe IDs and lookup helpers.</summary>
public RecipeData RecipeData{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Lamp light radius and influence state.</summary>
public LampData LampData{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Persistent collection of action IDs available for assignment via the character panel.</summary>
public ActionPoolData ActionPool{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> IDs of one-run scenarios completed in the current game. Grows as one-run scenario dialogs finish (see <c>DialogRuntime.End</c>), is replaced by the save's <c>CompletedScenarios</c> blob on load and cleared when a new game starts (see <c>GameData.ResetRuntime</c>). The scenario runner filters scene events against this set, which makes <c>is_one_run: true</c> hold across scene revisits and save/load cycles instead of only within a single scene visit. </summary>
public HashSet<string>CompletedScenarioIds{get;}=new();/// <summary> IDs of one-shot scenarios restored from a loaded save. Populated by <see cref="SaveService.Load"/> and consumed by the scenario runner to skip re-triggering. When <c>null</c>, no load has occurred yet (fresh game). Call <see cref="ClearLoadState"/> to reset after processing. </summary>
public HashSet<string>LoadedCompletedScenarioIds{get;set;}/// <summary> Clears the post-load scenario block list. Should be called after the scenario runner has consumed the IDs to prevent stale data from persisting across scene transitions. The persistent completion history itself lives in <see cref="CompletedScenarioIds"/> and is not affected. </summary>
public void ClearLoadState(){LoadedCompletedScenarioIds=null;}/// <summary> Resolves the currently active scene into a <see cref="Cthangover.Core.Scenes.GodotSceneType"/> enum value. Queries <see cref="Cthangover.Core.Scenes.SceneManager"/> first, then falls back to parsing the current scene's resource path. Defaults to <c>GodotSceneType.MainMenu</c> when unresolvable. </summary>
public GodotSceneType CurrentScene{get{var sceneManager=SceneContextNode.FindNode<SceneManager>("SceneManager");if(sceneManager!=null&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(sceneManager.CurrentSceneName)){if(System.Enum.TryParse<GodotSceneType>(sceneManager.CurrentSceneName,true,out var result))return result;}var scene=SceneContextNode.CurrentScene;if(scene!=null){var path=scene.SceneFilePath;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)){var name=System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(path);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name)&&System.Enum.TryParse<GodotSceneType>(name,true,out var result))return result;}}return GodotSceneType.MainMenu;}}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Cthangover.Core.Quests;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Pure marshalling helper: packs <see cref="RuntimeData"/> into a <c>"__core__"</c> <see cref="ModSlot"/> (named <see cref="DataBlob"/> blocks per subsystem) and restores it back. Does not touch filesystem, validation, or mod dispatch — that is the responsibility of <see cref="SaveService"/>. </summary>
public static class RuntimeSerializer{/// <summary> Lightweight DTO serialised into <see cref="ModMetadata.CustomData"/> of the <c>"__core__"</c> slot so that <see cref="SaveService.GetSaveSlots"/> can extract preview info without deserialising full game-state blobs. </summary>
public class CoreSlotPreview{public string CurrentSceneName{get;set;}public long GameTime{get;set;}public int CharacterCount{get;set;}}/// <summary> Builds the <c>"__core__"</c> <see cref="ModSlot"/> with named <see cref="DataBlob"/> blocks for each subsystem (Time, Lamp, Characters, Quests, BattleSet, Inventory, Recipes, ActionPool, CompletedScenarios) and slot-level preview metadata in <see cref="ModMetadata.CustomData"/>. </summary>
public static ModSlot BuildCoreSlot(RuntimeData runtime,string coreVersion,string currentSceneName,HashSet<string>completedScenarioIds){var slot=new ModSlot{Metadata=new ModMetadata{ModId=SavePackage.CoreSlotKey,ModName="Core Game",MinCoreVersion=coreVersion,IsRequired=true,}};slot.Data["Time"]=new DataBlob(1,runtime.Time.Tick);var lampBlob=new DataBlob(1);lampBlob.SetFloat("Radius",runtime.LampData.Radius);lampBlob.SetFloat("Influence",runtime.LampData.Influence);slot.Data["Lamp"]=lampBlob;slot.Data["Characters"]=new DataBlob(1,runtime.CharacterData.Characters.Values.ToList());slot.Data["Quests"]=new DataBlob(1,QuestFactory.Instance.GetAll());slot.Data["BattleSet"]=new DataBlob(1,runtime.CharacterData.BattleSet.ToList());slot.Data["Inventory"]=new DataBlob(1,runtime.Inventory.Items.Select(o=>new CItem{ID=o.Item.ID,Count=o.Count}).ToList());slot.Data["Recipes"]=new DataBlob(1,runtime.RecipeData.Data.ToList());slot.Data["ActionPool"]=new DataBlob(1,runtime.ActionPool.ActionIds.ToList());slot.Data["CompletedScenarios"]=new DataBlob(1,completedScenarioIds.ToList());var preview=new CoreSlotPreview{CurrentSceneName=currentSceneName,GameTime=runtime.Time.Tick,CharacterCount=runtime.CharacterData.Characters?.Count??0,};slot.Metadata.CustomData=JsonSerializer.Serialize(preview,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteCompactOptions);return slot;}/// <summary> Restores core state from the <c>"__core__"</c> slot's blobs back into the given <paramref name="runtime"/> instance. Silently skips any missing blob key — the corresponding subsystem keeps its previous value, except <see cref="RuntimeData.CompletedScenarioIds"/> which is always reset first: a loaded save is the authoritative completion history of its own playthrough, so completions from a previously running game must never leak into it. </summary>
public static void RestoreCoreState(ModSlot coreSlot,RuntimeData runtime){if(coreSlot.Data==null)return;runtime.CompletedScenarioIds.Clear();if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("Time",out var timeBlob))runtime.Time.SetTime(timeBlob.ReadJson<long>());if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("Lamp",out var lampBlob)){runtime.LampData.Radius=lampBlob.GetFloat("Radius",100f);runtime.LampData.Influence=lampBlob.GetFloat("Influence",0.5f);}if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("Characters",out var charBlob)){var chars=charBlob.ReadJson<List<CharacterInfoData>>();runtime.CharacterData.Characters=new Dictionary<string,CharacterInfoData>();if(chars!=null)foreach(var c in chars)runtime.CharacterData.Characters[c.CharacterType]=c;}if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("Quests",out var questBlob))QuestFactory.Instance.SetAll(questBlob.ReadJson<List<QuestBase>>());if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("BattleSet",out var bsBlob))runtime.CharacterData.BattleSet=bsBlob.ReadJson<List<string>>()?.ToHashSet()??new HashSet<string>();if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("Inventory",out var invBlob)){var items=invBlob.ReadJson<List<CItem>>();runtime.Inventory.Items=items?.Select(o=>(IItemContainer)new ItemContainer{Item=ItemFactory.Instance.Get(o.ID),Count=o.Count}).ToList()??new List<IItemContainer>();}if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("Recipes",out var recipeBlob))runtime.RecipeData.Data=recipeBlob.ReadJson<List<string>>()?.ToHashSet()??new HashSet<string>();if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("ActionPool",out var apBlob))runtime.ActionPool.ActionIds=apBlob.ReadJson<List<string>>()??new List<string>();if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("CompletedScenarios",out var csBlob)){runtime.LoadedCompletedScenarioIds=csBlob.ReadJson<List<string>>()?.ToHashSet()??new HashSet<string>();runtime.CompletedScenarioIds.UnionWith(runtime.LoadedCompletedScenarioIds);}}/// <summary> Reads slot preview metadata from <see cref="ModMetadata.CustomData"/> JSON. Returns defaults when the field is absent or malformed. </summary>
public static CoreSlotPreview ReadSlotPreview(ModMetadata meta){var result=new CoreSlotPreview();if(meta?.CustomData==null)return result;try{var preview=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CoreSlotPreview>(meta.CustomData,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(preview!=null)return preview;}catch{}return result;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Root DTO of the save file. Contains save identification (SaveId, Timestamp, CoreVersion) and a <see cref="ModData"/> dictionary holding data slots from every mod that implements <see cref="Cthangover.Core.Mods.IModSaveable"/>, plus the reserved <c>"__core__"</c> slot that stores all core game state. The core itself does not inspect or deserialise mod blob payloads — it only routes byte arrays between the save file and the mod that owns each slot. </summary>
public class SavePackage{public const string CoreSlotKey="__core__";/// <summary>User-facing save name (e.g. "slot_1").</summary>
public string SaveId{get;set;}/// <summary>UTC timestamp when the save was created.</summary>
public DateTime Timestamp{get;set;}/// <summary>Version of the core that created this save.</summary>
public string CoreVersion{get;set;}/// <summary> Data slots from mods, keyed by ModId. The reserved key <c>"__core__"</c> holds core game state. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,ModSlot>ModData{get;set;}=new();}}

using System;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.View;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Static utility for capturing and loading save-slot thumbnail images. On save (<see cref="CaptureAndSave"/>), it grabs the current background texture from the <see cref="Cthangover.Core.UI.View.ViewBox"/>, scales it down to a 320×180 thumbnail, and writes a PNG next to the JSON save file. On load (<see cref="LoadScreenshot"/>), it reads the PNG back and returns a <see cref="Texture2D"/> suitable for the slot UI. A fallback solid-colour image is used when no background texture is available. </summary>
public static class SaveScreenshotService{private const string SaveDir="user://saves";/// <summary> Captures the current background image, downscales it to 320×180, and saves it as a PNG thumbnail alongside the save file. If the background texture is unavailable, a solid fallback image is used. Silently returns on error (logged internally). </summary>
public static void CaptureAndSave(string fileName){var absDir=ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(SaveDir);if(!DirAccess.DirExistsAbsolute(absDir))DirAccess.MakeDirRecursiveAbsolute(absDir);var safe=new string(fileName.Select(c=>char.IsLetterOrDigit(c)||c=='_'||c=='-'?c:'_').ToArray());var path=$"{SaveDir}/{safe}.png";try{var image=CaptureBackgroundImage();if(image==null)return;var smallImage=ScaleImage(image,320,180);smallImage.SavePng(ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(path));}catch(Exception e){GameLogger.Log("SAVE",$"Error capturing screenshot: {e.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}/// <summary> Loads the thumbnail PNG for a save slot and returns it as a <see cref="Texture2D"/>. Returns <c>null</c> if the file does not exist or fails to decode. </summary>
public static Texture2D LoadScreenshot(string fileName){var safe=new string(fileName.Select(c=>char.IsLetterOrDigit(c)||c=='_'||c=='-'?c:'_').ToArray());var path=$"{SaveDir}/{safe}.png";var absPath=ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(path);if(!System.IO.File.Exists(absPath))return null;try{var image=new Image();var err=image.Load(path);if(err!=Error.Ok)return null;return ImageTexture.CreateFromImage(image);}catch{return null;}}/// <summary> Retrieves the current background texture from the <see cref="Cthangover.Core.UI.View.ViewBox"/> node. Falls back to a 64×64 solid-dark image if no valid texture exists. </summary>
private static Image CaptureBackgroundImage(){var viewBox=SceneContextNode.FindNode<ViewBox>("ViewBox");if(viewBox?.Background?.Texture==null)return CreateFallbackImage();var image=viewBox.Background.Texture.GetImage();if(image==null||image.IsEmpty())return CreateFallbackImage();return image;}/// <summary> Produces a 64×64 solid dark-grey fallback image used when the actual background texture is unavailable. </summary>
private static Image CreateFallbackImage(){var image=Image.CreateEmpty(64,64,false,Image.Format.Rgba8);image.Fill(new Color(0.12f,0.12f,0.12f,1));return image;}/// <summary> Resizes <paramref name="source"/> to the given dimensions using Lanczos interpolation for high-quality downscaling of thumbnails. </summary>
private static Image ScaleImage(Image source,int width,int height){source.Resize(width,height,Image.Interpolation.Lanczos);return source;}}}
