using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Utils.Types;namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils{/// <summary> A string-keyed property bag with typed getters and setters, serving as the runtime representation of scenario entity state (characters, items, locations) and mod configuration data. Every value is stored as a plain <c>string</c> internally and parsed on demand by the typed accessors. </summary> <remarks> <para> The flat <c>string</c>-to-<c>string</c> dictionary allows the scenario scripting engine and mod JSON deserialisation to use a uniform property model without per-entity schema definitions. Type coercion happens at the getter/setter boundary, keeping the storage layer simple. </para> <para> Floating-point values use a culture-invariant <c>"."</c> decimal separator so that serialised JSON and scenario files produce identical results regardless of the host OS locale. </para> <para> Marked <see cref="SerializableAttribute"/> so that <see cref="System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer"/> can serialise <see cref="Values"/> directly. </para> </remarks>
[Serializable]public class PropertyData{private List<IPropertyInterceptor>_interceptors=new();private HashSet<string>_activeProperties=new();/// <summary> Registers an interceptor for a specific property key (defined by <see cref="IPropertyInterceptor.PropertyName"/>). Fires before every write to that property via any typed setter. </summary>
public void AddInterceptor(IPropertyInterceptor interceptor)=>_interceptors.Add(interceptor);/// <summary> Removes a previously registered interceptor. Safe to call during interception (though the current chain iteration completes before the list is updated). </summary>
public void RemoveInterceptor(IPropertyInterceptor interceptor)=>_interceptors.Remove(interceptor);/// <summary> Removes all registered interceptors at once. Typically used when unloading a mod that registered effect hooks. </summary>
public void ClearInterceptors()=>_interceptors.Clear();/// <summary> The backing key-value store. Keys are property names; values are always strings. Exposed publicly so that serialisers and bulk-copy operations can iterate directly without going through individual getters. </summary>
public IDictionary<string,string>Values{get;set;}=new Dictionary<string,string>();/// <summary> Generic typed getter. Looks up the raw string in <see cref="Values"/>, parses it through the <see cref="IParse{T}"/> registered for <typeparamref name="T"/> in <see cref="TParser"/>, and returns the result. Falls back to <paramref name="defaultValue"/> when the key is absent or the parser returns <c>default(T)</c>. </summary> <typeparam name="T">Must have a parser registered in <see cref="TParser"/>.</typeparam>
public T Get<T>(string name,T defaultValue){if(!Values.TryGetValue(name,out var value))return defaultValue;return TParser.Resolve<T>().Parse(value)??defaultValue;}/// <summary> Generic typed setter. Formats <paramref name="value"/> through the <see cref="IParse{T}"/> registered for <typeparamref name="T"/>, then routes the resulting string through the interceptor chain — interceptors matching <paramref name="name"/> are called in registration order, each potentially modifying the value before it's stored in <see cref="Values"/>. </summary> <remarks> Uses a <c>_activeProperties</c> set to prevent infinite recursion: when interceptor A for "Defence" calls <c>SetInt("Health", ...)</c>, Health's interceptors fire normally, but writing back to "Defence" skips the chain. </remarks> <typeparam name="T">Must have a parser registered in <see cref="TParser"/>.</typeparam>
public void Set<T>(string name,T value){var parser=TParser.Resolve<T>();var text=parser.Format(value);if(!_activeProperties.Add(name)){Values[name]=text;return;}try{var prev=GetStr(name);foreach(var interceptor in _interceptors){if(interceptor.PropertyName==name)text=interceptor.Intercept(prev,text);}Values[name]=text;}finally{_activeProperties.Remove(name);}}/// <summary> Retrieves the raw string stored under <paramref name="name"/>, or returns <paramref name="defaultValue"/> (which defaults to <c>null</c>) when the key is absent. </summary>
public string GetStr(string name,string defaultValue=null){return Get(name,defaultValue);}/// <summary> Parses the stored string as a 32-bit signed integer. Returns <paramref name="defaultValue"/> (0) when the key is missing or the value is blank. </summary>
public int GetInt(string name,int defaultValue=0){return Get(name,defaultValue);}/// <summary> Parses the stored string as a single-precision float using the invariant <c>"."</c> decimal separator, bypassing OS locale settings. Returns <paramref name="defaultValue"/> (0f) on missing/blank keys. </summary>
public float GetFloat(string name,float defaultValue=0f){return Get(name,defaultValue);}/// <summary> Parses the stored string as a 64-bit signed integer. Returns <paramref name="defaultValue"/> (0) when the key is missing or the value is blank. </summary>
public long GetLong(string name,long defaultValue=0){return Get(name,defaultValue);}/// <summary> Parses the stored string as a boolean via <see cref="bool.Parse"/>. Always returns <c>false</c> when the key is missing or blank (there is no overload with a custom default because <c>false</c> is the conventional default for boolean properties). </summary>
public bool GetBool(string name,bool defaultValue=false){return Get(name,defaultValue);}/// <summary> Stores a raw string value, overwriting any existing entry under the same <paramref name="name"/>. </summary>
public void SetStr(string name,string value){Set(name,value);}/// <summary> Converts the integer to its default string representation and stores it under <paramref name="name"/>. </summary>
public void SetInt(string name,int value){Set(name,value);}/// <summary> Converts the float to a culture-invariant string (dot decimal) and stores it under <paramref name="name"/>. </summary>
public void SetFloat(string name,float value){Set(name,value);}/// <summary> Converts the 64-bit integer to its default string representation and stores it under <paramref name="name"/>. </summary>
public void SetLong(string name,long value){Set(name,value);}/// <summary> Converts the boolean to <c>"True"</c> or <c>"False"</c> and stores it under <paramref name="name"/>. </summary>
public void SetBool(string name,bool value){Set(name,value);}/// <summary> Returns <c>true</c> if a property with the given <paramref name="name"/> exists in the backing dictionary, regardless of its value. </summary>
public bool Has(string name){return Values.ContainsKey(name);}/// <summary> Creates a shallow copy where the <see cref="Values"/> dictionary contents are duplicated key-by-key into a new <see cref="Dictionary{String, String}"/>. The string values themselves are shared (immutable reference type), so this is effectively a deep-enough clone for property mutation scenarios. </summary>
public PropertyData Clone(){var clone=new PropertyData();foreach(var kvp in Values)clone.Values[kvp.Key]=kvp.Value;return clone;}/// <summary> Imports a single JSON key-value pair into the property bag. Dispatches by <c>JsonValueKind</c> to the appropriate typed setter. Arrays and objects are stored as raw JSON strings. No merge logic — just a plain copy. </summary>
public static void ImportJsonProperty(PropertyData props,string key,object value){if(value is System.Text.Json.JsonElement je){switch(je.ValueKind){case System.Text.Json.JsonValueKind.Number:if(je.TryGetInt32(out var i))props.SetInt(key,i);else props.SetFloat(key,(float)je.GetDouble());break;case System.Text.Json.JsonValueKind.True:case System.Text.Json.JsonValueKind.False:props.SetBool(key,je.GetBoolean());break;case System.Text.Json.JsonValueKind.String:props.SetStr(key,je.GetString());break;default:props.SetStr(key,je.GetRawText());break;}}else{props.SetStr(key,value?.ToString());}}/// <summary> Imports all entries from a JSON extension-data dictionary into the property bag. No merge — each value is set directly. </summary>
public static void ImportJsonProperties(PropertyData props,Dictionary<string,object>extraProperties){if(extraProperties==null)return;foreach(var kvp in extraProperties)ImportJsonProperty(props,kvp.Key,kvp.Value);}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils{/// <summary> Reflection-based discovery utility that scans the current <see cref="AppDomain"/> for concrete implementations of a given type and instantiates them. This is the backbone of the project's plugin-discovery mechanism: mod behaviours, JSON converters, and command handlers register themselves simply by being public, non-abstract classes implementing a known interface or base class. </summary> <remarks> The returned collection uses <see cref="LinkedList{T}"/> for O(1) append during the scan. Callers may copy to a <see cref="List{T}"/> if random access is needed downstream. </remarks>
public static class Reflections{/// <summary> Walks every loaded assembly in the current <see cref="AppDomain"/>, finds every public, non-abstract class assignable to <typeparamref name="T"/>, creates a parameterless instance via <see cref="Activator.CreateInstance(Type)"/>, and appends it to the result list. </summary> <typeparam name="T">The base type or interface to search for.</typeparam> <returns>A collection of freshly-constructed instances in discovery order.</returns>
public static ICollection<T>FindAndCreate<T>(Assembly assemblyFilter=null,Predicate<Type>filter=null){var list=new LinkedList<T>();var typeT=typeof(T);if(assemblyFilter==null){foreach(var assembly in AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies())CheckAssembly(typeT,list,assembly,filter);}else{CheckAssembly(typeT,list,assemblyFilter,filter);}return list;}private static void CheckAssembly<T>(Type typeT,LinkedList<T>list,Assembly assemblyFilter,Predicate<Type>filter=null){Type[]types;try{types=assemblyFilter.GetTypes();}catch(ReflectionTypeLoadException ex){types=ex.Types.Where(t=>t!=null).ToArray();GameLogger.Log("REFLECTIONS",$"FindAndCreate<{typeT.Name}>: assembly '{assemblyFilter.GetName().Name}' partially loaded, continuing with {types.Length} type(s)",LogLevel.Warning);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("REFLECTIONS",$"FindAndCreate<{typeT.Name}>: cannot enumerate types of '{assemblyFilter.FullName}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Warning);return;}foreach(var type in types){if(!typeT.IsAssignableFrom(type)|| !type.IsPublic||type.IsAbstract||type.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes)==null)continue;if(filter!=null&& !filter.Invoke(type))continue;try{list.AddLast((T)Activator.CreateInstance(type));}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("REFLECTIONS",$"FindAndCreate<{typeT.Name}>: failed to instantiate '{type.FullName}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Warning);}}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils{/// <summary> A <see cref="System.Text.Json"/> converter that handles JSON fields which can be either a single string or an array of strings, normalising both into a <see cref="List{String}"/>. This accommodates the common mod-authoring convention where a single-value property may be written as a plain string for brevity but expanded to an array later. </summary> <remarks> On serialisation, single-element lists are collapsed back to a plain string value; empty lists emit <c>null</c>; multi-element lists produce a JSON array. This round-trips the "terse authoring" pattern. </remarks>
public class StringOrArrayConverter:JsonConverter<List<string>>{/// <summary> Normalises a JSON string token into a single-element list, or iterates a JSON array token to collect all string elements. Any other token type throws <see cref="JsonException"/>. </summary>
public override List<string>Read(ref Utf8JsonReader reader,Type typeToConvert,JsonSerializerOptions options){if(reader.TokenType==JsonTokenType.String){return new List<string>{reader.GetString()};}if(reader.TokenType==JsonTokenType.StartArray){var list=new List<string>();while(reader.Read()){if(reader.TokenType==JsonTokenType.EndArray)break;if(reader.TokenType==JsonTokenType.String)list.Add(reader.GetString());}return list;}throw new JsonException($"Expected string or array, got {reader.TokenType}");}/// <summary> Writes the list back to JSON. A single-element list is serialised as a string for readability; an empty list emits <c>null</c>; otherwise a full JSON array is produced. </summary>
public override void Write(Utf8JsonWriter writer,List<string>value,JsonSerializerOptions options){if(value==null||value.Count==0){writer.WriteNullValue();return;}if(value.Count==1){writer.WriteStringValue(value[0]);}else{writer.WriteStartArray();foreach(var item in value)writer.WriteStringValue(item);writer.WriteEndArray();}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils{/// <summary> Token-based string extraction helpers used primarily by the scenario scripting subsystem. The main use case is pulling text fragments enclosed between arbitrary delimiter pairs — such as curly braces in templated dialogue or square brackets in markup — without resorting to full regex. </summary>
public static class StringParsing{/// <summary> Scans <paramref name="text"/> for substrings enclosed between <paramref name="firstQuote"/> and <paramref name="secondQuote"/>, returning the inner content of each matching pair. Processing resumes after each closing delimiter, so nested or overlapping delimiters are <em>not</em> handled — only sequential, non-overlapping pairs. </summary> <param name="text">The source string to scan.</param> <param name="firstQuote">The opening delimiter token.</param> <param name="secondQuote">The closing delimiter token.</param> <returns>All extracted inner fragments, in left-to-right order.</returns> <exception cref="ArgumentException"> Thrown when an opening delimiter is found without its corresponding closing delimiter later in the string. </exception>
public static ICollection<string>GetIncludesInQuotes(this string text,string firstQuote,string secondQuote){var pos=0;var list=new List<string>();for(;;){var firstIndex=text.IndexOf(firstQuote,pos,StringComparison.InvariantCulture);if(firstIndex<0)break;var endIndex=text.IndexOf(secondQuote,firstIndex+firstQuote.Length,StringComparison.InvariantCulture);if(endIndex<0)throw new ArgumentException("second token '"+secondQuote+"' parse exception");list.Add(text.Substring(firstIndex+firstQuote.Length,endIndex-firstIndex-firstQuote.Length));pos=endIndex+1;}return list;}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils{/// <summary> Centralised texture-loading pipeline for the mod system. Because Godot's <c>ResourceLoader</c> cannot load assets embedded inside mod archives, this utility reads raw image bytes through <see cref="ModManager"/> and decodes them into <see cref="Godot.Texture2D"/> instances via Godot's <see cref="Image"/> API. It also performs extension-based key matching so that callers can omit file extensions when requesting textures. </summary>
public static class TextureUtils{/// <summary> Loads a texture identified by <paramref name="imagePath"/> from the mod group named <paramref name="groupName"/>. The path is normalised (slashes, casing, optional extension) before it is matched against the file manifest maintained by <see cref="ModManager.Instance"/>. </summary> <param name="groupName"> The logical mod group whose file manifest will be searched. </param> <param name="imagePath"> A project-relative path to the image. Leading slashes are stripped, any <c>groupName/</c> prefix is removed, and the extension may be omitted — the first file whose key starts with the normalised path and carries a recognised texture extension (from <c>ModConfig.Instance.GetTextureExtensionSet()</c>) will be loaded. </param> <returns> A decoded <see cref="Texture2D"/>, or <c>null</c> if the path is blank, no matching file is found, or decoding fails. </returns>
public static Texture2D LoadFromModGroup(string groupName,string imagePath){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(imagePath))return null;var normalized=NormalizeImagePath(imagePath,groupName);return LoadTextureFromModGroup(groupName,normalized);}private static string NormalizeImagePath(string path,string groupName){var normalized=ModPath.Normalize(path);var prefix=groupName+"/";if(normalized.StartsWith(prefix,System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))normalized=normalized.Substring(prefix.Length);normalized=normalized.ToLowerInvariant();return normalized;}private static Texture2D LoadTextureFromModGroup(string groupName,string idWithoutGroup){var files=Files.Collect(groupName);var textureExts=ModConfig.Instance.GetTextureExtensionSet();GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"LoadTextureFromModGroup: group='{groupName}' id='{idWithoutGroup}' files.Count={files.Count}",LogLevel.Debug);foreach(var k in files.Keys)GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"  file key='{k}' modId='{files[k].ModId}' fullPath='{files[k].FullPath}'",LogLevel.Debug);string matchedKey=null;foreach(var key in files.Keys){var ext=System.IO.Path.GetExtension(key);if(!textureExts.Contains(ext))continue;if(key==idWithoutGroup||key.StartsWith(idWithoutGroup+".",System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){matchedKey=key;break;}}if(matchedKey==null|| !files.TryGetValue(matchedKey,out var entry)){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"LoadTextureFromModGroup: FAILED - key not found for id='{idWithoutGroup}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var bytes=ModManager.Instance.ReadFileBinary(entry.ModId,entry.FullPath);if(bytes==null){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"LoadTextureFromModGroup: FAILED - ReadFileBinary returned null for modId='{entry.ModId}' fullPath='{entry.FullPath}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}return BytesToTexture(bytes,System.IO.Path.GetExtension(matchedKey));}private static Texture2D BytesToTexture(byte[]bytes,string extension){var image=new Image();Error error;var ext=extension?.ToLowerInvariant();if(ext==".png")error=image.LoadPngFromBuffer(bytes);else if(ext==".jpg"||ext==".jpeg")error=image.LoadJpgFromBuffer(bytes);else if(ext==".webp")error=image.LoadWebpFromBuffer(bytes);else return null;if(error!=Error.Ok)return null;var texture=ImageTexture.CreateFromImage(image);image.Dispose();return texture;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils.Types;/// <summary> Bidirectional parser for a type <typeparamref name="T"/>. <see cref="Parse"/> converts a string to <typeparamref name="T"/> (safe — returns <c>default</c> on unparseable input, never throws). <see cref="Format"/> converts <typeparamref name="T"/> back to a string (culture-invariant for numeric types). </summary> <remarks> Implementations are registered in <see cref="TParser"/> and used by <see cref="PropertyData.Get{T}"/>/<see cref="PropertyData.Set{T}"/> and <see cref="Cthangover.Core.Characters.PropertyInterceptor{T}"/>. Two implementation families exist: nullable (e.g. <c>IntParse : IParse&lt;int?&gt;</c>) for parsers that distinguish "absent" from "zero", and primitive (e.g. <c>IntPrimitiveParse : IParse&lt;int&gt;</c>) that fold absent into a sensible default. </remarks>
public interface IParse<T>{/// <summary> Converts a string to <typeparamref name="T"/>. Returns <c>default(T)</c> on null, empty, or unparseable input. Never throws. </summary>
T Parse(string value);/// <summary> Converts <typeparamref name="T"/> back to a string. Numeric types use <c>"."</c> as decimal separator (invariant culture). </summary>
string Format(T value);}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils.Types;/// <summary> Central registry for <see cref="IParse{T}"/> instances, keyed by <see cref="Type"/>. Resolves a typed parser from a dictionary without reflection — the <c>(IParse&lt;T&gt;)(object)</c> cast is safe because each entry was inserted with the correct <see cref="Type"/> key. </summary> <remarks> New types are registered by adding entries to <see cref="_parsers"/>. Each key must match the generic argument of its value exactly (both nullable and primitive variants are supported). Used by <see cref="PropertyData.Get{T}"/>, <see cref="PropertyData.Set{T}"/>, and <see cref="Cthangover.Core.Characters.PropertyInterceptor{T}"/>. </remarks>
public static class TParser{private static readonly Dictionary<Type,object>_parsers=new(){{typeof(int?),new IntParse()},{typeof(int),new IntPrimitiveParse()},{typeof(float?),new FloatParse()},{typeof(float),new FloatPrimitiveParse()},{typeof(long?),new LongParse()},{typeof(long),new LongPrimitiveParse()},{typeof(bool?),new BoolParse()},{typeof(bool),new BoolPrimitiveParse()},{typeof(string),new StringParse()},};/// <summary> Looks up the <see cref="IParse{T}"/> registered for <typeparamref name="T"/>. public static IParse<T>Resolve<T>(){if(_parsers.TryGetValue(typeof(T),out var boxed))return(IParse<T>)boxed;throw new NotSupportedException($"No parser for {typeof(T)}");}}

public class Vector2JsonConverter:JsonConverter<Vector2>{public override Vector2 Read(ref Utf8JsonReader reader,Type typeToConvert,JsonSerializerOptions options){if(reader.TokenType!=JsonTokenType.StartArray)throw new JsonException($"Expected StartArray for Vector2, got {reader.TokenType}.");reader.Read();var x=reader.GetSingle();reader.Read();var y=reader.GetSingle();reader.Read();if(reader.TokenType!=JsonTokenType.EndArray)throw new JsonException($"Expected EndArray for Vector2, got {reader.TokenType}.");return new Vector2(x,y);}public override void Write(Utf8JsonWriter writer,Vector2 value,JsonSerializerOptions options){writer.WriteStartArray();writer.WriteNumberValue(value.X);writer.WriteNumberValue(value.Y);writer.WriteEndArray();}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils{/// <summary> Serializes a <c>List&lt;Vector2&gt;</c> as a JSON array of <c>[x, y]</c> arrays. Used with <c>[JsonConverter]</c> on collection-typed properties to handle polygon point lists in map zone definitions. </summary>
public class Vector2ListJsonConverter:JsonConverter<List<Vector2>>{public override List<Vector2>Read(ref Utf8JsonReader reader,Type typeToConvert,JsonSerializerOptions options){if(reader.TokenType!=JsonTokenType.StartArray)throw new JsonException($"Expected StartArray for Vector2 list, got {reader.TokenType}.");var list=new List<Vector2>();while(reader.Read()){if(reader.TokenType==JsonTokenType.EndArray)return list;if(reader.TokenType!=JsonTokenType.StartArray)throw new JsonException($"Expected StartArray for Vector2 element, got {reader.TokenType}.");reader.Read();var x=reader.GetSingle();reader.Read();var y=reader.GetSingle();reader.Read();if(reader.TokenType!=JsonTokenType.EndArray)throw new JsonException($"Expected EndArray for Vector2 element, got {reader.TokenType}.");list.Add(new Vector2(x,y));}return list;}public override void Write(Utf8JsonWriter writer,List<Vector2>value,JsonSerializerOptions options){writer.WriteStartArray();foreach(var v in value){writer.WriteStartArray();writer.WriteNumberValue(v.X);writer.WriteNumberValue(v.Y);writer.WriteEndArray();}writer.WriteEndArray();}}}

public static class Vectors{/// <summary> Projects a <see cref="Godot.Vector3"/> onto the XY plane by discarding the Z component. Typically used when converting 3D world positions into 2D screen-space or minimap coordinates where depth is irrelevant. </summary>
public static Vector2 ToVector2(this Vector3 vector){return new Vector2(vector.X,vector.Y);}}}

===== FILE Core/Utils/VersionHelper.cs =====
using System;namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils{/// <summary> Per-segment version comparison. Version is split on '.', segments may contain letters ("1a", "alpha-3", "1b.2.0"). Algorithm: both arrays are padded with "0" to equal length, then lexicographic comparison. Each segment: if both parse as int — numeric comparison, otherwise string.CompareOrdinal. This is the only version comparison algorithm in the project — used in mod deduplication (ModRegistry.RegisterCandidates) and in versioned depends (ModDependency.IsSatisfiedBy). </summary>
public static class VersionHelper{/// <summary> Compares two version strings. Negative if a &lt; b, zero if equal, positive if a &gt; b. </summary>
public static int Compare(string a,string b){a=a?.Trim()??"0.0.0.0";b=b?.Trim()??"0.0.0.0";if(a.Length==0)a="0.0.0.0";if(b.Length==0)b="0.0.0.0";if(a==b)return 0;var segA=a.Split('.');var segB=b.Split('.');return CompareSegments(segA,segB);}/// <summary> Per-segment array comparison. Both are padded with "0" to equal length. Each segment: int comparison when possible, otherwise Ordinal. </summary>
public static int CompareSegments(string[]a,string[]b){var maxLen=Math.Max(a.Length,b.Length);for(int i=0;i<maxLen;i++){var sa=i<a.Length?a[i]:"0";var sb=i<b.Length?b[i]:"0";int cmp;if(int.TryParse(sa,out var ia)&&int.TryParse(sb,out var ib))cmp=ia.CompareTo(ib);else cmp=string.CompareOrdinal(sa,sb);if(cmp!=0)return cmp;}return 0;}/// <summary> Returns true when <c>a &lt; b</c> (a is an older version). </summary>
public static bool IsLessThan(string a,string b){return Compare(a,b)<0;}/// <summary> Returns true when <c>a &gt; b</c> (a is a newer version). </summary>
public static bool IsGreaterThan(string a,string b){return Compare(a,b)>0;}}}

using System.Diagnostics;using System.Text;namespace Cthangover.TestRunner{/// <summary> Cross-platform process launcher for the test runner. Uses <see cref="ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList"/> so paths and arguments with spaces survive on every OS, reads stdout/stderr asynchronously in UTF-8 (Godot logs are UTF-8) and kills the whole process tree on timeout, so a hung Godot can never stall the global run. </summary>
public static class ProcessRunner{public static ProcessResult Run(string fileName,IEnumerable<string>arguments,string workingDirectory,int timeoutSeconds){var startInfo=new ProcessStartInfo{FileName=fileName,WorkingDirectory=workingDirectory,UseShellExecute=false,RedirectStandardOutput=true,RedirectStandardError=true,StandardOutputEncoding=Encoding.UTF8,StandardErrorEncoding=Encoding.UTF8};foreach(var argument in arguments)startInfo.ArgumentList.Add(argument);var result=new ProcessResult();var stopwatch=Stopwatch.StartNew();using var process=new Process{StartInfo=startInfo};process.OutputDataReceived+=(_,e)=>Append(result,e.Data);process.ErrorDataReceived+=(_,e)=>Append(result,e.Data);process.Start();process.BeginOutputReadLine();process.BeginErrorReadLine();if(!process.WaitForExit(timeoutSeconds*1000)){result.TimedOut=true;try{process.Kill(entireProcessTree:true);}catch{}process.WaitForExit(5000);}else{process.WaitForExit();}stopwatch.Stop();result.Duration=stopwatch.Elapsed;result.ExitCode=result.TimedOut? -1:process.ExitCode;return result;}private static void Append(ProcessResult result,string line){if(line==null)return;lock(result.Output)result.Output.Add(line);}}}

using System.Text;namespace Cthangover.TestRunner{/// <summary> Cross-platform entry point for the whole test suite: builds the game assembly, runs xUnit unit tests, then every integration scene from <c>tests/tests.manifest.json</c> sequentially (they share the mod cache and write into <c>mods/</c>, so parallel runs are unsafe), and prints one summary with an aggregate exit code. Replaces the Windows-only PowerShell scripts; requires only the .NET 8 SDK and a Godot .NET executable on PATH, via <c>GODOT_BIN</c> or <c>--godot</c>. </summary>
public static class Program{public static int Main(string[]args){try{Console.OutputEncoding=Encoding.UTF8;}catch{}try{return Run(args);}catch(Exception ex){Console.Error.WriteLine($"test runner error: {ex.Message}");return 2;}}private static int Run(string[]args){var options=RunnerOptions.Parse(args);if(options.ShowHelp){Console.WriteLine(RunnerOptions.HelpText);return 0;}var root=ProjectLocator.Locate();var manifest=TestManifest.Load(Path.Combine(root,"tests","tests.manifest.json"));if(options.List){Console.WriteLine($"{"unit",-14} {manifest.Unit.Project}");foreach(var test in manifest.Integration)Console.WriteLine($"{test.Name,-14} {test.Scene}");return 0;}var godot=GodotLocator.Locate(options.Godot);var results=new List<TestResult>();if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(options.Switcher)){if(!EnsureBuild(root,options.NoBuild))return 1;results.Add(RunSwitcher(root,godot,options));return SummaryPrinter.Print(results,options.Json);}var selected=manifest.Integration.FirstOrDefault(t=>t.Name==options.Test);var runUnit=string.IsNullOrEmpty(options.Test)||options.Test=="unit";var runAllIntegration=string.IsNullOrEmpty(options.Test);if(!runUnit&&selected==null)throw new InvalidOperationException($"unknown test '{options.Test}'; use --list to see available tests");if((runAllIntegration||selected!=null)&& !EnsureBuild(root,options.NoBuild))return 1;if(runUnit){Console.WriteLine("Unit-тесты...");results.Add(RunUnit(root,manifest));}if(runAllIntegration){foreach(var test in manifest.Integration){Console.WriteLine($"Интеграционный тест: {test.Name}...");results.Add(RunIntegration(root,godot,test));}}else if(selected!=null){Console.WriteLine($"Интеграционный тест: {selected.Name}...");results.Add(RunIntegration(root,godot,selected));}return SummaryPrinter.Print(results,options.Json);}/// <summary> Builds the game assembly so Godot loads the current code (integration scenes and SceneSwitcher both run against it). Returns <c>false</c> after printing the compiler output when the build fails, so the caller can exit before reporting misleading test results. </summary>
private static bool EnsureBuild(string root,bool noBuild){if(noBuild)return true;Console.WriteLine("Сборка Cthangover.csproj...");var build=ProcessRunner.Run("dotnet",new[]{"build","Cthangover.csproj","--nologo","-v","q"},root,300);if(!build.TimedOut&&build.ExitCode==0)return true;Console.Error.WriteLine("Сборка не удалась:");Console.Error.WriteLine(build.OutputText);return false;}/// <summary> Runs the xUnit project through <c>dotnet test</c> with a TRX logger and reads exact counters from the report. TRX avoids parsing the localized console summary. </summary>
private static TestResult RunUnit(string root,TestManifest manifest){var trxDirectory=Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(),"cthangover_trx_"+Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));Directory.CreateDirectory(trxDirectory);try{var args=new List<string>{"test",manifest.Unit.Project,"--nologo","-v","q","--logger","trx;LogFileName=unit.trx","--results-directory",trxDirectory};var run=ProcessRunner.Run("dotnet",args,root,manifest.Unit.TimeoutSeconds);var counters=TrxParser.TryParseCounters(Path.Combine(trxDirectory,"unit.trx"));var result=new TestResult{Name="unit",Kind="unit",ExitCode=run.ExitCode,Duration=run.Duration,TimedOut=run.TimedOut,Passed= !run.TimedOut&&run.ExitCode==0,PassedChecks=counters?.Passed??0,FailedChecks=counters?.Failed??0};if(counters?.Failed>0)result.Passed=false;if(counters==null)result.Note="trx counters unavailable";else if(counters.Value.Skipped>0)result.Note=$"skipped={counters.Value.Skipped}";return result;}finally{try{Directory.Delete(trxDirectory,true);}catch{}}}/// <summary> Runs one integration scene headless and evaluates it from three sources: process exit code, the scene's <c>[TEST_RESULT]</c> line (authoritative for check counts) and the timeout flag. </summary>
private static TestResult RunIntegration(string root,string godot,IntegrationTestDefinition test){var args=new List<string>{"--headless","--path",root,test.Scene};if(test.Args!=null)args.AddRange(test.Args);var run=ProcessRunner.Run(godot,args,root,test.TimeoutSeconds);var parsed=ResultParser.Parse(run.Output);var passed= !run.TimedOut&&run.ExitCode==0&&(!parsed.HasResult||parsed.Failed==0);return new TestResult{Name=test.Name,Kind="integration",Passed=passed,TimedOut=run.TimedOut,ExitCode=run.ExitCode,PassedChecks=parsed.HasResult?parsed.Passed:(passed?1:0),FailedChecks=parsed.HasResult?parsed.Failed:(passed?0:1),Duration=run.Duration,Core=parsed.Core,Coverage=parsed.Coverage,Note=run.TimedOut?"timeout":(!parsed.HasResult?"no result marker":null)};}/// <summary> Smoke run through <c>SceneSwitcher</c> for arbitrary scenes and logical scene names. Unlike self-checking suites this has no <c>[TEST_RESULT]</c>; success means the auto-driver finished the dialog without hitting the SceneSwitcher timeout. </summary>
private static TestResult RunSwitcher(string root,string godot,RunnerOptions options){var args=new List<string>{"--headless","--path",root,"res://scenes/test/scene_switcher.tscn",$"--scene={options.Switcher}",$"--timeout={options.TimeoutSeconds}"};if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(options.Choices))args.Add($"--choices={options.Choices}");Console.WriteLine($"SceneSwitcher: {options.Switcher}...");var run=ProcessRunner.Run(godot,args,root,options.TimeoutSeconds+60);var ended=run.Output.Any(line=>line.Contains("DialogAutoDriver: dialog ended, quitting"));var timedOut=run.Output.Any(line=>line.Contains("SceneSwitcher: timeout"));var passed= !run.TimedOut&&run.ExitCode==0&&ended&& !timedOut;return new TestResult{Name="switcher",Kind="smoke",Passed=passed,TimedOut=run.TimedOut,ExitCode=run.ExitCode,PassedChecks=passed?1:0,FailedChecks=passed?0:1,Duration=run.Duration,Note=passed?$"scene={options.Switcher}":timedOut?$"timeout: scene={options.Switcher}":$"no dialog end: scene={options.Switcher}"};}}}

===== FILE tests/Cthangover.TestRunner/ResultParser.cs =====
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;namespace Cthangover.TestRunner{/// <summary> Parses the machine-readable markers every integration scene prints at the end of its run. The contract is deliberately tiny and stable: <c>[TEST_RESULT] name=... [core=...] passed=N failed=N</c> plus the battle coverage summary <c>[BATTLE_COVERAGE] coverage: N/M cores</c>. Exit code alone is not enough: a scene can exit 0 after a crash-free but failing run, and timeouts must be distinguishable from failures. </summary>
public static class ResultParser{private static readonly Regex ResultRegex=new(@"\[TEST_RESULT\]\s+name=(\S+)(?:\s+core=(\S+))?\s+passed=(\d+)\s+failed=(\d+)",RegexOptions.Compiled);private static readonly Regex CoverageRegex=new(@"\[BATTLE_COVERAGE\]\s+coverage:\s+(\d+)/(\d+)\s+cores",RegexOptions.Compiled);public static ParsedSceneResult Parse(IEnumerable<string>lines){var result=new ParsedSceneResult();foreach(var line in lines){var match=ResultRegex.Match(line);if(match.Success){result.HasResult=true;result.Name=match.Groups[1].Value;if(match.Groups[2].Success)result.Core=match.Groups[2].Value;result.Passed=int.Parse(match.Groups[3].Value);result.Failed=int.Parse(match.Groups[4].Value);continue;}var coverage=CoverageRegex.Match(line);if(coverage.Success)result.Coverage=$"{coverage.Groups[1].Value}/{coverage.Groups[2].Value}";}return result;}}}

namespace Cthangover.TestRunner{/// <summary> Parsed command-line options of the global test runner. Kept as a plain class with a hand-written parser: the runner must build and run with nothing but the .NET 8 SDK, so no CLI framework dependency is added. </summary>
public class RunnerOptions{/// <summary>Run only this test (unit or an integration name from the manifest).</summary>
public string Test{get;private set;}/// <summary>Print available tests and exit.</summary>
public bool List{get;private set;}/// <summary>Explicit path to the Godot executable; falls back to GODOT_BIN or PATH.</summary>
public string Godot{get;private set;}/// <summary>Skip the game assembly build before integration tests.</summary>
public bool NoBuild{get;private set;}/// <summary>Write a machine-readable JSON report to this path.</summary>
public string Json{get;private set;}/// <summary>Run SceneSwitcher against this scene path or logical scene name.</summary>
public string Switcher{get;private set;}/// <summary>Comma-separated dialog choice indexes for --switcher.</summary>
public string Choices{get;private set;}/// <summary>SceneSwitcher timeout in seconds.</summary>
public int TimeoutSeconds{get;private set;}=60;/// <summary>Print usage and exit.</summary>
public bool ShowHelp{get;private set;}public static RunnerOptions Parse(string[]args){var options=new RunnerOptions();for(var i=0;i<args.Length;i++){switch(args[i]){case"--test":options.Test=Next(args,ref i);break;case"--list":options.List=true;break;case"--godot":options.Godot=Next(args,ref i);break;case"--no-build":options.NoBuild=true;break;case"--json":options.Json=Next(args,ref i);break;case"--switcher":options.Switcher=Next(args,ref i);break;case"--choices":options.Choices=Next(args,ref i);break;case"--timeout":if(!int.TryParse(Next(args,ref i),out var timeout)||timeout<=0)throw new ArgumentException("--timeout expects a positive number of seconds");options.TimeoutSeconds=timeout;break;case"--help":case"-h":options.ShowHelp=true;break;default:throw new ArgumentException($"unknown option '{args[i]}'");}}return options;}private static string Next(string[]args,ref int i){if(i+1>=args.Length)throw new ArgumentException($"option '{args[i]}' requires a value");return args[++i];}public static string HelpText=>@"CThangover — глобальный раннер тестов (кроссплатформенный, .NET 8 + Godot .NET).

Использование:
  dotnet run --project tests/Cthangover.TestRunner -- [опции]

Без опций: сборка игры → unit-тесты → все интеграционные сцены из
tests/tests.manifest.json → сводка. Код выхода 0 только если всё зелёное.

Опции:
  --test <name>        выполнить только один тест: unit или имя из манифеста
                       (mod, actioncontext, tscn, scene_builder, coverage,
                        battle, battle_ff, menu)
  --list               показать список тестов
  --godot <path>       путь к Godot (по умолчанию GODOT_BIN или godot из PATH)
  --no-build           не собирать Cthangover.csproj перед интеграционными тестами
  --json <path>        записать машинный отчёт (JSON)
  --switcher <target>  smoke-прогон сцены через SceneSwitcher (путь .tscn или
                       логическое имя), с авто-диалогами
  --choices <0,1,...>  индексы выборов для --switcher
  --timeout <sec>      таймаут SceneSwitcher (по умолчанию 60)
  --help               эта справка

Примеры:
  dotnet run --project tests/Cthangover.TestRunner
  dotnet run --project tests/Cthangover.TestRunner -- --test battle_ff
  dotnet run --project tests/Cthangover.TestRunner -- --switcher home_kitchen --choices 0 --timeout 30
  dotnet run --project tests/Cthangover.TestRunner -- --json test-results.json";}}

using System.Text.Json;namespace Cthangover.TestRunner{/// <summary> Prints the single human-readable summary of the whole run and, when requested, writes the same data as JSON for machine consumption. Returns the aggregate exit code (0 only when every entry passed), which makes the runner usable from any CI or pre-commit hook without parsing console text. </summary>
public static class SummaryPrinter{public static int Print(IReadOnlyList<TestResult>results,string jsonPath){var allPassed=results.Count>0&&results.All(r=>r.Passed);Console.WriteLine();Console.WriteLine("=== ИТОГИ ТЕСТИРОВАНИЯ ===");foreach(var result in results){var status=result.Passed?"PASS":result.TimedOut?"TIMEOUT":"FAIL";var checks=result.PassedChecks+result.FailedChecks>0?$"{result.PassedChecks}/{result.PassedChecks + result.FailedChecks}":"-";var details=BuildDetails(result);var line=$"  {result.Name,-14} {status,-8} {checks,-10} {result.Duration.TotalSeconds,6:F1}s  {details}";WriteStatus(line,result.Passed);}Console.WriteLine();WriteStatus($"Успешно: {results.Count(r => r.Passed)}/{results.Count}",allPassed);WriteStatus(allPassed?"ВСЁ УСПЕШНО":"ЕСТЬ ПАДЕНИЯ",allPassed);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(jsonPath))WriteJson(jsonPath,results,allPassed);return allPassed?0:1;}private static string BuildDetails(TestResult result){var parts=new List<string>();if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(result.Core))parts.Add($"core={result.Core}");if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(result.Coverage))parts.Add($"coverage={result.Coverage}");if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(result.Note))parts.Add(result.Note);if(!result.Passed&& !result.TimedOut)parts.Add($"exit={result.ExitCode}");return string.Join("  ",parts);}private static void WriteStatus(string text,bool ok){if(Console.IsOutputRedirected){Console.WriteLine(text);return;}var previous=Console.ForegroundColor;Console.ForegroundColor=ok?ConsoleColor.Green:ConsoleColor.Red;Console.WriteLine(text);Console.ForegroundColor=previous;}private static void WriteJson(string path,IReadOnlyList<TestResult>results,bool allPassed){var report=new{success=allPassed,finishedAt=DateTimeOffset.Now,totalSeconds=Math.Round(results.Sum(r=>r.Duration.TotalSeconds),2),results=results.Select(r=>new{name=r.Name,kind=r.Kind,status=r.Passed?"pass":r.TimedOut?"timeout":"fail",passed=r.PassedChecks,failed=r.FailedChecks,exitCode=r.ExitCode,durationSeconds=Math.Round(r.Duration.TotalSeconds,2),core=r.Core,coverage=r.Coverage,note=r.Note})};var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(report,new JsonSerializerOptions{WriteIndented=true});File.WriteAllText(path,json);Console.WriteLine($"Отчёт записан: {path}");}}}

using System.Xml.Linq;namespace Cthangover.TestRunner{/// <summary> Reads xUnit counters from a Visual Studio TRX report produced by <c>dotnet test --logger trx</c>. TRX is used instead of parsing console output because the CLI summary text is localized (the project runs on Russian Windows and would break English-only parsers). </summary>
public static class TrxParser{public static(int Passed,int Failed,int Skipped)?TryParseCounters(string trxPath){if(!File.Exists(trxPath))return null;var document=XDocument.Load(trxPath);var counters=document.Descendants().FirstOrDefault(e=>e.Name.LocalName=="Counters");if(counters==null)return null;return(Read(counters,"passed"),Read(counters,"failed"),Read(counters,"skipped"));}private static int Read(XElement element,string attribute){return int.TryParse(element.Attribute(attribute)?.Value,out var value)?value:0;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog.Action.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Autotest{/// <summary> Auto-plays dialog scenes for integration tests and the AI workflow. Attached by <c>SceneSwitcher</c> and <c>MainMenuTestSetup</c>, it clicks <c>NextAction</c> at a fixed interval and answers selection prompts from <c>--choices=</c> (first variant when unspecified). The DialogBox is discovered lazily so the driver can be added before the dialog scene exists; end-of-dialog quits the process, optionally switching to <c>--scene2=</c> first. </summary>
public partial class DialogAutoDriver:Node{[Export]public float AdvanceInterval{get;set;}=0.1f;[Export]public bool AutoQuit{get;set;}=true;/// <summary> When set, a successful end of dialog emits <c>[TEST_RESULT] name=&lt;ResultName&gt; passed=1 failed=0</c> before quitting, so the global test runner can attribute the result to the calling test. Left empty by SceneSwitcher, whose smoke runs are evaluated by log markers instead. </summary>
public string ResultName{get;set;}/// <summary> How long the driver tolerates a discovered DialogBox staying idle (Runtime.IsEnd) before treating it as an empty scene and quitting. Covers the gap between scene load and the first scenario queue. </summary>
private const ulong FirstDialogGraceMs=3000;private DialogBox _dialogBox;private float _timer;private ulong _dialogFoundAtMs;private List<int>_choices=new();private int _choiceIndex;private string _sceneOnEnd;private bool _hasSeenRunningDialog;public override void _Ready(){ParseCmdArgs();}/// <summary> Looks the DialogBox up lazily through the tree root instead of the cached <c>SceneContextNode.FindNode</c>: the driver is often added before the dialog scene exists, and the context cache would poison the name as not-found until the next scene-exit event. </summary>
private DialogBox FindDialogBox(){var tree=GetTree();if(tree?.Root==null)return null;return tree.Root.FindChild("DialogBox",true,false)as DialogBox;}private void ParseCmdArgs(){var args=OS.GetCmdlineArgs();foreach(var arg in args){if(arg.StartsWith("--choices=")){var val=arg.Substring("--choices=".Length);_choices=val.Split(',').Select(s=>int.TryParse(s.Trim(),out var n)?n:-1).Where(n=>n>=0).ToList();break;}if(arg.StartsWith("--scene2="))_sceneOnEnd=arg.Substring("--scene2=".Length).Trim();}}public override void _Process(double delta){if(_dialogBox==null|| !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(_dialogBox)|| !_dialogBox.IsInsideTree()){_dialogBox=FindDialogBox();if(_dialogBox==null)return;_dialogFoundAtMs=Time.GetTicksMsec();_hasSeenRunningDialog=false;var choicesInfo=_choices.Count>0?"choices=["+string.Join(",",_choices)+"]":"no choices, will pick first variant each time";GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"DialogAutoDriver started, interval={AdvanceInterval}, {choicesInfo}");}_timer+=(float)delta;if(_timer<AdvanceInterval)return;_timer=0;if(_dialogBox.IsRunning)_hasSeenRunningDialog=true;// Runtime.IsEnd is also true while the very first queue has not been loaded yet, so end-handling waits until a dialog was actually observed running. In --scene2 mode the wait is indefinite (the second entry legitimately starts no dialog); otherwise a short grace period lets dialog-less scenes finish.
var waitingForFirstDialog= !_hasSeenRunningDialog&&(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_sceneOnEnd)||Time.GetTicksMsec()-_dialogFoundAtMs<FirstDialogGraceMs);if(_dialogBox.Runtime.IsEnd&& !waitingForFirstDialog){if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_sceneOnEnd)){var next=_sceneOnEnd;_sceneOnEnd=null;GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"DialogAutoDriver: dialog ended, switching to '{next}'");SceneContextNode.FindNode<SceneManager>("SceneManager")?.SwitchScene(next);return;}if(AutoQuit){if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ResultName))GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"[TEST_RESULT] name={ResultName} passed=1 failed=0");GameLogger.Log("TEST","DialogAutoDriver: dialog ended, quitting");GetTree().Quit();}SetProcess(false);return;}if(_dialogBox.Runtime.IsWaitAnswer){HandleSelection();return;}_dialogBox.NextAction();}private void HandleSelection(){var answerBox=_dialogBox.FindChild("AnswerBox",true,false)as AnswerBox;if(answerBox==null)return;var variants=answerBox.CreateModels()as ICollection<SelectVariant>;if(variants==null||variants.Count==0)return;var list=new List<SelectVariant>(variants);var pick=0;if(_choiceIndex<_choices.Count){pick=_choices[_choiceIndex];if(pick>=list.Count)pick=0;_choiceIndex++;}GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"DialogAutoDriver: choice #{_choiceIndex} picking index={pick} out of {list.Count}",LogLevel.Debug);_dialogBox.SelectVariant(list[pick]);}}}
#endif

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Menu;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Autotest{/// <summary> Automated smoke runs of the main menu. Two modes share the same setup: <list type="bullet"> <item><c>--test=menu</c> — waits for the menu to settle, clicks "New Game", then attaches a <see cref="DialogAutoDriver"/> to the tree root so it survives the scene change and auto-advances the opening scenario until it ends (exit code 0).</item> <item><c>--test=mod_manager</c> — clicks the first button provided by the mod <c>main_menu</c> registry (the mod_manager button), then verifies the mod scene was built, its grid exists and at least one mod card was created (exit code 0).</item> <item><c>--test=mod_collections</c> — clicks the collections button by its translation key, then verifies the collections scene was built, its list is populated and the dependency graph contains at least one frame and one mod node (exit code 0).</item> </list> A watchdog quits with exit code 1 if the flow does not finish within <c>--timeout=</c> seconds (default 120), so a run can never hang. </summary>
public partial class MainMenuTestSetup:Node{private const float ClickDelaySeconds=0.5f;private const float DriverAttachDelaySeconds=1.0f;private const float ModManagerSettleSeconds=1.0f;private const float DefaultTimeoutSeconds=120f;private float _timer=ClickDelaySeconds;private float _timeoutSeconds=DefaultTimeoutSeconds;private string _testName;private bool _enabled;private bool _started;public override void _Ready(){foreach(var arg in OS.GetCmdlineArgs()){if(arg.StartsWith("--test=")){var testName=arg.Substring("--test=".Length).ToLower();if(testName=="menu"||testName=="mod_manager"||testName=="mod_collections"){_testName=testName;_enabled=true;GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"MainMenuTestSetup: auto-test enabled via --test={testName}");}}else if(arg.StartsWith("--timeout=")&&float.TryParse(arg.Substring("--timeout=".Length),out var t)&&t>0){_timeoutSeconds=t;}}}public override void _Process(double delta){if(!_enabled||_started)return;_timer-=(float)delta;if(_timer>0)return;SetProcess(false);_started=true;if(_testName=="mod_manager")RunModManagerTest();else if(_testName=="mod_collections")RunModCollectionsTest();else RunNewGameTest();}private void RunNewGameTest(){var quitting",LogLevel.Error);Fail("menu");return;}var tree=GetTree();tree.CreateTimer(DriverAttachDelaySeconds).Timeout+=()=>{var driver=new DialogAutoDriver{ResultName="menu"};tree.Root.AddChild(driver);};tree.CreateTimer(_timeoutSeconds).Timeout+=()=>{GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"MainMenuTestSetup: timeout ({_timeoutSeconds}s) reached without dialog end, quitting",LogLevel.Error);Fail("menu");};GameLogger.Log("TEST","MainMenuTestSetup: clicking 'New Game' button");newGameBtn.EmitSignal("pressed");}private void RunModManagerTest(){var clicking first mod main-menu button");button.EmitSignal("pressed");GetTree().CreateTimer(ModManagerSettleSeconds).Timeout+=VerifyModManagerScreen;GetTree().CreateTimer(_timeoutSeconds).Timeout+=()=>{GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"MainMenuTestSetup: cards={cards})",LogLevel.Error);Fail("mod_manager");return;}GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"MainMenuTestSetup: mod manager OK, {cards} collectionButtons=list?.GetChildCount()??0;if(graph==null||frames==0||nodes==0||collectionButtons==0){GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"MainMenuTestSetup: collections screen built incompletely (graph={graph != null}, frames={frames}, nodes={nodes}, collections={collectionButtons})",LogLevel.Error);Fail("mod_collections");return;}GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"MainMenuTestSetup: collections OK, {collectionButtons} The test assembly cannot reference mod types, but it can inspect them by reflection, which keeps the check independent of node naming. </summary>
private static int CountDescendantsByTypeName(Node root,string typeName){var count=0;foreach(var child in root.GetChildren()){if(child.GetType().Name==typeName)count++;count+=CountDescendantsByTypeName(child,typeName);}return count;}/// <summary>Collects descendants whose runtime C# type has the given name.</summary>

private static Node FindFirstDescendantByTypeName(Node root,string typeName){foreach(var child in root.GetChildren()){if(child.GetType().Name==typeName)return child;var found=FindFirstDescendantByTypeName(child,typeName);if(found!=null)return found;}return null;}private void Fail(string testName){GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"[TEST_RESULT] name={testName} passed=0 failed=1");if(GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(this))GetTree().Quit(1);}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Autotest{/// <summary> Reports integration-test coverage of battle cores. The battle mod's registry is the single source of truth for how many battle cores the current mod set ships; <see cref="DeclaredTests"/> maps each core to the runner test type that drives it. A registered core without a declaration — or without the mod's IBattleAutoPlayable contract — fails the run, so adding a new core forces adding its test and the automation contract. The machine-readable lines are parsed by <c>tests/Cthangover.TestRunner</c>. <para/> Registry and contract types live in the turn-battle mod, so this setup goes through <see cref="TurnBattleBridge"/> instead of referencing them directly. </summary>
public partial class BattleCoverageTestSetup:Node{/// <summary> Battle core id to the runner test name covering it. Update together with <c>tests/tests.manifest.json</c> when a core is added. </summary>
private static readonly Dictionary<string,string>DeclaredTests=new(){["card_battle"]="battle",["ff_battle"]="battle_ff",};private int _failed;public override void _Ready(){if(!ModManager.Instance.IsInitialized)ModManager.Instance.Initialize();var coreIds=TurnBattleBridge.CoreIds();GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_COVERAGE",$"registered cores: {coreIds.Count}");foreach(var id in coreIds){if(!DeclaredTests.TryGetValue(id,out var testName)){Fail($"core={id} has no integration test declared");continue;}var autoPlayableType=TurnBattleBridge.AutoPlayableType();var coreType=TurnBattleBridge.GetCoreType(id);if(autoPlayableType==null||coreType==null|| !autoPlayableType.IsAssignableFrom(coreType)){Fail($"core={id} test={testName} does not implement IBattleAutoPlayable");continue;}Pass($"core={id} test={testName} autoplayable=true");}foreach(var declared in DeclaredTests){if(!coreIds.Contains(declared.Key))Fail($"declared test='{declared.Value}' references unknown core={declared.Key}");}var covered=coreIds.Count(id=>DeclaredTests.ContainsKey(id));GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_COVERAGE",$"coverage: {covered}/{coreIds.Count} cores");GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_COVERAGE",$"[TEST_RESULT] name=coverage passed={(_failed == 0 ? 1 : 0)} failed={_failed}");GetTree().Quit(_failed==0?0:1);}private void Pass(string message){GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_COVERAGE",$"PASS {message}");}private void Fail(string message){_failed++;GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_COVERAGE",$"FAIL {message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}
#endif

using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Autotest{/// <summary> Headless driver for the battle integration test. Both shipped battle cores wait for player input, so the driver periodically presses the "end turn" button of the active core, letting the enemy AI act until the battle scene reports <c>IsDestroyed</c> (victory or defeat). The core is selected by <c>--core=</c> (card_battle by default) and only affects how the end-turn button is located: card_battle nests it under a named node, ff_battle adds a plain Button directly to ToolPanel. A missing battle scene or an endless battle is reported as a failure and quits with exit code 1, so the CI run fails instead of hanging. <para/> The battle scene, core registry and autoplay contract live in the turn-battle mod, so all typed access goes through <see cref="TurnBattleBridge"/>. </summary>
public partial class BattleTestDriver:Node{private const string CardBattleCore="card_battle";private const string EndTurnButtonPath="ToolPanel/EndTurnButton/BtnEndTurn";private const double PollIntervalSeconds=0.25d;private const double SetupTimeoutSeconds=15d;private const double BattleTimeoutSeconds=90d;private const int MaxEndTurnPresses=30;private string _core=BattleTestSetup.DefaultBattleCore;private double _elapsed;private double _nextPoll;private int _turnPresses;private bool _finished;private bool _speedChecked;public override void _Ready(){foreach(var arg in OS.GetCmdlineArgs()){if(arg.StartsWith("--core="))_core=arg.Substring("--core=".Length).Trim();}}/// <summary> Preferred universal path: cores implementing the mod's IBattleAutoPlayable report when they wait for the player and accept a turn advance directly, so the driver does not depend on core-specific UI layout. The UI lookup in <see cref="FindEndTurnButton"/> remains as a fallback for cores without the contract. </summary>
private bool TryAdvanceAutoPlayable(Node battle){var core=TurnBattleBridge.GetActiveCore(battle);var autoType=TurnBattleBridge.AutoPlayableType();if(core==null||autoType==null|| !autoType.IsInstanceOfType(core))return false;var waiting=(bool?)autoType.GetProperty("IsWaitingForPlayerInput")?.GetValue(core)??false;if(!waiting)return false;_turnPresses++;GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_TEST",$"BattleTestDriver: auto turn #{_turnPresses}");autoType.GetMethod("AdvancePlayerTurn")?.Invoke(core,null);return true;}/// <summary> Locates the active core's end-turn button. card_battle builds a named widget at a fixed path; ff_battle creates an unnamed Button and adds it as a direct child of ToolPanel. </summary>
private Button FindEndTurnButton(Node battle){if(_core!=CardBattleCore){var toolPanel=battle.GetNodeOrNull<Control>("ToolPanel");if(toolPanel==null)return null;foreach(var child in toolPanel.GetChildren()){if(child is Button button)return button;}return null;}return battle.GetNodeOrNull<Button>(EndTurnButtonPath);}public override void _Process(double delta){if(_finished)return;_elapsed+=delta;if(_elapsed<_nextPoll)return;_nextPoll=_elapsed+PollIntervalSeconds;var battle=TurnBattleBridge.GetSceneContext();if(battle==null){if(_elapsed>=SetupTimeoutSeconds)Finish(false,"battle scene never became ready");return;}if(!_speedChecked){_speedChecked=true;if(Engine.TimeScale<BattleTestSetup.MaxBattleSpeed){GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_TEST",$"BattleTestDriver: core={_core}, battle speed was x{Engine.TimeScale}, forcing x{BattleTestSetup.MaxBattleSpeed}",LogLevel.Warning);Engine.TimeScale=BattleTestSetup.MaxBattleSpeed;}else{GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_TEST",$"BattleTestDriver: core={_core}, battle speed x{Engine.TimeScale}");}}if(TurnBattleBridge.IsDestroyed(battle)){Finish(true,$"battle finished in {_elapsed:F1}s, end-turn presses={_turnPresses}");return;}if(_turnPresses>=MaxEndTurnPresses||_elapsed>=BattleTimeoutSeconds){Finish(false,$"battle did not finish (presses={_turnPresses}, elapsed={_elapsed:F1}s)");return;}if(TryAdvanceAutoPlayable(battle))return;var endTurn=FindEndTurnButton(battle);if(endTurn==null|| !endTurn.Visible)return;_turnPresses++;GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_TEST",$"BattleTestDriver: end turn #{_turnPresses}");endTurn.EmitSignal("pressed");}private void Finish(bool passed,string message){_finished=true;GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_TEST",$"BattleTestDriver: {(passed ? "PASS" : "FAIL")} - {message}",passed?LogLevel.Message:LogLevel.Error);GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_TEST",$"[TEST_RESULT] name=battle core={_core} passed={(passed ? 1 : 0)} failed={(passed ? 0 : 1)}");GetTree().Quit(passed?0:1);}}}
#endif

using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Autotest{/// <summary> Prepares a deterministic battle encounter for <c>BattleTestScene</c>. Mods are initialized synchronously first — otherwise CharacterFactory and the battle core registry stay empty and the battle scene logs "No battle core available". No starter-party initializer runs in this direct scene launch, so the party consists of exactly the characters added here. <para/> The encounter lives in the turn-battle mod assembly, so the bridge prepares it through reflection: build BattleData with a caller-supplied background, select the active core, and store it in the mod's BattleRequest slot. </summary>
public partial class BattleTestSetup:Node{/// <summary> Battle speed applied to the run. The battle speed control restores <see cref="Settings.SettingsData.BattleSpeed"/> into <c>Engine.TimeScale</c> while the battle scene is being readied (after this node), so writing the setting here is the supported way to accelerate the whole test: battle timers and action animations both scale from <c>Engine.TimeScale</c>. The value is intentionally not persisted to disk. </summary>
public const int MaxBattleSpeed=8;public const string DefaultBattleCore="card_battle";private const string PartyMember="Murakami";private const string ReturnScene="MainMenu";public override void _Ready(){if(!ModManager.Instance.IsInitialized)ModManager.Instance.Initialize();GameData.Instance.Settings.BattleSpeed=MaxBattleSpeed;var core=ParseBattleCore();if(!TurnBattleBridge.HasCore(core))GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_TEST",$"BattleTestSetup: battle core '{core}' is not registered, scene will fall back to the first core",LogLevel.Warning);var runtime=GameData.Instance.Runtime;runtime.CharacterData.AddCharacterToParty(PartyMember);var data=TurnBattleBridge.CreateBattleData(Textures.Resolve("empty"),ReturnScene,core,"wolf_1","wolf_2","werewolf_girl_1");TurnBattleBridge.SetPendingBattle(data);GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_TEST",$"BattleTestSetup: core={core}, party=[{PartyMember}], enemies=3, speed=x{MaxBattleSpeed}");var battleScene=TscnScenes.LoadAndBuild("scenes/battle/battle.tscn");if(battleScene==null){GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_TEST","BattleTestSetup: failed to build mod battle scene 'scenes/battle/battle.tscn'",LogLevel.Error);GetTree().Quit(1);return;}// _Ready runs while the test root is still setting up its children, so a direct AddChild is rejected; defer until the tree is free.
GetParent().CallDeferred(Node.MethodName.AddChild,battleScene);GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_TEST",$"BattleTestSetup: battle scene built, deferred attach ({battleScene.GetType().Name})");}/// <summary> Reads <c>--core=</c> so one test scene covers both shipped battle cores: card_battle (default) and ff_battle. The value is passed to the mod's BattleData.ActiveBattleCore, which the battle scene resolves through the core registry before Init. </summary>

#if TOOLS
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Autotest{/// <summary> Reflection bridge between the core integration tests and the turn-battle mod. The battle platform (BattleData, BattleCoreRegistry, BattleRequest, BattleSceneContext, IBattleAutoPlayable) now lives in the <c>turn_battle_base</c> mod assembly, which the core test project cannot reference at compile time — so every access goes through reflection here. Keeping the reflection in one place lets the test setup and driver read almost like plain code and keeps the odd member names out of the tests. </summary>
internal static class TurnBattleBridge{/// <summary>Assembly name of the mod that owns the battle platform (matches its manifest id).</summary>
private const string BattleAssemblyName="turn_battle_base";private static Assembly FindBattleAssembly(){return AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies().FirstOrDefault(a=>a.GetName().Name==BattleAssemblyName);}private static Type FindType(string fullName){return FindBattleAssembly()?.GetType(fullName);}private static object GetRegistryInstance(){var type=FindType("Cthangover.Core.Battle.BattleCoreRegistry");return type?.GetField("Instance",BindingFlags.Public|BindingFlags.Static)?.GetValue(null);}/// <summary>Checks whether a battle core id was registered by the loaded mods.</summary>
public static bool HasCore(string coreId){var instance=GetRegistryInstance();if(instance==null){GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_TEST",$"TurnBattleBridge.HasCore('{coreId}'): registry instance not found, assembly={FindBattleAssembly()?.GetName().Name ?? "NULL"}",LogLevel.Warning);return false;}return(bool?)instance.GetType().GetMethod("HasCore")?.Invoke(instance,new object[]{coreId})??false;}/// <summary>Selects the active battle core by id (throws when unknown, same as production).</summary>
public static void SetActiveCore(string coreId){var instance=GetRegistryInstance();instance?.GetType().GetMethod("SetActive")?.Invoke(instance,new object[]{coreId});}/// <summary>Registered core ids, sorted, for the coverage check.</summary>
public static IReadOnlyList<string>CoreIds(){var instance=GetRegistryInstance();var ids=instance?.GetType().GetProperty("CoreIds")?.GetValue(instance)as IReadOnlyList<string>;return ids??Array.Empty<string>();}/// <summary>Registered <see cref="Type"/> of a core so tooling can check its interfaces.</summary>
public static Type GetCoreType(string coreId){var instance=GetRegistryInstance();return instance?.GetType().GetMethod("GetCoreType")?.Invoke(instance,new object[]{coreId})as Type;}/// <summary>The mod's IBattleAutoPlayable contract type, or null when the mod is not loaded.</summary>
public static Type AutoPlayableType(){return FindType("Cthangover.Core.Battle.IBattleAutoPlayable");}/// <summary> Builds a pending encounter exactly like BattleService does, but with a caller-supplied background so the test does not depend on scene state. Returns the mod's BattleData instance (typed as object). </summary>
public static object CreateBattleData(Texture2D background,string returnScene,string coreId,params string[]enemies){var dataType=FindType("Cthangover.Core.Settings.BattleData");var init=dataType?.GetMethod("InitBattle",new[]{typeof(Texture2D),typeof(string),typeof(string[])});var data=init?.Invoke(null,new object[]{background,returnScene,enemies});if(data==null){GameLogger.Log("BATTLE_TEST",$"TurnBattleBridge: failed to create BattleData via reflection (asm={FindBattleAssembly()?.GetName().Name ?? "NULL"}, dataType={dataType != null}, init={init != null})",LogLevel.Error);return null;}dataType.GetProperty("ActiveBattleCore")?.SetValue(data,coreId);return data;}/// <summary>Stores a prepared encounter in the mod's static BattleRequest slot.</summary>

#if TOOLS
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;namespace Cthangover.Core.Autotest{/// <summary> Reflection bridge between the core integration tests and the recruiting mod. The roster types live in the <c>recruiting</c> mod assembly, which the core test project cannot reference at compile time — so the persistence test manipulates the roster through this helper. Keeping the reflection in one place keeps the test itself readable. </summary>
internal static class RecruitingBridge{private const string ModAssemblyName="recruiting";private const string RosterTypeName="Cthangover.Core.Relationship.RecruitingData";private const string RecruitTypeName="Cthangover.Core.Relationship.Recruit";/// <summary>True when the recruiting mod assembly is loaded.</summary>
public static bool IsLoaded=>FindAssembly()!=null;private static Assembly FindAssembly(){return AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies().FirstOrDefault(a=>a.GetName().Name==ModAssemblyName);}private static object GetRoster(){var type=FindAssembly()?.GetType(RosterTypeName);return type?.GetField("Instance",BindingFlags.Public|BindingFlags.Static)?.GetValue(null);}/// <summary>Number of entries in the session roster, or -1 when the mod is not loaded.</summary>
public static int Count(){var roster=GetRoster();var data=roster?.GetType().GetProperty("Data")?.GetValue(roster)as System.Collections.IList;return data?.Count?? -1;}/// <summary>Adds a recruit through the production factory method.</summary>
public static void Add(string id,string characterId){var roster=GetRoster();roster?.GetType().GetMethod("Add")?.Invoke(roster,new object[]{id,characterId});}/// <summary>Character IDs of all current recruits, in roster order.</summary>
public static List<string>CharacterIds(){var result=new List<string>();var roster=GetRoster();if(roster?.GetType().GetProperty("Data")?.GetValue(roster)is not System.Collections.IEnumerable data)return result;var characterIdProperty=FindAssembly()?.GetType(RecruitTypeName)?.GetProperty("CharacterID");foreach(var recruit in data){if(recruit!=null&&characterIdProperty!=null)result.Add(characterIdProperty.GetValue(recruit)as string);}return result;}}}
#endif

using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Autotest{/// <summary> Integration test for the recruiting mod's contracts. It lives in the core test project because it needs core save infrastructure (SaveService, ModSaveableRegistry) and reaches the mod-owned roster through <see cref="RecruitingBridge"/>. <para/> The test exercises the full flow: <list type="number"> <item>"New Game" clears the roster through the NewGameStartedEvent subscription in the mod initializer.</item> <item>Recruits added after that are written into the mod's own save slot.</item> <item>A second "New Game" wipes the roster, proving the reset is not dependent on the save file.</item> <item>CharactersDefeatedEvent drives the roll: the built-in condition gate blocks recruitment without the <c>slave_master</c> skill and the roll lands once the gate opens.</item> <item>Loading the save replaces the roster with exactly the saved IDs.</item> </list> </summary>
public partial class RecruitingPersistenceTestSetup:Node{private const string SaveName="recruiting_test";private const string RecruitableEnemy="werewolf_girl_1";private const int FlowAttempts=30;private int _passed;private int _failed;public override void _Ready(){if(!ModManager.Instance.IsInitialized)ModManager.Instance.Initialize();// The initializer's new-game subscription and behaviour scan are normally installed by SceneManager.Initialize; call it explicitly so the test does not depend on autoload timing.
ModInitializerRegistry.NotifyResourcesReady();if(!RecruitingBridge.IsLoaded){Fail("recruiting mod assembly is not loaded");Finish();return;}var gameData=GameData.Instance;gameData.StartNewGame();AssertEqual(0,RecruitingBridge.Count(),"roster empty after new game");RecruitingBridge.Add("test_recruit","Murakami");RecruitingBridge.Add("test_recruit","Marao");AssertEqual(2,RecruitingBridge.Count(),"roster has two entries after Add");SaveService.Save(SaveName);Pass($"saved '{SaveName}'");gameData.StartNewGame();AssertEqual(0,RecruitingBridge.Count(),"new game clears the roster");PublishDefeated();AssertEqual(0,RecruitingBridge.Count(),"condition gate blocks recruitment without slave_master");gameData.Runtime.SkillData.AddSkill("slave_master");for(var i=0;i<FlowAttempts;i++)PublishDefeated();AssertTrue(RecruitingBridge.Count()>0,"characters_defeated event recruits after the gate opens");var loaded=SaveService.Load(SaveName);AssertTrue(loaded,"SaveService.Load returns true");AssertEqual(2,RecruitingBridge.Count(),"roster restored from the mod slot");var characterIds=RecruitingBridge.CharacterIds();AssertTrue(characterIds.Contains("Murakami"),"restored 'Murakami'");AssertTrue(characterIds.Contains("Marao"),"restored 'Marao'");SaveService.DeleteSave(SaveName);Finish();}private static void PublishDefeated(){ModEventBus.Publish(new CharactersDefeatedEvent{Source="test",CharacterIds=new[]{RecruitableEnemy},});}private void AssertEqual(int expected,int actual,string label){if(expected==actual)Pass($"{label}: {expected}");else Fail($"{label}: expected {expected}, got {actual}");}private void AssertTrue(bool condition,string label){if(condition)Pass($"{label}: true");else Fail($"{label}: expected true, got false");}private void Pass(string message){_passed++;GameLogger.Log("RECRUIT_TEST",$"  [PASS] {message}");}private void Fail(string message){_failed++;GameLogger.Log("RECRUIT_TEST",$"  [FAIL] {message}",LogLevel.Error);}private void Finish(){GameLogger.Log("RECRUIT_TEST",$"RecruitingPersistenceTestSetup: {_passed} passed, {_failed} failed");GameLogger.Log("RECRUIT_TEST",$"[TEST_RESULT] name=recruiting passed={_passed} failed={_failed}");GetTree().Quit(_failed==0?0:1);}}}
#endif

using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Items;namespace Engine.Tests.Items{public class ItemInfoTests{[Fact]public void ItemInfo_ExtraProperties_RoundTrip(){var json=@"{
                ""Id"": ""test/item"",
                ""Name"": ""Test Item"",
                ""Description"": ""A test item"",
                ""Cost"": 42,
                ""Sprite"": ""test/sprite"",
                ""ItemType"": ""Food"",
                ""ItemAction"": ""use_heal"",
                ""Durability"": 100,
                ""Quality"": ""legendary"",
                ""IsSpecial"": true
            }";var options=new JsonSerializerOptions{PropertyNameCaseInsensitive=true,ReadCommentHandling=System.Text.Json.JsonCommentHandling.Skip};var info=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ItemInfo>(json,options);Assert.Equal("test/item",info.ID);Assert.Equal("Test Item",info.Name);Assert.Equal(42,info.Cost);Assert.Equal("Food",info.ItemType.ToString());Assert.NotNull(info.ExtraProperties);Assert.Equal(3,info.ExtraProperties.Count);var durability=Assert.IsType<JsonElement>(info.ExtraProperties["Durability"]);Assert.Equal(100,durability.GetInt32());var quality=Assert.IsType<JsonElement>(info.ExtraProperties["Quality"]);Assert.Equal("legendary",quality.GetString());var isSpecial=Assert.IsType<JsonElement>(info.ExtraProperties["IsSpecial"]);Assert.True(isSpecial.GetBoolean());var serializedBack=JsonSerializer.Serialize(info,options);var restored=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ItemInfo>(serializedBack,options);Assert.Equal(info.ID,restored.ID);Assert.NotNull(restored.ExtraProperties);Assert.True(restored.ExtraProperties.ContainsKey("Durability"));}[Fact]public void ItemInfo_NoExtraProperties_IsNull(){var json=@"{
                ""Id"": ""test/item"",
                ""Name"": ""Test"",
                ""Cost"": 1,

using Cthangover.Core.UI.Messages;namespace Engine.Tests.Messages{public class NotificationBufferTests{public NotificationBufferTests(){NotificationBuffer.Clear();}// ── Add ──
[Fact]public void Add_ValidText_EnqueuesAndIncreasesPendingCount(){NotificationBuffer.Add("Test notification");Assert.Equal(1,NotificationBuffer.PendingCount);}[Fact]public void Add_MultipleTexts_AllQueued(){NotificationBuffer.Add("First");NotificationBuffer.Add("Second");NotificationBuffer.Add("Third");Assert.Equal(3,NotificationBuffer.PendingCount);}[Fact]public void Add_NullText_IsIgnored(){NotificationBuffer.Add(null);Assert.Equal(0,NotificationBuffer.PendingCount);}[Fact]public void Add_EmptyString_IsIgnored(){NotificationBuffer.Add("");Assert.Equal(0,NotificationBuffer.PendingCount);}[Fact]public void Add_WhitespaceString_IsAccepted(){NotificationBuffer.Add("   ");Assert.Equal(1,NotificationBuffer.PendingCount);}// ── TryDequeue ──
[Fact]public void TryDequeue_BufferHasEntry_ReturnsTrueAndText(){NotificationBuffer.Add("Hello");var result=NotificationBuffer.TryDequeue(out var text);Assert.True(result);Assert.Equal("Hello",text);}[Fact]public void TryDequeue_BufferEmpty_ReturnsFalseAndNullText(){var result=NotificationBuffer.TryDequeue(out var text);Assert.False(result);Assert.Null(text);}[Fact]public void TryDequeue_PreservesFifoOrder(){NotificationBuffer.Add("A");NotificationBuffer.Add("B");NotificationBuffer.Add("C");NotificationBuffer.TryDequeue(out var first);NotificationBuffer.TryDequeue(out var second);NotificationBuffer.TryDequeue(out var third);Assert.Equal("A",first);Assert.Equal("B",second);Assert.Equal("C",third);}[Fact]public void TryDequeue_AfterDequeue_DecreasesPendingCount(){NotificationBuffer.Add("A");NotificationBuffer.Add("B");NotificationBuffer.TryDequeue(out _);Assert.Equal(1,NotificationBuffer.PendingCount);NotificationBuffer.TryDequeue(out _);Assert.Equal(0,NotificationBuffer.PendingCount);}// ── PendingCount ──
[Fact]public void PendingCount_EmptyBuffer_ReturnsZero(){Assert.Equal(0,NotificationBuffer.PendingCount);}[Fact]public void PendingCount_AfterClear_ReturnsZero(){NotificationBuffer.Add("A");NotificationBuffer.Add("B");NotificationBuffer.Clear();Assert.Equal(0,NotificationBuffer.PendingCount);}[Fact]public void PendingCount_AfterDequeueAll_ReturnsZero(){NotificationBuffer.Add("A");NotificationBuffer.TryDequeue(out _);Assert.Equal(0,NotificationBuffer.PendingCount);}// ── Clear ──
[Fact]public void Clear_WithPendingItems_EmptiesBuffer(){NotificationBuffer.Add("A");NotificationBuffer.Add("B");NotificationBuffer.Clear();Assert.Equal(0,NotificationBuffer.PendingCount);Assert.False(NotificationBuffer.TryDequeue(out _));}[Fact]public void Clear_OnEmptyBuffer_DoesNotThrow(){NotificationBuffer.Clear();Assert.Equal(0,NotificationBuffer.PendingCount);}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Engine.Tests.Mods{/// <summary> Tests the catalog merge rules: provenance tagging, cross-catalog deduplication and — most importantly — the variant-conflict rule. When the same mod id/version/title appears with different content hashes, the variants must survive as separate entries so the manager can warn the player instead of silently merging (or picking) one of them. </summary>
public class CatalogMergerTests{private static CatalogExportEntry Entry(string id,string version,string name,string installHash,string source){return new CatalogExportEntry{Id=id,Name=name,Version=version,Downloads=new List<CatalogEntryDownload>{new(){Version=version,InstallSha256=installHash,Urls=new                 ""Id"": ""Marao"",
                ""Name"": ""characters/player/marao"",

                ""Attack"": 5,
                ""Point"": 1,
                ""Actions"": [""physics/attack"", ""physics/defence""]
            }";var patch=new PropertyPatch{ID="Marao",ExtraProperties=new Dictionary<string,object>{["Health"]=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>("5000"),["Attack"]=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>("1200"),["Point"]=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>("2"),["Actions$add"]=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>(@"[""physics/stun""]")}};var patches=new Dictionary<string,List<PropertyPatch>>{["Marao"]=new(){patch}};var merger=new JsonPatchMerger();var mergedJson=merger.Merge(maraoJson,"Marao",patches);var result=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CharacterInfo>(mergedJson,ReadOptions);Assert.Equal(5000,result.Health);Assert.Equal(1200,result.Attack);Assert.Equal(2,result.Point);Assert.Contains("physics/stun",result.Actions);Assert.Contains("physics/attack",result.Actions);Assert.Contains("physics/defence",result.Actions);Assert.Equal(3,result.Actions.Count);}[Fact]public void Merge_WithoutPatch_KeepsOriginalValues(){var maraoJson=@"{
                ""Id"": ""Marao"",
                ""Health"": 16,
                ""Attack"": 5,
                ""Point"": 1,
                ""Actions"": [""physics/attack"", ""physics/defence""]
            }";var merger=new JsonPatchMerger();var mergedJson=merger.Merge(maraoJson,"Marao",null);var result=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CharacterInfo>(mergedJson,ReadOptions);Assert.Equal(16,result.Health);Assert.Equal(5,result.Attack);Assert.Equal(1,result.Point);Assert.Equal(2,result.Actions.Count);}[Fact]public void Merge_ActionsAdd_Deduplicates(){var maraoJson=@"{
                ""Id"": ""Marao"",
                ""Actions"": [""physics/attack"", ""physics/defence""]
            }";var patch=new PropertyPatch{ID="Marao",ExtraProperties=new Dictionary<string,object>{["Actions$add"]=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>(@"[""physics/attack"", ""physics/stun""]")}};var patches=new Dictionary<string,List<PropertyPatch>>{["Marao"]=new(){patch}};var merger=new JsonPatchMerger();var mergedJson=merger.Merge(maraoJson,"Marao",patches);var result=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CharacterInfo>(mergedJson,ReadOptions);Assert.Contains("physics/attack",result.Actions);Assert.Contains("physics/defence",result.Actions);Assert.Contains("physics/stun",result.Actions);}[Fact]public void Merge_ActionsRemove_RemovesSpecific(){var maraoJson=@"{
                ""Id"": ""Marao"",
                ""Actions"": [""physics/attack"", ""physics/defence"", ""physics/stun""]
            }";var patch=new PropertyPatch{ID="Marao",ExtraProperties=new Dictionary<string,object>{["Actions$remove"]=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>(@"[""physics/defence""]")}};var patches=new Dictionary<string,List<PropertyPatch>>{["Marao"]=new(){patch}};var merger=new JsonPatchMerger();var mergedJson=merger.Merge(maraoJson,"Marao",patches);var result=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CharacterInfo>(mergedJson,ReadOptions);Assert.Contains("physics/attack",result.Actions);Assert.Contains("physics/stun",result.Actions);Assert.DoesNotContain("physics/defence",result.Actions);Assert.Equal(2,result.Actions.Count);}[Fact]public void Deserialize_PatchFile_RoundTrip(){var json=@"{
                ""Items"": [
                    {
                        ""Id"": ""Marao"",

                        ""Attack"": 1200,
                        ""Point"": 2,
