using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Text;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Engine.Tests.Mods.Mocks{public class MockModFileProvider:IModFileProvider{private readonly Dictionary<string,string>_textFiles=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);private readonly Dictionary<string,byte[]>_binaryFiles=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);private readonly HashSet<string>_directories=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);private readonly string _modName;public string Mod=>_modName;public string RootPath=>null;public MockModFileProvider(string modName){_modName=modName;}public void AddFile(string path,string content){_textFiles[path.Replace('\\','/')]=content;var dir=Path.GetDirectoryName(path.Replace('\\','/'))?.Replace('\\','/');while(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dir)){_directories.Add(dir+"/");var parent=Path.GetDirectoryName(dir)?.Replace('\\','/');if(parent==dir)break;dir=parent;}}public void AddBinaryFile(string path,byte[]data){_binaryFiles[path.Replace('\\','/')]=data;}public void AddDirectory(string path){_directories.Add(path.Replace('\\','/').TrimEnd('/')+"/");}public bool FileExists(string path){return _textFiles.ContainsKey(path.Replace('\\','/'))||_binaryFiles.ContainsKey(path.Replace('\\','/'));}public IEnumerable<string>ListFiles(string directory=""){var prefix=string.IsNullOrEmpty(directory)?"":directory.Replace('\\','/').TrimEnd('/')+"/";var result=new List<string>();foreach(var dir in _directories){if(dir.StartsWith(prefix)&&dir!=prefix){var relative=dir.Substring(prefix.Length);var slashIdx=relative.IndexOf('/');if(slashIdx==relative.Length-1)result.Add(prefix+relative);}}foreach(var file in _textFiles.Keys){if(file.StartsWith(prefix)){var relative=file.Substring(prefix.Length);if(!relative.Contains("/"))result.Add(file);}}foreach(var file in _binaryFiles.Keys){if(file.StartsWith(prefix)){var relative=file.Substring(prefix.Length);if(!relative.Contains("/")&& !_textFiles.ContainsKey(file))result.Add(file);}}return result;}public string ReadFileText(string path){_textFiles.TryGetValue(path.Replace('\\','/'),out var content);return content;}public byte[]ReadFileBinary(string path){_binaryFiles.TryGetValue(path.Replace('\\','/'),out var data);return data;}public Stream OpenStream(string path){var content=ReadFileText(path);if(content==null)return null;return new MemoryStream(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(content));}public string GetFileSystemPath(string path){return null;}public string ResolveIncludePath(string includePath,string currentPath){return ModPath.ResolveRelative(includePath,currentPath);}public void Dispose(){}}}

graph=Resolve(collection,catalog);var plan=ModCollectionPlan.Build(graph,catalog);var item=Assert.Single(plan.Install);Assert.Equal("1.0",item.Version);}[Fact]public void item=Assert.Single(plan.Install);Assert.Equal("core",item.ModId);}private static ModCollectionGraph Resolve(ModCollection collection,List<CatalogExportEntry>catalog,params using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Engine.Tests.Mods{/// <summary> Tests the collection graph resolution rules: mechanics group the declared mods, <c>depends</c> produce the arrows and pull transitive dependencies into the graph as external nodes, and every node's state reflects the three live sources (local registry, disabled store, catalog cache). </summary>
public class ModCollectionResolverTests{[Fact]public void Resolve_NullCollection_ReturnsEmptyGraph(){var graph=ModCollectionResolver.Resolve(null,new Dictionary<string,IModInfo>(),new HashSet<string>(),new List<CatalogExportEntry>());Assert.NotNull(graph);Assert.Empty(graph.Nodes);Assert.Empty(graph.Edges);Assert.Empty(graph.Mechanics);}[Fact]public void Resolve_GroupsNodesByMechanicInDeclarationOrder(){var collection=Collection(Mechanic("core","app"),Mechanic("ui","skin"));var mods=Mods(Local("app","1.0"),Local("skin","1.0"));var graph=ModCollectionResolver.Resolve(collection,mods,new HashSet<string>(),new List<CatalogExportEntry>());Assert.Equal(2,graph.Nodes.Count);Assert.Equal("app",graph.Nodes[0].ModId);Assert.Equal("core",graph.Nodes[0].MechanicId);Assert.Equal("skin",graph.Nodes[1].ModId);Assert.Equal("ui",graph.Nodes[1].MechanicId);Assert.False(graph.Nodes[0].IsExternal);Assert.Equal(2,graph.InstalledCount);}[Fact]public void Resolve_DependencyOfDeclaredMod_BecomesExternalNodeWithEdge(){var collection=Collection(Mechanic("game","app"));var mods=Mods(Local("app","1.0","core>=1"),Local("core","2.0"));var graph=ModCollectionResolver.Resolve(collection,mods,new HashSet<string>(),new List<CatalogExportEntry>());var core=Node(graph,"core");Assert.True(core.IsExternal);Assert.Null(core.MechanicId);Assert.Single(graph.Edges);Assert.Equal("core",graph.Edges[0].FromModId);Assert.Equal("app",graph.Edges[0].ToModId);}[Fact]public void Resolve_TransitiveDependencies_ArePulledInRecursively(){var collection=Collection(Mechanic("game","top"));var mods=Mods(Local("top","1.0","middle"),Local("middle","1.0","base"),Local("base","1.0"));var graph=ModCollectionResolver.Resolve(collection,mods,new HashSet<string>(),new List<CatalogExportEntry>());Assert.Equal(3,graph.Nodes.Count);Assert.Contains(graph.Edges,e=>e.FromModId=="middle"&&e.ToModId=="top");Assert.Contains(graph.Edges,e=>e.FromModId=="base"&&e.ToModId=="middle");}[Fact]public void Resolve_StatesReflectLocalDisabledCatalogAndMissing(){var collection=Collection(Mechanic("game","on","off","remote","gone"));var mods=Mods(Local("on","1.0"),Local("off","1.0"));var catalog=new List<CatalogExportEntry>{Catalog("remote","1.0")};var graph=ModCollectionResolver.Resolve(collection,mods,new HashSet<string>{"off"},catalog);Assert.Equal(ModCollectionNodeState.Installed,Node(graph,"on").State);Assert.Equal(ModCollectionNodeState.Disabled,Node(graph,"off").State);Assert.Equal(ModCollectionNodeState.InCatalog,Node(graph,"remote").State);Assert.Equal(ModCollectionNodeState.Missing,Node(graph,"gone").State);Assert.Equal(1,graph.InstalledCount);Assert.Equal(4,graph.TotalCount);}[Fact]public void Resolve_PinnedVersionNotSatisfied_ReportsMismatch(){var collection=Collection(Mechanic("game","app>=2"));var mods=Mods(Local("app","1.5"));var graph=ModCollectionResolver.Resolve(collection,mods,new HashSet<string>(),new List<CatalogExportEntry>());Assert.Equal(ModCollectionNodeState.VersionMismatch,Node(graph,"app").State);Assert.Equal(">=2",Node(graph,"app").RequiredVersion);}[Fact]public void Resolve_PinnedVersionSatisfied_ReportsInstalled(){var collection=Collection(Mechanic("game","app>=1"));var mods=Mods(Local("app","1.5"));var graph=ModCollectionResolver.Resolve(collection,mods,new HashSet<string>(),new List<CatalogExportEntry>());Assert.Equal(ModCollectionNodeState.Installed,Node(graph,"app").State);}[Fact]public void Resolve_SessionInstalled_TreatedAsInstalled(){var collection=Collection(Mechanic("game","app"));var session=new HashSet<string>{"app"};var graph=ModCollectionResolver.Resolve(collection,new Dictionary<string,IModInfo>(),new HashSet<string>(),new List<CatalogExportEntry>(),session);Assert.Equal(ModCollectionNodeState.Installed,Node(graph,"app").State);}[Fact]public void Resolve_ModDeclaredByTwoMechanics_BelongsToFirst(){var collection=Collection(Mechanic("first","shared"),Mechanic("second","shared"));var mods=Mods(Local("shared","1.0"));var graph=ModCollectionResolver.Resolve(collection,mods,new HashSet<string>(),new List<CatalogExportEntry>());Assert.Single(graph.Nodes);Assert.Equal("first",Node(graph,"shared").MechanicId);}[Fact]public void Resolve_UnnamedMechanic_GetsStableFallbackId(){var collection=Collection(new ModCollectionMechanic{Mods=new List<string>{"app"},});var mods=Mods(Local("app","1.0"));var graph=ModCollectionResolver.Resolve(collection,mods,new HashSet<string>(),new List<CatalogExportEntry>());Assert.Equal("mechanic_0",graph.Mechanics[0].Id);Assert.Equal("mechanic_0",Node(graph,"app").MechanicId);}[Fact]public void ModCollectionNode Node(ModCollectionGraph graph,string modId)=>graph.Nodes.First(n=>n.ModId==modId);private static ModCollection Collection(params string[]mods)=>new(){Id=id,Name=id,Mods=new List<string>(mods)};private static ModInfo Local(string id,string version,params string[]depends){var manifest=new ModManifest{Id=id,Name=id,Version=version};var list=new List<ModDependency>();foreach(var dep in depends)list.Add(ModDependency.Parse(dep));manifest.Depends=list;return new ModInfo{Id=id,Name=id,Manifest=manifest};}private static Dictionary<string,IModInfo>Mods(params ModInfo[]mods){var result=new Dictionary<string,IModInfo>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var mod in mods)result[mod.Id]=mod;return result;}private static CatalogExportEntry Catalog(string id,params string[]versions){var entry=new CatalogExportEntry{Id=id,Name=id,Version=versions.Length>0?versions[0]:null,Downloads=new List<CatalogEntryDownload>(),SourceUrls=new List<string>{"https://catalog.test/catalog.json"},};foreach(var using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Engine.Tests.Mods.Mocks;namespace Engine.Tests.Mods{/// <summary> Tests the collection store: player files persist and survive round-trips, broken files never throw, and bundled <c>collections/*.json</c> files are discovered through <see cref="IModFileProvider"/> so both folder and zip mods work identically. </summary>
public class ModCollectionStoreTests:IDisposable{private const string TestFile="collections.json";public void Dispose(){try{if(File.Exists(TestFile))File.Delete(TestFile);}catch{}}[Fact]public void LoadUser_NoFile_ReturnsEmpty(){if(File.Exists(TestFile))File.Delete(TestFile);var result=ModCollectionStore.LoadUser();Assert.Empty(result);}[Fact]public void SaveUser_ThenLoadUser_Roundtrip(){var original=new List<ModCollection>{new(){Id="card_novel",Name="Card Novel",Version="1.0.0",Mechanics=new List<ModCollectionMechanic>{new(){Id="core",Name="Core",Mods=new List<string>{"visual_novel_core>=1"},},new(){Id="cards",Mods=new List<string>{"card_battle"},Optional=true,},},},new(){Id="tools",Name="Tools"},};ModCollectionStore.SaveUser(original);var loaded=ModCollectionStore.LoadUser();Assert.Equal(2,loaded.Count);Assert.Equal("card_novel",loaded[0].Id);Assert.Equal("Card Novel",loaded[0].Name);Assert.Equal("1.0.0",loaded[0].Version);Assert.Equal(2,loaded[0].Mechanics.Count);Assert.Equal("core",loaded[0].Mechanics[0].Id);Assert.Equal("visual_novel_core>=1",loaded[0].Mechanics[0].Mods[0]);Assert.True(loaded[0].Mechanics[1].Optional);Assert.All(loaded,c=>Assert.Equal(ModCollectionOrigin.User,c.Origin));}[Fact]public void SaveUser_Null_WritesEmptyListFile(){ModCollectionStore.SaveUser(null);Assert.True(File.Exists(TestFile));Assert.Empty(ModCollectionStore.LoadUser());}[Fact]public void LoadUser_InvalidJson_ReturnsEmpty(){File.WriteAllText(TestFile,"{ not a list }}}");var result=ModCollectionStore.LoadUser();Assert.Empty(result);}[Fact]public void LoadUser_EntryWithoutId_IsSkipped(){var json="""
            [
              { "name": "No id" },
              { "id": "valid", "name": "Valid" }
            ]
            """;File.WriteAllText(TestFile,json);var result=ModCollectionStore.LoadUser();var collection=Assert.Single(result);Assert.Equal("valid",collection.Id);}[Fact]public void LoadFromProvider_Null_ReturnsEmpty(){Assert.Empty(ModCollectionStore.LoadFromProvider(null));}[Fact]public void LoadFromProvider_ReadsBundledCollection(){var provider=new MockModFileProvider("card_battle");provider.AddFile("manifest.json","{}");provider.AddFile("collections/card_novel.json","""
            {
              "id": "card_novel",
              "name": "Card Novel",
              "mechanics": [
                { "id": "cards", "name": "Cards", "mods": ["card_battle>=1"] }
              ]
            }
            """);var result=ModCollectionStore.LoadFromProvider(provider);var collection=Assert.Single(result);Assert.Equal("card_novel",collection.Id);Assert.Equal(ModCollectionOrigin.BuiltIn,collection.Origin);Assert.Equal("card_battle>=1",collection.Mechanics[0].Mods[0]);}[Fact]public void LoadFromProvider_SkipsBrokenAndNonJsonFiles(){var provider=new MockModFileProvider("pack");provider.AddFile("collections/notes.txt","not a collection");provider.AddFile("collections/broken.json","{ broken ]");provider.AddFile("collections/no_id.json","{ \"name\": \"anonymous\" }");provider.AddFile("collections/good.json","{ \"id\": \"good\", \"name\": \"Good\" }");var result=ModCollectionStore.LoadFromProvider(provider);var collection=Assert.Single(result);Assert.Equal("good",collection.Id);}[Fact]public void LoadFromProvider_NoCollectionsFolder_ReturnsEmpty(){var provider=new MockModFileProvider("plain");provider.AddFile("manifest.json","{}");Assert.Empty(ModCollectionStore.LoadFromProvider(provider));}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Engine.Tests.Mods{/// <summary> Round-trip tests for the collection JSON DTO. Collections are authored by hand, shipped inside mods and cached from catalogs, so every field must survive serialization exactly; <see cref="ModCollection.Origin"/> is runtime-only and must stay out of the file. </summary>
public class ModCollectionTests{[Fact]public void SerializeDeserialize_FullCollection_RoundTripsAllFields(){var original=new ModCollection{Id="card_novel",Name="Card Novel",Author="ct",Description="A visual novel with card battles.",Version="1.2.0",IconUrl="https://example.com/card_novel.png",SourceUrls=new List<string>{"https://catalog.test/catalog.json"},Mechanics=new List<ModCollectionMechanic>{new(){Id="vn_core",Name="Novel Core",Description="Story engine.",Mods=new List<string>{"visual_novel_core>=1"},},new(){Id="cards",Name="Card Game",Mods=new List<string>{"card_battle>=1.1","turn_battle_base>=1"},Optional=true,},},};var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(original,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteIndentedOptions);var restored=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ModCollection>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);Assert.Equal(original.Id,restored.Id);Assert.Equal(original.Name,restored.Name);Assert.Equal(original.Author,restored.Author);Assert.Equal(original.Description,restored.Description);Assert.Equal(original.Version,restored.Version);Assert.Equal(original.IconUrl,restored.IconUrl);Assert.Equal(original.SourceUrls,restored.SourceUrls);Assert.Equal(2,restored.Mechanics.Count);Assert.Equal("vn_core",restored.Mechanics[0].Id);Assert.Equal("Novel Core",restored.Mechanics[0].Name);Assert.Equal("Story engine.",restored.Mechanics[0].Description);Assert.Single(restored.Mechanics[0].Mods);Assert.Equal("visual_novel_core>=1",restored.Mechanics[0].Mods[0]);Assert.False(restored.Mechanics[0].Optional);Assert.Equal("cards",restored.Mechanics[1].Id);Assert.Equal(2,restored.Mechanics[1].Mods.Count);Assert.True(restored.Mechanics[1].Optional);}[Fact]public void Serialize_Origin_IsNotWrittenToJson(){var collection=new ModCollection{Id="local",Origin=ModCollectionOrigin.User};var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(collection,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteIndentedOptions);Assert.DoesNotContain("Origin",json);}[Fact]public void Deserialize_UnknownFields_AreIgnored(){const string json="""
            {
              "id": "x",
              "name": "X",
              "future_field": { "unknown": true },
              "mechanics": [ { "id": "m", "mods": ["a"], "another_future": 5 } ]
            }
            """;var collection=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ModCollection>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);Assert.Equal("x",collection.Id);Assert.Single(collection.Mechanics);Assert.Equal("a",collection.Mechanics[0].Mods[0]);}[Fact]public void DisplayTitle_FallsBackToId(){Assert.Equal("some_id",new ModCollection{Id="some_id"}.DisplayTitle);Assert.Equal("Named",new ModCollection{Id="x",Name="Named"}.DisplayTitle);}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Engine.Tests.Mods{public class ModCompilerTests{private const string ValidClassCode=@"
using Cthangover.Core.Mods;
public class TestModInit : IModInitializer
{
    public void OnModLoaded(string modId) { }
    public void OnModResourcesReady() { }
}
";[Fact]public void CompileString_ValidCode_ReturnsAssembly(){var result=ModCompiler.CompileString(ValidClassCode,"test_script");Assert.NotNull(result);Assert.True(result.Success);Assert.NotNull(result.Assembly);Assert.Empty(result.Errors);}[Fact]public void CompileString_InvalidCode_ReturnsErrors(){var code="broken csharp code {{{";var result=ModCompiler.CompileString(code,"bad_script");Assert.False(result.Success);Assert.Null(result.Assembly);Assert.NotNull(result.Errors);Assert.NotEmpty(result.Errors);}[Fact]public void Compile_EmptySources_ReturnsNull(){var sources=new List<(string,string)>();var result=ModCompiler.Compile("test_mod",sources);Assert.Null(result);}[Fact]public void Compile_ValidSingleFile_ReturnsAssembly(){var sources=new List<(string,string)>{("TestClass.cs",ValidClassCode)};var result=ModCompiler.Compile("test_mod_valid",sources);Assert.NotNull(result);}[Fact]public void Compile_SyntaxError_ReturnsNull(){var sources=new List<(string,string)>{("Broken.cs","totally broken code @@@")};var result=ModCompiler.Compile("test_mod_broken",sources);Assert.Null(result);}[Fact]public void InvalidateCache_NoDir_ReturnsFalse(){var result=ModCompiler.InvalidateCache("nonexistent_mod");Assert.False(result);}[Fact]public void Compile_CachesToDisk(){var modId="test_mod_cached_"+System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0,8);var sources=new List<(string,string)>{("Test.cs",ValidClassCode)};var result=ModCompiler.Compile(modId,sources);Assert.NotNull(result);try{ModCompiler.InvalidateCache(modId);}catch{}}[Fact]public void Compile_DifferentSource_DifferentHash(){var modId1="test_hash_a_"+System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0,6);var modId2="test_hash_b_"+System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0,6);var codeA=@"using Cthangover.Core.Mods;
public class TestA : IModInitializer { public void OnModLoaded(string m) { } public void OnModResourcesReady() { } }";var codeB=@"using Cthangover.Core.Mods;
public class TestB : IModInitializer { public void OnModLoaded(string m) { } public void OnModResourcesReady() { } }";var sources1=new List<(string,string)>{("Test.cs",codeA)};var sources2=new List<(string,string)>{("Test.cs",codeB)};var r1=ModCompiler.Compile(modId1,sources1);var r2=ModCompiler.Compile(modId2,sources2);Assert.NotNull(r1);Assert.NotNull(r2);try{ModCompiler.InvalidateCache(modId1);}catch{}try{ModCompiler.InvalidateCache(modId2);}catch{}}[Fact]public void CompileAll_PreCancelledToken_Throws(){using var cts=new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource();cts.Cancel();Assert.Throws<OperationCanceledException>(()=>{ModCompiler.CompileAll(new Dictionary<string,IModInfo>(),cts.Token);});}[Fact]public void Compile_PreCancelledToken_Throws(){var sources=new List<(string,string)>{("TestClass.cs",ValidClassCode)};using var cts=new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource();cts.Cancel();Assert.Throws<OperationCanceledException>(()=>{ModCompiler.Compile("test_mod_cancelled",sources,cts.Token);});}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Engine.Tests.Mods{/// <summary> Tests the persistence behavior of <see cref="ModLoadOrderStore"/> that the stateless <see cref="ModLoadOrder"/> tests do not cover: the JSON file itself, the move operations and the cleanup used by <see cref="ModUninstaller"/>. using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Engine.Tests.Mods{public class ModSaveableRegistryTests{private static readonly System.Type RegisteredType=typeof(ModSaveableRegistry).GetNestedType("RegisteredSaveable",BindingFlags.NonPublic|BindingFlags.Static);private static readonly FieldInfo SaveablesField=typeof(ModSaveableRegistry).GetField("_saveables",BindingFlags.NonPublic|BindingFlags.Static);private static void SetSaveables(params(IModSaveable instance,string modId)[]entries){var list=(System.Collections.IList)SaveablesField.GetValue(null);list.Clear();foreach(var(instance,modId)in entries){var reg=System.Activator.CreateInstance(RegisteredType);RegisteredType.GetField("Instance").SetValue(reg,instance);RegisteredType.GetField("ModId").SetValue(reg,modId);list.Add(reg);}}private static readonly FieldInfo RegistryInitializedField=typeof(ModRegistry).GetField("initialized",BindingFlags.NonPublic|BindingFlags.Instance);private static void InitModRegistry(){var registry=ModRegistry.Instance;if(!(bool)RegistryInitializedField.GetValue(registry)){RegistryInitializedField.SetValue(registry,true);}}// ─── CollectSaveData ───────────────────────────────────────

using System;using System.IO;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Engine.Tests.Mods{public class ModSettingsRegistryTests:IDisposable{private const string ModSettingsDir="mod_settings";private static readonly System.Type RegisteredType=typeof(ModSettingsRegistry).GetNestedType("RegisteredModSettings",BindingFlags.NonPublic|BindingFlags.Static);private static readonly FieldInfo EntriesField=typeof(ModSettingsRegistry).GetField("_entries",BindingFlags.NonPublic|BindingFlags.Static);private static readonly FieldInfo RegistryInitializedField=typeof(ModRegistry).GetField("initialized",BindingFlags.NonPublic|BindingFlags.Instance);public void Dispose(){try{if(Directory.Exists(ModSettingsDir))Directory.Delete(ModSettingsDir,true);}catch{}}private static void InitRegistry(){var registry=ModRegistry.Instance;if(!(bool)RegistryInitializedField.GetValue(registry))RegistryInitializedField.SetValue(registry,true);}private static void SetEntries(params(IModSettings instance,string modId)[]entries){var list=(System.Collections.IList)EntriesField.GetValue(null);list.Clear();foreach(var(instance,modId)in entries){var reg=System.Activator.CreateInstance(RegisteredType);RegisteredType.GetField("Instance").SetValue(reg,instance);RegisteredType.GetField("ModId").SetValue(reg,modId);list.Add(reg);}}// ─── Definitions ──────────────────────────────────────────
[Fact]public void GetDefinitions_returns_definitions_from_registered_mod(){var def=new ModSettingDefinition{Key="volume",Name="Volume",Type=SettingType.Integer,DefaultValue="50"};var settings=new Mocks.MockModSettings(new System.Collections.Generic.List<ModSettingDefinition>{def});SetEntries((settings,"audio_mod"));var result=ModSettingsRegistry.GetDefinitions("audio_mod");Assert.Single(result);Assert.Equal("volume",result[0].Key);Assert.Equal("Volume",result[0].Name);Assert.Equal(SettingType.Integer,result[0].Type);Assert.Equal("50",result[0].DefaultValue);}[Fact]public void GetDefinitions_unknown_mod_returns_empty(){SetEntries();Assert.Empty(ModSettingsRegistry.GetDefinitions("unknown"));}// ─── Write/Apply roundtrip in-memory ───────────────────────
[Fact]public void WriteCurrentValues_then_ApplyValues_roundtrip_preserves_data(){SetEntries((new Mocks.MockModSettings(),"test_mod"));var saved=ModSettingsRegistry.WriteCurrentValues("test_mod");Assert.Equal(42,saved.GetInt("test_int"));Assert.Equal("hello",saved.GetString("test_str"));saved.SetInt("test_int",99);saved.SetString("test_str","updated");var reader=new Mocks.MockModSettings();SetEntries((reader,"test_mod"));ModSettingsRegistry.ApplyValues("test_mod",saved);Assert.True(reader.ReadValuesCalled);Assert.Equal(99,reader.LastReadBlob.GetInt("test_int"));Assert.Equal("updated",reader.LastReadBlob.GetString("test_str"));}[Fact]public void WriteCurrentValues_unknown_mod_returns_empty_blob(){SetEntries();var blob=ModSettingsRegistry.WriteCurrentValues("unknown");Assert.NotNull(blob);Assert.Equal(1,blob.Version);}[Fact]public void ApplyValues_null_blob_skips_read(){var settings=new Mocks.MockModSettings();SetEntries((settings,"test_mod"));ModSettingsRegistry.ApplyValues("test_mod",null);Assert.False(settings.ReadValuesCalled);}[Fact]public void ApplyValues_unknown_mod_does_not_crash(){SetEntries();ModSettingsRegistry.ApplyValues("unknown",new DataBlob());}// ─── File I/O: Save / Load / Delete ────────────────────────
[Fact]public void SaveModSettings_then_LoadModSettings_roundtrip_preserves_data(){var blob=new DataBlob();blob.SetInt("volume",80);blob.SetString("mode","fast");blob.SetBool("enabled",true);ModSettingsRegistry.SaveModSettings("test_mod",blob);var loaded=ModSettingsRegistry.LoadModSettings("test_mod");Assert.Equal(80,loaded.GetInt("volume"));Assert.Equal("fast",loaded.GetString("mode"));Assert.True(loaded.GetBool("enabled"));}[Fact]public void LoadModSettings_no_file_returns_empty_blob(){var blob=ModSettingsRegistry.LoadModSettings("nonexistent_mod");Assert.NotNull(blob);Assert.Empty(blob.GetBytes());}[Fact]public void DeleteModSettings_removes_file(){var blob=new DataBlob();blob.SetInt("x",1);ModSettingsRegistry.SaveModSettings("deletable_mod",blob);ModSettingsRegistry.DeleteModSettings("deletable_mod");var loaded=ModSettingsRegistry.LoadModSettings("deletable_mod");Assert.Empty(loaded.GetBytes());}[Fact]public void SaveModSettings_overwrites_existing_file(){var blob1=new DataBlob();blob1.SetInt("x",1);ModSettingsRegistry.SaveModSettings("overwrite_mod",blob1);var blob2=new DataBlob();blob2.SetInt("x",99);ModSettingsRegistry.SaveModSettings("overwrite_mod",blob2);var loaded=ModSettingsRegistry.LoadModSettings("overwrite_mod");Assert.Equal(99,loaded.GetInt("x"));}[Fact]public void LoadAll_applies_saved_settings_to_registered_mods(){var blob=new DataBlob();blob.SetInt("x",55);ModSettingsRegistry.SaveModSettings("loadall_mod",blob);var settings=new Mocks.MockModSettings();SetEntries((settings,"loadall_mod"));ModSettingsRegistry.LoadAll();Assert.True(settings.ReadValuesCalled);Assert.Equal(55,settings.LastReadBlob.GetInt("x"));}// ─── GetModsWithSettings ───────────────────────────────────

using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Providers;namespace Engine.Tests.Mods{/// <summary> Tests the filesystem half of <see cref="ModUninstaller"/>. The registry lookup path needs a live mod set, so it is covered by integration; here the guarantees are: a mod directory is removed recursively, a zip mod is removed as a file, and a missing target reports failure instead of throwing. <see cref="ModRegistry.AllDiscoveredMods"/> is never seeded, so unknown ids must not be deletable. </summary>
public class ModUninstallerTests:IDisposable{private readonly string _testDir;public ModUninstallerTests(){_testDir=Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(),$"mod_uninstaller_test_{System.Guid.NewGuid():N}");Directory.CreateDirectory(_testDir);}public void Dispose(){if(Directory.Exists(_testDir))Directory.Delete(_testDir,recursive:true);}[Fact]public void DeleteModFiles_Folder_RemovesRecursively(){var modDir=Path.Combine(_testDir,"some_mod");Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(modDir,"scenes"));File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(modDir,"manifest.json"),"{}");File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(modDir,"scenes","a.tscn"),"");var result=ModUninstaller.DeleteModFiles(modDir);Assert.True(result);Assert.False(Directory.Exists(modDir));}[Fact]public void DeleteModFiles_ZipFile_RemovesArchive(){var zipPath=Path.Combine(_testDir,"some_mod.zip");File.WriteAllBytes(zipPath,new byte[]{0x50,0x4B,0x03,0x04});var result=ModUninstaller.DeleteModFiles(zipPath);Assert.True(result);Assert.False(File.Exists(zipPath));}[Fact]public void DeleteModFiles_MissingPath_ReturnsFalse(){var result=ModUninstaller.DeleteModFiles(Path.Combine(_testDir,"nonexistent"));Assert.False(result);}[Fact]public void DeleteModFiles_EmptyPath_ReturnsFalse(){Assert.False(ModUninstaller.DeleteModFiles(""));Assert.False(ModUninstaller.DeleteModFiles(null));}[Fact]public void CanUninstall_NullModInfo_ReturnsFalse(){Assert.False(ModUninstaller.CanUninstall((IModInfo)null));}[Fact]public void CanUninstall_ModOutsideKnownRoots_ReturnsFalse(){var modDir=Path.Combine(_testDir,"external_mod");Directory.CreateDirectory(modDir);var info=new ModInfo{Id="external_mod",FileProvider=new FolderModFileProvider(modDir,"external_mod"),};Assert.False(ModUninstaller.CanUninstall(info));}}}

using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Engine.Tests.Mods{public class PropertyPatchTests{[Fact]public void PropertyPatch_RoundTrip_PreservesProperties(){var patch=new PropertyPatch{ID="TestEntity",ExtraProperties=new Dictionary<string,object>{{"IntProp",JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>("42")},{"StrProp",JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>("\"hello\"")},{"BoolProp",JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>("true")},{"FloatProp",JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>("3.14")}}};var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(patch);var restored=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<PropertyPatch>(json);Assert.Equal("TestEntity",restored.ID);Assert.NotNull(restored.ExtraProperties);var intVal=Assert.IsType<JsonElement>(restored.ExtraProperties["IntProp"]);Assert.Equal(42,intVal.GetInt32());var strVal=Assert.IsType<JsonElement>(restored.ExtraProperties["StrProp"]);Assert.Equal("hello",strVal.GetString());var boolVal=Assert.IsType<JsonElement>(restored.ExtraProperties["BoolProp"]);Assert.True(boolVal.GetBoolean());var floatVal=Assert.IsType<JsonElement>(restored.ExtraProperties["FloatProp"]);Assert.Equal(3.14,floatVal.GetDouble());}[Fact]public void PropertyPatch_WildcardId_PreservesAsterisk(){var patch=new PropertyPatch{ID="*",ExtraProperties=new Dictionary<string,object>{{"GlobalProp",JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>("1")}}};var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(patch);var restored=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<PropertyPatch>(json);Assert.Equal("*",restored.ID);}[Fact]public void PropertyPatch_EmptyExtraProperties_IsNullByDefault(){var patch=new PropertyPatch{ID="Test"};var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(patch);var restored=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<PropertyPatch>(json);Assert.Equal("Test",restored.ID);Assert.Null(restored.ExtraProperties);}[Fact]public void PropertyPatch_FileDataDeserialization_Works(){var json=@"
            {
                ""Items"": [
                    { ""Id"": ""Hero"", ""Strength"": 15, ""Magic"": 5 },
                    { ""Id"": ""*"", ""GlobalStat"": 100 }
                ]
            }";var options=new JsonSerializerOptions{PropertyNameCaseInsensitive=true,ReadCommentHandling=System.Text.Json.JsonCommentHandling.Skip};var fileData=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<FileData<PropertyPatch>>(json,options);Assert.NotNull(fileData);Assert.Equal(2,fileData.Items.Count);Assert.Equal("Hero",fileData.Items[0].ID);Assert.Equal("*",fileData.Items[1].ID);var heroProps=fileData.Items[0].ExtraProperties;Assert.NotNull(heroProps);Assert.Contains("Strength",heroProps.Keys);Assert.Contains("Magic",heroProps.Keys);var starProps=fileData.Items[1].ExtraProperties;Assert.NotNull(starProps);Assert.Contains("GlobalStat",starProps.Keys);}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Quests;namespace Engine.Tests.Quests{/// <summary> Covers <see cref="QuestFactory"/>'s save round-trip and new-game reset: <c>SetAll</c> must restore registered quests and tolerate entries from content that no longer exists, while <c>ResetAll</c> must wipe progress so a second playthrough starts clean. Both mutate the process-wide singleton, so the class joins the non-parallel ConditionStateMonitor collection. </summary>
[Collection("ConditionStateMonitor")]public class QuestFactoryTests{[Fact]public void SetAll_RegisteredQuest_RestoresStatusTagsAndStage(){var quest=Register("FactorySave");var saved=new QuestBase{ID="FactorySave",Name="Test",Status=QuestStatus.Progress,Data=new QuestData{Status=3},};saved.Data.Tags.Add("tag");QuestFactory.Instance.SetAll(new List<QuestBase>{saved});Assert.Equal(QuestStatus.Progress,quest.Status);Assert.Equal(3,quest.Data.Status);Assert.True(quest.ContainsTag("tag"));}[Fact]public void SetAll_UnregisteredQuest_SkipsWithoutThrowing(){var quest=Register("FactoryKnown");var saved=new List<QuestBase>{new QuestBase{ID="FactoryGone",Name="Gone",Status=QuestStatus.End},new QuestBase{ID="FactoryKnown",Name="Test",Status=QuestStatus.Progress},};QuestFactory.Instance.SetAll(saved);Assert.Equal(QuestStatus.Progress,quest.Status);}[Fact]public void ResetAll_WipesStatusTagsAndStage(){var quest=Register("FactoryReset");quest.Status=QuestStatus.End;quest.AddTag("earned");quest.Data.SetStatus(5);QuestFactory.Instance.ResetAll();Assert.Equal(QuestStatus.NotStarted,quest.Status);Assert.Empty(quest.Data.Tags);Assert.Equal(0,quest.Data.Status);}private static QuestBase Register(string id){var quest=new QuestBase{ID=id,Name="Test "+id};var factory=GetFactory();SetPrivate(factory,"isLoaded",true);var dict=(IDictionary<string,QuestBase>)GetPrivate(factory,"dataByID");dict[id]=quest;return quest;}private static object GetFactory(){var lazyField=typeof(QuestFactory).GetField("instance",BindingFlags.Static|BindingFlags.NonPublic);var lazy=lazyField.GetValue(null);return lazy.GetType().GetProperty("Value").GetValue(lazy);}private static object GetPrivate(object factory,string fieldName){return typeof(QuestFactory).GetField(fieldName,BindingFlags.Instance|BindingFlags.NonPublic).GetValue(factory);}private static void SetPrivate(object factory,string fieldName,object value){typeof(QuestFactory).GetField(fieldName,BindingFlags.Instance|BindingFlags.NonPublic).SetValue(factory,value);}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Quests;using Engine.Tests.Scenarios;namespace Engine.Tests.Quests{/// <summary> Covers <see cref="QuestTagLocale"/>: the composite key built from a quest's locale prefix and tag, and the translation lookup with its raw-tag fallback. The journal stamps are the only consumer, so a regression here surfaces as untranslated or wrongly namespaced seals. </summary>
public class QuestTagLocaleTests{private readonly QuestBase _quest=new QuestBase{ID="AwakeningQuest",Name="quest/awakening",};[Fact]public void Key_ComposesQuestPrefixAndTag(){Assert.Equal("quest/awakening/tag/cloak_taken",QuestTagLocale.Key(_quest,"cloak_taken"));}[Fact]public void Key_NullQuest_ReturnsNull(){Assert.Null(QuestTagLocale.Key(null,"cloak_taken"));}[Fact]public void Key_EmptyTag_ReturnsNull(){Assert.Null(QuestTagLocale.Key(_quest,""));Assert.Null(QuestTagLocale.Key(_quest,null));}[Fact]public void Key_QuestWithoutLocalePrefix_ReturnsNull(){Assert.Null(QuestTagLocale.Key(new QuestBase{ID="NoName"},"cloak_taken"));}[Fact]public void Translate_UsesCompositeKey_NotRawTag(){var locale=new TestLocale();locale.Set("cloak_taken","Raw");locale.Set("quest/awakening/tag/cloak_taken","Cloak found");Assert.Equal("Cloak found",QuestTagLocale.Translate(_quest,"cloak_taken",locale));}[Fact]public void Translate_MissingKey_ReturnsRawTag(){Assert.Equal("cloak_taken",QuestTagLocale.Translate(_quest,"cloak_taken",new TestLocale()));}[Fact]public void Translate_NullQuest_ReturnsRawTag(){Assert.Equal("cloak_taken",QuestTagLocale.Translate(null,"cloak_taken",new TestLocale()));}[Fact]public void Translate_NullProvider_ReturnsRawTag(){Assert.Equal("cloak_taken",QuestTagLocale.Translate(_quest,"cloak_taken",null));}}}

namespace Engine.Tests.Scenarios{/// <summary> Marks the ConditionStateMonitor tests as non-parallel. The monitor's <c>Version</c> is a global monotonic counter shared across the whole process, so its delta-based assertions must not run concurrently with other test classes that also publish events (e.g. ScenarioConditionTests). </summary>
[CollectionDefinition("ConditionStateMonitor",DisableParallelization=true)]public class ConditionStateMonitorCollection{}}

using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Quests;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;namespace Engine.Tests.Scenarios{public class ScenarioConditionTests{[Fact]public void Evaluate_Null_ReturnsTrue(){Assert.True(ScenarioCondition.Evaluate(null));}[Fact]public void Evaluate_EmptyString_ReturnsTrue(){Assert.True(ScenarioCondition.Evaluate(""));}[Fact]public void Evaluate_Whitespace_ReturnsTrue(){Assert.True(ScenarioCondition.Evaluate("  \t "));}[Fact]public void Evaluate_FlagEqual_Match_ReturnsTrue(){ScenarioCondition.SetFlag("testFlag","done");Assert.True(ScenarioCondition.Evaluate("testFlag == \"done\""));}[Fact]public void Evaluate_FlagEqual_NoMatch_ReturnsFalse(){ScenarioCondition.SetFlag("testFlag","running");Assert.False(ScenarioCondition.Evaluate("testFlag == \"done\""));}[Fact]public void Evaluate_FlagNotEqual_Match_ReturnsTrue(){ScenarioCondition.SetFlag("testFlag","running");Assert.True(ScenarioCondition.Evaluate("testFlag != \"done\""));}[Fact]public void Evaluate_FlagNotEqual_NoMatch_ReturnsFalse(){ScenarioCondition.SetFlag("testFlag","done");Assert.False(ScenarioCondition.Evaluate("testFlag != \"done\""));}[Fact]public void Evaluate_FlagMissing_Equal_ReturnsFalse(){Assert.False(ScenarioCondition.Evaluate("missingFlag == \"x\""));}[Fact]public void Evaluate_FlagMissing_NotEqual_ReturnsTrue(){Assert.True(ScenarioCondition.Evaluate("missingFlag != \"x\""));}[Fact]public void Evaluate_FlagMissing_GreaterOrEqual_ReturnsFalse(){Assert.False(ScenarioCondition.Evaluate("missingFlag >= 0"));}[Fact]public void Evaluate_FlagNumeric_LessThan(){ScenarioCondition.SetFlag("count","3");Assert.True(ScenarioCondition.Evaluate("count < 5"));Assert.False(ScenarioCondition.Evaluate("count < 3"));}[Fact]public void using Cthangover.Core.Localization;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog.Action;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog.Action.Impls;namespace Engine.Tests.Scenarios{public class ScenarioModMergeTests{private const string ModAScenario=@"
# TestModAEvent - from test_mod_a
background scene_a_bg
text ""Это текст из мода A. Привет из test_mod_a!"" key=cross_mod/text_a
text ""Если ты это видишь, локализация A работает."" key=cross_mod/text_a_2
end
";private const string ModBScenario=@"
# TestModBEvent - from test_mod_b
background scene_b_bg
text ""Это текст из мода B. Привет из test_mod_b!"" key=cross_mod/text_b
select ""Выбери действие:"" key=cross_mod/choose_b
option ""Продолжить"" key=cross_mod/opt_continue -> :continue
option ""Выйти"" key=cross_mod/opt_exit -> :exit

:continue
text ""Ты выбрал продолжить."" key=cross_mod/text_continue
end

:exit
switch_scene Menu
end
";[Fact]public void ModA_Scenario_Parses_Correctly(){var dlg=ScenarioParser.Parse(ModAScenario);Assert.Equal(4,dlg.Queue.Count);var bg=Assert.IsType<ActionBackground>(dlg.Queue[0]);Assert.Equal("scene_a_bg",bg.SpriteID);var text1=Assert.IsType<ActionText>(dlg.Queue[1]);Assert.Equal("Это текст из мода A. Привет из test_mod_a!",text1.Text);var text2=Assert.IsType<ActionText>(dlg.Queue[2]);Assert.Equal("Если ты это видишь, локализация A работает.",text2.Text);Assert.IsType<ActionEnd>(dlg.Queue[3]);}[Fact]public void ModB_Scenario_Parses_Correctly(){var dlg=ScenarioParser.Parse(ModBScenario);Assert.Equal(9,dlg.Queue.Count);var bg=Assert.IsType<ActionBackground>(dlg.Queue[0]);Assert.Equal("scene_b_bg",bg.SpriteID);var text=Assert.IsType<ActionText>(dlg.Queue[1]);Assert.Equal("Это текст из мода B. Привет из test_mod_b!",text.Text);var select=Assert.IsType<ActionSelect>(dlg.Queue[2]);Assert.Equal("Выбери действие:",select.Text);Assert.Equal(2,select.Variants.Count);Assert.Equal("Продолжить",select.Variants[0].Text);Assert.Equal("continue",select.Variants[0].GoTo);Assert.Equal("Выйти",select.Variants[1].Text);Assert.Equal("exit",select.Variants[1].GoTo);var pointContinue=Assert.IsType<ActionEmpty>(dlg.Queue[3]);Assert.Equal("continue",pointContinue.ID);var continueText=Assert.IsType<ActionText>(dlg.Queue[4]);Assert.Equal("Ты выбрал продолжить.",continueText.Text);Assert.IsType<ActionEnd>(dlg.Queue[5]);var pointExit=Assert.IsType<ActionEmpty>(dlg.Queue[6]);Assert.Equal("exit",pointExit.ID);Assert.IsType<ActionSwitchScene>(dlg.Queue[7]);Assert.IsType<ActionEnd>(dlg.Queue[8]);}[Fact]public void ModAB_Scenarios_With_Localization_Resolves_Keys(){var locale=new TestLocale();locale.Set("cross_mod/text_a","This is text from mod A. Greetings from test_mod_a!");locale.Set("cross_mod/text_b","This is text from mod B. Greetings from test_mod_b!");locale.Set("cross_mod/choose_b","Choose an action:");locale.Set("cross_mod/opt_continue","Continue");locale.Set("cross_mod/opt_exit","Exit");locale.Set("cross_mod/text_continue","You chose to continue.");var dlgA=ScenarioParser.Parse(ModAScenario,locale);var textA=Assert.IsType<ActionText>(dlgA.Queue[1]);Assert.Equal("This is text from mod A. Greetings from test_mod_a!",textA.Text);var dlgB=ScenarioParser.Parse(ModBScenario,locale);var textB=Assert.IsType<ActionText>(dlgB.Queue[1]);Assert.Equal("This is text from mod B. Greetings from test_mod_b!",textB.Text);var select=Assert.IsType<ActionSelect>(dlgB.Queue[2]);Assert.Equal("Choose an action:",select.Text);Assert.Equal("Continue",select.Variants[0].Text);Assert.Equal("Exit",select.Variants[1].Text);var continueText=Assert.IsType<ActionText>(dlgB.Queue[4]);Assert.Equal("You chose to continue.",continueText.Text);}[Fact]public void ModAB_Scenarios_Without_Locale_Fallback_To_Original_Text(){var locale=new TestLocale();var dlgA=ScenarioParser.Parse(ModAScenario,locale);var textA=Assert.IsType<ActionText>(dlgA.Queue[1]);Assert.Equal("Это текст из мода A. Привет из test_mod_a!",textA.Text);var dlgB=ScenarioParser.Parse(ModBScenario,locale);var textB=Assert.IsType<ActionText>(dlgB.Queue[1]);Assert.Equal("Это текст из мода B. Привет из test_mod_b!",textB.Text);}[Fact]public void ModAB_ScenarioQueue_Has_Different_Action_Counts(){var dlgA=ScenarioParser.Parse(ModAScenario);var dlgB=ScenarioParser.Parse(ModBScenario);Assert.Equal(4,dlgA.Queue.Count);Assert.Equal(9,dlgB.Queue.Count);Assert.NotEqual(dlgA.Queue.Count,dlgB.Queue.Count);}[Fact]public void CrossMod_EventMerge_Simulates_Two_Mods_Contributing_To_Same_Scene(){var modAEvents=new List<string>{"@scenario:TestModAEvent"};var modBEvents=new List<string>{"@scenario:TestModBEvent"};var seen=new HashSet<string>();var merged=new List<string>();foreach(var evt in modAEvents)if(seen.Add(evt))merged.Add(evt);foreach(var evt in modBEvents)if(seen.Add(evt))merged.Add(evt);Assert.Equal(2,merged.Count);Assert.Contains("@scenario:TestModAEvent",merged);Assert.Contains("@scenario:TestModBEvent",merged);}[Fact]public void CrossMod_Dedup_Removes_Duplicate_Events_From_Different_Mods(){var modAEvents=new List<string>{"@scenario:TestModAEvent","@scenario:SharedEvent"};var modBEvents=new List<string>{"@scenario:TestModBEvent","@scenario:SharedEvent"};var seen=new HashSet<string>();var merged=new List<string>();foreach(var evt in modAEvents)if(seen.Add(evt))merged.Add(evt);foreach(var evt in modBEvents)if(seen.Add(evt))merged.Add(evt);Assert.Equal(3,merged.Count);Assert.Contains("@scenario:TestModAEvent",merged);Assert.Contains("@scenario:TestModBEvent",merged);Assert.Contains("@scenario:SharedEvent",merged);}[Fact]public void CrossMod_Events_Process_Sequentially(){var dlgA=ScenarioParser.Parse(ModAScenario);var dlgB=ScenarioParser.Parse(ModBScenario);var combinedQueue=new List<IActionCommand>();combinedQueue.AddRange(dlgA.Queue);combinedQueue.AddRange(dlgB.Queue);Assert.Equal(4+9,combinedQueue.Count);Assert.IsType<ActionBackground>(combinedQueue[0]);Assert.IsType<ActionEnd>(combinedQueue[3]);Assert.IsType<ActionBackground>(combinedQueue[4]);Assert.IsType<ActionEnd>(combinedQueue[combinedQueue.Count-1]);}}}

using Cthangover.CardBattle.UI;using Cthangover.Core.Battle.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.Actions{/// <summary> Base class for animated battle actions that move, rotate, and scale card controls through a sequence of visual phases. Subclasses implement <c>DoInternalAction</c> to advance a frame-by-frame animation state machine driven by <see cref="CardBattleCore"/>'s per-frame polling loop (<c>while (!DoAction()) await frame;</c>). Captures source/target positions and rotations in <see cref="DoStart"/> so that <see cref="DoEnd"/> can restore them regardless of what the animation did. </summary>
public abstract class AbstractBattleAction:IBattleAction{protected double Timestamp{get;set;}= -1;protected float Speed{get;set;}protected ActionCharacter Action{get;set;}protected CharacterCardNode Source{get;set;}protected CharacterCardNode Target{get;set;}protected Control SourceControl{get;set;}protected Vector2 SourcePos{get;set;}protected float SourceRot{get;set;}protected Control TargetControl{get;set;}protected Vector2 TargetPos{get;set;}protected float TargetRot{get;set;}/// <summary> Advances the animation by one frame. Called in a loop by <see cref="CardBattleCore.RunEnemyTurn"/> with <c>await root.ToSignal(frame)</c> between calls. Returns <c>true</c> when the animation has completed all phases and the action result has been applied. Returns <c>true</c> early if any required node became null (card was destroyed mid-animation). </summary> <returns><c>true</c> when the animation is finished or cannot proceed.</returns>

public void DoStart(){if(Source==null||Target==null||Action==null)return;SourceControl=Source.GetControlNode();SourcePos=SourceControl.GlobalPosition;SourceRot=SourceControl.Rotation;TargetControl=Target.GetControlNode();TargetPos=TargetControl.GlobalPosition;TargetRot=TargetControl.Rotation;DoInternalStart();}/// <summary> Restores source and target card controls to their original positions, rotations, and visual state captured during <see cref="DoStart"/>. public void DoEnd(){if(Source==null||Target==null||Action==null)return;DoInternalEnd();}}}

namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.Actions{/// <summary> Phases of the animated battle action state machine used by <see cref="PhysicsAttackAction"/> and <see cref="PhysicsDefenceAction"/>. Each tick, the action evaluates the current phase, interpolates card positions/rotations/scales, and transitions to the next phase when its duration elapses. The <c>Recover</c> phase signals completion by returning <c>true</c> from <c>DoInternalAction</c>. </summary>
public enum ActionPhase{/// <summary>Initial delay before any movement.</summary>
Wait,/// <summary>Source card rotates toward target and begins slight movement.</summary>
Prepare,/// <summary>Source card travels from its position to the target along a movement pattern.</summary>
MoveForAttack,/// <summary>Damage/effect is applied to the target card at the point of impact.</summary>
AttackImpact,/// <summary>Target card shows knockback, squashing, and shaking reaction.</summary>
TargetReaction,/// <summary>Source card returns toward its original position.</summary>
MoveForBack,/// <summary>All cards smoothly return to their original transforms.</summary>
Recover}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Battle.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.Actions{/// <summary> Registry that maps action type IDs (<c>"physics/attack"</c>, <c>"physics/defence"</c>, <c>"physics/stun"</c>) to their respective <see cref="IActionExecutor"/> implementations. Created by <see cref="CardBattleCore"/> and registered with <see cref="ActionExecutorHub"/> at battle startup so that actions resolved during drag-and-drop or enemy AI turns go through the correct damage/defence/stun logic. </summary>
public class CardBattleActionProvider:IActionExecutorProvider{private readonly Dictionary<string,IActionExecutor>_executors;/// <summary> Initializes the provider with the three card-battle action executors: <see cref="PhysicsDamageActionCard"/> for attacks, <see cref="PhysicsDefenceActionCard"/> for defence buffs, and <see cref="PhysicsStunActionCard"/> for stun effects. </summary>
public CardBattleActionProvider(){_executors=new Dictionary<string,IActionExecutor>{["physics/attack"]=new PhysicsDamageActionCard(),["physics/defence"]=new PhysicsDefenceActionCard(),["physics/stun"]=new PhysicsStunActionCard(),};}/// <summary> Looks up the <see cref="IActionExecutor"/> for the given <paramref name="actionId"/>. Logs a warning and returns <c>null</c> if no executor is registered, allowing the caller to gracefully skip unrecognized actions. </summary>
public IActionExecutor GetExecutor(string actionId){if(!_executors.TryGetValue(actionId,out var executor))GameLogger.Log("CARD_BATTLE",$"No executor registered for action '{actionId}'",LogLevel.Warning);return executor;}}}

This is the visual counterpart of <see cref="PhysicsDamageActionCard"/> — it handles the presentation while the executor handles the stat changes. public PhysicsAttackAction(CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target,ActionCharacter action,float DoInternalStart(){Timestamp=Time.GetTicksUsec()/1_000_000.0;damageApplied=false;stunEffectSpawned=false;phase=ActionPhase.Wait;targetOriginalScale=TargetControl.Scale;}private float GetPhaseProgress(){float elapsed=(float)(Time.GetTicksUsec()/1_000_000.0-Timestamp)*Speed*(float)Engine.TimeScale;float duration=GetCurrentPhaseDuration();return Mathf.Clamp(elapsed/duration,0f,1f);}private float GetCurrentPhaseDuration(){switch(phase){case ActionPhase.Wait:return waitDuration;case ActionPhase.Prepare:return prepareDuration;case ActionPhase.MoveForAttack:return moveForAttackDuration;case ActionPhase.AttackImpact:return attackImpactDuration;case ActionPhase.TargetReaction:return targetReactionDuration;case ActionPhase.MoveForBack:return moveForBackDuration;case ActionPhase.Recover:return recoverDuration;default:return 1f;}}private void ResetTimestamp(){Timestamp=Time.GetTicksUsec()/1_000_000.0;}protected override bool DoInternalAction(){float progress=GetPhaseProgress();switch(phase){case ActionPhase.Wait:if(progress>=1f){phase=ActionPhase.Prepare;ResetTimestamp();targetOriginalPos=TargetControl.GlobalPosition;targetOriginalScale=TargetControl.Scale;knockbackDirection=(TargetControl.GlobalPosition-SourceControl.GlobalPosition).Normalized();InitializeMovementPattern();}break;case ActionPhase.Prepare:{float prepareProgress=EaseOutQuad(Mathf.Min(progress,1f));Vector2 preparePosition=GetMovementPosition(prepareProgress*0.1f);SourceControl.GlobalPosition=SourcePos.Lerp(preparePosition,prepareProgress);SourceControl.Rotation=Mathf.Lerp(SourceRot,TargetRot,prepareProgress*0.3f);if(progress>=1f){phase=ActionPhase.MoveForAttack;ResetTimestamp();}break;}case ActionPhase.MoveForAttack:{float attackProgress=EaseInOutQuad(Mathf.Min(progress,1f));Vector2 targetPosition=GetMovementPosition(attackProgress);SourceControl.GlobalPosition=targetPosition;SourceControl.Rotation=Mathf.Lerp(SourceRot,TargetRot,attackProgress);if(progress>=1f){phase=ActionPhase.AttackImpact;ResetTimestamp();attackRotation=(float)GD.RandRange(-35f,35f)*Mathf.Pi/180f;}break;}case ActionPhase.AttackImpact:{float impactProgress=EaseInOutQuad(Mathf.Min(progress*3f,1f));SourceControl.Rotation=Mathf.Lerp(TargetRot,attackRotation,impactProgress);if(!damageApplied&&progress>=0.3f){damageApplied=true;var result=ActionExecutorHub.Instance.Execute(Action,Source.Card,Target.Card);Source.UpdateInfo();Target.UpdateInfo();if(result.Result){LogAttackResult(result);}else{GameLogger.Log("CARD_ACT",$"PhysicsAttackAction: failed to execute action {Action.Name} (source={Source.Card.Name} target={Target.Card.Name})",LogLevel.Error);}}if(progress>=1f){phase=ActionPhase.TargetReaction;ResetTimestamp();}break;}case ActionPhase.TargetReaction:{float reactionProgress=EaseInOutQuad(Mathf.Min(progress,1f));bool isStun=Action!=null&&Action.GetInt("Turn",0)>1;float currentKnockback=targetReactionIntensity;if(isStun)currentKnockback*=2.5f;knockbackPos=targetOriginalPos+knockbackDirection*currentKnockback;TargetControl.GlobalPosition=targetOriginalPos.Lerp(knockbackPos,reactionProgress);squashScale=targetOriginalScale;float currentSquash=isStun?0.35f:0.2f;squashScale.X*=1f-reactionProgress*currentSquash;squashScale.Y*=1f+reactionProgress*(currentSquash*0.5f);TargetControl.Scale=squashScale;float ActionPhase.MoveForBack:{float backProgress=EaseOutQuad(Mathf.Min(progress,1f));Vector2 backPosition=GetMovementPosition(1f-progress);SourceControl.GlobalPosition=backPosition.Lerp(SourcePos,backProgress);SourceControl.Rotation=Mathf.Lerp(attackRotation,SourceRot,backProgress);TargetControl.GlobalPosition=knockbackPos.Lerp(targetOriginalPos,backProgress);TargetControl.Scale=squashScale.Lerp(targetOriginalScale,backProgress);float currentShake=Mathf.Sin(backProgress*Mathf.Pi)*shake*(1f-backProgress);TargetControl.Rotation=Mathf.Lerp(currentShake*30f*Mathf.Pi/180f,TargetRot,backProgress);if(progress>=1f){phase=ActionPhase.Recover;ResetTimestamp();}break;}case ActionPhase.Recover:{float recoverProgress=EaseOutQuad(Mathf.Min(progress,1f));SourceControl.GlobalPosition=SourceControl.GlobalPosition.Lerp(SourcePos,recoverProgress);SourceControl.Rotation=Mathf.Lerp(SourceControl.Rotation,SourceRot,recoverProgress);TargetControl.GlobalPosition=TargetControl.GlobalPosition.Lerp(TargetPos,recoverProgress);TargetControl.Rotation=Mathf.Lerp(TargetControl.Rotation,TargetRot,recoverProgress);TargetControl.Scale=TargetControl.Scale.Lerp(targetOriginalScale,recoverProgress);if(progress>=1f)return true;break;}default:return true;}return false;}protected override void DoInternalEnd(){if(SourceControl!=null){SourceControl.GlobalPosition=SourcePos;SourceControl.Rotation=SourceRot;}if(TargetControl!=null){TargetControl.GlobalPosition=TargetPos;TargetControl.Rotation=TargetRot;TargetControl.Scale=targetOriginalScale;}}/// <summary> Mirrors the resolved action onto the UI: floating damage / absorbed shield numbers, a colour pulse on the target card and journal rows, so an AI attack reads the same as the player's own attack. Stun actions (a "Turn" above 1) flash the electric zap instead of damage numbers. </summary>
private void LogAttackResult(ChangedAttributes result){var targetName=TranslationServer.Translate(Target.Card.Name).ToString();var isStun=Action!=null&&Action.GetInt("Turn",0)>1;var defenceLost= -result.Target.Defence;if(defenceLost>0){ShowDamageBehaviour.SpawnDefence(defenceLost,TargetControl,TargetControl.GlobalPosition);BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_shield_absorb"),targetName,defenceLost),UI.BattleLogKind.Shield);}if(isStun){Target.PlayZap();BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_stun"),targetName,Action.GetInt("Turn",0)),UI.BattleLogKind.Status);return;}if(result.Target.Damage>0){ShowDamageBehaviour.SpawnDamage(result.Target.Damage,TargetControl,TargetControl.GlobalPosition);Target.Flash(UiTokens.DangerText);BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_damage"),Translate(Action.Name),TranslationServer.Translate(Source.Card.Name).ToString(),targetName,result.Target.Damage),UI.BattleLogKind.Damage);}}private static string Translate(string key)=>TranslationServer.Translate(key).ToString();private void InitializeMovementPattern(){Vector2 direction=(TargetPos-SourcePos).Normalized();Vector2 perpendicular=new Vector2(-direction.Y,direction.X);switch(movementPattern){case MovementPattern.Arc:movementControlPoint=SourcePos+direction*0.5f+perpendicular*2f;break;case MovementPattern.Zigzag:movementControlPoint=SourcePos+direction*0.5f+perpendicular*1.5f;break;case MovementPattern.Spiral:movementControlPoint=TargetPos+perpendicular*1.5f;break;case MovementPattern.Dash:movementControlPoint=SourcePos+direction*0.3f;break;default:movementControlPoint=TargetPos;break;}}private Vector2 GetMovementPosition(float progress){switch(movementPattern){case MovementPattern.Direct:return SourcePos.Lerp(TargetPos,progress);case MovementPattern.Arc:return SourcePos.Lerp(movementControlPoint,progress).Lerp(movementControlPoint.Lerp(TargetPos,progress),progress);case MovementPattern.Zigzag:if(progress<0.5f)return SourcePos.Lerp(movementControlPoint,progress*2f);else return movementControlPoint.Lerp(TargetPos,(progress-0.5f)*2f);case MovementPattern.Spiral:{Vector2 toTarget=TargetPos-SourcePos;float angle=progress*Mathf.Pi*2f;float radius=(1f-progress)*1.5f;Vector2 spiralOffset=new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(angle),Mathf.Sin(angle))*radius;return SourcePos.Lerp(TargetPos,progress)+spiralOffset;}case MovementPattern.Dash:if(progress<0.3f)return SourcePos.Lerp(movementControlPoint,progress/0.3f);else if(progress<0.7f)return movementControlPoint;else return using Cthangover.Core.Cards.StatusEffect;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.Actions{/// <summary> Executor that applies physical damage from an attack card to a target. Calculates damage as <c>card_attack_multiplier × user_attack_stat</c>, reduces it by the target's current defence value (which is consumed in the process), and applies the remainder to the target's health. Invokes <c>OnTakeDamage</c>/<c>OnDealDamage</c> hooks on both characters' <see cref="StatusEffectQueue"/> so that damage-modifying status effects can intercept and adjust the values before they are applied. Registered in <see cref="CardBattleActionProvider"/> under <c>"physics/attack"</c>. </summary>
public class PhysicsDamageActionCard:ActionBase{/// <summary> Unique identifier registered in <see cref="CardBattleActionProvider"/> as <c>"physics/attack"</c>. </summary>
public override string ID=>"PhysicsDamageActionCard";/// <summary> Resolves the attack: deducts action points from <paramref name="user"/> via <c>CheckRequiredAndUsePoint</c>, computes raw damage from the card's attack multiplier and the user's attack stat, applies status-effect damage hooks, consumes <paramref name="target"/>'s defence shield first, then subtracts remaining damage from health. Returns a <see cref="ChangedAttributes"/> with the actual damage and defence-loss deltas for the floating text display. </summary>
public override ChangedAttributes Execute(ActionCharacter actionCard,Character user,Character target){if(target==null||user==null|| !CheckRequiredAndUsePoint(actionCard,user))return new ChangedAttributes{Result=false};var damageDelta=Mathf.RoundToInt(actionCard.GetFloat("Attack",1f)*user.Attributes.Attack.Value);StatusEffectService.Of(target).OnTakeDamage(user,ref damageDelta);StatusEffectService.Of(user).OnDealDamage(target,ref damageDelta);var defenceDelta=0;var ignoreArmor=user.HasPassiveEffect("IgnoreArmor");if(!ignoreArmor&&target.Attributes.Defence.Value>0){defenceDelta=target.Attributes.Defence.Value>=damageDelta?damageDelta:target.Attributes.Defence.Value;damageDelta-=defenceDelta;}target.Attributes.Defence.Value-=defenceDelta;target.Attributes.Health.Value-=damageDelta;return new ChangedAttributes{Result=true,Target={Damage=damageDelta,Defence= -defenceDelta}};}}}

using System;using Cthangover.CardBattle.UI;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle{/// <summary> Static sink for battle journal entries. Player action strategies and the battle core run without a reference to the UI screen, so they publish here instead of reaching into the scene tree; the <see cref="BattleLogPanel"/> subscribes while it exists and unsubscribes on tree exit, which keeps the hub empty outside of a battle. public static void Log(string text,BattleLogKind kind=BattleLogKind.Info)=>Entry?.Invoke(text,kind);}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Battle;using Cthangover.Core.Battle.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.Cards.StatusEffect;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.CharacterPanel;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.CardBattle.Player;using Cthangover.CardBattle.UI;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle{/// <summary> Core orchestrator for the card-based turn battle system. Owns the full battle lifecycle: it instantiates the UI screen rebuilt from the mockup (mockups/card_battle, defined in <c>scenes/card_battle_screen.tscn</c>), cycles between player and enemy turns, drives the animated enemy actions through <see cref="AbstractBattleAction"/>, applies status effects each turn and detects win/loss when one side loses all cards. <para/> The core talks to the screen through its assembled widgets (<see cref="CardBattleScreen.Hud"/>, <see cref="BattleLogPanel"/>, <see cref="BattleBanner"/>, panels) instead of walking the scene tree, and publishes journal rows via <see cref="BattleLogHub"/> so other battle code can log without a UI reference. Implements <see cref="IBattleCore"/> so the battle engine can select this mod as the active battle type. </summary>
public class CardBattleCore:IBattleCore,IBattleAutoPlayable{private const int PlayerCardLimit=4;private const float BaseCardWidth=230f;private const float BaseCardHeight=420f;private const float CellOffset=10f;private Character[]_playerChars;private Character[]_enemyChars;private IBattleContext _ctx;private CardBattleScreen _screen;private BattleCardPanel _playerPanel;private BattleCardPanel _enemyPanel;private CardController _cardController;private EndTurnButton _endTurnButton;private BattleSide _currentOrder;private bool _playerTurnActive;private int _round;/// <summary>Unique identifier for this battle core, used by the battle engine to select the card battle mod.</summary>
public string Id=>"card_battle";/// <summary> Provides <see cref="IActionExecutor"/> instances for the three card action types (physics/attack, physics/defence, physics/stun) used during action resolution. </summary>
public IActionExecutorProvider ActionProvider{get;}=new Actions.CardBattleActionProvider();/// <summary> Instantiates the battle screen from <c>scenes/card_battle_screen.tscn</c>, attaches it to the battle scene's <c>Panel</c> and binds the panels, end-turn button and input controller. Enemy characters are deep-copied so defeats are tracked independently per battle instance. The <see cref="CardBattleActionProvider"/> is registered with <see cref="ActionExecutorHub"/>. </summary>
public void Init(Character[]playerChars,Character[]enemyChars,IBattleContext ctx){_playerChars=playerChars;_ctx=ctx;_enemyChars=new Character[enemyChars.Length];for(var i=0;i<enemyChars.Length;i++)_enemyChars[i]=enemyChars[i]?.Copy()??enemyChars[i];ActionExecutorHub.Instance.SetActiveProvider(ActionProvider);var root=ctx.RootNode as Node;var panel=root.GetNodeOrNull<Control>("Panel")??root;_screen=(CardBattleScreen)TscnScenes.LoadAndBuild("scenes/card_battle_screen.tscn");_screen.Name="CardBattleScreen";_screen.EnsureConstructed();panel.AddChild(_screen);_playerPanel=_screen.PlayerPanel;_enemyPanel=_screen.EnemyPanel;_endTurnButton=_screen.EndTurnButton;_endTurnButton.SetVisible(false);_endTurnButton.OnPressed+=OnEndTurnPressed;_cardController=_screen.Controller;_cardController.Setup(_screen);}/// <summary> Calculates the pointer scale fitting both sides on screen, initializes every card and starts the first player turn. Subscribes to <c>OnCardDead</c> to record defeated enemies for the victory screen and to <c>OnActionExecuted</c> to detect automatic turn completion. </summary>
public void Start(){var enemyCount=_enemyChars?.Length??1;_enemyPanel.UseRows=enemyCount>6;var cardScale=CalculateCardScale(enemyCount);_cardController.CardScale=cardScale;_playerPanel.Init(_playerChars,true,cardScale);_enemyPanel.Init(_enemyChars,false,cardScale);_enemyPanel.OnCardDead+=OnEnemyCardDead;_cardController.OnActionExecuted+=CheckPlayerTurnEnd;BattleSceneContext.Instance.OnBattleCleared+=OnBattleCleared;_round=0;_currentOrder=BattleSide.Player;StartPlayerTurn();}private float CalculateCardScale(int enemyCount){var viewport=((Node)_ctx.RootNode).GetViewport().GetVisibleRect().Size;var enemyPanelWidth=viewport.X*0.96f;var playerPanelWidth=viewport.X*0.55f;var enemyPanelHeight=viewport.Y*0.446f;float maxCardScale;if(_enemyPanel.UseRows){var maxPerRow=_enemyPanel.GetMaxCardsPerRow();var rows=_enemyPanel.GetCurrentRowCount(enemyCount);var widthScale=(enemyPanelWidth-(maxPerRow-1)*CellOffset)/(maxPerRow*BaseCardWidth);var heightScale=(enemyPanelHeight-(rows-1)*CellOffset)/(rows*BaseCardHeight);maxCardScale=Mathf.Max(0.1f,Mathf.Min(widthScale,heightScale));}else{var effectiveCount=Mathf.Max(enemyCount,1);maxCardScale=Mathf.Max(0.1f,(enemyPanelWidth-(effectiveCount-1)*CellOffset)/(effectiveCount*BaseCardWidth));}var playerFitScale=Mathf.Max(0.1f,(playerPanelWidth-(PlayerCardLimit-1)*CellOffset)/(PlayerCardLimit*BaseCardWidth));return Mathf.Min(Mathf.Min(maxCardScale,playerFitScale),1f);}private void OnEnemyCardDead(CharacterCardNode card){if(card?.Card==null)return;var ctx=BattleSceneContext.Instance;if(ctx!=null){ctx.RecordEnemyDefeated(card.Card);ctx.NotifyCharacterDied(card.Card);}_screen.Hud.SetEnemiesAlive(CountAlive(_enemyPanel));BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_dead"),card.Card.Name),BattleLogKind.Dead);}private void StartPlayerTurn(){_round+=1;_currentOrder=BattleSide.Player;_playerTurnActive=true;BattleSceneContext.Instance.IsWait=false;_cardController.ClearSelections();_cardController.ClearActions();_screen.ActionsPanel.ClearBody();_screen.ActionsPanel.ClearSubject();_endTurnButton?.SetVisible(true);foreach(var card in _playerPanel.CardList){StatusEffectService.Of(card.Card).OnTurnStart();card.Card.Attributes.Point.Value=card.Card.Attributes.Point.BaseValue;card.UpdateInfo();}_screen.Hud.SetTurn(true);_screen.Hud.SetRound(_round);_screen.Hud.SetEnemiesAlive(CountAlive(_enemyPanel));_screen.LogPanel.SetRound(_round);_screen.Banner.Show(Translate("battle/turn_player"));BattleLogHub.Log(Translate("battle/log_turn_player")+" · "+string.Format(Translate("battle/log_round"),_round),BattleLogKind.Turn);}private void OnEndTurnPressed()=>OnPlayerTurnEnd();private void CheckPlayerTurnEnd(){if(_currentOrder!=BattleSide.Player)return;if(!HasAliveCards(_enemyPanel)){_ctx.EndBattle(BattleSide.Player);return;}foreach(var card in _playerPanel.CardList){if(!card.IsDead&&card.Card?.Attributes?.Point?.Value>0)return;}BattleLogHub.Log(Translate("battle/log_out_of_points"),BattleLogKind.Info);OnPlayerTurnEnd();}/// <summary> Ends the player's turn: hides the end-turn button, pauses the battle, plays the enemy-turn banner and journal line, waits for two frames plus a short pause so the UI settles, then runs the enemy AI. Ends the battle immediately when no enemies remain. </summary>
public async void OnPlayerTurnEnd(){_playerTurnActive=false;_endTurnButton?.SetVisible(false);BattleSceneContext.Instance.IsWait=true;if(!HasAliveCards(_enemyPanel)){_ctx.EndBattle(BattleSide.Player);return;}_screen.Hud.SetTurn(false);_screen.Banner.Show(Translate("battle/turn_enemy"));BattleLogHub.Log(Translate("battle/log_turn_enemy"),BattleLogKind.Turn);var root=(Node)_ctx.RootNode;await root.ToSignal(root.GetTree(),"process_frame");await root.ToSignal(root.GetTree().CreateTimer(0.5f),"timeout");await RunEnemyTurn();}private async Task RunEnemyTurn(){_currentOrder=BattleSide.Enemy;_endTurnButton?.SetVisible(false);var root=(Node)_ctx.RootNode;foreach(var card in _enemyPanel.CardList.ToList()){if(card.IsDead||card.Card?.Actions==null||card.Card.Actions.Count==0)continue;StatusEffectService.Of(card.Card).OnTurnStart();if(StatusEffectService.Of(card.Card).HasStun()){card.UpdateInfo();card.PlayZap();BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_stun_skip"),card.Card.Name),BattleLogKind.Status);continue;}card.Card.Attributes.Point.Value=card.Card.Attributes.Point.BaseValue;var action=PickEnemyAction(card);if(action==null)continue;var target=PickEnemyTarget(card,action);if(target==null)continue;card.UpdateInfo();if(action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToEnemy){BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_enemy_action"),card.Card.Name,ActionCharacterUi.Translate(action.Name),target.Card.Name),BattleLogKind.Info);}var animatedAction=CreateAnimatedAction(card,target,action);if(animatedAction!=null){animatedAction.DoStart();while(!animatedAction.DoAction())await root.ToSignal(root.GetTree(),"process_frame");animatedAction.DoEnd();}await root.ToSignal(root.GetTree().CreateTimer(0.2f),"timeout");if(!HasAliveCards(_playerPanel)){_ctx.EndBattle(BattleSide.Enemy);return;}}if(!HasAliveCards(_playerPanel)){_ctx.EndBattle(BattleSide.Enemy);return;}StartPlayerTurn();}private ActionCharacter PickEnemyAction(CharacterCardNode card){var actions=card.Card.Actions;if(actions==null||actions.Count==0)return null;return actions[GD.RandRange(0,actions.Count-1)];}private CharacterCardNode PickEnemyTarget(CharacterCardNode source,ActionCharacter action){if(action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToEnemy){var alivePlayers=_playerPanel.CardList.Where(c=> !c.IsDead&&c.Card?.Attributes?.Health?.Value>0).ToList();if(alivePlayers.Count==0)return null;return alivePlayers[GD.RandRange(0,alivePlayers.Count-1)];}if(action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToAlias||action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToSelf)return source;GameLogger.Log("CARD_BATTLE",$"PickEnemyTarget: unsupported action type {action.Type}",LogLevel.Warning);return null;}private Actions.AbstractBattleAction CreateAnimatedAction(CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target,ActionCharacter action){if(action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToEnemy)return new Actions.PhysicsAttackAction(source,target,action);if(action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToAlias||action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToSelf)return new Actions.PhysicsDefenceAction(source,target,action);GameLogger.Log("CARD_BATTLE",$"CreateAnimatedAction: unsupported action type {action.Type}",LogLevel.Warning);return null;}private static bool HasAliveCards(BattleCardPanel panel){foreach(var card in panel.CardList){if(!card.IsDead&&card.Card?.Attributes?.Health?.Value>0)return true;}return false;}private static int CountAlive(BattleCardPanel panel){var alive=0;foreach(var card in panel.CardList){if(!card.IsDead&&card.Card?.Attributes?.Health?.Value>0)alive++;}return alive;}private void OnBattleCleared(){_screen?.Clear();}private static string Translate(string key)=>TranslationServer.Translate(key).ToString();/// <summary> <c>true</c> between <see cref="StartPlayerTurn"/> and the start of <see cref="OnPlayerTurnEnd"/> — matches the visibility window of the end-turn button, so automation presses exactly one turn per window. </summary>
public bool IsWaitingForPlayerInput=>_playerTurnActive;/// <summary>Automation hook: ends the player's turn without selecting cards.</summary>
public void AdvancePlayerTurn()=>OnPlayerTurnEnd();}}

using Cthangover.CardBattle.UI;using Cthangover.Core.Battle;using Cthangover.Core.Battle.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.TurnBattle;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.Player{/// <summary> Strategy for <c>ToEnemy</c> actions. Validates that the target is an enemy, highlights both cards with a red attack outline, executes the action via <see cref="ActionExecutorHub"/> and reports the outcome: floating damage / defence-loss numbers on the target, a colour pulse on the card and a journal row through <see cref="BattleLogHub"/>. Stun actions (those with a "Turn" above 1) additionally flash the electric zap over the target instead of printing damage, matching the mockup's stun feedback. </summary>
public class AttackToEnemyStrategy:ICardActionStrategy{/// <summary>Returns <c>true</c> if the action type is <c>ToEnemy</c> and the target is an enemy card.</summary>
public bool Check(ActionCharacter action,CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target){return action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToEnemy&&target!=null&& !target.IsPlayer;}/// <summary>Shows a red attack overlay on both the dragged action card and the target enemy card.</summary>
public void HighlightTarget(ActionCardNode actionCard,CharacterCardNode target){actionCard.Attack();target.Attack();}/// <summary> Resolves the attack and publishes its result: damage and absorbed shield as floating numbers plus journal rows, or the stun effect with its zap flash for control actions. </summary>
public void Execute(CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target,ActionCharacter action){if(source?.Card==null||target?.Card==null||action==null)return;var result=ActionExecutorHub.Instance.Execute(action,source.Card,target.Card);source.UpdateInfo();target.UpdateInfo();if(!result.Result)return;var actionName=Translate(action.Name);var sourceName=Translate(source.Card.Name);var targetName=Translate(target.Card.Name);var isStun=action.GetInt("Turn",0)>1;var defenceLost= -result.Target.Defence;if(defenceLost>0){ShowDamageBehaviour.SpawnDefence(defenceLost,target,target.GlobalPosition);BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_shield_absorb"),targetName,defenceLost),BattleLogKind.Shield);}if(isStun){target.PlayZap();BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_stun"),targetName,action.GetInt("Turn",0)),BattleLogKind.Status);return;}if(result.Target.Damage>0){ShowDamageBehaviour.SpawnDamage(result.Target.Damage,target,target.GlobalPosition);target.Flash(UiTokens.DangerText);BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_damage"),actionName,sourceName,targetName,result.Target.Damage),BattleLogKind.Damage);}else if(defenceLost==0){BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_absorbed"),actionName,sourceName,targetName),BattleLogKind.Shield);}}private static string Translate(string key)=>TranslationServer.Translate(key).ToString();}}

using Cthangover.CardBattle.UI;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.Player{/// <summary> Factory that returns the appropriate <see cref="ICardActionStrategy"/> implementation for a given <see cref="ActionCharacter"/>. Dispatches based on <see cref="ActionCharacterType"/>: <c>ToEnemy</c> → <see cref="AttackToEnemyStrategy"/>, <c>ToAlias</c> → <see cref="SupportStrategy"/>, <c>ToSelf</c> → <see cref="SelfStrategy"/>. Used by <see cref="CardController"/> during drag-and-drop to determine valid targeting behavior and by <see cref="CanTarget"/> for pre-validation. </summary>
public static class CardActionStrategyFactory{/// <summary> Returns the matching strategy for the action's type, or <c>null</c> if any argument is null or the type is unrecognized. </summary>
public static ICardActionStrategy Get(ActionCharacter action,CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target){if(action==null||source==null||target==null)return null;switch(action.Type){case ActionCharacterType.ToEnemy:return new AttackToEnemyStrategy();case ActionCharacterType.ToAlias:return new SupportStrategy();case ActionCharacterType.ToSelf:return new SelfStrategy();default:return null;}}/// <summary> Convenience method that gets the strategy via <see cref="Get"/> and immediately calls <see cref="ICardActionStrategy.Check"/> on it. Returns <c>false</c> if no strategy matches or any argument is null. </summary>
public static bool CanTarget(ActionCharacter action,CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target){if(action==null||source==null||target==null)return false;return Get(action,source,target)?.Check(action,source,target)??false;}}}

using Cthangover.CardBattle.UI;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.Player{/// <summary> Strategy interface that defines validation, visual highlighting, and execution for a specific type of card action during the player's drag-and-drop targeting flow. The <see cref="CardActionStrategyFactory"/> dispatches to the correct strategy based on the action's <see cref="ActionCharacterType"/>. <see cref="CardController"/> calls <see cref="Check"/> during drag to validate targets, <see cref="HighlightTarget"/> to show valid/invalid visual feedback, and <see cref="Execute"/> when the card is dropped on a valid target. </summary>
public interface ICardActionStrategy{/// <summary> Validates whether <paramref name="action"/> can be performed by <paramref name="source"/> on <paramref name="target"/>. Called each frame during drag to determine visual feedback. </summary>
bool Check(ActionCharacter action,CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target);/// <summary> Applies visual highlighting to both the <paramref name="actionCard"/> being dragged and the <paramref name="target"/> character card (e.g. red outline for attack, green for support). </summary>
void HighlightTarget(ActionCardNode actionCard,CharacterCardNode target);/// <summary> Executes the action via <see cref="ActionExecutorHub"/> and spawns floating damage/defence text. Called on successful card drop by <see cref="CardController.OnEndDrag"/>. </summary>
void Execute(CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target,ActionCharacter action);}}

using Cthangover.CardBattle.UI;using Cthangover.Core.Battle;using Cthangover.Core.Battle.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.TurnBattle;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.Player{/// <summary> Strategy for self-targeting actions (<c>ToSelf</c>). Validates that the source and target are the same card, highlights with a green selection outline and applies the effect to the caster. Shield gains print a floating blue number and a journal row; the card pulses to make the buff readable without reading the log. </summary>
public class SelfStrategy:ICardActionStrategy{/// <summary>Returns <c>true</c> only when <paramref name="source"/> and <paramref name="target"/> are the same card.</summary>
public bool Check(ActionCharacter action,CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target){return source!=null&&source==target;}/// <summary>Shows a green selection overlay on both the dragged action card and the source card.</summary>
public void HighlightTarget(ActionCardNode actionCard,CharacterCardNode target){actionCard.Select();target.Select();}/// <summary>Executes the self-targeted action and reports shields and healing.</summary>
public void Execute(CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target,ActionCharacter action){if(source?.Card==null||action==null)return;var result=ActionExecutorHub.Instance.Execute(action,source.Card,source.Card);source.UpdateInfo();if(!result.Result)return;if(result.Target.Defence>0){ShowDamageBehaviour.SpawnDefence(result.Target.Defence,source,source.GlobalPosition);source.Flash(UiTokens.Info);BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_shield_gain"),Translate(source.Card.Name),result.Target.Defence),BattleLogKind.Buff);}if(result.Target.Damage>0)ShowDamageBehaviour.SpawnDamage(result.Target.Damage,source,source.GlobalPosition,true);}private static string Translate(string key)=>TranslationServer.Translate(key).ToString();}}

using Cthangover.CardBattle.UI;using Cthangover.Core.Battle.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.Player{/// <summary> Strategy for stun actions targeting enemies. Extends the standard <c>ToEnemy</c> check by also verifying that the action has at least 2 turns of stun duration (<c>"Turn" > 1</c>). Highlights with red attack overlays and applies the stun effect via <see cref="ActionExecutorHub"/> without spawning damage text (stun has no numerical effect to display). Not currently returned by <see cref="CardActionStrategyFactory"/> — available for future use when stun cards need distinct drag-and-drop behavior from attack cards. </summary>
public class StunToEnemyStrategy:ICardActionStrategy{/// <summary> Returns <c>true</c> when the action targets an enemy and has a turn count greater than 1. </summary>
public bool Check(ActionCharacter action,CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target){return action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToEnemy&&target!=null&& !target.IsPlayer&&action.GetInt("Turn",0)>1;}/// <summary> Shows a red attack overlay on both cards, same as <see cref="AttackToEnemyStrategy"/>. </summary>
public void HighlightTarget(ActionCardNode actionCard,CharacterCardNode target){actionCard.Attack();target.Attack();}/// <summary> Applies the stun via <see cref="ActionExecutorHub"/>. Does not spawn damage/defence text. </summary>
public void Execute(CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target,ActionCharacter action){if(source?.Card==null||target?.Card==null||action==null)return;ActionExecutorHub.Instance.Execute(action,source.Card,target.Card);source.UpdateInfo();target.UpdateInfo();}}}
