using System;namespace Cthangover.Live2D.Cubism.Framework{/// <summary> Smooth target-point tracking for face/eye movement parameters. Drives the ParamAngleX/Y and ParamEyeBallX/Y model parameters in <see cref="CubismModelNode"/>. Uses a velocity-based smoothing approach: each update computes a desired velocity toward the target, applies acceleration limits, enforces a maximum safe approach speed to prevent overshoot near the target, and integrates velocity into position. The tracking is frame-rate independent — delta time is scaled by a factor of 30 (matching Cubism's internal 30fps reference). Acceleration and max velocity are clamped per Cubism SDK conventions (FaceParamMaxV = 40, FrameToMaxSpeed = 4.5). </summary>
public class CubismTargetPoint{private const float FaceParamMaxV=40f;private const float FrameToMaxSpeed=4.5f;private float _faceTargetX,_faceTargetY;private float _faceX,_faceY;private float _faceVX,_faceVY;private float _lastTimeSeconds;private float _userTimeSeconds;/// <summary>Current smoothed X position.</summary>
public float X=>_faceX;/// <summary>Current smoothed Y position.</summary>
public float Y=>_faceY;/// <summary> Sets the target point immediately. The actual position will smoothly approach this target over subsequent calls to <see cref="Update"/>. </summary>
public void Set(float x,float y){_faceTargetX=x;_faceTargetY=y;}/// <summary> Advances the smoothing simulation by one frame. Computes delta-time-weighted velocity toward target, applies acceleration clamping and safe approach speed limiting, then integrates position. Called each frame from <see cref="CubismModelNode.OnUpdate"/> before injecting face-tracking parameters. </summary>
public void Update(float deltaTimeSeconds){_userTimeSeconds+=deltaTimeSeconds;var deltaTimeWeight=(_userTimeSeconds-_lastTimeSeconds)*30f;_lastTimeSeconds=_userTimeSeconds;if(deltaTimeWeight<=0f)return;var maxV=FaceParamMaxV/30f;var maxA=deltaTimeWeight*maxV/FrameToMaxSpeed;var dx=_faceTargetX-_faceX;var dy=_faceTargetY-_faceY;var distance=MathF.Sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);if(distance<0.01f)return;var vx=maxV*dx/distance;var vy=maxV*dy/distance;var ax=vx-_faceVX;var ay=vy-_faceVY;var aLen=MathF.Sqrt(ax*ax+ay*ay);if(aLen>0f){var clampedA=MathF.Min(aLen,maxA);ax=ax*clampedA/aLen;ay=ay*clampedA/aLen;}var maxSafeV=0.5f*(MathF.Sqrt(maxA*maxA+8f*maxA*distance)-maxA);var vLen=MathF.Sqrt(_faceVX*_faceVX+_faceVY*_faceVY);if(vLen>maxSafeV&&vLen>0f){var scale=maxSafeV/vLen;_faceVX*=scale;_faceVY*=scale;}_faceVX+=ax;_faceVY+=ay;_faceX+=_faceVX;_faceY+=_faceVY;}}}

using Godot;using Cthangover.Live2D.Cubism.Framework;namespace Cthangover.Live2D.Cubism.Services{/// <summary> Configuration for <see cref="Live2DService.CreateModel(Node, Live2DModelConfig)"/>. Otherwise <see cref="FitMode.FitAuto"/> is used. </summary>
public class Live2DModelConfig{public string ModelPath;public string ModId;public string NodeName;public Vector2?Position;public Vector2?Scale;public float AnchorX=0.5f;public float AnchorY=0.5f;public FitMode ScaleFit=FitMode.FitAuto;}/// <summary> High-level factory for creating Live2D model nodes and attaching them to the scene tree. Encapsulates the boilerplate of instantiating <see cref="CubismModelNode"/>, adding to a parent, and calling <see cref="CubismModelNode.LoadModelFromMod"/>. </summary>
public static class Live2DService{/// <summary> Creates a <see cref="CubismModelNode"/>, adds it to <paramref name="parent"/>, and loads the model from the specified mod. </summary> <param name="parent">Parent node to attach the model to.</param> <param name="modelPath">Path to the .model3.json file, relative to the mod root.</param> <param name="modId">Registered mod ID containing the model assets.</param> <param name="nodeName">Godot node name for the model instance.</param> <returns>The created and loaded model node.</returns>
public static CubismModelNode CreateModel(Node parent,string modelPath,string nodeName,string modId=null){return CreateModel(parent,new Live2DModelConfig{ModelPath=modelPath,ModId=modId,NodeName=nodeName});}/// <summary> Creates a <see cref="CubismModelNode"/> using full configuration. namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> User-triggered mod operation. The screen resolves a tile's primary action via <see cref="ModActions.GetPrimary"/> and executes the kind here; the detail view maps its buttons to the same kinds. Every kind is persisted to disk immediately but only takes effect after a restart. </summary>
public enum ModActionKind{/// <summary>Download and install the selected catalog version.</summary>
Install,/// <summary>Install a newer catalog version over the local copy.</summary>
Update,/// <summary>Install an older catalog version over the local copy.</summary>
Downgrade,/// <summary>Reinstall the same version to replace locally modified files.</summary>
Reinstall,/// <summary>Delete the installed mod (user mods root only), then clean per-mod state.</summary>
Delete,/// <summary>Allow the mod to load on next start.</summary>
Enable,/// <summary>Prevent the mod from loading on next start.</summary>
Disable,}}

namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Business rules deciding which operation a mod tile offers. The tile shows a single contextual button; its meaning follows the state machine: catalog-only → Install, newer remote → Update, older remote → Downgrade, same version but edited locally → Reinstall, otherwise → Delete for deletable local mods and nothing for protected/shipped ones. </summary>
public static class ModActions{/// <summary>Primary action for a tile/detail page, or null when there is nothing to do.</summary>
public static ModActionKind?GetPrimary(ModCardData data){if(data==null)return null;if(!data.IsInstalled)return data.HasRemote?ModActionKind.Install:null;if(data.HasRemote){switch(data.Status){case ModItemStatus.UpdateAvailable:return ModActionKind.Update;case ModItemStatus.DowngradeAvailable:return ModActionKind.Downgrade;case ModItemStatus.ModifiedLocally:return ModActionKind.Reinstall;}}return data.IsDeletable?ModActionKind.Delete:null;}/// <summary>True for actions that download and install files.</summary>
public static bool IsInstall(ModActionKind kind)=>kind==ModActionKind.Install||kind==ModActionKind.Update||kind==ModActionKind.Downgrade||kind==ModActionKind.Reinstall;}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> One row of the mod manager grid: everything the tile and the detail page need to render a mod, regardless of whether it exists locally, in the online catalog, or both. The manager builds these in <see cref="ModManagerModel.Reload"/> by merging <c>ModRegistry.AllDiscoveredMods</c> with <c>CatalogService.CachedEntries</c>. <para/> <see cref="Status"/> is derived (not stored by the registry) from the local version, the selected catalog download and the local install hash — call <see cref="RecomputeStatus"/> after changing <see cref="SelectedDownload"/>, <see cref="IsDisabled"/> or the install state. </summary>
public class ModCardData{/// <summary>Stable mod id shared by the local mod and the catalog entry.</summary>
public string Id{get;set;}/// <summary>Localized display title (local manifest name or catalog locale name).</summary>
public string Title{get;set;}/// <summary>Author string from whichever source is available.</summary>
public string Author{get;set;}/// <summary>Localized description.</summary>
public string Description{get;set;}/// <summary>Installed version string, or null for catalog-only mods.</summary>
public string LocalVersion{get;set;}/// <summary>Manifest category (local) or catalog category (remote), flags combined.</summary>
public CategoryType Category{get;set;}=CategoryType.Other;/// <summary>Loaded local mod, or null when only the catalog knows this id.</summary>
public ModInfo LocalInfo{get;set;}/// <summary>Merged catalog entry, or null for local-only (development) mods.</summary>
public CatalogExportEntry Catalog{get;set;}/// <summary>True when a local copy exists (including an install done in this session).</summary>
public bool IsInstalled{get;set;}/// <summary>True when the local copy is listed in <c>disabled_mods.json</c>.</summary>
public bool IsDisabled{get;set;}/// <summary>True when <see cref="ModUninstaller"/> may delete the local copy.</summary>
public bool IsDeletable{get;set;}/// <summary>True for the mod manager itself, which cannot be disabled or deleted.</summary>
public bool IsProtected{get;set;}/// <summary>Derived tile state; see <see cref="RecomputeStatus"/>.</summary>
public ModItemStatus Status{get;set;}/// <summary>Catalog downloads, newest first (as merged by the catalog service).</summary>
public List<CatalogEntryDownload>Downloads{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Version chosen in the tile/detail combo box; defaults to the newest download.</summary>
public CatalogEntryDownload SelectedDownload{get;set;}/// <summary>True when an online catalog entry exists for this mod.</summary>
public bool HasRemote=>Catalog!=null;/// <summary> True when several catalogs publish this id with the same version and title but different content — the tile and detail page warn about it. </summary>
public bool IsConflict=>Catalog?.VariantConflict==true;/// <summary>Catalog URLs that published this variant, or null for local-only mods.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>SourceUrls=>Catalog?.SourceUrls;/// <summary>First catalog URL; used to install exactly this variant and to match cards after reload.</summary>
public string PrimarySource=>ModCatalogSource.FirstUrl(SourceUrls);/// <summary> Identity of a card across model reloads: the mod id plus the catalog variant it represents. Needed because conflicting variants share an id. </summary>
public string MatchKey=>$"{Id}|{PrimarySource ?? string.Empty}";/// <summary>True when the tile should show the enable/disable switch.</summary>
public bool CanToggleEnabled=>IsInstalled&& !IsProtected;/// <summary>Version to display next to the title: installed version or newest catalog version.</summary>
public string DisplayVersion=> !string.IsNullOrEmpty(LocalVersion)?LocalVersion:SelectedDownload?.Version??Catalog?.Version;/// <summary> Derives <see cref="Status"/> from the local and selected remote versions. Priority: not installed → disabled → version comparison → hash comparison. A missing catalog entry always yields <see cref="ModItemStatus.Installed"/> for a local copy. </summary>
public void RecomputeStatus(){if(!IsInstalled){Status=ModItemStatus.NotInstalled;return;}if(IsDisabled){Status=ModItemStatus.Disabled;return;}var remoteVersion=SelectedDownload?.Version??Catalog?.Version;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(remoteVersion)||string.IsNullOrEmpty(LocalVersion)){Status=ModItemStatus.Installed;return;}var comparison=VersionHelper.Compare(remoteVersion,LocalVersion);if(comparison>0){Status=ModItemStatus.UpdateAvailable;return;}if(comparison<0){Status=ModItemStatus.DowngradeAvailable;return;}var remoteHash=SelectedDownload?.InstallSha256;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(remoteHash)&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(LocalInfo?.InstallSha256)&& !string.Equals(LocalInfo.InstallSha256,remoteHash,System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){Status=ModItemStatus.ModifiedLocally;return;}Status=ModItemStatus.Installed;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Live filter state of the manager. Empty status/category sets mean "all", which matches Nexus-style sidebars where checkboxes only ever narrow the list. Search matches title, id and author case-insensitively. The state also owns the sort mode and the optional grouping toggle. </summary>
public class ModFilterState{/// <summary>Free-text query matched against title, id and author.</summary>
public string Search{get;set;}=string.Empty;/// <summary>Selected statuses; empty means no status restriction.</summary>
public HashSet<ModItemStatus>Statuses{get;}=new();/// <summary>Selected categories; empty means no category restriction.</summary>
public HashSet<CategoryType>Categories{get;}=new();/// <summary>Grid ordering mode.</summary>
public ModSortMode Sort{get;set;}=ModSortMode.Name;/// <summary>When true the grid renders category headers between groups.</summary>
public bool GroupByCategory{get;set;}/// <summary>Full match: search + status + category.</summary>
public bool Matches(ModCardData item)=>MatchesSearch(item)&&MatchesStatuses(item)&&MatchesCategories(item);/// <summary>Match ignoring the category set — used to compute category counts.</summary>
public bool MatchesExceptCategory(ModCardData item)=>MatchesSearch(item)&&MatchesStatuses(item);/// <summary>Match ignoring the status set — used to compute status counts.</summary>
public bool MatchesExceptStatus(ModCardData item)=>MatchesSearch(item)&&MatchesCategories(item);/// <summary>Returns matching items in the configured order.</summary>
public List<ModCardData>Apply(IEnumerable<ModCardData>source){var result=new List<ModCardData>();foreach(var item in source){if(Matches(item))result.Add(item);}result.Sort(Compare);return result;}/// <summary>Clears search, statuses and categories; keeps sort and grouping.</summary>
public void Reset(){Search=string.Empty;Statuses.Clear();Categories.Clear();}private int Compare(ModCardData a,ModCardData b){switch(Sort){case ModSortMode.Author:var byAuthor=string.Compare(a.Author,b.Author,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);return byAuthor!=0?byAuthor:CompareTitle(a,b);case ModSortMode.Status:var byStatus=ModStatusNames.SortRank(a.Status).CompareTo(ModStatusNames.SortRank(b.Status));return byStatus!=0?byStatus:CompareTitle(a,b);default:return CompareTitle(a,b);}}private static int CompareTitle(ModCardData a,ModCardData b)=>string.Compare(a.Title,b.Title,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);private bool MatchesSearch(ModCardData item){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Search))return true;var query=Search.Trim();return Contains(item.Title,query)||Contains(item.Id,query)||Contains(item.Author,query);}private bool MatchesStatuses(ModCardData item)=>Statuses.Count==0||Statuses.Contains(item.Status);private bool MatchesCategories(ModCardData item)=>Categories.Count==0||(item.Category&AsFlags())!=0;private CategoryType AsFlags(){var flags=(CategoryType)0;foreach(var category in Categories)flags|=category;return flags;}private static bool Contains(string value,string query)=> !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)&&value.Contains(query,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);}}

namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> UI-level state of a mod tile. Combines the local install state with the online catalog comparison so a single value drives the tile badge and the contextual action button. <see cref="ModifiedLocally"/> means the local content hash differs from the catalog entry of the same version — the player edited the mod and overwriting would lose their changes. </summary>
public enum ModItemStatus{/// <summary>No local copy exists; only the catalog entry is shown.</summary>
NotInstalled,/// <summary>Installed and up-to-date with the selected catalog version (or no catalog entry).</summary>
Installed,/// <summary>The catalog has a newer version than the installed one.</summary>
UpdateAvailable,/// <summary>The catalog's selected version is older than the installed one.</summary>
DowngradeAvailable,/// <summary>Same version as the catalog, but the local content hash differs.</summary>
ModifiedLocally,/// <summary>Installed but disabled by the player (<c>disabled_mods.json</c>).</summary>
Disabled,}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Godot;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Merges everything known about mods into the manager's grid model: local mods discovered by <see cref="ModRegistry"/> (with enable state and deletability) and online catalog entries from <see cref="CatalogService"/>. A mod present in both sources becomes one combined card; catalog-only mods appear as installable tiles. <para/> The model also owns the session overrides that keep the UI honest after file operations: a mod installed or deleted from the manager is not yet reflected by the registry (which is loaded once per launch), so <see cref="MarkInstalled"/> / <see cref="MarkRemoved"/> adjust the view and the restart banner tells the player when the change becomes real. </summary>
public class ModManagerModel{/// <summary>Id of the mod that renders this UI; it can never be disabled or removed.</summary>
public const string SelfModId="mod_manager";private readonly List<ModCardData>_items=new();private readonly HashSet<string>_removed=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);private readonly Dictionary<string,string>_installed=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);/// <summary>All cards, unsorted and unfiltered; rebuild with <see cref="Reload"/>.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<ModCardData>Items=>_items;/// <summary> Rebuilds the card list from the current registry, disabled store and catalog cache. Safe to call on every action completion and after a catalog refresh. </summary>
public void Reload(){_items.Clear();var disabled=DisabledModsStore.Load();var variantsById=BuildCatalogVariants();var localIds=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);var ordered=ModRegistry.Instance.GetOrderedModIds(filterDisabled:false);foreach(var id in ordered){if(_removed.Contains(id))continue;if(!ModRegistry.Instance.AllDiscoveredMods.TryGetValue(id,out var info)||info is not ModInfo modInfo)continue;localIds.Add(id);var isDisabled=disabled.Contains(id);if(variantsById.TryGetValue(id,out var variants)){foreach(var variant in variants)_items.Add(BuildLocalCard(id,modInfo,isDisabled,variant));}else{_items.Add(BuildLocalCard(id,modInfo,isDisabled,null));}}foreach(var pair in variantsById){if(localIds.Contains(pair.Key)||_removed.Contains(pair.Key))continue;foreach(var variant in pair.Value)_items.Add(BuildRemoteCard(variant));}}/// <summary>Remembers that a mod was deleted this session so it stays hidden until restart.</summary>
public void MarkRemoved(string modId){_removed.Add(modId);_installed.Remove(modId);}/// <summary>Remembers a successful install so the card shows as installed before restart.</summary>
public void MarkInstalled(string modId,string version){_removed.Remove(modId);_installed[modId]=version??string.Empty;}/// <summary> Applies an enable/disable toggle with the same cascade as the legacy menu: disabling a mod also disables its dependents, enabling one also re-enables the dependencies it needs. </summary>
public void SetEnabled(string modId,bool enabled){var disabled=DisabledModsStore.Load();if(enabled){disabled.Remove(modId);var info=ModRegistry.Instance.GetMod(modId)as ModInfo;var dependencies=info?.Manifest?.DependencyIds;if(dependencies!=null){foreach(var dependency in dependencies)disabled.Remove(dependency);}}else{disabled.Add(modId);CollectDependents(modId,disabled);}DisabledModsStore.Save(disabled);}/// <summary>Category buckets for the sidebar, respecting every filter except the category set.</summary>
public Dictionary<CategoryType,int>CountCategories(ModFilterState filter){var counts=new Dictionary<CategoryType,int>();foreach(var item in _items){if(!filter.MatchesExceptCategory(item))continue;foreach(var category in ModCategoryNames.Ordered){if((item.Category&category)==0)continue;counts[category]=counts.GetValueOrDefault(category)+1;}}return counts;}/// <summary>Status buckets for the sidebar, respecting every filter except the status set.</summary>
public Dictionary<ModItemStatus,int>CountStatuses(ModFilterState filter){var counts=new Dictionary<ModItemStatus,int>();foreach(var item in _items){if(!filter.MatchesExceptStatus(item))continue;counts[item.Status]=counts.GetValueOrDefault(item.Status)+1;}return counts;}/// <summary> Indexes catalog entries by mod id. Normally one entry per id, but a variant conflict (same id/version/title, different content across catalogs) produces several entries that the UI shows as separate mods. </summary>
private Dictionary<string,List<CatalogExportEntry>>BuildCatalogVariants(){var index=new Dictionary<string,List<CatalogExportEntry>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);var entries=CatalogService.CachedEntries;if(entries==null)return index;foreach(var entry in entries){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry?.Id))continue;if(!index.TryGetValue(entry.Id,out var list)){list=new List<CatalogExportEntry>();index[entry.Id]=list;}list.Add(entry);}return index;}private ModCardData BuildLocalCard(string id,ModInfo modInfo,bool disabled,CatalogExportEntry catalog){var data=new ModCardData{Id=id,Title=modInfo.DisplayTitle,Author=modInfo.Author,Description=modInfo.LocalizedDescription,LocalVersion=modInfo.Version,Category=modInfo.Manifest?.Category??CategoryType.Other,LocalInfo=modInfo,Catalog=catalog,IsInstalled=true,IsDisabled=disabled,IsDeletable=ModUninstaller.CanUninstall(modInfo),IsProtected=string.Equals(id,SelfModId,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase),};if(_installed.TryGetValue(id,out var installedVersion))data.LocalVersion=installedVersion;ApplyDownloads(data,catalog);data.RecomputeStatus();return data;}private ModCardData BuildRemoteCard(CatalogExportEntry catalog){var locale=GetCatalogLocale();var data=new ModCardData{Id=catalog.Id,Title=catalog.GetLocalizedName(locale),Author=catalog.Author,Description=catalog.GetLocalizedDescription(locale),Category=catalog.Category,Catalog=catalog,IsInstalled=false,};if(_installed.TryGetValue(catalog.Id,out var installedVersion)){data.IsInstalled=true;data.LocalVersion=installedVersion;}ApplyDownloads(data,catalog);data.RecomputeStatus();return data;}private static void ApplyDownloads(ModCardData data,CatalogExportEntry catalog){data.Downloads=catalog?.Downloads??new List<CatalogEntryDownload>();data.SelectedDownload=data.Downloads.Count>0?data.Downloads[0]:null;}private static string GetCatalogLocale(){var locale=TranslationServer.GetLocale();return string.IsNullOrEmpty(locale)?"en":locale;}private static void CollectDependents(string modId,HashSet<string>disabled){var allMods=ModRegistry.Instance.AllDiscoveredMods;foreach(var pair in allMods){if(disabled.Contains(pair.Key)||pair.Value is not ModInfo info)continue;var dependencies=info.Manifest?.DependencyIds;if(dependencies!=null&&dependencies.Contains(modId)){disabled.Add(pair.Key);CollectDependents(pair.Key,disabled);}}}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Read-only cross-mod lookups used by the detail page: direct dependencies, reverse dependencies (which mods depend on this one) and declared conflicts. Prefers local manifest data and falls back to the catalog entry for mods that are not installed. </summary>
public static class ModQueries{/// <summary>Dependency strings (<c>core&gt;=1</c> format) of a mod, whatever source knows it.</summary>
public static List<string>GetDependencies(ModCardData data){var manifestDeps=data?.LocalInfo?.Manifest?.DependencyIds;if(manifestDeps!=null&&manifestDeps.Count>0)return manifestDeps;return data?.Catalog?.Depends??new List<string>();}/// <summary>Ids of installed mods whose manifests depend on <paramref name="modId"/>.</summary>
public static List<string>GetDependents(string modId){var result=new List<string>();if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId))return result;var allMods=ModRegistry.Instance.AllDiscoveredMods;if(allMods==null)return result;foreach(var pair in allMods){if(pair.Key==modId||pair.Value is not ModInfo info)continue;var deps=info.Manifest?.DependencyIds;if(deps!=null&&deps.Contains(modId))result.Add(pair.Key);}return result;}/// <summary>Declared mutually exclusive mod ids (manifest first, catalog fallback).</summary>
public static List<string>GetConflicts(ModCardData data){var manifestConflicts=data?.LocalInfo?.Manifest?.ConflictsWith;if(manifestConflicts!=null&&manifestConflicts.Count>0)return manifestConflicts;return data?.Catalog?.ConflictsWith??new List<string>();}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Dependency graph of one <see cref="ModCollectionGraph"/> rendered with <c>GraphEdit</c>. Nodes are mods, arrows point from a dependency to the mod that needs it, and every mechanic gets its own <c>GraphFrame</c> whose title is the mechanic name — the collection is never shown as a flat list, the grouping is what tells the player which layer of the game each mod implements. <para/> The view is read-only: connections cannot be dragged, node positions are assigned deterministically (mechanics top-to-bottom, mods in rows of four) so the same collection always lays out the same way. Node colors follow <see cref="CollectionStateNames"/>; clicking a node reports it through <see cref="NodeSelected"/> and the screen fills the details panel, clicking empty space clears the selection. </summary>
public partial class CollectionGraphView:Control{private const float OriginX=40f;private const float OriginY=40f;private const float NodeWidth=240f;private const float NodeHeight=110f;private const float NodeGapX=40f;private const float RowGapY=40f;private const float FramePaddingX=30f;private const float FrameHeaderHeight=48f;private const int NodesPerRow=4;private GraphEdit _graph;private readonly Dictionary<string,ModCollectionNode>_nodesByGraphName=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);/// <summary>Raised when the player clicks a mod node; the payload is the resolved graph node.</summary>
public event Action<ModCollectionNode>NodeSelected;/// <summary>Raised when the selection is cleared by clicking empty space.</summary>
public event Action SelectionCleared;/// <summary>Rebuilds the whole graph for the given resolved collection.</summary>
public void Populate(ModCollectionGraph graph){EnsureGraph();Clear();if(graph==null)return;var cursorY=OriginY;foreach(var mechanic in graph.Mechanics){var members=CollectMembers(graph,mechanic.Id);if(members.Count==0)continue;var title=string.IsNullOrEmpty(mechanic.Name)?mechanic.Id:mechanic.Name;if(mechanic.Optional)title+=" · "+TranslationServer.Translate("mod_manager/collection_optional");cursorY=AddFrame(title,members,cursorY);}var external=CollectExternal(graph);if(external.Count>0)AddFrame(TranslationServer.Translate("mod_manager/collection_externals"),external,cursorY);ConnectEdges(graph);}/// <summary>Removes all frames, nodes and connections.</summary>
public void Clear(){if(_graph==null)return;_graph.ClearConnections();foreach(var child in _graph.GetChildren()){if(child is GraphElement element){_graph.RemoveChild(element);element.QueueFree();}}_nodesByGraphName.Clear();}private void EnsureGraph(){if(_graph!=null&&GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(_graph))return;_graph=GetNode<GraphEdit>("Graph");_graph.RightDisconnects=false;_graph.MinimapEnabled=true;_graph.ShowGrid=true;_graph.SnappingEnabled=true;_graph.SnappingDistance=20;_graph.ConnectionLinesThickness=2f;_graph.ConnectionLinesAntialiased=true;_graph.NodeSelected+=OnGraphNodeSelected;_graph.NodeDeselected+=OnGraphNodeDeselected;}/// <summary> Lays out one mechanic as a frame with its mods in rows of four and returns the Y coordinate below the frame. The frame autoshrinks around the attached nodes, so only the vertical cursor is computed here. </summary>
private float AddFrame(string title,List<ModCollectionNode>members,float cursorY){var frame=new GraphFrame{Title=title,AutoshrinkEnabled=true,AutoshrinkMargin=24,};_graph.AddChild(frame);frame.PositionOffset=new Vector2(OriginX,cursorY);var x=OriginX+FramePaddingX;var y=cursorY+FrameHeaderHeight;var inRow=0;foreach(var member in members){var node=CreateNode(member);_graph.AddChild(node);node.PositionOffset=new Vector2(x,y);_graph.AttachGraphElementToFrame(node.Name,frame.Name);_nodesByGraphName[member.ModId]=member;inRow++;if(inRow>=NodesPerRow){inRow=0;x=OriginX+FramePaddingX;y+=NodeHeight+RowGapY;}else{x+=NodeWidth+NodeGapX;}}return y+NodeHeight+RowGapY+24f;}private static GraphNode CreateNode(ModCollectionNode data){var graphNode=new GraphNode{Name=data.ModId,Title=string.IsNullOrEmpty(data.Title)?data.ModId:data.Title,Size=new Vector2(NodeWidth,NodeHeight),};graphNode.AddChild(new Label{Text=BuildSubtitle(data),AutowrapMode=TextServer.AutowrapMode.WordSmart,CustomMinimumSize=new Vector2(NodeWidth-24,0),});var color=CollectionStateNames.Color(data.State);var titlebar=UiKit.Frame(UiTokens.RadiusMd,UiTokens.Alpha(color,0.3f));titlebar.CornerRadiusBottomLeft=0;titlebar.CornerRadiusBottomRight=0;graphNode.AddThemeStyleboxOverride("titlebar",titlebar);graphNode.SetSlot(0,true,0,UiTokens.White,true,0,color);graphNode.TooltipText=$"{graphNode.Title}\n{data.ModId}";return graphNode;}private static string BuildSubtitle(ModCollectionNode data){var lines=new List<string>();if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(data.InstalledVersion))lines.Add($"v{data.InstalledVersion}");if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(data.RequiredVersion))lines.Add(data.RequiredVersion);lines.Add(CollectionStateNames.Translate(data.State));return string.Join("\n",lines);}private void ConnectEdges(ModCollectionGraph graph){foreach(var edge in graph.Edges){if(!_nodesByGraphName.TryGetValue(edge.FromModId,out var from)|| !_nodesByGraphName.TryGetValue(edge.ToModId,out var to)){continue;}if(string.Equals(from.ModId,to.ModId,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;_graph.ConnectNode(from.ModId,0,to.ModId,0);}}private static List<ModCollectionNode>CollectMembers(ModCollectionGraph graph,string mechanicId){var result=new List<ModCollectionNode>();foreach(var node in graph.Nodes){if(string.Equals(node.MechanicId,mechanicId,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))result.Add(node);}return result;}private static List<ModCollectionNode>CollectExternal(ModCollectionGraph graph){var result=new List<ModCollectionNode>();foreach(var node in graph.Nodes){if(node.IsExternal)result.Add(node);}return result;}private void OnGraphNodeSelected(Node node){if(node is not GraphNode graphNode)return;if(_nodesByGraphName.TryGetValue(graphNode.Name.ToString(),out var data))NodeSelected?.Invoke(data);}private void OnGraphNodeDeselected(Node node){SelectionCleared?.Invoke();}}}

using System;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Nexus-style mod tile. The layout lives in <c>scenes/components/mod_card.tscn</c> so it can be edited in the Godot editor; this script only binds data and reacts to input. It exposes a cover image, title (always two lines tall), author, catalog source, status badge, version combo box, a single contextual action button and an enable/disable switch. <para/> All rows are reserved to the same height on purpose: tiles in the grid must look identical regardless of whether a mod has a catalog entry, versions, an author or an action. Version selection mutates the shared <see cref="ModCardData.SelectedDownload"/> and refreshes the tile in place, so changing versions never rebuilds the grid or loses scroll position. </summary>

public void The panel does not own the state and never rebuilds the grid itself — it announces every change through <see cref="Changed"/>. </summary>
public partial class ModFilterPanel:VBoxContainer{private ModFilterState _state;private Label _title;private Button _reset;private Label _statusCaption;private Label _categoryCaption;private CheckButton _groupToggle;private VBoxContainer _statusList;private VBoxContainer _categoryList;private readonly Dictionary<ModItemStatus,CheckBox>_statusBoxes=new();private readonly Dictionary<CategoryType,CheckBox>_categoryBoxes=new();/// <summary>Raised after any filter or grouping change.</summary>

public void Bind(ModFilterState state){_state=state;_title=GetNode<Label>("Title");_reset=GetNode<Button>("Reset");_statusCaption=GetNode<Label>("StatusCaption");_categoryCaption=GetNode<Label>("CategoryCaption");_groupToggle=GetNode<CheckButton>("GroupToggle");_statusList=GetNode<VBoxContainer>("StatusList");_categoryList=GetNode<VBoxContainer>("CategoryList");_title.Text=TranslationServer.Translate("mod_manager/filters");_reset.Text=TranslationServer.Translate("mod_manager/reset_filters");_statusCaption.Text=TranslationServer.Translate("mod_manager/filter_status");_categoryCaption.Text=TranslationServer.Translate("mod_manager/filter_categories");_groupToggle.Text=TranslationServer.Translate("mod_manager/group_by_category");_groupToggle.ButtonPressed=_state.GroupByCategory;_statusCaption.AddThemeColorOverride("font_color",UiTokens.Muted);_categoryCaption.AddThemeColorOverride("font_color",UiTokens.Muted);_reset.Pressed+=OnResetPressed;_groupToggle.Toggled+=OnGroupToggled;foreach(var status in Enum.GetValues<ModItemStatus>())AddStatusCheck(status);foreach(var category in ModCategoryNames.Ordered)AddCategoryCheck(category);}/// <summary>Refreshes the numbers in the checkbox captions.</summary>
public void RefreshCounts(Dictionary<CategoryType,int>categoryCounts,Dictionary<ModItemStatus,int>statusCounts){foreach(var pair in _statusBoxes){var count=statusCounts.GetValueOrDefault(pair.Key);pair.Value.Text=$"{ModStatusNames.Translate(pair.Key)} ({count})";}foreach(var pair in _categoryBoxes){var count=categoryCounts.GetValueOrDefault(pair.Key);pair.Value.Text=$"{ModCategoryNames.Translate(pair.Key)} ({count})";}}private void AddStatusCheck(ModItemStatus status){var box=new CheckBox{Text=ModStatusNames.Translate(status),ButtonPressed=_state.Statuses.Contains(status),};box.Toggled+=pressed=>OnStatusToggled(status,pressed);_statusBoxes[status]=box;_statusList.AddChild(box);}private void AddCategoryCheck(CategoryType category){var box=new CheckBox{Text=ModCategoryNames.Translate(category),ButtonPressed=_state.Categories.Contains(category),};box.Toggled+=pressed=>OnCategoryToggled(category,pressed);_categoryBoxes[category]=box;_categoryList.AddChild(box);}private void OnStatusToggled(ModItemStatus status,bool pressed){if(pressed)_state.Statuses.Add(status);else _state.Statuses.Remove(status);Changed?.Invoke();}private void OnCategoryToggled(CategoryType category,bool pressed){if(pressed)_state.Categories.Add(category);else _state.Categories.Remove(category);Changed?.Invoke();}private void OnGroupToggled(bool pressed){_state.GroupByCategory=pressed;Changed?.Invoke();}private void OnResetPressed(){_state.Reset();foreach(var box in _statusBoxes.Values)box.SetPressedNoSignal(false);foreach(var box in _categoryBoxes.Values)box.SetPressedNoSignal(false);ResetRequested?.Invoke();Changed?.Invoke();}}}

Cards flow inside <see cref="HFlowContainer"/>s, so the number of columns adapts to the viewport width — the Godot answer to Nexus's responsive auto-fill grid. In grouping mode one section per category is created with a header; in flat mode a single header-less section is used. </summary>
public partial class ModGridView:ScrollContainer{private const string GroupScene="scenes/components/mod_grid_group.tscn";private const string CardScene="scenes/components/mod_card.tscn";private VBoxContainer _host;/// <summary>Raised when a card body is clicked.</summary>

public void SetItems(IReadOnlyList<ModCardData>items,bool groupByCategory){if(_host==null)_host=GetNode<VBoxContainer>("Host");foreach(var child in _host.GetChildren())child.QueueFree();if(items==null||items.Count==0){_host.AddChild(BuildEmptyLabel());return;}if(!groupByCategory){FillGroup(AddGroup(null),items);return;}foreach(var category in ModCategoryNames.Ordered){var group=new List<ModCardData>();foreach(var item in items){if(ModCategoryNames.Primary(item.Category)==category)group.Add(item);}if(group.Count==0)continue;var header=$"{ModCategoryNames.Translate(category)}  ·  {group.Count}";FillGroup(AddGroup(header),group);}}private ModGridGroup AddGroup(string header){var group=TscnScenes.LoadAndBuild(GroupScene)as ModGridGroup;if(group==null){GameLogger.Log("MOD_MANAGER",$"Grid: failed to build '{GroupScene}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}group.SetHeader(header);_host.AddChild(group);return group;}private void FillGroup(ModGridGroup group,IReadOnlyList<ModCardData>items){if(group==null)return;foreach(var data in items){var card=TscnScenes.LoadAndBuild(CardScene)as ModCard;if(card==null){GameLogger.Log("MOD_MANAGER",$"Grid: failed to build '{CardScene}'",LogLevel.Error);continue;}group.Flow.AddChild(card);card.Clicked+=OnCardClicked;card.ActionPressed+=OnCardActionPressed;card.EnabledToggled+=OnCardEnabledToggled;card.VersionChanged+=OnCardVersionChanged;card.Init(data);}}private static Label BuildEmptyLabel(){return UiKit.EmptyState(TranslationServer.Translate("mod_manager/no_results"));}private void OnCardClicked(ModCardData data)=>CardClicked?.Invoke(data);private void OnCardActionPressed(ModCardData data)=>ActionPressed?.Invoke(data);private void OnCardEnabledToggled(ModCardData data)=>EnabledToggled?.Invoke(data);private void OnCardVersionChanged(ModCardData data)=>VersionChanged?.Invoke(data);}}

Public names are preserved so existing widgets keep compiling, but each one is an alias or a thin wrapper around the core theming API. using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Presentation helpers for catalog provenance. The manager shows where a mod comes from without cluttering the tile: a short host label plus the full URL list in the tooltip, and a "+N" marker when several catalogs publish the same build. </summary>
public static class ModCatalogSource{/// <summary>First source URL, or null when there are none.</summary>
public static string FirstUrl(IReadOnlyList<string>urls)=>urls!=null&&urls.Count>0?urls[0]:null;/// <summary>Host of a URL (fallback: the raw string when it does not parse).</summary>
public static string Host(string url){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url))return null;if(Uri.TryCreate(url,UriKind.Absolute,out var uri)&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(uri.Host))return uri.Host;return url;}/// <summary>Short label: host plus "+N" for extra catalogs, or null when unknown.</summary>
public static string Label(IReadOnlyList<string>urls){var first=FirstUrl(urls);if(first==null)return null;var host=Host(first);var extra=urls.Count-1;return extra>0?$"{host} +{extra}":host;}/// <summary>Newline-joined full URL list for tooltips.</summary>
public static string Tooltip(IReadOnlyList<string>urls)=>urls==null||urls.Count==0?null:string.Join("\n",urls);}}

using System;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Caches;using Godot;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Loads preview images for mod tiles and the detail page. Local mods use their bundled <c>mod.png</c> / <c>mod.jpg</c>; catalog-only mods fall back to <see cref="ModIconCache"/>, which downloads and caches the entry's <c>icon_url</c> under <c>user://mod_cache/icons</c>. Returning null is a normal outcome — the card then keeps its flat placeholder. </summary>
public static class ModPreviewLoader{/// <summary>Reads the mod's bundled preview image, or null when absent/unreadable.</summary>
public static Texture2D LoadLocal(ModInfo info){var provider=info?.FileProvider;if(provider==null)return null;byte[]data=null;if(provider.FileExists("mod.png"))data=provider.ReadFileBinary("mod.png");else if(provider.FileExists("mod.jpg"))data=provider.ReadFileBinary("mod.jpg");if(data==null||data.Length==0)return null;var image=new Image();Error error;if(data[0]==0x89)error=image.LoadPngFromBuffer(data);else if(data[0]==0xFF)error=image.LoadJpgFromBuffer(data);else return null;if(error!=Error.Ok){image.Dispose();return null;}var texture=ImageTexture.CreateFromImage(image);image.Dispose();return texture;}/// <summary> Asynchronously resolves a catalog icon; the callback may fire later (network) or immediately (memory/disk cache). </summary>
public static void LoadRemote(string modId,string iconUrl,Action<Texture2D>onLoaded){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(iconUrl))return;ModIconCache.GetOrDownload(modId,iconUrl,onLoaded);}}}

===== FILE mods/recruiting/src/DefeatedCharactersRecruiter.cs =====
using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Turns a <see cref="CharactersDefeatedEvent"/> into recruit attempts. The recruiting mod subscribes to the core-neutral event, so the system that defeated the characters (battle, trap, script) does not know about recruiting — and recruiting does not depend on any combat mod. This replaces the old hardcoded call inside the victory screen. <para/> For every reported id the character template is resolved through <see cref="CharacterFactory"/> (the battle copy and the template share <c>RecruitmentChance</c>), checked against the condition gate (<see cref="RecruitBehaviourRegistry.CanRecruit"/>), rolled 1–100 and, on success, added to the roster. The roll is skipped entirely when no conditions are registered or the chance is zero, matching the old flow. </summary>
public static class DefeatedCharactersRecruiter{/// <summary>Event-bus handler; safe to call with a null or empty payload.</summary>
public static void Process(CharactersDefeatedEvent evt){if(evt?.CharacterIds==null)return;var runtime=GameData.Instance?.Runtime;if(runtime==null)return;var registry=RecruitBehaviourRegistry.Instance;foreach(var id in evt.CharacterIds){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))continue;var enemy=CharacterFactory.Instance.Get(id);if(enemy==null||enemy.RecruitmentChance<=0)continue;if(!registry.CanRecruit(enemy,runtime))continue;if(System.Random.Shared.Next(1,101)>enemy.RecruitmentChance)continue;RecruitingData.Instance.Add(enemy.ID,enemy.ID);GameLogger.Log("RECRUIT",$"Recruited '{enemy.ID}' after '{evt.Source}' defeat",LogLevel.Message);}}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Relationship;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Recruitment condition that gates the "enslave" recruit option behind the <c>slave_master</c> skill. When the player attempts to recruit an NPC, the recruitment system queries all registered <see cref="IRecruitCondition"/> implementations; if this condition is present and the player does not have the skill, the enslavement option is hidden or disabled. </summary>
public class EnslaveCondition:IRecruitCondition{/// <summary> Identifies this condition as the enslavement gate for the recruitment system (maps to <c>enslave</c> option). </summary>
public string Id=>"enslave";/// <summary> Determines whether enslavement is available for the given enemy. Checks the runtime skill data for the <c>slave_master</c> skill. The target <paramref name="enemy"/> is provided but not inspected because the condition depends solely on the player's skills. </summary>
public bool CanRecruit(Character enemy,RuntimeData runtime){return runtime.SkillData.HasSkill("slave_master");}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Per-recruit behaviour plugin discovered via reflection from mod assemblies. Each implementation is registered into <see cref="RecruitBehaviourRegistry"/> by <see cref="Mods.ModAssemblyLoader.RegisterAssembly"/> and then invoked for <b>every</b> active recruit — not just those from the owning mod — during tick, configure, and removal lifecycle events. This cross-recruit dispatch pattern is intentional: a behaviour might want to introspect all recruits (e.g. a "rivalry" system that checks for conflicting personalities), so the registry passes the full recruit list to every behaviour rather than filtering by ownership. </summary>
public interface IRecruitBehaviour{/// <summary>Unique identifier for lookup via <c>RecruitBehaviourRegistry.Get</c>.</summary>
string Id{get;}/// <summary> Called once when a recruit is added to the party (via <c>RecruitingData.Add</c>). Use for initial stat setup, buff application, or spawning companion nodes. </summary>
void ConfigureRecruit(Recruit recruit,RuntimeData runtime);/// <summary> Called every game tick for each active recruit. The <paramref name="currentTick"/> value is the global <c>RuntimeData.Time.Tick</c> counter — use it for cooldown-based or periodic logic rather than maintaining a private timer. </summary>
void OnTick(Recruit recruit,RuntimeData runtime,long currentTick);/// <summary> Called when a recruit is removed from the party (via <c>RecruitingData.Remove</c>). Clean up any persisted state, buffs, or companion nodes. </summary>
void OnRemove(Recruit recruit,RuntimeData runtime);}}

using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Gating predicate for the recruit system. Implementations are auto-discovered from mod assemblies by <see cref="RecruitBehaviourRegistry.RegisterAssembly"/> and evaluated conjunctively — <b>all</b> conditions must return <c>true</c> for recruitment to succeed. string Id{get;}/// <summary> Returns <c>true</c> if the given <paramref name="enemy"/> can be recruited under current game state. Called from <c>RecruitBehaviourRegistry.CanRecruit</c> as part of a conjunctive gate — a single <c>false</c> blocks recruitment. </summary>

using Cthangover.Core.Relationship;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Tracks nutrition and starvation for party recruits. Works by recording the tick when a recruit last ate (<c>FullnessTime</c>), then each tick computes the elapsed time as a percentage of a 24-hour window. Once the fullness window expires (100%+), the recruit loses 1 HP per tick until fed again via a ration or meal action. Registered with the <see cref="Recruit"/> behaviour pipeline and called by the time system on each global tick. </summary>
public class NutritionBehaviour:IRecruitBehaviour{/// <summary> Unique behaviour identifier used to look up and configure this behaviour from <see cref="Recruit"/>'s behaviour collection. </summary>
public string Id=>"nutrition";/// <summary> Called when the behaviour is first attached to a recruit. Seeds <c>FullnessTime</c> with the current global tick so that starve-damage begins counting from this point. </summary>
public void ConfigureRecruit(Recruit recruit,RuntimeData runtime){recruit.Properties.SetLong("FullnessTime",runtime.Time.Tick);}/// <summary> Evaluates whether the recruit has gone beyond the fullness window (24 in-game hours, represented as <c>24 * 4 * 60</c> ticks) since <c>FullnessTime</c>. If the window is exceeded, reduces the recruit's <c>PROP_HEALTH</c> by 1 per tick until they are fed. Tick-driven starvation allows gradual death when rations run out. </summary>
public void OnTick(Recruit recruit,RuntimeData runtime,long currentTick){var fullnessTime=recruit.Properties.GetLong("FullnessTime");if(fullnessTime==0)return;var windowSize=24*4*60L;var deltaTime=currentTick-fullnessTime;var fullness=(float)deltaTime/windowSize*100f;if(fullness>100){var hp=recruit.Properties.GetInt(Recruit.PROP_HEALTH);if(hp>0)recruit.Properties.SetInt(Recruit.PROP_HEALTH,hp-1);}}/// <summary> Cleanup hook invoked when the behaviour is detached from a recruit. No persistent state requires teardown; exists for interface contract. </summary>
public void OnRemove(Recruit recruit,RuntimeData runtime){}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Central registry and lifecycle dispatcher for recruit behaviours and conditions. Behaviours (<see cref="IRecruitBehaviour"/>) and conditions (<see cref="IRecruitCondition"/>) are auto-discovered from mod assemblies by <c>RecruitingInitializer</c>, which rescans assemblies as mods announce themselves and does a full AppDomain pass at resources-ready — the core's ModAssemblyLoader contains no recruiting knowledge. <b>Condition gating</b> — <see cref="CanRecruit"/> evaluates every registered condition conjunctively (logical AND), so a single <c>false</c> blocks recruitment. This allows mods to compose recruitment gates without coordination. <b>Id-based deduplication</b> — a rescan replaces any earlier implementation with the same <c>Id</c>, so mod reloads (which re-run registration) do not double-dispatch notifications. <b>Tick registration</b> — the first call to any lifecycle method triggers <see cref="RecruitTickController.EnsureRegistered"/>, which registers for the scene's timer event. This avoids paying the tick overhead unless at least one behaviour is active. <b>Singleton</b> — accessed via the static <c>Instance</c> field rather than a <c>Lazy&lt;T&gt;</c> wrapper because Godot reflection-based discovery must tolerate partial-initialisation scenarios where <c>Lazy</c>'s thread-safety check could deadlock. </summary>
public class RecruitBehaviourRegistry{/// <summary>Eagerly-initialised singleton for reflection-safe access.</summary>
public static readonly RecruitBehaviourRegistry Instance=new();private readonly List<IRecruitBehaviour>_behaviours=new();private readonly List<IRecruitCondition>_conditions=new();private readonly RecruitTickController _tickController=new();private void EnsureTickRegistered(){_tickController.EnsureRegistered();}/// <summary> Scans an assembly for implementations of <see cref="IRecruitBehaviour"/> and <see cref="IRecruitCondition"/>, instantiates them via the parameterless constructor, and registers them by Id. Called by <c>RecruitingInitializer</c> as mods load. </summary>
public void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly){foreach(var behaviour in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IRecruitBehaviour>(assembly))RegisterBehaviour(behaviour);foreach(var condition in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IRecruitCondition>(assembly))RegisterCondition(condition);}/// <summary> Scans every assembly loaded in the current <see cref="System.AppDomain"/> and registers all behaviours and conditions. Serves as the resources-ready safety net for assemblies whose name differs from the mod id (precompiled DLLs). </summary>
public void RegisterAll(){foreach(var behaviour in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IRecruitBehaviour>())RegisterBehaviour(behaviour);foreach(var condition in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IRecruitCondition>())RegisterCondition(condition);GameLogger.Log("RECRUIT",$"RecruitBehaviourRegistry.RegisterAll: {_behaviours.Count} behaviour(s), {_conditions.Count} condition(s)");}private void RegisterBehaviour(IRecruitBehaviour behaviour){if(behaviour==null)return;_behaviours.RemoveAll(existing=>existing.Id==behaviour.Id);_behaviours.Add(behaviour);}private void RegisterCondition(IRecruitCondition condition){if(condition==null)return;_conditions.RemoveAll(existing=>existing.Id==condition.Id);_conditions.Add(condition);}/// <summary> Conjunctive gate: returns <c>true</c> only if every registered <see cref="IRecruitCondition"/> returns <c>true</c> for the given enemy and runtime state. </summary>
public bool CanRecruit(Character enemy,RuntimeData runtime){return _conditions.All(c=>c.CanRecruit(enemy,runtime));}/// <summary> Looks up a behaviour by its <c>Id</c> (linear scan — behaviour lists are small enough that a dictionary is unnecessary). Returns <c>null</c> if not found. </summary>
public IRecruitBehaviour Get(string id){return _behaviours.Find(b=>b.Id==id);}/// <summary>Returns all registered behaviours for external enumeration.</summary>
public IEnumerable<IRecruitBehaviour>All(){return _behaviours;}/// <summary> Dispatches <see cref="IRecruitBehaviour.OnTick"/> to every behaviour for every active recruit. Ensures tick registration on first call via lazy init. </summary>
public void OnTick(){EnsureTickRegistered();var runtime=GameData.Instance.Runtime;if(runtime==null)return;var recruits=RecruitingData.Instance.Data;foreach(var behaviour in _behaviours){foreach(var recruit in recruits){behaviour.OnTick(recruit,runtime,runtime.Time.Tick);}}}/// <summary> Dispatches <see cref="IRecruitBehaviour.ConfigureRecruit"/> to every behaviour for the newly-added <paramref name="recruit"/>. </summary>
public void OnConfigure(Recruit recruit){EnsureTickRegistered();var runtime=GameData.Instance.Runtime;if(runtime==null)return;foreach(var behaviour in _behaviours)behaviour.ConfigureRecruit(recruit,runtime);}/// <summary> Dispatches <see cref="IRecruitBehaviour.OnRemove"/> to every behaviour for the departing <paramref name="recruit"/>. </summary>
public void OnRemove(Recruit recruit){EnsureTickRegistered();var runtime=GameData.Instance.Runtime;if(runtime==null)return;foreach(var behaviour in _behaviours)behaviour.OnRemove(recruit,runtime);}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Lazy bridge between the scene timer system and the recruit behaviour tick loop. Implements <see cref="IOnTimeEvent"/> so it can be registered with <see cref="SceneEventController"/> via <c>AddTimerTickEventListener</c>. Registration is lazy (<see cref="EnsureRegistered"/> is a no-op after the first call) because the recruit system should not force the timer subsystem to activate if no behaviours are actually loaded. The first behaviour lifecycle method in <see cref="RecruitBehaviourRegistry"/> calls <c>EnsureRegistered</c>, which finds the scene's <c>EventController</c> node and subscribes. <c>Priority = 0</c> so recruit ticks fire at a neutral point in the timer event chain — before or after other listeners as determined by their relative priorities. </summary>
public class RecruitTickController:IOnTimeEvent{/// <summary>Neutral priority — doesn't preempt or follow any specific listener.</summary>
public int Priority=>0;private bool _registered;/// <summary> Finds the scene's <c>EventController</c> node and subscribes this controller as a timer-tick listener. Idempotent — subsequent calls do nothing. </summary>
public void EnsureRegistered(){if(_registered)return;var eventController=SceneContextNode.FindNode<SceneEventController>("EventController");if(eventController==null)return;eventController.AddTimerTickEventListener(this);_registered=true;}/// <summary> Called by <see cref="SceneEventController"/> on every timer tick. Delegates to <see cref="RecruitBehaviourRegistry.OnTick"/>. </summary>
public void OnTimerTick(){RecruitBehaviourRegistry.Instance.OnTick();}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Container and factory for the party's recruit roster. The roster is owned by the recruiting mod through the static <see cref="Instance"/> instead of living in the core <c>RuntimeData</c>, so the core knows nothing about recruiting. Persistence is handled by the mod's <c>RecruitingSaveable</c> (<c>IModSaveable</c>), and a new game clears the roster through the <c>NewGameStartedEvent</c> subscription in <c>RecruitingInitializer</c>. <para/> Provides ID-based lookup, duplicate-safe addition (auto-generates a unique <c>Guid</c> if the requested ID collides), and removal that notifies <see cref="RecruitBehaviourRegistry"/> so behaviours can clean up. <see cref="Add"/> initialises the recruit's <c>Properties</c> with a default health of 10 via <see cref="Recruit.PROP_HEALTH"/> and immediately calls <c>RecruitBehaviourRegistry.OnConfigure</c>, giving every registered behaviour a chance to set up per-recruit state before the next tick fires. </summary>
public class RecruitingData{/// <summary> Session-wide roster. There is exactly one roster per playthrough — starting a new game clears it, loading a save replaces its contents. </summary>
public static readonly RecruitingData Instance=new();/// <summary>The current recruit roster.</summary>
public List<Recruit>Data{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>True if a recruit with the given ID exists in the roster.</summary>
public bool HasID(string id){return GetByID(id)!=null;}/// <summary>Returns the recruit with the given ID, or null if not found.</summary>
public Recruit GetByID(string id){foreach(var item in Data){if(item.ID==id)return item;}return null;}/// <summary> Generates a unique ID: if <paramref name="id"/> is free, returns it unchanged; otherwise appends a <c>Guid</c> suffix. Loops until an unused ID is found (guaranteed because Guid is unique enough for any practical roster size). </summary>
private string GenID(string id){for(;;){if(!HasID(id))return id;id=Guid.NewGuid().ToString();}}/// <summary> Creates a new <see cref="Recruit"/> from the given <paramref name="characterID"/>, assigns a unique instance ID, initialises default health, appends to the roster, and fires <c>RecruitBehaviourRegistry.OnConfigure</c> so behaviours can set up per-recruit state. </summary>
public Recruit Add(string id,string characterID){var data=new Recruit{ID=GenID(id),CharacterID=characterID,};data.Properties.SetInt(Recruit.PROP_HEALTH,10);Data.Add(data);RecruitBehaviourRegistry.Instance.OnConfigure(data);return data;}/// <summary> Removes the recruit with the given ID from the roster. Notifies <see cref="RecruitBehaviourRegistry.OnRemove"/> before deleting the entry so behaviours can persist state or clean up companion nodes. </summary>
public void Remove(string id){for(int i=Data.Count-1;i>=0;i--){if(Data[i].ID==id){RecruitBehaviourRegistry.Instance.OnRemove(Data[i]);Data.RemoveAt(i);return;}}}}}

using System;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Lifecycle entry point of the recruiting mod. The core's ModAssemblyLoader no longer knows about recruit behaviours, so this initializer takes over: <list type="number"> <item>Every mod announcement triggers a scan of that mod's assembly for <see cref="IRecruitBehaviour"/> and <see cref="IRecruitCondition"/> implementations (the compiler names source-compiled assemblies after their mod id).</item> <item>The resources-ready pass rescans the whole AppDomain as a safety net for precompiled DLLs whose assembly name differs from the mod id.</item> <item>It subscribes to <see cref="CharactersDefeatedEvent"/> and routes it into <see cref="DefeatedCharactersRecruiter"/> — the publisher (battle, trap, script) stays unaware of recruiting, so the whole system can be disabled by removing this mod.</item> <item>It also subscribes to <see cref="NewGameStartedEvent"/> and clears the roster — the core used to discard it implicitly with RuntimeData, but the roster now lives in <see cref="RecruitingData.Instance"/> and must be reset explicitly on "New Game".</item> </list> Persistence is not handled here: <see cref="RecruitingSaveable"/> is an <c>IModSaveable</c> and is discovered by ModSaveableRegistry automatically. </summary>
public class RecruitingInitializer:IModInitializer{private static bool _newGameSubscribed;private static bool _defeatedSubscribed;/// <summary>Registers behaviours and conditions from the mod that just announced itself.</summary>
public void OnModLoaded(string modId){RegisterAssembly(FindAssembly(modId));}/// <summary>Installs the event subscriptions and rescans every loaded assembly.</summary>
public void OnModResourcesReady(){EnsureNewGameReset();EnsureDefeatedSubscription();RecruitBehaviourRegistry.Instance.RegisterAll();}private static void EnsureNewGameReset(){if(_newGameSubscribed)return;_newGameSubscribed=true;ModEventBus.Subscribe<NewGameStartedEvent>(OnNewGameStarted);}private static void EnsureDefeatedSubscription(){if(_defeatedSubscribed)return;_defeatedSubscribed=true;ModEventBus.Subscribe<CharactersDefeatedEvent>(DefeatedCharactersRecruiter.Process);}private static void OnNewGameStarted(NewGameStartedEvent evt){RecruitingData.Instance.Data.Clear();}private static void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly){if(assembly==null)return;RecruitBehaviourRegistry.Instance.RegisterAssembly(assembly);}private static Assembly FindAssembly(string modId){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId))return null;return AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies().FirstOrDefault(assembly=>assembly.GetName().Name==modId);}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Persists the recruit roster in the mod's own save slot. The core save used to carry a <c>"Recruits"</c> blob inside the <c>__core__</c> slot, but the roster now belongs to the recruiting mod — so it saves through the generic <see cref="IModSaveable"/> contract under the mod id <c>recruiting</c>. <para/> <see cref="OnLoad"/> replaces the roster wholesale and does not re-fire <c>ConfigureRecruit</c>: persisted per-recruit properties (for example the nutrition timer) are already in the blob and behaviours continue their tick logic from the restored state, matching the old core behaviour. Backward compatibility with the old core blob is intentionally not provided — old saves start with an empty roster. </summary>
public class RecruitingSaveable:IModSaveable{private const string BlobKey="Recruits";/// <summary>Writes the session roster into the mod slot.</summary>
public void OnSave(ModSlot slot){slot.Data[BlobKey]=new DataBlob(1,RecruitingData.Instance.Data);}/// <summary>Restores the roster from the mod slot; an absent blob yields an empty roster.</summary>
public bool OnLoad(ModSlot slot,out string errorMessage){errorMessage=null;var data=new List<Recruit>();if(slot?.Data!=null&&slot.Data.TryGetValue(BlobKey,out var blob))data=blob.ReadJson<List<Recruit>>()??new List<Recruit>();RecruitingData.Instance.Data=data;return true;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Tools.InteractiveEditor{/// <summary> Data model for the interactive editor. Holds interactive definition fields, manages collider vertex list for polygon editing, and produces the output JSON. </summary>
public class InteractiveEditorController{/// <summary>Unique identifier for the interactive object resource.</summary>
public string Id{get;set;}="new_interactive";/// <summary>Texture key mapped to a sprite resource by the resource system.</summary>
public string Texture{get;set;}="";/// <summary>Render layer: <c>"foreground"</c>, <c>"background"</c>, or <c>"ui"</c>.</summary>
public string Layer{get;set;}="foreground";/// <summary>Z-index for draw order within the layer.</summary>
public int ZIndex{get;set;}/// <summary>Whether the interactive is initially enabled.</summary>
public bool Enabled{get;set;}=true;/// <summary>Whether the interactive is visible.</summary>
public bool Visible{get;set;}=true;/// <summary>Mouse cursor override name, e.g. <c>"PointingHand"</c>. Empty for default.</summary>
public string Cursor{get;set;}="";/// <summary>Collider shape type: <c>"rect"</c>, <c>"circle"</c>, or <c>"polygon"</c>.</summary>
public string HitType{get;set;}="rect";/// <summary>Normalised X position of the rect collider (0–1).</summary>
public float RectX{get;set;}/// <summary>Normalised Y position of the rect collider (0–1).</summary>
public float RectY{get;set;}/// <summary>Normalised width of the rect collider (0–1).</summary>
public float RectW{get;set;}=0.1f;/// <summary>Normalised height of the rect collider (0–1).</summary>
public float RectH{get;set;}=0.1f;/// <summary>Normalised X centre of the circle collider (0–1).</summary>
public float CircleX{get;set;}=0.5f;/// <summary>Normalised Y centre of the circle collider (0–1).</summary>
public float CircleY{get;set;}=0.5f;/// <summary>Normalised radius of the circle collider (0–1).</summary>
public float CircleRadius{get;set;}=0.05f;/// <summary>List of normalised (0–1) vertices defining the polygon collider.</summary>
public List<Vector2>PolygonVertices{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Hex colour string (e.g. <c>"#FFFF0033"</c>) for the highlight overlay.</summary>
public string HighlightColorHex{get;set;}="#FFFF0033";/// <summary>Scale multiplier applied to the sprite when highlighted.</summary>
public float HighlightScale{get;set;}=1.02f;/// <summary>Scenario file path executed on click.</summary>
public string OnClickScenario{get;set;}="";/// <summary>Inline DSL commands executed on click, one per line.</summary>
public string OnClickCommands{get;set;}="";/// <summary>DSL commands executed when the mouse enters the interactive area.</summary>
public string OnHoverEnter{get;set;}="";/// <summary>DSL commands executed when the mouse leaves the interactive area.</summary>
public string OnHoverLeave{get;set;}="";/// <summary>Builds an InteractiveDefinition from current state.</summary>
public InteractiveDefinition ToDefinition(){var hitArea=new HitAreaDefinition{Type=HitType};switch(HitType){case"rect":hitArea.X=RectX;hitArea.Y=RectY;hitArea.Width=RectW;hitArea.Height=RectH;break;case"circle":hitArea.X=CircleX;hitArea.Y=CircleY;hitArea.Radius=CircleRadius;break;case"polygon":hitArea.Vertices=PolygonVertices.ToArray();break;}var clickAction=new ClickAction();if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(OnClickScenario))clickAction.Scenario=OnClickScenario.Trim();if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(OnClickCommands)){var lines=OnClickCommands.Split('\n',System.StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);var cleanLines=new List<string>();foreach(var line in lines){var trimmed=line.Trim();if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmed))cleanLines.Add(trimmed);}if(cleanLines.Count>0)clickAction.Commands=cleanLines.ToArray();}return new InteractiveDefinition{ID=Id,Texture=string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Texture)?null:Texture.Trim(),Layer=Layer,ZIndex=ZIndex,Enabled=Enabled,Visible=Visible,Cursor=string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Cursor)?null:Cursor.Trim(),HitArea=hitArea,Highlight=new HighlightDefinition{ColorHex=HighlightColorHex,Scale=HighlightScale},Actions=new InteractiveActionDefinition{OnClick=(clickAction.Scenario!=null||clickAction.Commands!=null)?clickAction:null,OnHoverEnter=string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(OnHoverEnter)?null:OnHoverEnter.Trim(),OnHoverLeave=string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(OnHoverLeave)?null:OnHoverLeave.Trim()}};}/// <summary>Loads state from an InteractiveDefinition.</summary>
public void FromDefinition(InteractiveDefinition def){if(def==null)return;Id=def.ID??"new_interactive";Texture=def.Texture??"";Layer=def.Layer??"foreground";ZIndex=def.ZIndex;Enabled=def.Enabled;Visible=def.Visible;Cursor=def.Cursor??"";if(def.HitArea!=null){HitType=def.HitArea.Type??"rect";RectX=def.HitArea.X;RectY=def.HitArea.Y;RectW=def.HitArea.Width;RectH=def.HitArea.Height;CircleX=def.HitArea.X;CircleY=def.HitArea.Y;CircleRadius=def.HitArea.Radius;PolygonVertices=def.HitArea.Vertices!=null?new List<Vector2>(def.HitArea.Vertices):new List<Vector2>();}else{HitType="rect";}if(def.Highlight!=null){HighlightColorHex=def.Highlight.ColorHex??"#FFFF0033";HighlightScale=def.Highlight.Scale;}OnClickScenario=def.Actions?.OnClick?.Scenario??"";OnClickCommands=def.Actions?.OnClick?.Commands!=null?string.Join("\n",def.Actions.OnClick.Commands):"";OnHoverEnter=def.Actions?.OnHoverEnter??"";OnHoverLeave=def.Actions?.OnHoverLeave??"";}/// <summary>Serializes the definition to formatted JSON (FileData envelope).</summary>
public string ToJson(){var def=ToDefinition();var wrapper=new{Items=new[]{def}};var options=new JsonSerializerOptions{WriteIndented=true,PropertyNamingPolicy=JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase,DefaultIgnoreCondition=JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull};return JsonSerializer.Serialize(wrapper,options);}/// <summary>Parses JSON back into the controller. Returns false on failure.</summary>
public bool FromJson(string json){try{var options=new JsonSerializerOptions{PropertyNameCaseInsensitive=true,ReadCommentHandling=System.Text.Json.JsonCommentHandling.Skip};var wrapper=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<FileDataWrapper>(json,options);if(wrapper?.Items!=null&&wrapper.Items.Count>0){FromDefinition(wrapper.Items[0]);return true;}return false;}catch{return false;}}private class FileDataWrapper{public List<InteractiveDefinition>Items{get;set;}}/// <summary>Updates a polygon vertex at the given index.</summary>
public void SetPolygonVertex(int index,Vector2 value){while(PolygonVertices.Count<=index)PolygonVertices.Add(Vector2.Zero);PolygonVertices[index]=value;}/// <summary>Removes a polygon vertex at the given index.</summary>
public void RemovePolygonVertex(int index){if(index>=0&&index<PolygonVertices.Count)PolygonVertices.RemoveAt(index);}/// <summary>Adds a new polygon vertex at the default position (center of viewport).</summary>
public void AddPolygonVertex(){var offset=PolygonVertices.Count*0.04f;PolygonVertices.Add(new Vector2(0.5f+offset,0.5f+offset));}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Tools.InteractiveEditor{/// <summary> Draggable 16x16 handle representing a collider vertex on the preview area. public partial class InteractiveEditorHandle:ColorRect{/// <summary>Index of the vertex this handle represents (0-based).</summary>
public int VertexIndex;/// <summary>Invoked during drag with the centre position of the handle in global coordinates.</summary>
public System.Action<Vector2>DragUpdate;/// <summary>Invoked when the handle is clicked (mouse down).</summary>
public System.Action Clicked;/// <summary>Invoked when the drag ends (mouse up). Used to sync sidebar values.</summary>
public System.Action DragEnd;private bool _dragging;private Vector2 _dragOffset;/// <summary>Creates a handle with the given colour, size 16×16, and index for vertex identification.</summary>
public InteractiveEditorHandle(Color color,int index){VertexIndex=index;Size=new Vector2(16,16);Color=color;MouseFilter=Control.MouseFilterEnum.Stop;MouseDefaultCursorShape=Control.CursorShape.PointingHand;GuiInput+=OnGuiInput;}private void OnGuiInput(InputEvent@event){if(@event is InputEventMouseButton mb&&mb.ButtonIndex==MouseButton.Left){if(mb.Pressed){_dragging=true;_dragOffset=GetGlobalMousePosition()-GlobalPosition;GameLogger.Log("INTERACTIVE_HANDLE",$"drag start idx={VertexIndex} pos={GlobalPosition}");Clicked?.Invoke();}else{_dragging=false;GameLogger.Log("INTERACTIVE_HANDLE",$"drag end idx={VertexIndex}");DragEnd?.Invoke();}AcceptEvent();}else if(@event is InputEventMouseMotion&&_dragging){var center=GlobalPosition+Size/2;GlobalPosition=GetGlobalMousePosition()-_dragOffset;DragUpdate?.Invoke(center);}}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Lights;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.LightEditor{/// <summary> Data controller for the light editor tool. Maintains a list of <see cref="LightDef"/> objects and feeds up to 10 lights plus one sentinel entry into the <c>"timed_sprite"</c> shader material for real-time preview. Exports lights as JSON (<see cref="ExportLightsJson"/>) or as a scenario DSL snippet (<see cref="ExportScenarioSnippet"/>). Uses a dirty-flag pattern so shader uniform updates only occur when the light list changes. </summary>
public class LightEditorController{/// <summary>The editable list of light definitions. Capped at 10 for shader preview.</summary>
public List<LightDef>Lights{get;}=new();private readonly Vector2[]previewPositions=new Vector2[11];private readonly Color[]previewColors=new Color[11];private readonly float[]previewRadii=new float[11];private readonly float[]previewInfluence=new float[11];private bool dirty=true;/// <summary>Initialises preview arrays with out-of-bounds sentinel values.</summary>
public LightEditorController(){for(int i=0;i<11;i++){previewPositions[i]=new Vector2(-1000f,-1000f);previewRadii[i]=0f;previewInfluence[i]=0f;previewColors[i]=UiTokens.White;}}/// <summary> Creates a <see cref="ShaderMaterial"/> using the <c>"timed_sprite"</c> shader with night-time weights applied. Returns <c>null</c> if the shader is not found. </summary>
public ShaderMaterial CreatePreviewMaterial(){var shader=Shaders.Resolve("timed_sprite");if(shader==null)return null;var mat=new ShaderMaterial{Shader=shader};var night=new Vector4(0,0,0,1);mat.SetShaderParameter("time_weights",night);mat.SetShaderParameter("use_time",true);return mat;}/// <summary>Sets the background texture uniform on the preview shader material.</summary>
public void SetBackgroundForPreview(Texture2D texture,ShaderMaterial material){if(material!=null)material.SetShaderParameter("background_map",texture);}/// <summary>Sets the depth mask texture uniform on the preview shader material.</summary>
public void SetDepthForPreview(Texture2D texture,ShaderMaterial material){if(material!=null)material.SetShaderParameter("depth_mask",texture);}/// <summary>Sets the albedo texture uniform on the preview shader material.</summary>
public void SetAlbedoForPreview(Texture2D texture,ShaderMaterial material){if(material!=null)material.SetShaderParameter("albedo_map",texture);}/// <summary>Appends a <see cref="LightDef"/> to the list and marks the preview dirty.</summary>
public void AddLight(LightDef light){Lights.Add(light);dirty=true;}/// <summary>Removes the light at <paramref name="index"/>. No-op if out of range.</summary>
public void RemoveLight(int index){if(index<0||index>=Lights.Count)return;Lights.RemoveAt(index);dirty=true;}/// <summary>Removes all lights from the list and marks dirty.</summary>
public void Clear(){Lights.Clear();dirty=true;}/// <summary>Forces the preview to be recalculated on the next <see cref="UpdatePreview"/> call.</summary>
public void MarkDirty(){dirty=true;}/// <summary> Packs up to 10 lights plus a sentinel into shader uniform arrays. Only executes if <c>dirty</c> is <c>true</c>. Converts each light's normalised position to pixel coordinates relative to the preview area. </summary>
public void UpdatePreview(ShaderMaterial material,Vector2 previewGlobalPos,Vector2 previewSize){if(material==null|| !dirty)return;for(int i=0;i<11;i++){previewPositions[i]=new Vector2(-1000f,-1000f);previewRadii[i]=0f;previewInfluence[i]=0f;previewColors[i]=UiTokens.White;}int count=Mathf.Min(Lights.Count,10);for(int i=0;i<count;i++){var pixelPos=Lights[i].ToPixelPos(previewSize);previewPositions[i]=new Vector2(pixelPos.X+previewGlobalPos.X,pixelPos.Y+previewGlobalPos.Y);previewRadii[i]=Lights[i].Radius;previewInfluence[i]=Lights[i].Influence;previewColors[i]=Lights[i].ToColor();}var posArray=new Godot.Collections.Array<Vector2>();var colArray=new Godot.Collections.Array<Color>();var radArray=new Godot.Collections.Array<float>();var infArray=new Godot.Collections.Array<float>();for(int i=0;i<11;i++){posArray.Add(previewPositions[i]);colArray.Add(previewColors[i]);radArray.Add(previewRadii[i]);infArray.Add(previewInfluence[i]);}material.SetShaderParameter("light_count",count);material.SetShaderParameter("light_positions",posArray);material.SetShaderParameter("light_colors",colArray);material.SetShaderParameter("light_radii",radArray);material.SetShaderParameter("light_influence",infArray);material.SetShaderParameter("light_radius_scale",1.0f);dirty=false;}/// <summary>Serialises the light list as a compact JSON string.</summary>
public string ExportLightsJson(){return JsonSerializer.Serialize(Lights,Cthangover.Core.Utils.JsonOptionsProvider.WriteCompactOptions);}/// <summary>Produces a <c>light_set</c> scenario DSL command with the lights JSON as its argument.</summary>
public string ExportScenarioSnippet(){var json=ExportLightsJson();return$"light_set \"{json.Replace("\"", "\\\"")}\"";}}}

using Cthangover.Core.UI.Lights;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.LightEditor{/// <summary> Draggable 24×24 coloured handle representing a light source on the preview. Overrides <c>_GuiInput</c> (Godot virtual) for mouse drag support; the colour is taken from <see cref="LightDef.ToColor"/>. Raises <see cref="DragUpdate"/> with the handle's centre position in global coordinates for the window to convert back to normalised coordinates. </summary>
public partial class LightEditorHandle:ColorRect{/// <summary>Index of the light in <see cref="LightEditorController.Lights"/>.</summary>
public int LightIndex;/// <summary>Invoked during drag with the centre position in global coordinates.</summary>
public System.Action<Vector2>DragUpdate;/// <summary>Invoked when the handle is clicked (mouse down).</summary>
public System.Action Clicked;private bool dragging;private Vector2 dragOffset;/// <summary>Creates a 24×24 handle coloured to match the light's <see cref="LightDef.ToColor"/> value.</summary>
public LightEditorHandle(LightDef light,int index){LightIndex=index;Size=new Vector2(24,24);Color=light.ToColor();MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Stop;}/// <summary>Handles mouse drag and click via Godot's virtual input system (<c>_GuiInput</c>).</summary>
public override void _GuiInput(InputEvent@event){if(@event is InputEventMouseButton mb&&mb.ButtonIndex==MouseButton.Left){if(mb.Pressed){dragging=true;dragOffset=GetGlobalMousePosition()-GlobalPosition;Clicked?.Invoke();}else{dragging=false;}AcceptEvent();}else if(@event is InputEventMouseMotion&&dragging){GlobalPosition=GetGlobalMousePosition()-dragOffset;DragUpdate?.Invoke(GlobalPosition+Size/2);}}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.SceneBuilder{/// <summary> Curated property lists shown by the scene builder inspector, mirroring the Godot editor's most-used entries. Deliberately hardcoded instead of derived from <c>ClassDB</c>: the runtime tscn builder ignores theme overrides and metadata, so a fixed allow-list guarantees every visible property is both live-applied via <c>Set()</c> and faithfully written back to the file. Two shapes: a free Control gets the layout/rect/visibility/misc set; a Control managed by a Container ignores anchors/offsets entirely (the parent recomputes them every frame), so it gets container-relevant fields instead — otherwise the inspector would show editable-looking values that do nothing, which is exactly how anchored scenes looked "wrong" before file-truth init. </summary>

Control){if(insideContainer){result.Add(("tools/scene_builder/inspector_cat_container",BuildContainer()));}else{result.Add(("tools/scene_builder/inspector_cat_layout",BuildLayout()));result.Add(("tools/scene_builder/inspector_cat_rect",BuildRect()));}result.Add(("tools/scene_builder/inspector_cat_visibility",BuildControlVisibility()));result.Add(("tools/scene_builder/inspector_cat_misc",BuildMisc()));}else new List<InspectableProperty>{Enum("layout_mode",new long[]{0,1,2,3},new[]{"Position","Anchors","Container","Uncontrolled"}),Float("anchor_left",-8d,8d,0.01d),Float("anchor_top",-8d,8d,0.01d),Float("anchor_right",-8d,8d,0.01d),Float("anchor_bottom",-8d,8d,0.01d),Enum("grow_horizontal",new long[]{0,1,2},new[]{"Begin","End","Both"}),Enum("grow_vertical",new long[]{0,1,2},new[]{"Begin","End","Both"}),Float("offset_left",-100000d,100000d,1d),Float("offset_top",-100000d,100000d,1d),Float("offset_right",-100000d,100000d,1d),Float("offset_bottom",-100000d,100000d,1d)};}private static List<InspectableProperty>BuildRect(){return new Builds an interactive node hierarchy tree, tracks selection for the highlight overlay, and reads/writes the raw tscn source so the tool can edit and save mod scenes in place. Mod scene listing is sourced from <see cref="TscnSceneResolver.Collect"/> (deduplicated by mod load order), while base scenes come from <see cref="ModScenes.CollectTscnFiles"/>. </summary>
