using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnParsing;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.SceneBuilder{/// <summary> Snapshot of the raw node properties currently stored in a .tscn source text: node address → property key → unparsed literal. The inspector uses it to show what the FILE contains rather than post-layout live values — after Godot lays out a control its position/size reflect computed layout, which previously made anchored nodes look like they had none. Rebuild via <see cref="Build"/> whenever the source text changes. Section addressing matches <see cref="TscnTextSurgery"/> through <see cref="TscnNodeAddressing"/>. </summary>
public class TscnFileProps{private readonly Dictionary<string,Dictionary<string,string>>_nodes=new();/// <summary>Parses tscn source into the snapshot; empty snapshot for null/empty text.</summary>
public static TscnFileProps Build(string text){var result=new TscnFileProps();if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))return result;Dictionary<string,string>current=null;foreach(var token in new TscnLexer().Tokenize(text)){if(token.Type==TscnTokenType.SectionHeader){current=null;if(token.SectionName=="node"){var path=TscnNodeAddressing.ComputePath(token.SectionAttrs);if(path!=null&& !result._nodes.ContainsKey(path)){current=new Dictionary<string,string>();result._nodes[path]=current;}}}else if(token.Type==TscnTokenType.Property&&current!=null){if(!current.ContainsKey(token.PropertyKey))current[token.PropertyKey]=token.PropertyValue;}}return result;}/// <summary>Raw property literals of one node; null when the section is absent from the file.</summary>
public IReadOnlyDictionary<string,string>GetNodeProperties(string nodePath){return _nodes.TryGetValue(nodePath??"",out var props)?props:null;}}}

using System.Globalization;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.SceneBuilder{/// <summary> Inverse of <see cref="TscnValueFormatter"/>: parses raw .tscn property literals (as stored in the file, e.g. "0.5", "Vector2(160, 50)", "\"Go\"") into display values for inspector widgets. using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.SceneBuilder{/// <summary> Single source of truth for mapping a <c>[node]</c> section's attributes to the address path used across the scene builder tool (inspector selection, tscn text surgery, file property snapshots). Both <see cref="TscnTextSurgery"/> and <see cref="TscnFileProps"/> must resolve sections identically, so the rule lives here and nowhere else: no parent attribute = scene root (""), parent="." = direct child of root, otherwise parent path + "/" + name. </summary>
internal static class TscnNodeAddressing{/// <summary>Computes the node address from section attributes; null when attributes lack a usable name.</summary>
public static string ComputePath(Dictionary<string,string>attrs){if(attrs==null|| !attrs.TryGetValue("name",out var name)||string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))return null;if(!attrs.TryGetValue("parent",out var parent))return"";return parent=="."?name:parent+"/"+name;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnParsing;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.SceneBuilder{/// <summary> Targeted line edits of raw .tscn source without a full re-serialization: the file is tokenized with <see cref="TscnLexer"/> (which reports 1-based line numbers), the affected <c>[node]</c> sections are located by their Godot address path (via <see cref="TscnNodeAddressing"/>, shared with <see cref="TscnFileProps"/>), and only the involved lines are touched. Everything outside them — comments, blank lines, formatting — survives. Beyond property upsert/removal it can insert a whole new node section right after its parent's block (parent-before-child order is what the runtime builder relies on) and delete a node subtree together with any dangling [connection] entries. Newly inserted properties follow Godot's layout convention (<c>layout_mode</c> → anchors → grow → offsets → rest) so the builder applies them in a valid sequence. </summary>
public static class TscnTextSurgery{/// <summary> Inserts or replaces one property line inside the given node's section. nodePath uses .tscn addressing relative to the scene root ("", "Panel", "Panel/Btn"); "" addresses the root node section itself. Returns false when the section does not exist in this file (e.g. override sections for instanced sub-scenes). </summary>

using System.Globalization;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.SceneBuilder{/// <summary> Serializes editor-side <see cref="Variant"/> values into .tscn literal syntax accepted by the runtime parser (<c>TscnPropertyParser</c>): floats always carry a decimal point, strings are quoted with Godot escape sequences, composite types use the <c>Type(a, b, ...)</c> constructor form. public static class TscnValueFormatter{/// <summary>Formats a Variant as a .tscn property value; null when not representable.</summary>
public static string Format(Variant value){switch(value.VariantType){case Variant.Type.Nil:return"null";case Variant.Type.Bool:return value.AsBool()?"true":"false";case Variant.Type.Int:return value.AsInt64().ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);case Variant.Type.Float:return FormatFloat(value.AsDouble());case Variant.Type.String:return Quote(value.AsString());case Variant.Type.Vector2:{var v=value.AsVector2();var x=FormatFloat(v.X);var y=FormatFloat(v.Y);return x==null||y==null?null:$"Vector2({x}, {y})";}case Variant.Type.Color:{var c=value.AsColor();var r=FormatFloat(c.R);var g=FormatFloat(c.G);var b=FormatFloat(c.B);var a=FormatFloat(c.A);return r==null||g==null||b==null||a==null?null:$"Color({r}, {g}, {b}, {a})";}default:return null;}}/// <summary> Formats a float in invariant culture with a guaranteed decimal point ("1" → "1.0"). Values pass through float precision first because every numeric property edited here originates from Godot float properties — that yields the short canonical form ("0.35" instead of the double expansion "0.34999999403953552"). Null for NaN/Infinity. </summary>
public static string FormatFloat(double v){var f=(float)v;if(!float.IsFinite(f))return null;var s=f.ToString("R",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);if(!s.Contains('.')&& !s.Contains('e')&& !s.Contains('E'))s+=".0";return s;}private static string Quote(string s){var escaped=s.Replace("\\","\\\\").Replace("\"","\\\"").Replace("\n","\\n").Replace("\r","\\r").Replace("\t","\\t");return"\""+escaped+"\"";}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Tools.Services{/// <summary> Static service for discovering and loading mod background resources. public static class ModResourceService{/// <summary> Returns all unique background IDs (filenames without extension) from the <c>"backgrounds"</c> file collection across all installed mods. </summary>

public static class ScenarioSyntaxService{/// <summary> Builds a <see cref="CodeHighlighter"/> for scenario DSL syntax. using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;namespace Cthangover.Core.Battle.Actions{/// <summary> Central action-execution dispatcher. Resolves an action ID to an IActionExecutor in two tiers: first the active provider (set by the current IBattleCore, allowing per-battle-engine overrides), then a global fallback registry. This two-level lookup lets mods supply custom executors for specific battle cores without replacing the global ones. Execute returns ChangedAttributes to allow the caller to inspect the result (success/failure, stat deltas). </summary>
public class ActionExecutorHub{/// <summary> Singleton hub instance. There is one global dispatcher shared across all battle cores; cores swap providers via <see cref="SetActiveProvider"/> when they activate. </summary>
public static readonly ActionExecutorHub Instance=new();private IActionExecutorProvider _activeProvider;private readonly Dictionary<string,IActionExecutor>_globalExecutors=new();/// <summary> Installs a per-core executor provider. The active provider is consulted before the global registry, allowing the current battle core to override specific action handlers. </summary>
public void SetActiveProvider(IActionExecutorProvider provider){_activeProvider=provider;}/// <summary> Registers a fallback executor in the global pool, keyed by <see cref="IActionExecutor.ActionId"/>. Global executors are used when no active provider supplies a match. </summary>
public void RegisterGlobal(IActionExecutor executor){if(executor!=null&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(executor.ActionId))_globalExecutors[executor.ActionId]=executor;}/// <summary> Dispatches an action to the appropriate executor. Resolution order: active provider first, then global registry. Returns <c>Result = false</c> if no executor is found or if <paramref name="action"/> is null. </summary>

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Battle.Actions{/// <summary> Sequential action queue that processes one IBattleAction per frame until it signals completion (DoAction returns true), then moves to the next. Fires OnStopMachine when the queue drains naturally or is explicitly stopped — used by battle cores to detect when a turn's animation sequence is finished. Actions can be added before or during processing; the machine starts automatically once at least one action is queued and no current action is running. <para/> Derives from <see cref="ModNode"/> so the engine lifecycle callbacks reach this runtime-compiled script through the core base class (mod assemblies have no Godot source generation of their own). </summary>
public partial class BattleActionMachine:ModNode{/// <summary> Pending action queue. Actions are dequeued one-by-one in the process hook, starting the next as soon as the current signals completion. Can be extended while the machine is running — new actions will be processed after the current queue drains. </summary>
public List<IBattleAction>Actions{get;set;}=new();private IBattleAction CurrentAction{get;set;}private bool _hadActions;/// <summary> Fired when the machine drains naturally or is explicitly stopped. Battle cores subscribe to advance the turn phase without polling. </summary>
public event StopMachineDelegate OnStopMachine;protected override void OnExitTree(){base.OnExitTree();StopMachine();}protected override void OnProcess(double delta){if(Actions.Count==0&&CurrentAction==null){if(_hadActions){_hadActions=false;StopMachine();}return;}var action=CurrentAction;if(action==null){CurrentAction=Actions[0];Actions.RemoveAt(0);action=CurrentAction;_hadActions=true;action?.DoStart();}if(action==null){_hadActions=false;StopMachine();return;}if(action.DoAction()){action.DoEnd();CurrentAction=null;}}/// <summary> Enqueues a single action. If the machine is idle (no current action), processing starts on the next _Process tick. </summary>
public void AddAction(IBattleAction action){if(action==null)return;Actions.Add(action);}/// <summary> Batch-enqueues multiple actions. All are appended to the existing queue and processed in FIFO order on subsequent frames. </summary>
public void AddActions(List<IBattleAction>actions){if(actions==null||actions.Count==0)return;Actions.AddRange(actions);}/// <summary> Immediately clears the queue, aborts the current action, and fires <see cref="OnStopMachine"/>. Called on tree exit and when the queue drains naturally. </summary>
public void StopMachine(){CurrentAction=null;Actions.Clear();_hadActions=false;OnStopMachine?.Invoke();}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Battle.Actions{/// <summary> Adapter that lets a GDScript mod act as a battle action executor. The script is detected by <see cref="TurnBattleGDScriptHook"/> when it exposes <c>get_action_id()</c> and <c>execute(action, user, target)</c>; this adapter flattens the C# arguments into Godot dictionaries via <see cref="BattleGDScriptBridge"/> and maps the returned dictionary back to <see cref="ChangedAttributes"/>. Dictionaries are used instead of custom RefCounted DTOs because runtime-compiled mod classes get no Godot source generation, so their members would not be visible to GDScript. </summary>
public class GDBattleActionExecutor:IActionExecutor{private readonly GodotObject _instance;/// <summary>Creates an adapter around a live GDScript object. The object is retained by reference.</summary>
public GDBattleActionExecutor(string actionId,GodotObject instance){ActionId=actionId;_instance=instance;}/// <summary>Action id reported by the script through <c>get_action_id()</c>.</summary>
public string ActionId{get;}/// <summary> Calls the script and converts its result. A script that returns anything other than a dictionary (or throws) yields a failed result so one broken mod cannot abort the action pipeline. </summary>
public ChangedAttributes Execute(ActionCharacter action,Character user,Character target){var gdAction=BattleGDScriptBridge.ActionToDictionary(action);var gdUser=BattleGDScriptBridge.CharacterToDictionary(user);var gdTarget=BattleGDScriptBridge.CharacterToDictionary(target);var variant=_instance.Call("execute",gdAction,gdUser,gdTarget);if(variant.VariantType!=Variant.Type.Dictionary)return new ChangedAttributes{Result=false};return BattleGDScriptBridge.ResultFromDictionary(variant.AsGodotDictionary());}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Battle{/// <summary> Pluggable battle-core registry. Scans assemblies for non-abstract IBattleCore implementations, registers them by ID (each core self-identifies), and activates one by ID. GetActive constructs a fresh instance every call — battle cores are stateless between battles. Falls back to the first registered core if no active ID was set, enabling mods to ship drop-in battle engines. </summary>
public class BattleCoreRegistry{/// <summary>Singleton registry instance.</summary>
public static readonly BattleCoreRegistry Instance=new();private readonly Dictionary<string,Type>_cores=new();private string _activeCoreId;/// <summary> Scans <paramref name="assembly"/> for non-abstract <see cref="IBattleCore"/> implementations, instantiates each to read its <see cref="IBattleCore.Id"/>, and registers the type by ID. Called at startup so mods can ship drop-in cores. </summary>
public void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly){foreach(var instance in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IBattleCore>(assembly)){_cores[instance.Id]=instance.GetType();}}/// <summary> Scans every assembly loaded in the current <see cref="System.AppDomain"/> for <see cref="IBattleCore"/> implementations and registers them by id. Called by the battle mod's initializer after assemblies land, which replaces the old core-side fan-out in ModAssemblyLoader — the core no longer references battle types. Re-registering an id overwrites the earlier type, so repeated scans (mod reload) stay idempotent. </summary>
public void RegisterAll(){foreach(var instance in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IBattleCore>()){_cores[instance.Id]=instance.GetType();}GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"BattleCoreRegistry.RegisterAll: {_cores.Count} core(s) registered: [{string.Join(", ", CoreIds)}]");}/// <summary> Selects the active core by ID. Throws if the core is not registered. The selected core will be instantiated fresh on the next call to <see cref="GetActive"/>. </summary>
public void SetActive(string id){if(!_cores.ContainsKey(id))throw new Exception($"Battle core '{id}' not found");_activeCoreId=id;}/// <summary> Constructs a fresh instance of the active core type. Falls back to the first registered core if no active ID was set. Throws if no cores are registered at all. </summary>
public IBattleCore GetActive(){if(_activeCoreId!=null&&_cores.ContainsKey(_activeCoreId))return(IBattleCore)Activator.CreateInstance(_cores[_activeCoreId]);var firstId=GetFirstCoreId();if(firstId!=null){_activeCoreId=firstId;return(IBattleCore)Activator.CreateInstance(_cores[firstId]);}throw new Exception("No active battle core set. Use battle.set_core first.");}/// <summary> Returns the ID of the first registered core, or null if the registry is empty. Used as a fallback when no active core has been explicitly set. </summary>
public string GetFirstCoreId(){return _cores.Keys.FirstOrDefault();}/// <summary> Checks whether a core with the given <paramref name="id"/> has been registered. </summary>
public bool HasCore(string id){return _cores.ContainsKey(id);}/// <summary> Registered core IDs, sorted for stable output. Used by the battle coverage tool as the single source of truth for how many battle cores ship with the current mod set. </summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>CoreIds{get{var ids=new List<string>(_cores.Keys);ids.Sort(System.StringComparer.Ordinal);return ids;}}/// <summary> Returns the registered <see cref="Type"/> for a core, or <c>null</c>. Lets tooling inspect a core's implemented interfaces (e.g. <see cref="IBattleAutoPlayable"/>) without instantiating it. </summary>
public Type GetCoreType(string id){return _cores.TryGetValue(id,out var type)?type:null;}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Battle{/// <summary> Converts battle data to and from plain Godot collections so GDScript mods can work with it. The previous bridge exposed <c>[GlobalClass]</c> DTOs (GDCharacter, GDBattleResult, GDWingroundContext), but classes compiled at runtime inside mods never go through Godot's C# source generator, so their properties and methods are invisible to GDScript. Dictionaries and arrays are native variants and work regardless of which assembly produced them. <para/> Keys are snake_case to match GDScript conventions. The same helpers are used by <see cref="GDBattleActionExecutor"/> (action/character snapshots in, result deltas out) and <see cref="GDWingroundListener"/> (victory context in, exp/loot mutations out). </summary>
public static class BattleGDScriptBridge{/// <summary>Flattens a character into a dictionary of primitive stats and identity fields.</summary>
public static Godot.Collections.Dictionary CharacterToDictionary(Character character){var data=new Godot.Collections.Dictionary();if(character==null)return data;data["id"]=character.ID;data["name"]=character.Name;data["level"]=character.Level;data["exp"]=character.Exp;data["recruitment_chance"]=character.RecruitmentChance;var attrs=character.Attributes;if(attrs!=null){data["health_value"]=attrs.Health?.Value??0;data["health_max"]=attrs.Health?.BaseValue??0;data["defence_value"]=attrs.Defence?.Value??0;data["defence_max"]=attrs.Defence?.BaseValue??0;data["attack_value"]=attrs.Attack?.Value??0;data["attack_max"]=attrs.Attack?.BaseValue??0;data["point_value"]=attrs.Point?.Value??0;data["point_max"]=attrs.Point?.BaseValue??0;var properties=new Godot.Collections.Dictionary<string,string>();if(attrs.Properties?.Values!=null){foreach(var kvp in attrs.Properties.Values)properties[kvp.Key]=kvp.Value;}data["properties"]=properties;}return data;}/// <summary>Flattens an action card into a dictionary of identity fields and raw properties.</summary>
public static Godot.Collections.Dictionary ActionToDictionary(ActionCharacter action){var data=new Godot.Collections.Dictionary();if(action==null)return data;data["id"]=action.ID;data["name"]=action.Name;data["description"]=action.Description;data["type"]=(int)action.Type;var properties=new Godot.Collections.Dictionary<string,string>();if(action.Properties?.Values!=null){foreach(var kvp in action.Properties.Values)properties[kvp.Key]=kvp.Value;}data["properties"]=properties;return data;}/// <summary> Builds <see cref="ChangedAttributes"/> from the dictionary a GDScript executor returns. Missing keys default to zero/false; <c>result</c> defaults to <c>true</c> so a script that only reports deltas still counts as a successful action. </summary>
public static ChangedAttributes ResultFromDictionary(Godot.Collections.Dictionary data){if(data==null)return new ChangedAttributes{Result=false};var result=new ChangedAttributes();if(data.TryGetValue("source_damage",out var sourceDamage))result.Source.Damage=sourceDamage.AsInt32();if(data.TryGetValue("source_defence",out var sourceDefence))result.Source.Defence=sourceDefence.AsInt32();if(data.TryGetValue("target_damage",out var targetDamage))result.Target.Damage=targetDamage.AsInt32();if(data.TryGetValue("target_defence",out var targetDefence))result.Target.Defence=targetDefence.AsInt32();result.Result= !data.TryGetValue("result",out var success)||success.AsBool();return result;}/// <summary>Builds the mutable victory context dictionary passed to GDScript winground hooks.</summary>
public static Godot.Collections.Dictionary WingroundToDictionary(WingroundContext ctx){var data=new Godot.Collections.Dictionary();if(ctx==null)return data;var expGained=new Godot.Collections.Dictionary<string,int>();if(ctx.PlayerExpGained!=null){foreach(var kvp in ctx.PlayerExpGained)expGained[kvp.Key]=kvp.Value;}data["exp_gained"]=expGained;var defeated=new Godot.Collections.Array<Godot.Collections.Dictionary>();if(ctx.DefeatedEnemies!=null){foreach(var enemy in ctx.DefeatedEnemies)defeated.Add(CharacterToDictionary(enemy));}data["defeated_enemies"]=defeated;var loot=new Godot.Collections.Array<Godot.Collections.Dictionary>();if(ctx.GeneratedLoot!=null){foreach(var item in ctx.GeneratedLoot){loot.Add(new Godot.Collections.Dictionary{["item_id"]=item.Item?.ID??string.Empty,["count"]=item.Count,});}}data["generated_loot"]=loot;data["return_scene"]=ctx.BattleData?.ReturnScene??string.Empty;return data;}/// <summary> Writes GDScript mutations from a winground context dictionary back to the C# pipeline. public static void SyncWingroundBack(Godot.Collections.Dictionary data,WingroundContext ctx){if(data==null||ctx==null)return;if(data.TryGetValue("exp_gained",out var expVariant)&&expVariant.AsGodotDictionary()is Godot.Collections.Dictionary expDict&&ctx.PlayerExpGained!=null){ctx.PlayerExpGained.Clear();foreach(var key in expDict.Keys)ctx.PlayerExpGained[key.AsString()]=expDict[key].AsInt32();}if(data.TryGetValue("generated_loot",out var lootVariant)&&lootVariant.AsGodotArray()is Godot.Collections.Array lootArray&&ctx.GeneratedLoot!=null){ctx.GeneratedLoot.Clear();foreach(var entry in lootArray){if(entry.AsGodotDictionary()is not Godot.Collections.Dictionary itemDict)continue;var itemId=itemDict.TryGetValue("item_id",out var idVariant)?idVariant.AsString():null;var count=itemDict.TryGetValue("count",out var countVariant)?countVariant.AsInt32():0;ctx.GeneratedLoot.Add(new ItemContainer{Item=string.IsNullOrEmpty(itemId)?null:ItemFactory.Instance.Get(itemId),Count=count,});}}}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Actions;namespace Cthangover.Core.Battle{/// <summary> Dispatched by the scenario DSL to initiate battle. Reads "scene", "enemies", "quest_id" and "new_tag" from dialog variables and calls <see cref="BattleService.Init"/>. The enemies string is a comma-separated list embedded in the scenario script. Battle initialization must happen *after* the background has been set by a prior background action, otherwise the encounter gets a null backdrop. <para/> Registered by the battle mod's assembly scan, so the core scenario action registry stays free of battle commands. </summary>
public class BattleInitAction:IScenarioAction{/// <summary>Registered as "battle.init" — the scenario DSL's primary battle initiation command.</summary>
public string Name=>"battle.init";/// <summary> Reads battle parameters from dialog variables and initiates battle construction. Requires both "scene" and "enemies" to be non-empty — returns early with a log if either is missing. </summary>
public void Run(IActionContext ctx){var sceneRaw=ctx.GetParam("scene");var enemies=ctx.GetParam("enemies");var questId=ctx.GetParam("quest_id");var newTag=ctx.GetParam("new_tag");if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(sceneRaw)||string.IsNullOrEmpty(enemies)){ctx.Log("EVENT","BattleInitAction: missing 'scene' or 'enemies' variable");return;}BattleService.Init(sceneRaw,enemies,questId,newTag);ctx.Log("EVENT",$"BattleInitAction: battle started at '{sceneRaw}' with enemies '{enemies}'");}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Quests;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Lights;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Battle{/// <summary> Entry point for starting a battle encounter. Constructs <see cref="BattleData"/> from scenario parameters and stores it in <see cref="BattleRequest"/> for the battle scene to pick up. Captures the current background texture (via <see cref="BackgroundFactory"/> using <see cref="SceneContextNode.LastBackgroundID"/>) so the battle scene has the correct visual context, and snapshots the depth/albedo lighting maps from <see cref="UiLightController"/> for visual consistency. If a quest id is provided, the quest is bound to the encounter and an optional new tag triggers a quest notification. The active battle core is resolved from <see cref="BattleCoreRegistry"/> — wrapped in try/catch because the registry may not be initialized when called from non-battle contexts (e.g. preloading). </summary>
public static class BattleService{/// <summary> Constructs and stores <see cref="BattleRequest.Current"/> for the upcoming encounter. Must be called after a background has been set by a prior scenario background action, otherwise the backdrop is null. The enemies string is a comma-separated list resolved by <see cref="BattleData.InitBattle"/>. </summary>
public static void Init(string sceneType,string enemies,string questId=null,string newTag=null){var enemyList=enemies.Split(',');var background=BackgroundFactory.Instance.Get(SceneContextNode.LastBackgroundID);GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"BattleService.Init: lastBgId='{SceneContextNode.LastBackgroundID}', bgTexture={(background != null ? "loaded" : "NULL")}",background==null?LogLevel.Error:LogLevel.Debug);var data=BattleData.InitBattle(background,sceneType,enemyList);data.DepthMap=UiLightController.Instance?.CurrentDepthMap;data.AlbedoMap=UiLightController.Instance?.CurrentAlbedoMap;GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"BattleService.Init: depthMap from LightsCtrl = {(data.DepthMap != null ? "captured" : "NULL")}, albedoMap = {(data.AlbedoMap != null ? "captured" : "NULL")}",data.DepthMap==null&&data.AlbedoMap==null?LogLevel.Error:LogLevel.Debug);try{data.ActiveBattleCore=BattleCoreRegistry.Instance.GetActive()?.Id;}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"BattleService.Init: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}",LogLevel.Error);}if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(questId)){try{var quest=QuestFactory.Instance.Get(questId);data.Quest=quest;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(newTag)){data.NewTag=newTag;quest.SendNotification();}}catch(KeyNotFoundException){GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"BattleService.Init: quest '{questId}' not found, battle will proceed without quest",LogLevel.Error);}}BattleRequest.Current=data;}}}

The context is marshalled into a plain Godot dictionary (<c>exp_gained</c>, <c>defeated_enemies</c>, <c>generated_loot</c>, <c>return_scene</c>) before each call and synced back afterward, so GDScript mutations to exp and loot propagate to the C# victory pipeline. Dictionaries replace the old GDWingroundContext RefCounted DTO because mod classes compiled at runtime are not visible to GDScript. </summary>
public class GDWingroundListener:IWingroundListener{private readonly GodotObject _instance;public string Id{get;}/// <summary> Creates a bridge around a live GDScript object. The caller must ensure the object outlives the registry. </summary>
public GDWingroundListener(string id,GodotObject instance){Id=id;_instance=instance;}public void OnBeforeExpAward(WingroundContext ctx){if(!_instance.HasMethod("on_winground_before_exp"))return;var gdCtx=BattleGDScriptBridge.WingroundToDictionary(ctx);_instance.Call("on_winground_before_exp",gdCtx);BattleGDScriptBridge.SyncWingroundBack(gdCtx,ctx);}public void OnAfterLootGenerated(WingroundContext ctx){if(!_instance.HasMethod("on_winground_after_loot"))return;var gdCtx=BattleGDScriptBridge.WingroundToDictionary(ctx);_instance.Call("on_winground_after_loot",gdCtx);BattleGDScriptBridge.SyncWingroundBack(gdCtx,ctx);}public void OnBeforeShow(WingroundContext ctx){if(!_instance.HasMethod("on_winground_before_show"))return;var gdCtx=BattleGDScriptBridge.WingroundToDictionary(ctx);_instance.Call("on_winground_before_show",gdCtx);BattleGDScriptBridge.SyncWingroundBack(gdCtx,ctx);}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Battle{/// <summary> Optional automation contract for battle cores. The base <see cref="IBattleCore"/> contract describes how a battle starts but not how it advances: every core owns its own UI and waits for player input in its own way. Integration tests and AI tooling therefore ask the core itself when it waits for the player and how to advance the turn, instead of hunting for core-specific buttons by node path. Cores that don't implement this interface are still runnable but are reported as not universally testable by the battle coverage tool. </summary>
public interface IBattleAutoPlayable{/// <summary> <c>true</c> while the core accepts a player turn advance. Must become <c>false</c> immediately when the turn ends, so a polling driver cannot trigger two turns in a row. </summary>
bool IsWaitingForPlayerInput{get;}/// <summary> Ends the current player turn through the same path the core's UI uses (skipping the player's actions is a valid strategy for smoke tests). Must be a no-op when <see cref="IsWaitingForPlayerInput"/> is <c>false</c>. </summary>
void AdvancePlayerTurn();}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Battle{/// <summary> Extension point for mods to inspect and mutate victory-screen data. Implementations are auto-discovered via <see cref="WingroundListenerRegistry.RegisterAssembly"/> (C#) or detected by method signature in <see cref="Mods.ModGDScriptLoader"/> (GDScript). The three hooks fire in order during <see cref="WingroundBehaviour.Show"/>: <list type="number"> <item><see cref="OnBeforeExpAward"/> — EXP data is available but has not yet been applied to characters.</item> <item><see cref="OnAfterLootGenerated"/> — loot has been rolled from enemies but has not yet been added to inventory.</item> <item><see cref="OnBeforeShow"/> — all processing is done; final chance to mutate data before the UI appears.</item> </list> The same <see cref="WingroundContext"/> instance is passed to all listeners across all three phases, so mutations from earlier hooks are visible to later hooks and to subsequent listeners. </summary>

void OnBeforeExpAward(WingroundContext ctx);/// <summary> Called after loot has been generated from <see cref="WingroundContext.DefeatedEnemies"/> but before the items are added to the player's inventory. <see cref="WingroundContext.GeneratedLoot"/> is populated and mutable — adding, removing, or modifying entries here directly affects the inventory outcome. </summary>
void OnAfterLootGenerated(WingroundContext ctx);/// <summary> Called after EXP, loot, inventory, and recruitment have all been processed, immediately before the victory UI is shown (<c>base.Show()</c>). using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.TurnBattle{/// <summary> Floating damage-number overlay. Self-contained: creates its own Label in _Ready, floats upward with random horizontal drift, fades alpha, then QueueFrees itself. Static factory methods (SpawnDamage, SpawnDefence) instantiate and parent it in one call — damage is red, heal is green, defence is blue. MouseFilter is Ignore so clicks pass through to cards underneath. </summary>
public partial class ShowDamageBehaviour:Control{private Label _label;private float duration=1.0f;private float floatDistance=80f;private float driftRange=30f;private Vector2 startPosition;/// <summary> Builds the label on first use. Godot does not dispatch <c>_Ready</c> overrides declared in mod assemblies (only methods generated in the core project run), so the label cannot be created in <c>_Ready</c> — it is created here, right before the first animation starts. </summary>
private void EnsureLabel(){if(_label!=null)return;MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Ignore;_label=new Label();_label.SetAnchorsPreset(LayoutPreset.Center);_label.HorizontalAlignment=HorizontalAlignment.Center;_label.VerticalAlignment=VerticalAlignment.Center;_label.AddThemeFontSizeOverride("font_size",28);_label.AddThemeColorOverride("font_outline_color",UiTokens.Alpha(Colors.Black,1f));_label.AddThemeConstantOverride("outline_size",6);AddChild(_label);}/// <summary> Creates and parents a floating damage (or heal) number. Damage is red, heal is green. The label floats upward with a random horizontal drift and auto-destructs after the tween completes. Skips values &lt;= 0. </summary>
public static void SpawnDamage(int amount,Node parent,Vector2 position,bool isHeal=false){if(amount<=0)return;var color=isHeal?UiTokens.SuccessText:UiTokens.DangerText;var hint=new ShowDamageBehaviour();parent.AddChild(hint);hint.Init(amount,position,color);}/// <summary> Creates and parents a floating defence number (blue). Same floating behaviour as <see cref="SpawnDamage"/>. Skips values &lt;= 0. </summary>
public static void SpawnDefence(int amount,Node parent,Vector2 position){if(amount<=0)return;var hint=new ShowDamageBehaviour();parent.AddChild(hint);hint.Init(amount,position,UiTokens.Info);}/// <summary> Sets the label text, colour, and world position, then starts the floating animation tween. Called by the static factory methods after instantiation. </summary>
public void Init(int amount,Vector2 worldPosition,Color?color=null){EnsureLabel();_label.Text=amount.ToString();if(color.HasValue)_label.Modulate=color.Value;GlobalPosition=worldPosition;startPosition=Position;RunAnimation();}private async void RunAnimation(){float driftX=(float)GD.RandRange(-driftRange,driftRange);Vector2 targetPos=startPosition+new Vector2(driftX,-floatDistance);var tween=CreateTween();tween.SetParallel(true);tween.SetEase(Tween.EaseType.Out).SetTrans(Tween.TransitionType.Cubic);tween.TweenProperty(this,"position",targetPos,duration);var fadeTween=CreateTween();fadeTween.TweenProperty(_label,"modulate:a",0f,duration*0.8f);await ToSignal(tween,"finished");QueueFree();}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Characters;namespace Cthangover.Core.Cards.StatusEffect{/// <summary> Behaviour hooks for a status effect type. Each hook receives the owning character so a single IStatusActions instance can be shared across multiple characters. OnDealDamage / OnTakeDamage use ref int to let effects amplify or reduce damage before it is applied. ModifyAttributes is a passive stat modifier called independently of turn phases. OnFinalAction fires once when the effect expires. All hooks have empty default semantics — effects override only the hooks they care about. </summary>
public interface IStatusActions{/// <summary>Factory key matching the <c>Actions</c> field in <see cref="StatusEffectInfo"/>, e.g. <c>"basic/stun"</c>.</summary>
string ID{get;}/// <summary>Fires when the owning character's turn begins. Use for start-of-turn damage-over-time or regeneration effects.</summary>
void OnTurnStart(Character target);/// <summary>Fires when the owning character's turn ends. Mirrors <see cref="OnTurnStart"/> for symmetry; useful for effects that activate after the character acts.</summary>
void OnTurnEnd(Character target);/// <summary>Called before the owning character deals damage to <paramref name="target"/>. Modify <paramref name="damage"/> via <see langword="ref"/> to amplify or reduce outgoing damage — all active effects stack multiplicatively through the queue's iteration.</summary>
void OnDealDamage(Character source,Character target,ref int damage);/// <summary>Called before the owning character receives damage from <paramref name="source"/>. Modify <paramref name="damage"/> via <see langword="ref"/> to add damage reduction or vulnerability. Fires after <see cref="OnDealDamage"/> in the damage pipeline.</summary>
void OnTakeDamage(Character target,Character source,ref int damage);/// <summary>Fires immediately when the effect is first placed on a character. Use for one-shot stat boosts, visual feedback, or initialisation logic.</summary>
void OnApply(Character target);/// <summary>Fires when the effect is manually removed (e.g. via a cleanse card). Not called on natural expiration — use <see cref="OnFinalAction"/> for that path.</summary>
void OnRemove(Character target);/// <summary>Fires once when the effect expires naturally (timer reaches zero). Use for end-of-effect triggers like explosion damage or stat restoration. Not called on manual removal.</summary>
void OnFinalAction(Character target);/// <summary>Passive stat modifier invoked independently of turn phases. Receives a reference to the character's attribute container; implementors can add flat or percentage bonuses that other effects may also contribute to.</summary>
void ModifyAttributes(CharacterAttributes attributes);}}

using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Cards.StatusEffect{/// <summary> Status effect data contract. Separates identity (ID, Name, Icon) from mutable state (Duration, RemainingTurns) and behaviour (Actions — an IStatusActions hook set). Copy() is required so the StatusEffectQueue can clone effects when characters are duplicated. </summary>
public interface IStatusEffect{/// <summary>Unique mod identifier, e.g. <c>"basic/stun"</c>. Used by factories and the queue to look up and remove effects by key.</summary>
string ID{get;}/// <summary>Display name shown in the battle UI.</summary>
string Name{get;}/// <summary>Flavour text explaining the effect to the player.</summary>
string Description{get;}/// <summary>High-level category (<c>Buff</c>, <c>Debuff</c>, <c>Stun</c>) used for UI tinting and quick type checks like <see cref="StatusEffectQueue.HasStun"/>.</summary>
StatusEffectType EffectType{get;}/// <summary>Base duration in turns. Set during effect creation; may be overridden by the caller via <see cref="StatusEffectQueue.Add"/>. A value of 0 or negative means the effect never expires naturally.</summary>
int Duration{get;set;}/// <summary>Turns remaining before the effect expires. Decremented each turn boundary by the queue. Independent of <c>Duration</c> so that the original value is preserved for display or re-apply logic.</summary>
int RemainingTurns{get;set;}/// <summary>Icon texture loaded from the <c>"characters"</c> mod group, displayed beside the effect name in the HUD.</summary>
Texture2D Icon{get;}/// <summary>Behaviour hooks that fire during turn phases and on damage events. Resolved by <c>StatusEffectActionFactory</c> from the <see cref="StatusEffectInfo.Actions"/> string ID.</summary>
IStatusActions Actions{get;}/// <summary>Creates a shallow clone. <c>Actions</c> is a shared reference (stateless singleton) so it is not deep-copied. Used by <see cref="StatusEffectQueue.Copy"/> when duplicating a character.</summary>
IStatusEffect Copy();}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Cards.StatusEffect{/// <summary> Per-character status-effect pipeline. Manages a list of active effects, advancing their timers on turn boundaries and removing expired ones after firing OnFinalAction. Add resolves the effect info via the factory and calls OnApply immediately. OnTurnStart iterates backwards to safely remove expired effects during traversal. OnDealDamage / OnTakeDamage pipe through every active effect via ref parameters, enabling multiplicative stacking. ActiveStatusEffects returns a defensive copy so external code cannot mutate the internal list. Copy creates a deep clone for character duplication, re-firing OnApply on the new owner. </summary>
public class StatusEffectQueue{private readonly List<IStatusEffect>activeStatusEffectData;private readonly Character owner;/// <summary>Defensive copy of the internal effect list. Returns a new <c>List</c> each access so external code cannot mutate the queue's backing store. Safe for enumeration.</summary>
public List<IStatusEffect>ActiveStatusEffects=>activeStatusEffectData.ToList();/// <summary>Initialises an empty queue bound to <paramref name="owner"/>. The owner reference is used by all action-hook calls to pass the affected character.</summary> <param name="owner">The character who carries these effects.</param>
public StatusEffectQueue(Character owner){this.activeStatusEffectData=new List<IStatusEffect>();this.owner=owner;}/// <summary>Checks whether any active effect has <see cref="StatusEffectType.Stun"/>. Called by the battle engine to determine if the owner should skip their turn.</summary> <returns><see langword="true"/> if at least one Stun-type effect is active.</returns>
public bool HasStun(){foreach(var statusEffect in activeStatusEffectData)if(statusEffect.EffectType==StatusEffectType.Stun)return true;return false;}/// <summary>Looks up <paramref name="statusEffectId"/> in the factory, constructs a <see cref="StatusEffectItem"/>, optionally overrides its duration, fires <c>OnApply</c>, and appends it to the active list.</summary> <param name="statusEffectId">Factory key matching a <see cref="StatusEffectInfo"/> entry.</param> <param name="duration">If positive, overwrites the default duration from the effect definition.</param> <returns><see langword="false"/> if the factory lookup fails (key not found); otherwise <see langword="true"/>.</returns>
public bool Add(string statusEffectId,int duration= -1){var statusEffectInfo=Factories.Impls.StatusEffectInfoFactory.Instance.Get(statusEffectId);if(statusEffectInfo==null){GameLogger.Log("STATUS",$"statusEffect with ID '{statusEffectId}' not found!",LogLevel.Error);return false;}var statusEffect=new StatusEffectItem(statusEffectInfo);if(duration>0){statusEffect.Duration=duration;statusEffect.RemainingTurns=duration;}statusEffect.Actions?.OnApply(owner);activeStatusEffectData.Add(statusEffect);return true;}/// <summary>Removes the first effect matching <paramref name="statusEffectId"/> from the active list. Fires <c>OnRemove</c> so the effect can clean up before disappearing (e.g. revert stat modifications).</summary> <param name="statusEffectId">Factory key of the effect to remove.</param> <returns><see langword="false"/> if no matching effect was found; otherwise <see langword="true"/>.</returns>
public bool Remove(string statusEffectId){var statusEffect=activeStatusEffectData.FirstOrDefault(b=>b.ID==statusEffectId);if(statusEffect==null)return false;statusEffect.Actions?.OnRemove(owner);activeStatusEffectData.Remove(statusEffect);return true;}/// <summary>Advances all active effects at the start of the owner's turn. Fires <c>OnTurnStart</c> on each effect, decrements <see cref="IStatusEffect.RemainingTurns"/> for timed effects, and removes expired ones after firing <c>OnFinalAction</c>. Iterates backwards so removals do not corrupt the index.</summary>
public void OnTurnStart(){for(int i=activeStatusEffectData.Count-1;i>=0;i--){var statusEffect=activeStatusEffectData[i];statusEffect.Actions?.OnTurnStart(owner);if(statusEffect.RemainingTurns>0&&statusEffect.Duration>0){statusEffect.RemainingTurns--;if(statusEffect.RemainingTurns<=0){statusEffect.Actions?.OnFinalAction(owner);activeStatusEffectData.RemoveAt(i);}}}}/// <summary>Fires end-of-turn hooks on all active effects. Operates on a defensive copy so that <c>OnTurnEnd</c> callbacks that add or remove effects do not invalidate the enumerator. Decrements remaining turns and removes expired effects via <see cref="Remove"/> (which also fires <c>OnRemove</c>).</summary>
public void OnTurnEnd(){foreach(var statusEffect in ActiveStatusEffects){statusEffect.Actions?.OnTurnEnd(owner);statusEffect.RemainingTurns--;if(statusEffect.RemainingTurns<=0){statusEffect.Actions?.OnFinalAction(owner);Remove(statusEffect.ID);}}}/// <summary>Pipes outgoing damage through every active effect's <c>OnDealDamage</c> hook, allowing each to modify <paramref name="damage"/> via <see langword="ref"/>. Effects iterate in insertion order; multiplicative stacking means order-agnostic results for flat modifiers but order-sensitive for percentage modifiers.</summary> <param name="target">The character receiving the damage.</param> <param name="damage">The damage value, modifiable by effects through the <see langword="ref"/> parameter.</param>
public void OnDealDamage(Character target,ref int damage){foreach(var statusEffect in activeStatusEffectData){statusEffect.Actions?.OnDealDamage(owner,target,ref damage);}}/// <summary>Pipes incoming damage through every active effect's <c>OnTakeDamage</c> hook. Called after <see cref="OnDealDamage"/> in the damage pipeline, so defensive modifiers stack on top of the attacker's amplified value.</summary> <param name="source">The character dealing the damage.</param> <param name="damage">The damage value, modifiable by effects through the <see langword="ref"/> parameter.</param>
public void OnTakeDamage(Character source,ref int damage){foreach(var statusEffect in activeStatusEffectData){statusEffect.Actions?.OnTakeDamage(owner,source,ref damage);}}/// <summary>Removes all active effects, firing <c>OnRemove</c> on each before clearing the list. Used when a character dies or an encounter ends so effects do not leak between battles.</summary>
public void ClearAll(){foreach(var statusEffect in activeStatusEffectData){statusEffect.Actions?.OnRemove(owner);}activeStatusEffectData.Clear();}/// <summary>Deep-clones the entire queue for a new character owner. Each effect is copied via <see cref="IStatusEffect.Copy"/>, and <c>OnApply</c> is re-fired on <paramref name="newOwner"/> so initialisation hooks run in the target's context. Used when a character is duplicated mid-encounter (e.g. a summon or mirror effect).</summary> <param name="newOwner">The character who will own the clone.</param> <returns>A new <see cref="StatusEffectQueue"/> bound to <paramref name="newOwner"/> with copies of all active effects.</returns>
public StatusEffectQueue Copy(Character newOwner){var newSystem=new StatusEffectQueue(newOwner);foreach(var statusEffect in activeStatusEffectData){var copiedstatusEffect=statusEffect.Copy();copiedstatusEffect.Actions?.OnApply(newOwner);newSystem.activeStatusEffectData.Add(copiedstatusEffect);}return newSystem;}}}

using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;namespace Cthangover.Core.Cards.StatusEffect{/// <summary> Side-table that owns the <see cref="StatusEffectQueue"/> of every character participating in battle. The queue used to live on <see cref="Character"/> itself, but the core character model must stay free of battle subsystems — so the battle mod keeps queues keyed by character instance instead. <para/> Uses <see cref="ConditionalWeakTable{TKey, TValue}"/>: queues die together with their character, which matters because each battle constructs fresh copies via <see cref="Character.Copy"/> and discards them afterwards. All access happens on the main thread during battle, so no extra locking is needed beyond what the weak table provides. </summary>
public static class StatusEffectService{private static readonly ConditionalWeakTable<Character,StatusEffectQueue>queues=new();/// <summary> Returns the queue of <paramref name="character"/>, creating an empty one on first access. Returns <c>null</c> for a null character so call sites can keep their existing null-conditional patterns. </summary>
public static StatusEffectQueue Of(Character character){if(character==null)return null;return queues.GetValue(character,CreateQueue);}private static StatusEffectQueue CreateQueue(Character owner){return new StatusEffectQueue(owner);}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Cards.StatusEffect{/// <summary> High-level classification for status effects. Buff/Debuff are informational (UI colouring, stacking rules); Stun is singled out because the queue has a dedicated HasStun() check that the battle engine queries to skip a stunned character's turn. </summary>
public enum StatusEffectType{/// <summary>Positive effect that benefits the bearer (e.g. stat boost, regeneration). Rendered with a friendly tint in the UI.</summary>
Buff,/// <summary>Negative effect that harms the bearer (e.g. damage over time, stat reduction). Rendered with a hostile tint in the UI.</summary>

private static readonly Lazy<StatusEffectActionFactory>instance=new(()=>new StatusEffectActionFactory());public static StatusEffectActionFactory Instance=>instance.Value;public StatusEffectActionFactory(){actions=new Dictionary<string,IStatusActions>();foreach(var action in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IStatusActions>()){actions.Add(action.ID,action);}}
#endregion

using Cthangover.Core.Battle;using Cthangover.Core.Battle.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.TurnBattle{/// <summary> GDScript hook of the turn-battle mod. The core's ModGDScriptLoader walks every <c>.gd</c> file generically and hands objects to registered hooks; this hook recognizes the two battle-side contracts: <list type="bullet"> <item><c>get_action_id()</c> + <c>execute(action, user, target)</c> — wraps the script in a <see cref="GDBattleActionExecutor"/> and registers it in the global <see cref="ActionExecutorHub"/> pool.</item> <item><c>get_winground_listener_id()</c> plus any of the three <c>on_winground_*</c> methods — wraps the script in a <see cref="GDWingroundListener"/>.</item> </list> Keeping the recognition here means the core loader no longer mentions any battle method name. </summary>
public class TurnBattleGDScriptHook:IGDScriptHook{/// <summary>Stable id used by <see cref="GDScriptHookRegistry"/> for replacement on reload.</summary>
public string Id=>"turn_battle_base.gd_hook";/// <summary>Inspects one compiled script and registers an adapter when a contract matches.</summary>
public void TryRegister(GodotObject obj,string modId,string filePath){if(obj==null)return;if(obj.HasMethod("get_action_id")&&obj.HasMethod("execute")){var actionId=obj.Call("get_action_id").AsString();if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(actionId)){ActionExecutorHub.Instance.RegisterGlobal(new GDBattleActionExecutor(actionId,obj));GameLogger.Log("GDS_MOD",$"Registered GDScript battle executor '{actionId}' from mod '{modId}' ({filePath})");}}var hasWingroundHook=obj.HasMethod("on_winground_before_exp")||obj.HasMethod("on_winground_after_loot")||obj.HasMethod("on_winground_before_show");if(hasWingroundHook&&obj.HasMethod("get_winground_listener_id")){var listenerId=obj.Call("get_winground_listener_id").AsString();if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(listenerId)){WingroundListenerRegistry.Instance.RegisterListener(new GDWingroundListener(listenerId,obj));GameLogger.Log("GDS_MOD",$"Registered GDScript winground listener '{listenerId}' from mod '{modId}' ({filePath})");}}}}}

using System;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Audio;using Cthangover.Core.Battle;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.TurnBattle{/// <summary> Lifecycle entry point of the turn-battle mod. Three responsibilities: <list type="number"> <item>Publishes the logical "Battle" scene route with fade transition and combat music, so the core can route <c>switch_scene Battle</c> without hardcoding a battle path.</item> <item>Registers <see cref="TurnBattleGDScriptHook"/> so GDScript mods can still supply action executors and winground listeners after the battle bridge moved out of the core loader.</item> <item>Discovers <see cref="IBattleCore"/> and <see cref="IWingroundListener"/> implementations across mod assemblies — this replaces the core-side registry fan-out in ModAssemblyLoader. Every mod announcement triggers a scan of that mod's assembly, and the resources-ready pass re-scans the whole AppDomain as a safety net for assemblies whose name differs from the mod id (precompiled DLLs).</item> </list> </summary>
public class TurnBattleSceneInitializer:IModInitializer{private const string BattleScenePath="scenes/battle/battle.tscn";/// <summary> Registers battle cores and winground listeners from the mod that just announced itself, and installs the GDScript hook. Assemblies are looked up by mod id (the compiler names every source-compiled assembly after its mod), so no event plumbing is needed — the initializer simply rescans as the mod set grows. The hook must be installed here, not at resources-ready: ModGDScriptLoader processes <c>.gd</c> sources during assembly registration finalization, before resources become ready. </summary>
public void OnModLoaded(string modId){GDScriptHookRegistry.Register(new TurnBattleGDScriptHook());RegisterAssembly(FindAssembly(modId));}/// <summary> Publishes the scene route and rescans all loaded assemblies for battle cores and winground listeners. </summary>
public void OnModResourcesReady(){SceneRouteRegistry.Register("Battle",BattleScenePath,fade:true,musicScene:"Battle",music:MusicType.Combat);BattleCoreRegistry.Instance.RegisterAll();WingroundListenerRegistry.Instance.RegisterAll();}private static void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly){if(assembly==null)return;BattleCoreRegistry.Instance.RegisterAssembly(assembly);WingroundListenerRegistry.Instance.RegisterAssembly(assembly);}private static Assembly FindAssembly(string modId){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId))return null;return AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies().FirstOrDefault(assembly=>assembly.GetName().Name==modId);}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Core.Battle{/// <summary> Mutable context passed to <see cref="IWingroundListener"/> hooks during the victory-screen pipeline. Listeners receive the same instance across all three phases (before EXP, after loot, before show) and can mutate any field — including removing enemies, adjusting earned EXP per character, or modifying the generated loot list. The <see cref="WingroundBehaviour"/> reads these fields after each hook, so changes take effect immediately. </summary>
public class WingroundContext{/// <summary> Per-character EXP earned during this battle, keyed by <see cref="Character.ID"/>. Populated from <see cref="BattleSceneContext.PlayerExpGained"/> before the first hook and consumed by <see cref="WingroundBehaviour"/> to award EXP to <see cref="CharacterData"/>. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,int>PlayerExpGained{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> Enemies defeated during this battle. Used by the victory screen for loot generation and recruitment rolls. Null entries are skipped by <see cref="WingroundBehaviour"/>. </summary>
public List<Character>DefeatedEnemies{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> Loot items generated from <see cref="DefeatedEnemies"/>. Filled by <see cref="WingroundBehaviour"/> between the "before EXP" and "after loot" hooks. Listeners can add, remove, or modify entries before the items are committed to inventory. </summary>
public List<ItemContainer>GeneratedLoot{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> The <see cref="BattleData"/> that started this battle. Read-only reference — do not mutate the object itself (it is shared with the quest system) but its fields such as <c>ReturnScene</c> are writable. </summary>
public BattleData BattleData{get;set;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Battle{/// <summary> Singleton registry that collects <see cref="IWingroundListener"/> implementations (C# via reflection, GDScript via <see cref="RegisterListener"/>) and broadcasts winground lifecycle hooks to all of them in registration order. Reflects the same pattern as the recruiting mod's <c>RecruitBehaviourRegistry</c>: a static Instance, reflection-based <c>RegisterAssembly</c>, and manual <c>RegisterListener</c> for GDScript bridges. </summary>
public class WingroundListenerRegistry{public static readonly WingroundListenerRegistry Instance=new();private readonly List<IWingroundListener>_listeners=new();/// <summary> Scans <paramref name="assembly"/> for concrete types that implement <see cref="IWingroundListener"/> and instantiates them via their parameterless constructor. Called by the battle mod's initializer as mods announce themselves. </summary>
public void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly){foreach(var instance in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IWingroundListener>(assembly)){try{RegisterListener(instance);GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"WingroundListenerRegistry: registered C# listener '{instance.Id}' from assembly '{assembly.GetName().Name}'");}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"WingroundListenerRegistry: failed to create listener '{instance.GetType().FullName}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}/// <summary> Scans every assembly loaded in the current <see cref="System.AppDomain"/> and registers all <see cref="IWingroundListener"/> implementations. Called by the battle mod's initializer so the core does not need to reference battle types during its assembly fan-out. </summary>
public void RegisterAll(){foreach(var instance in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IWingroundListener>())RegisterListener(instance);GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"WingroundListenerRegistry.RegisterAll: {_listeners.Count} listener(s) registered");}/// <summary> Registers a listener, replacing any earlier one with the same <see cref="IWingroundListener.Id"/>. Deduplication matters because the registry is rescanned from the whole AppDomain on mod reload (used by the GDScript bridge <see cref="GDWingroundListener"/> and by <see cref="RegisterAll"/>). Safe to call from any thread — the underlying list is not thread-safe but all registrations happen during mod initialisation before battle scenes are loaded. </summary>
public void RegisterListener(IWingroundListener listener){if(listener==null)return;_listeners.RemoveAll(existing=>existing.Id==listener.Id);_listeners.Add(listener);GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"WingroundListenerRegistry: registered listener '{listener.Id}'");}/// <summary> Broadcasts <see cref="IWingroundListener.OnBeforeExpAward"/> to every registered listener. Exceptions from individual listeners are logged and swallowed so one broken mod cannot break the victory screen for others. </summary>
public void NotifyBeforeExpAward(WingroundContext ctx){foreach(var listener in _listeners){try{listener.OnBeforeExpAward(ctx);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"WingroundListenerRegistry: {listener.Id}.OnBeforeExpAward threw: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}/// <summary> Broadcasts <see cref="IWingroundListener.OnAfterLootGenerated"/> to every registered listener. </summary>
public void NotifyAfterLootGenerated(WingroundContext ctx){foreach(var listener in _listeners){try{listener.OnAfterLootGenerated(ctx);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"WingroundListenerRegistry: {listener.Id}.OnAfterLootGenerated threw: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}/// <summary> Broadcasts <see cref="IWingroundListener.OnBeforeShow"/> to every registered listener. </summary>
public void NotifyBeforeShow(WingroundContext ctx){foreach(var listener in _listeners){try{listener.OnBeforeShow(ctx);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"WingroundListenerRegistry: {listener.Id}.OnBeforeShow threw: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Phase: Contracts. Parses every mod's declared C# sources with Roslyn and extracts typed property accesses (<c>GetInt("Turn")</c>, <c>SetFloat("Attack", ...)</c>) from <c>DataBlob</c>, <c>PropertyData</c> and <c>ActionCharacter</c>, which share the same method names. The analysis is syntactic on purpose: it needs no metadata references, so it runs on the background thread and never triggers assembly loading. Findings: non-literal keys (<c>DYNAMIC_KEY</c>, info), the same key used with different value types (<c>TYPE_CONFLICT</c>, error), reads of keys that are neither declared in JSON nor written anywhere (<c>READ_UNDECLARED</c> / <c>READ_UNDECLARED_WITH_DEFAULT</c>), and writes that no code ever reads (<c>WRITE_UNUSED</c>, info). </summary>
public class CSharpPropertyStrategy:IValidationStrategy{private static readonly Dictionary<string,string>TypeByMethod=new(StringComparer.Ordinal){{"GetInt","int"},{"SetInt","int"},{"GetFloat","float"},{"SetFloat","float"},{"GetString","string"},{"SetString","string"},{"GetStr","string"},{"SetStr","string"},{"GetBool","bool"},{"SetBool","bool"},{"GetLong","long"},{"SetLong","long"},};public string Id=>"csharp_properties";public ValidationPhase Phase=>ValidationPhase.Contracts;public int Order=>200;public ValidationFeature Feature=>ValidationFeature.CSharp;public void Validate(ValidationContext context){var usages=new List<CodePropertyUsage>();var literalCounts=new Dictionary<string,int>(StringComparer.Ordinal);foreach(var mod in context.Mods){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();foreach(var file in CollectSources(mod)){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();ParseSource(mod.Id,file.Path,file.Source,usages,literalCounts);}}ReportDynamicKeys(context,usages);ReportTypeConflicts(context,usages);ReportUndeclaredReads(context,usages);ReportUnusedWrites(context,usages,literalCounts);}private static List<(string Path,string Source)>CollectSources(IModInfo mod){var result=new List<(string Path,string Source)>();var provider=mod.FileProvider;if(provider==null)return result;var patterns=(mod as ModInfo)?.Manifest?.Sources;if(patterns!=null&&patterns.Count>0){foreach(var pattern in patterns){var prefix=pattern;var suffix="*.cs";var separator=pattern.LastIndexOf('/');if(separator>=0){prefix=pattern.Substring(0,separator);suffix=pattern.Substring(separator+1);}foreach(var file in ModFileReader.ListFiles(provider,prefix,true)){if(!MatchesSource(file,suffix))continue;var source=provider.ReadFileText(file);if(source!=null)result.Add((file,source));}}}if(result.Count==0){foreach(var file in ModFileReader.ListFiles(provider,string.Empty,true)){if(!file.EndsWith(".cs",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var source=provider.ReadFileText(file);if(source!=null)result.Add((file,source));}}return result;}private static bool MatchesSource(string file,string suffix){if(!file.EndsWith(".cs",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return false;if(suffix=="*"||suffix=="*.cs")return true;if(suffix.StartsWith("*.",StringComparison.Ordinal))return usages){if(!usage.IsWrite||usage.Key==null)continue;if(readKeys.Contains(usage.Key))continue;if(!reported.Add(usage.ModId+"|"+usage.Key))continue;// A key that appears as a string literal more often namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> A single typed property access extracted from a mod's C# source: <c>action.GetInt("Turn", 3)</c> becomes (key=Turn, type=int, read, hasDefault=true). <c>DataBlob</c> and <c>PropertyData</c> share the same method names, so the collector intentionally does not distinguish receivers — only the key, type and direction matter for cross-mod conflict detection. </summary>
public class CodePropertyUsage{public string ModId{get;set;}public string File{get;set;}public int Line{get;set;}public string Key{get;set;}public string Type{get;set;}public bool IsWrite{get;set;}public bool HasDefault{get;set;}public string Method{get;set;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Phase: Reconciliation. Checks manifest <c>depends</c> entries: malformed strings, required dependencies missing from the loaded set, and circular dependency chains. The registry already filters mods with broken dependencies at load time and the compiler only logs a warning for cycles, so this strategy is what turns those silent conditions into reportable findings. </summary>
public class DependsStrategy:IValidationStrategy{public string Id=>"depends";public ValidationPhase Phase=>ValidationPhase.Reconciliation;public int Order=>100;public ValidationFeature Feature=>ValidationFeature.Json;public void Validate(ValidationContext context){var manifests=new Dictionary<string,ModManifest>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var mod in context.Mods){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();var manifest=(mod as ModInfo)?.Manifest;if(manifest!=null)manifests[mod.Id]=manifest;}foreach(var entry in manifests){var depends=entry.Value.Depends;if(depends==null)continue;foreach(var dependency in depends){if(!dependency.IsValid){context.AddError("SCHEMA_WRONG_TYPE",$"invalid dependency string: {dependency.Error}",entry.Key,"manifest.json",0,"use format modId[op][version][?]");continue;}if(dependency.IsOptional||manifests.ContainsKey(dependency.ModId))continue;context.AddError("REF_NOT_FOUND",$"required dependency '{dependency.ModId}' is not loaded",entry.Key,"manifest.json",0,$"install mod '{dependency.ModId}' or mark the dependency optional with '?'");}}DetectCycles(context,manifests);}private static void DetectCycles(ValidationContext context,Dictionary<string,ModManifest>manifests){var state=new Dictionary<string,int>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);var path=new List<string>();var reported=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var modId in manifests.Keys)Visit(context,manifests,modId,state,path,reported);}private static void Visit(ValidationContext context,Dictionary<string,ModManifest>manifests,string modId,Dictionary<string,int>state,List<string>path,HashSet<string>reported){if(state.TryGetValue(modId,out var existing)){if(existing==1)ReportCycle(context,modId,path,reported);return;}state[modId]=1;path.Add(modId);var depends=manifests[modId].Depends;if(depends!=null){foreach(var dependency in depends){if(!dependency.IsValid|| !manifests.ContainsKey(dependency.ModId))continue;Visit(context,manifests,dependency.ModId,state,path,reported);}}path.RemoveAt(path.Count-1);state[modId]=2;}private static void ReportCycle(ValidationContext context,string repeated,List<string>path,HashSet<string>reported){var start= -1;for(var i=0;i<path.Count;i++){if(string.Equals(path[i],repeated,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){start=i;break;}}if(start<0)return;var cycle=new List<string>();for(var i=start;i<path.Count;i++)cycle.Add(path[i]);cycle.Add(repeated);var key=BuildCycleKey(cycle);if(!reported.Add(key))return;context.AddError("REF_CIRCULAR",$"circular dependency: {string.Join(" -> ", cycle)}",repeated,"manifest.json",0,"break the cycle by removing one of the dependencies");}private static string BuildCycleKey(List<string>cycle){var sorted=new List<string>(cycle);sorted.Sort(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);return string.Join("|",sorted);}}}

namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> One self-contained validation step, discovered by reflection like every other plugin point in the project (<c>Reflections.FindAndCreate</c>). Strategies run sequentially in (Phase, Order, Id) order on the validator background thread: Schema strategies validate source shapes, Contracts strategies fill <see cref="ValidationContext.Graph"/> with declarations, references and code usages, and Reconciliation strategies compare those facts and emit findings. To add scenario validation, implement this interface in a new class: extract declarations and references into the graph in the Contracts phase and match them in Reconciliation — no service changes are needed. </summary>
public interface IValidationStrategy{/// <summary>Stable identifier used in logs and in the sort order.</summary>
string Id{get;}/// <summary>Execution stage; strategies of earlier phases run first.</summary>
ValidationPhase Phase{get;}/// <summary>Order inside the phase; lower runs first.</summary>
int Order{get;}/// <summary>Capability group gated by the user settings.</summary>
ValidationFeature Feature{get;}/// <summary> Runs the strategy. Data problems must be reported through the <see cref="ValidationContext"/> and must not throw; unexpected exceptions are caught and logged by <see cref="ValidatorService"/>. </summary>
void Validate(ValidationContext context);}}

entry in manifest.MainMenu){if(entry==null||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entry.ScenePath))continue;if(!provider.FileExists(entry.ScenePath))context.AddError("REF_NOT_FOUND",$"main_menu scene_path CollectActionReferences(ValidationContext context,IModInfo mod,JsonElement entity){var actions=JsonReadHelper.GetProperty(entity,"Actions");if(!JsonReadHelper.IsArray(actions))return;foreach(var using System;using System.Text.Json;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Case-insensitive reads over <see cref="JsonElement"/> used by the JSON contract strategy. Mod JSON deliberately mixes naming styles (<c>"Id"</c>, <c>"id"</c>, <c>"defaultBackground"</c>) and the runtime reads it with case-insensitive options, so the validator must not depend on exact casing either. </summary>
public static class JsonReadHelper{/// <summary> Returns the first matching property by exact name, then by case-insensitive comparison. Null when the element is not an object or no name matches. </summary>
public static JsonElement?GetProperty(JsonElement element,params string[]names){if(element.ValueKind!=JsonValueKind.Object)return null;foreach(var name in names){if(element.TryGetProperty(name,out var exact))return exact;}foreach(var property in element.EnumerateObject()){foreach(var name in names){if(string.Equals(property.Name,name,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return property.Value;}}return null;}/// <summary>Returns the string value of the first matching property, or null.</summary>
public static string GetString(JsonElement element,params string[]names){var value=GetProperty(element,names);if(value==null||value.Value.ValueKind!=JsonValueKind.String)return null;return value.Value.GetString();}/// <summary>True when the element exists and is an array.</summary>
public static bool IsArray(JsonElement?element)=>element!=null&&element.Value.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.Array;}}

using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Phase: Schema. Validates the mandatory shape of every mod's <c>manifest.json</c>: <c>id</c> and <c>version</c> must be present and be strings, and <c>id</c> must not be empty. The runtime silently falls back to the filesystem entry name for a missing id and tolerates a missing version, so these are exactly the problems an author should fix before publishing. </summary>
public class ManifestSchemaStrategy:IValidationStrategy{public string Id=>"manifest_schema";public ValidationPhase Phase=>ValidationPhase.Schema;public int Order=>100;public ValidationFeature Feature=>ValidationFeature.Json;public void Validate(ValidationContext context){foreach(var mod in context.Mods){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();var text=mod.FileProvider?.ReadFileText("manifest.json");if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text)){context.AddError("SCHEMA_MISSING_FIELD","manifest.json is missing or empty",mod.Id,"manifest.json");continue;}JsonDocument document;try{document=JsonDocument.Parse(text,JsonOptionsProvider.DocumentOptions);}catch(JsonException ex){context.AddError("JSON_PARSE_ERROR",$"manifest.json is not valid JSON: {ex.Message}",mod.Id,"manifest.json");continue;}using(document){ValidateStringField(context,mod.Id,document.RootElement,"id",required:true);ValidateStringField(context,mod.Id,document.RootElement,"version",required:true);ValidateStringField(context,mod.Id,document.RootElement,"name",required:false);}}}private static void ValidateStringField(ValidationContext context,string modId,JsonElement root,string field,bool required){var value=JsonReadHelper.GetProperty(root,field);if(value==null){if(required)context.AddError("SCHEMA_MISSING_FIELD",$"manifest.json has no '{field}'",modId,"manifest.json");return;}if(value.Value.ValueKind!=JsonValueKind.String){context.AddError("SCHEMA_WRONG_TYPE",$"'{field}' must be a string",modId,"manifest.json");return;}if(required&&string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value.Value.GetString()))context.AddError("SCHEMA_MISSING_FIELD",$"'{field}' must not be empty",modId,"manifest.json");}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Pure .NET file access used by validation strategies. Works with both folder and zip providers through <see cref="IModFileProvider"/> and resolves the project's <c>${include}</c> directives with the same public helper the runtime resolvers use, so the validator sees exactly the JSON the game will see. Safe on the background validation thread because it touches neither Godot nor the resolver caches. </summary>
public static class ModFileReader{/// <summary> Lists files under a mod-relative directory. Directories are pushed onto the work stack only when <paramref name="recursive"/> is set, so the caller can mirror the shallow group reads of <c>JsonGroupResolver</c> or the recursive scene scan. </summary>
public static List<string>ListFiles(IModFileProvider provider,string directory,bool recursive){var result=new List<string>();if(provider==null)return result;var pending=new Stack<string>();pending.Push(directory??string.Empty);while(pending.Count>0){var current=pending.Pop();foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles(current)){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){if(recursive)pending.Push(entry.TrimEnd('/'));continue;}result.Add(entry);}}return result;}/// <summary> Reads a mod file and expands every <c>${path}</c> include. Returns null when the file is absent; include failures propagate as <see cref="InvalidOperationException"/> so the caller can report them with the owning file name. </summary>
public static string ReadResolved(IModFileProvider provider,string path){var content=provider.ReadFileText(path);if(content==null)return null;var visited=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase){path};return ModResolutionContext.ExpandModIncludes(provider,content,path,visited);}/// <summary>True when the file path ends with one of the given extensions.</summary>
public static bool HasExtension(string path,HashSet<string>extensions){var dot=path.LastIndexOf('.');return dot>0&&extensions.Contains(path.Substring(dot));}}}

namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Phase: Reconciliation. Matches every reference collected by contract strategies against the declarations in the graph and reports <c>REF_NOT_FOUND</c> for the missing ones. Because the graph is global, a reference in one mod may resolve to a declaration in another — exactly how the runtime factories and scene loader resolve content. </summary>
public class ReferenceStrategy:IValidationStrategy{public string Id=>"references";public ValidationPhase Phase=>ValidationPhase.Reconciliation;public int Order=>200;public ValidationFeature Feature=>ValidationFeature.Json;public void Validate(ValidationContext context){foreach(var reference in context.Graph.References){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(context.Graph.HasDeclaration(reference.Kind,reference.TargetId))continue;context.AddError("REF_NOT_FOUND",$"{reference.Kind} '{reference.TargetId}' is referenced but never declared",reference.ModId,reference.File,reference.Line,$"declare {reference.Kind} '{reference.TargetId}' or fix the reference");}}}}

public const string FileName="report.json";/// <summary> Writes the report and returns the absolute path, or null when the directory could not be resolved or the write failed. Never throws — a failed report must not interrupt the game. </summary>

The command vocabulary is not hardcoded: known command words come from <see cref="ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory"/> (mods add commands through <c>RegisterAssembly</c>), and each command's argument contract comes from <see cref="IScenarioCommandSpec"/> implemented by the strategy itself. Commands without a spec are still recognised, just not argument-checked. Checks performed: <list type="bullet"> <item>unknown command words (<c>SCENARIO_UNKNOWN_COMMAND</c>);</item> <item>missing / extra / unknown / empty arguments based on the command spec;</item> <item>jump targets (<c>goto</c>, <c>option</c>) must point at an existing <c>:label</c>;</item> <item><c>select</c> without options and <c>option</c> outside a select block;</item> <item>references collected by <see cref="ICommandReferenceMetadata"/> are added to the shared graph (backgrounds, scenes, music, sounds, effects, avatars) and checked by <see cref="ReferenceStrategy"/>; scenario actions are checked against the action registry.</item> </list> </summary>

body=metadataResult.remainingText;var lines=body.Split('\n');var lineOffset=text.Split('\n').Length-lines.Length;var labels=CollectLabels(context,mod,file,lines,lineOffset);var pendingSelectLine= -1;var pendingSelectHasOptions=false;var lineNumber=lineOffset;foreach(var rawLine in lines){lineNumber++;var line=rawLine.Trim();if(line.Length==0||line.StartsWith('#')){FinalizeSelect(context,mod,file,ref pendingSelectLine,ref pendingSelectHasOptions);continue;}if(line.StartsWith(':')){FinalizeSelect(context,mod,file,ref pendingSelectLine,ref pendingSelectHasOptions);continue;}var pendingSelectHasOptions);pendingSelectLine=lineNumber;pendingSelectHasOptions=false;CheckEmptyNamed(context,mod,file,lineNumber,command,named);CheckAllowedNamed(context,mod,file,lineNumber,command,named,SelectAllowedNamed);CheckPositionalRange(context,mod,file,lineNumber,command,positional,0,1);AddAvatarReferences(context,mod,file,lineNumber,named);continue;}if(command=="option"){if(pendingSelectLine<0)context.AddWarning("SCENARIO_ORPHAN_OPTION","option referenceMetadata=strategy as lineNumber=lineOffset;foreach(var rawLine in lines){lineNumber++;var line=rawLine.Trim();if(line.Length==0||line.StartsWith('#'))continue;if(!line.StartsWith(':'))continue;var label=line.Substring(1).Trim();if(label.Length==0){context.AddError("SCENARIO_MISSING_ARGUMENT","label name is -1;pendingSelectHasOptions=false;}private static void CheckSpec(ValidationContext context,IModInfo mod,string file,int line,string command,List<string>positional,Dictionary<string,string>named,string arrowTarget,IScenarioCommandSpec spec,HashSet<string>labels){var argumentCount=positional.Count+named.Count;if(argumentCount==0&& got {argumentCount}",mod.Id,file,line);if(spec.MaxPositional>=0&&positional.Count>spec.MaxPositional)context.AddWarning("SCENARIO_UNEXPECTED_ARGUMENT",$"'{command}' accepts at most {spec.MaxPositional} positional argument(s), got {positional.Count}",mod.Id,file,line);CheckPositionalRange(context,mod,file,line,command,positional,spec.MinPositional,spec.MaxPositional);var required=spec.RequiredNamed;if(required!=null){foreach(var name in required){if(!named.TryGetValue(name.ToLowerInvariant(),out var value)||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))context.AddError("SCENARIO_MISSING_ARGUMENT",$"'{command}' requires named argument '{name}'",mod.Id,file,line);}}var allowed=spec.AllowedNamed;if(allowed!=null&&allowed.Count>0)CheckAllowedNamed(context,mod,file,line,command,named,allowed);var
